-- Primary native Luau payload extracted statically from loadstring4.txt.
-- Source SHA-256: 51bbe912b41da9c4915e57772ca10b1c60a18ff8ab6ab2ae9cd83134a0fabca0
-- VM table slot [9]; outer VM/authentication loader is not included.
-- Wrapper table helpers are replaced with their original implementations below.
-- Requires the original Roblox/executor APIs. Runtime behavior has not been tested.

local lphPackValues, lphUnpackRaw, lphMoveValues = table.pack, unpack, table.move

local lphAppendValues = function(target, offset, ...)
  local values = lphPackValues(...)
  lphMoveValues(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, target)
end

local lphAppendPacked = function(target, offset, values)
  for index = 1, values.n, 1 do
    target[offset + index] = values[index]
  end
  target.n = offset + values.n
end

local lphUnpackValues = function(values)
  return lphUnpackRaw(values, 1, values.n)
end

local modules = {cache = {}}
modules.load = function(G)
  if not (modules.cache[G]) then
    local i, u = modules.cache, {}
    u.c, i[G] = modules[G](), u
  end
  return modules.cache[G].c
end

    end

        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function ZO(YV)
    if LO.dead then
      return
    end
    local OV, QV = YV.UserInputType
    if OV == uO then
      QV = PO(YV)
      LO.tp = QV
    else
      if ((OV == yO) or (OV == fO)) or (OV == GO) then
        LO.tp = nil
        QV = (kO())
      else
      end
    end
    local fO = LO.listen
    if fO then
      local FV = N(YV)
      if FV then
        LO.listen = nil
        fO.lst = false
        if FV == "Escape" then
          fO:setkey(nil)
        elseif FV == "Backspace" then
          fO:setkey(nil)
        elseif (DV[FV] and fO.o.nomouse) or ((FV == "MouseButton1") and mV(QV)) then
          fO:draw()
        else
          if DV[FV] then
            LO.eat = fO
            k(0.35, function()
              if LO.eat == fO then
                LO.eat = nil
              end
            end)
          end
          fO:setkey(FV)
        end
        return
      end
    end
    if QV then
      if OV ~= GO then
        if #LO.pops > 0 then
          ZV(QV)
        end
      end
    end
    if OV == uO then
      return
    end
    OV = N(YV)
    if OV then
      if Z:GetFocusedTextBox() then
        return
      elseif mV(QV) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if OV == "Escape" then
      if LO.open then
        if #LO.pops > 0 then
          AO(LO.pops[#LO.pops])
          return
        end
      end
    end
    YV = LO.bmap[OV]
    if YV then
      for fO = #YV, 1, -1 do
        OV = YV[fO]
        if OV then
          OV:bdown()
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function fO(GO)
    if LO.dead then
      return
    end
    local ZV, mV, YV = GO.UserInputType, LO.drag, LO.tg
    if YV and (((ZV == uO) and (YV.i == GO)) or ((ZV == yO) and YV.m)) then
      LO.tg = nil
      YV.tap((YV.m and kO()) or PO(GO))
    end
    if mV.mv then
      if (ZV == yO) and not mV.ti then
        fV(true)
      elseif ZV == uO then
        if mV.ti == GO then
          fV(true)
        end
      end
    end
    YV = N(GO)
    if not YV then
      return
    end
    GO = LO.bmap[YV]
    if GO then
      for N = #GO, 1, -1 do
        YV = GO[N]
        if YV then
          YV:bup()
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function N(GO, ZV)
    local mV, YV = I(ZV.X - GO.p0.X), I(ZV.Y - GO.p0.Y)
    if mV > 6 then
      if mV >= YV then
        LO.tg = nil
        GO.drag(ZV)
      elseif YV > 6 then
        LO.tg = nil
      end
    elseif YV > 6 then
      LO.tg = nil
    end
  end
  local function GO(ZV)
    if LO.dead then
      return
    end
    local mV, YV = ZV.UserInputType, LO.drag
    if mV == iO then
      LO.tp = nil
      local OV = LO.tg
      if OV then
        if OV.m then
          N(OV, kO())
        end
      end
      if YV.mv then
        if not (YV.ti) then
          YV.mv(kO())
        end
      end
      iV()
    elseif mV == uO then
      local mV = PO(ZV)
      LO.tp = mV
      local OV = LO.tg
      if OV then
        if OV.i == ZV then
          N(OV, mV)
        end
      end
      if YV.mv then
        if YV.ti == ZV then
          YV.mv(mV)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function N()
    for ZV, mV in next, LO.bmap, nil do
      for YV = #mV, 1, -1 do
        ZV = mV[YV]
        if ZV then
          ZV:bup()
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function ZV(mV)
    local YV = mV and o(LO.pops, mV)
    G((YV and (YV + 1)) or 1)
  end
  do
    local G = {}
    G.__index = G
    local mV, YV, OV = 0, setmetatable, {__mode = "k"}
    local QV = YV({}, OV)
    local function YV(OV, FV, IV, EV)
      mV += 1
      local VV, NV = setmetatable, {id = mV, kind = EV, c = FV, o = IV, name = (IV.name or IV.text) or "", flag = IV.flag, cb = IV.cb or IV.callback, dis = false, an = 0, tmp = (IV.tmp or (FV and FV.tmp)) or false}
      return VV(NV, OV)
    end
    local function mV(OV)
      local FV = (OV.h == true) or ((OV.o or 0) > 0)
      if OV.l == FV then
        return
      end
      OV.l = FV
      local IV, EV, VV = OV.hl, {}, FV and ((OV.b.soft and EO.phov) or EO.hov)
      EV.BackgroundTransparency = VV or 1
      s(IV, EV, 0.12, hO)
    end
    local function OV(FV, IV)
      local EV = FV and QV[FV]
      if EV then
        if not (EV.hl) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      EV.o = Q(0, (EV.o or 0) + ((IV and 1) or -1))
      mV(EV)
    end
    local FV = {}
    FV.__index = FV
    local function IV(EV, VV, NV, aV)
      local UV = UO("Frame", {Size = x(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = K, BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = (NV and EO.card) or 1, LayoutOrder = VV, Parent = EV})
      if NV then
        gO(UV, 7)
        oO(UV, EO.edge)
      end
      cO(UV, 0)
      return setmetatable({f = UV, rows = {}, n = 0, rad = (NV and 7) or 0, pop = aV, soft = not NV}, FV)
    end
    FV.fix = function(EV)
      local VV, NV, aV = EV.rows
      for UV = 1, #VV, 1 do
        local gV = VV[UV]
        if gV.r.Visible then
          NV, aV = NV or gV, gV
        else
        end
      end
      local UV = EV.rad
      for gV = 1, #VV, 1 do
        local XV = VV[gV]
        if XV.sp then
          XV.sp.Visible = XV ~= NV
        end
        gV = XV.hc and XV.hl
        if gV then
          local VV, oV = (UV > 0) and (XV == NV), (UV > 0) and (XV == aV)
          XV.hc.CornerRadius = l(0, ((VV or oV) and UV) or 0)
          if VV and not oV then
            gV.Position, gV.Size = v(0, 0), x(1, 0, 1, UV)
          elseif oV and not VV then
            gV.Position, gV.Size = v(0, -UV), x(1, 0, 1, UV)
          else
            gV.Position, gV.Size = v(0, 0), H(1, 1)
          end
        end
      end
      EV.f.Visible = NV ~= nil
    end
    FV.add = function(EV, VV, NV)
      EV.n = EV.n + 1
      local aV = UO("Frame", {Size = x(1, 0, 0, VV), LayoutOrder = EV.n, Parent = EV.f})
      local UV = {r = aV, b = EV}
      if not (EV.soft) then
        UV.sp = UO("Frame", {Size = x(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = EO.sep, ZIndex = 3, Parent = aV})
      end
      if if NV then not NV else EV.soft then
        UV.hl = UO("Frame", {Size = H(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, Parent = aV})
        gO(UV.hl, 7)
        uV(aV, EV.pop, function()
          UV.h = true
          mV(UV)
        end, function()
          UV.h = false
          mV(UV)
        end)
      elseif NV then
      else
        VV = UO("Frame", {Size = H(1, 1), ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 0, Parent = aV})
        UV.hl = UO("Frame", {Size = H(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, Parent = VV})
        UV.hc = gO(UV.hl, 0)
        uV(aV, EV.pop, function()
          UV.h = true
          mV(UV)
        end, function()
          UV.h = false
          mV(UV)
        end)
      end
      QV[aV] = UV
      VV = EV.rows
      VV[#VV + 1] = UV
      EV:fix()
      return aV, UV
    end
    FV.del = function(mV, EV)
      local VV = QV[EV]
      if not (VV) then
        return
      end
      QV[EV] = nil
      local NV = mV.rows
      local aV = o(NV, VV)
      if aV then
        R(NV, aV)
      end
      EV:Destroy()
      mV:fix()
    end
    FV.clear = function(mV)
      local FV = mV.rows
      for EV = #FV, 1, -1 do
        local VV = FV[EV]
        QV[VV.r] = nil
        VV.r:Destroy()
        FV[EV] = nil
      end
      mV.n = 0
      mV:fix()
    end
    G.get = function(mV)
      return mV.val
    end
    G.eff = function(mV)
      return mV.val
    end
    G.ser = function(mV)
      return mV.val
    end
    G.unser = function(mV, mV)
      return mV
    end
    G.load = function(mV)
    end
    G.draw = function(mV)
    end
    G.rw = function(mV)
      return mV.row or (mV.host and mV.host.row)
    end
    G.nexta = function(mV)
      mV.an = mV.an + 1
      return mV.an * 2
    end
    G.hostof = function(mV)
      if mV.accf then
        return mV
      end
      return mV.host
    end
    local function mV(FV, EV)
      local VV = FV.accs
      if VV then
      else
        VV = {}
        FV.accs = VV
      end
      VV[#VV + 1] = EV
      EV.host = FV
      if EV.name == "" then
        EV.name = FV.name
      end
    end
    G.kbdraw = function(FV)
      local EV = FV.bnd
      if not (EV) then
        return
      end
      if FV.pv then
        sO(FV)
      end
      local VV, NV = EV.key, FV.kt
      if VV then
        if NV then
        else
          local aV = FV:hostof()
          if not (aV) then
            return
          end
          local UV = UO("TextButton", {Size = v(0, 18), AutomaticSize = n, TextSize = 11, BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = EO.ctl, LayoutOrder = (FV.lo or 1000000) - 1, Parent = aV.accf}, {TextColor3 = "dim"})
          gO(UV, 4)
          oO(UV, EO.ctle)
          pO(UV, 6, 6, 0, 0)
          HO(UV.MouseButton1Click, function()
            KO(FV)
          end)
          FV.kt = UV
          NV = UV
        end
      else
      end
      if NV then
        NV.Visible = VV ~= nil
        if VV then
          NV.Text = IO(VV)
          s(NV, {TextColor3 = (EV.act and wO.acc) or wO.dim}, 0.12, hO)
        end
      end
    end
    G.bdown = function(FV)
      local EV = FV.bnd
      if EV then
        if FV.dis then
          return
        elseif FV.dead then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      if EV.mode == "hold" then
        if not (EV.act) then
          EV.act = true
          FV:draw()
          FV:fire()
        end
      elseif FV.kind == "tgl" then
        FV:set(not FV.val)
      else
        EV.act = not EV.act
        FV:draw()
        FV:fire()
      end
    end
    G.bup = function(FV)
      local EV = FV.bnd
      if EV then
        if EV.mode == "hold" then
          if EV.act then
            EV.act = false
            FV:draw()
            FV:fire()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    G.onchange = function(FV, EV)
      local VV = FV.ucb
      if VV then
      else
        VV = {}
        FV.ucb = VV
      end
      VV[#VV + 1] = EV
      return FV
    end
    G.fire = function(FV, EV)
      local VV = FV:eff()
      if FV.flag then
        if not (FV.tmp) then
          TO.flags[FV.flag] = VV
          if FV.a ~= nil then
            TO.flags[FV.flag .. "_a"] = FV.a
          end
        end
      end
      local NV = FV.prof
      if NV then
        if not (NV.ld) then
          NV.dirty = true
          if tostring(NV.cur) == NV.g then
            NV:spread(FV)
          end
        end
      end
      if not (EV) then
        if FV.cb then
          L(FV.cb, VV, FV.a)
        end
        NV = FV.ucb
        if NV then
          for aV = 1, #NV, 1 do
            L(NV[aV], VV, FV.a)
          end
        end
      end
      EV = FV.dnt
      if EV then
        for VV = 1, #EV, 1 do
          EV[VV]:chkdep()
        end
      end
      if FV.ind then
        if not (FV.tmp) then
          nO()
        end
      end
    end
    G.dep = function(FV, EV, VV)
      local NV = FV.deps
      if NV then
      else
        NV = {}
        FV.deps = NV
      end
      NV[#NV + 1] = {src = EV, want = VV}
      VV = EV.dnt
      if VV then
      else
        VV = {}
        EV.dnt = VV
      end
      if not (o(VV, FV)) then
        VV[#VV + 1] = FV
      end
      FV:chkdep()
      return FV
    end
    G.chkdep = function(FV)
      local EV, VV = true, FV.deps
      if VV then
        for NV = 1, #VV, 1 do
          local aV = VV[NV]
          local VV, UV = aV.src, aV.want
          NV = VV:eff()
          aV = if type(UV) == "function" then UV(NV) else if UV == nil then NV == true else if type(NV) == "table" then o(NV, UV) ~= nil else NV == UV
          if if aV then VV.dis else not aV then
            EV = false
            break
          end
        end
      else
      end
      FV:setdis(not EV)
    end
    G.setdis = function(FV, EV)
      EV = EV == true
      if FV.dis == EV then
        return FV
      end
      FV.dis = EV
      FV:draw()
      if FV.ind then
        if not (FV.tmp) then
          nO()
        end
      end
      local VV = FV.accs
      if VV then
        for NV = 1, #VV, 1 do
          VV[NV]:setdis(EV)
        end
      end
      VV = FV.dnt
      if VV then
        for EV = 1, #VV, 1 do
          VV[EV]:chkdep()
        end
      end
      return FV
    end
    G.vis = function(FV, EV)
      local VV = FV.row
      if VV then
        VV.Visible = EV ~= false
        local EV = QV[VV]
        if EV then
          EV.b:fix()
        end
      end
      return FV
    end
    G.setbind = function(FV, EV, VV)
      local NV = FV.bnd
      if not (NV) then
        return FV
      end
      if NV.key then
        JV(FV, NV.key)
      end
      NV.act = false
      NV.key = EV
      if VV then
        NV.mode = VV
      end
      if EV then
        qV(FV, EV)
      end
      FV:kbdraw()
      FV:draw()
      FV:fire()
      return FV
    end
    local function FV(EV)
      if EV then
        AO(EV)
        EV.md:clean()
        EV.box:Destroy()
      end
    end
    G.destroy = function(EV)
      if EV.dead then
        return
      end
      EV.dead = true
      local VV = EV.bnd
      if VV then
        if VV.key then
          JV(EV, VV.key)
        end
      end
      if EV.kind == "kbd" then
        if EV.val then
          JV(EV, EV.val)
        end
      end
      if LO.listen == EV then
        LO.listen = nil
      end
      VV = o(TO.els, EV)
      if VV then
        R(TO.els, VV)
      end
      VV = EV.prof
      if VV then
        local NV = o(VV.els, EV)
        if NV then
          R(VV.els, NV)
        end
      end
      if EV.flag then
        if TO.fl[EV.flag] == EV then
          TO.fl[EV.flag] = nil
          TO.flags[EV.flag] = nil
        end
      end
      VV = EV.accs
      if VV then
        for NV = #VV, 1, -1 do
          VV[NV]:destroy()
        end
      end
      VV = EV.host
      if VV then
        if VV.accs then
          local NV = o(VV.accs, EV)
          if NV then
            R(VV.accs, NV)
          end
        end
      end
      FV(EV.lp)
      FV(EV.pp)
      FV(EV.sp)
      VV = EV.row
      if VV then
        local FV = QV[VV]
        if FV then
          FV.b:del(VV)
        elseif VV.Parent then
          VV:Destroy()
        end
      elseif EV.ctl then
        EV.ctl:Destroy()
      end
      if EV.kt then
        EV.kt:Destroy()
      end
      rO(EV)
      nO()
    end
    G.padset = function(QV, FV, EV)
      local VV = QV.pd
      if not (VV) then
        return QV
      end
      EV = if FV == "on" then EV == true else if FV == "nm" then V(tostring(EV or ""), 1, 24) else if FV == "sz" then Y(tonumber(EV) or 100, 70, 150) else Y(tonumber(EV) or 100, 0, 100)
      if VV[FV] == EV then
        return QV
      end
      VV[FV] = EV
      CO(QV)
      eO()
      return QV
    end
    local function QV(FV)
      if FV.tmp then
        return
      end
      local EV = TO.els
      EV[#EV + 1] = FV
      EV = FV:ser()
      FV.def = if type(EV) == "table" then T(EV) else EV
      if FV.flag then
        TO.fl[FV.flag] = FV
        TO.flags[FV.flag] = FV:eff()
        if FV.a ~= nil then
          TO.flags[FV.flag .. "_a"] = FV.a
        end
        EV = FV.c and FV.c.tab
        local VV = EV and EV.prof
        if VV then
          if not (FV.o.noprof) then
            FV.prof = VV
            VV.els[#VV.els + 1] = FV
          end
        end
      end
      if FV.ind then
        if FV.ind.on then
          nO()
        elseif FV.bnd then
          if FV.bnd.key then
            nO()
          end
        end
      end
      EV = FV.pd
      if EV then
        local VV = (FV.flag and LO.pads) and LO.pads[FV.flag]
        if type(VV) == "table" then
          EV.on = VV.o == true
          EV.sz = Y(tonumber(VV.s) or 100, 70, 150)
          EV.rd = Y(tonumber(VV.r) or 100, 0, 100)
          EV.nm = ((type(VV.n) == "string") and V(VV.n, 1, 24)) or ""
          local NV = VV.p
          EV.pos = (((type(NV) == "table") and (#NV == 4)) and NV) or nil
        end
        CO(FV)
      end
    end
    local FV = {}
    FV.__index = FV
    SO = function(EV, VV, NV)
      return setmetatable({frame = EV, tab = VV, pop = NV, n = 0}, FV)
    end
    FV.blk = function(EV)
      local VV = EV.cb
      if VV then
      else
        EV.n = EV.n + 1
        VV = IV(EV.frame, EV.n, true, EV.pop)
        EV.cb = VV
      end
      return VV
    end
    FV.brk = function(IV)
      IV.cb = nil
    end
    FV.row = function(IV, EV, VV)
      return IV:blk():add(EV or 30, VV)
    end
    FV.free = function(IV, EV)
      IV.cb = nil
      IV.n = IV.n + 1
      return UO("Frame", {Size = x(1, 0, 0, EV or 0), AutomaticSize = (EV and e) or K, LayoutOrder = IV.n, Parent = IV.frame})
    end
    FV.head = function(IV, EV)
      local VV = IV:row(32, true)
      UO("TextLabel", {Position = v(12, 0), Size = x(1, -24, 1, 0), Text = tostring(EV or ""), FontFace = VO.b, TextSize = 13, TextTruncate = r, Parent = VV})
      return VV
    end
    FV.space = function(IV, EV)
      return IV:free(EV or 6)
    end
    FV.value = function(IV, EV)
      local VV = YV(G, IV, EV, "value")
      VV.val = EV.default
      VV.set = function(IV, EV, NV)
        IV.val = EV
        IV:fire(NV)
        return IV
      end
      VV.load = VV.set
      QV(VV)
      return VV
    end
    FV.div = function(IV)
      local EV = IV:free(1)
      UO("Frame", {Position = v(6, 0), Size = x(1, -12, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = 0.955, Parent = EV})
      return EV
    end
    local function IV(EV, VV)
      local NV = VV.pop
      local aV = VV:row((NV and 28) or 30)
      local UV, gV = UO("TextButton", {Size = H(1, 1), ZIndex = 1, Parent = aV}), UO("Frame", {AnchorPoint = W(1, 0.5), Position = x(1, -10, 0.5, 0), Size = v(0, 22), AutomaticSize = n, ZIndex = 2, Parent = aV})
      MO(gV, 8, C.Right)
      local XV, oV, RV, pV = 12
      if EV.o.icon then
        oV, XV = UO("ImageLabel", {AnchorPoint = W(0, 0.5), Position = x(0, 12, 0.5, 0), Size = v(13, 13), Image = aO(EV.o.icon), ZIndex = 2, Parent = aV}, {ImageColor3 = "txt"}), 32
        RV, pV = XV, oV
      else
        RV, pV = XV, oV
      end
      local XV, oV
      if EV.name ~= "" then
        oV = UO("TextLabel", {Position = v(RV, 0), Size = x(1, -(RV + 12), 1, 0), Text = EV.name, TextSize = 13, TextTruncate = r, ZIndex = 2, Parent = aV}, {TextColor3 = "txt"})
        HO(gV:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
          oV.Size = x(1, -((RV + 18) + (gV.AbsoluteSize.X / JO())), 1, 0)
        end)
        if pV then
          HO(oV:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"), function()
            pV.ImageColor3 = oV.TextColor3
          end)
        end
      else
        oV = XV
      end
      if NV then
        VV = NV.rws
        if VV then
        else
          VV = {}
          NV.rws = VV
        end
        local NV, XV = #VV + 1, {r = aV}
        XV.n, XV.af, XV.x, VV[NV] = oV and EV.name, gV, RV, XV
      end
      EV.row = aV
      EV.hit = UV
      EV.accf = gV
      EV.lbl = oV
      return aV, UV, gV
    end
    local EV = setmetatable({}, G)
    EV.__index = EV
    FV.toggle = function(VV, NV)
      NV = NV or {}
      local aV = YV(EV, VV, NV, "tgl")
      aV.val = NV.default == true
      aV.lo = 1000000
      local UV, UV, gV = IV(aV, VV)
      VV = UO("Frame", {Size = v(26, 14), BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = EO.trk, LayoutOrder = aV.lo, Parent = gV})
      XO(VV)
      gV = UO("Frame", {AnchorPoint = W(0, 0.5), Position = x(0, 2, 0.5, 0), Size = v(10, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 0, Parent = VV}, {BackgroundColor3 = "knob"})
      XO(gV)
      aV.trk = VV
      aV.kn = gV
      aV.bnd = {key = nil, mode = NV.mode or "toggle", act = false}
      aV.ind = {on = (NV.ind ~= nil) and (NV.ind ~= false), name = ((type(NV.ind) == "string") and NV.ind) or ""}
      aV.pd = {on = false, sz = 100, rd = 100, nm = ""}
      HO(UV.InputBegan, function(VV)
        if zO(VV.UserInputType) then
          aV.lpd = false
        end
      end)
      HO(UV.MouseButton1Click, function()
        if aV.lpd then
          aV.lpd = false
          return
        end
        if not (aV.dis) then
          aV:set(not aV.val)
        end
      end)
      HO(UV.MouseButton2Click, function()
        KO(aV)
      end)
      wV(UV, function()
        aV.lpd = true
        KO(aV)
      end)
      if NV.bind then
        aV.bnd.key = NV.bind
        qV(aV, NV.bind)
      end
      aV:draw(true)
      QV(aV)
      return aV
    end
    EV.eff = function(VV)
      local NV = VV.bnd
      if NV.act then
        if NV.mode == "hold" then
          return not VV.val
        end
      end
      return VV.val
    end

      NV = NV == true
      if VV.val == NV then
        return VV

      VV.val = NV

      return VV

        VV:set(NV)

    end

      local NV, aV = EV:eff(), EV.dis
      local UV, gV, XV, oV, RV, pV, cV = (aV and wO.faint) or (((NV and EV.o.risky) and wO.bad) or wO.txt), (NV and wO.acc) or BO, (NV and ((aV and 0.6) or 0)) or ((aV and 0.95) or EO.trk), (NV and BO) or wO.knob, x(0, (NV and 14) or 2, 0.5, 0), (aV and 0.55) or 0, EV.lbl
      if VV then
        if cV then
          cV.TextColor3 = UV
        end
        EV.trk.BackgroundColor3, EV.trk.BackgroundTransparency = gV, XV
        EV.kn.Position, EV.kn.BackgroundColor3, EV.kn.BackgroundTransparency = RV, oV, pV
      else
        if cV then
          s(cV, {TextColor3 = UV}, 0.14, hO)
        end
        s(EV.trk, {BackgroundColor3 = gV, BackgroundTransparency = XV}, 0.16, hO)
        s(EV.kn, {Position = RV, BackgroundColor3 = oV, BackgroundTransparency = pV}, 0.2)
      end
      EV:kbdraw()
    end
    G.settings = function(EV, VV)
      VV = VV or {}
      local NV = EV:hostof()
      if not NV then
        return nil
      end
      local aV, UV = EV.c, UO("ImageButton", {Size = v(14, 14), Image = aO("dots"), LayoutOrder = -1, Parent = NV.accf}, {ImageColor3 = "dim"})

      gV.owner = EV

      end)

    local EV = setmetatable({}, G)

    local function VV(NV, aV, UV)
      local gV = UO("Frame", {Size = v(0, 22), AutomaticSize = n, LayoutOrder = NV.lo, Parent = aV})
      MO(gV, 8)
      local XV = UO("TextBox", {Size = v(0, 18), AutomaticSize = n, BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = EO.ctl, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = z.Center, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = gV})
      gO(XV, 4)
      oO(XV, EO.ctle)
      pO(XV, 7, 7, 0, 0)
      UO("UISizeConstraint", {MinSize = W(40, 18), Parent = XV})
      aV = UO("TextButton", {Size = v(NV.o.sw or 72, 18), LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = gV})
      local oV = UO("Frame", {AnchorPoint = W(0, 0.5), Position = H(0, 0.5), Size = x(1, 0, 0, 4), BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = EO.trk, Parent = aV})
      XO(oV)
      local RV = UO("Frame", {Size = H(0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0, Parent = oV}, {BackgroundColor3 = "acc"})
      XO(RV)
      local pV = UO("Frame", {AnchorPoint = W(0.5, 0.5), Position = H(0, 0.5), Size = v(10, 10), BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = 0, ZIndex = 3, Parent = oV})
      XO(pV)
      NV.ctl = gV
      NV.vl = XV
      NV.trk = aV
      NV.bar = oV
      NV.fil = RV
      NV.kn = pV
      NV.mv = function(gV)
        local RV, cV = oV.AbsolutePosition.X, oV.AbsoluteSize.X
        if cV <= 0 then
          return
        end
        local oV = NV.min + (Y((gV.X - RV) / cV, 0, 1) * (NV.max - NV.min))
        if NV.bnd.act then
          NV:setbv(oV)
        else
          NV:set(oV)
        end
      end
      NV.mu = function()
        NV.drg = false
        local gV = (NV.hov and 12) or 10
        s(pV, {Size = v(gV, gV)}, 0.14)
        if NV.pend then
          NV.pend = false
          NV:fire()
        end
      end
      local function gV(oV)
        NV.drg = true
        s(pV, {Size = v(12, 12)}, 0.14)
        yV(NV.mv, NV.mu, UV, oV)
      end
      HO(aV.InputBegan, function(oV)
        if NV.dis then
          return
        end
        local RV = oV.UserInputType
        local cV = (RV == yO) and LO.ph
        if (RV == yO) and not cV then
          NV.mv(kO())
          gV(oV)
        elseif (RV == uO) or cV then
          local RV = {i = oV}
          RV.p0 = (cV and kO()) or PO(oV)
          RV.m = cV
          RV.drag = function(cV)
            NV.mv(cV)
            gV(oV)
          end
          RV.tap = function(gV)
            NV.mv(gV)
            NV.mu()
          end
          LO.tg = RV
          k(0.5, function()
            if LO.tg == RV then
              LO.tg = nil
              KO(NV)
            end
          end)
        end
      end)
      HO(aV.MouseButton2Click, function()
        KO(NV)
      end)
      uV(aV, UV, function()
        NV.hov = true
        if not (NV.drg) then
          s(pV, {Size = v(12, 12)}, 0.14)
        end
      end, function()
        NV.hov = false
        if not (NV.drg) then
          s(pV, {Size = v(10, 10)}, 0.14)
        end
      end)
      HO(XV.Focused, function()
        if NV.dis then
          XV:ReleaseFocus()
          return
        end
        NV.foc = true
        XV.Text = tostring(NV:eff())
        XV.TextColor3 = wO.acc
        OV(NV:rw(), true)
      end)
      HO(XV.FocusLost, function()
        if NV.foc then
          NV.foc = false
          OV(NV:rw(), false)
        end
        local aV = tonumber((U(XV.Text, "[^%d%.%-]", "")))
        if aV then
          if NV.bnd.act then
            NV:setbv(aV)
          else
            NV:set(aV)
          end
        end
        NV:draw()
      end)
    end
    FV.slider = function(NV, aV, UV)
      aV = aV or {}
      local gV = YV(EV, NV, aV, "sld")
      gV.min, gV.max = aV.min or 0, aV.max or 100
      gV.dec = (aV.dec or aV.decimals) or 0
      gV.step = aV.step or (10 ^ (-gV.dec))
      gV.pat = "%." .. (gV.dec .. "f")
      gV.suf = aV.suffix or ""
      gV.zero = aV.zero
      gV.val = gV:rnd(aV.default or gV.min)
      gV.bnd = {key = nil, mode = aV.mode or "hold", act = false, v = gV.val}
      gV.ind = {on = (aV.ind ~= nil) and (aV.ind ~= false), name = ((type(aV.ind) == "string") and aV.ind) or ""}
      gV.pd = {on = false, sz = 100, rd = 100, nm = ""}
      if aV.bindvalue ~= nil then
        gV.bnd.v = gV:rnd(aV.bindvalue)
      end
      if UV then
        mV(UV, gV)
        gV.lo = UV:nexta()
        VV(gV, UV.accf, NV.pop)
      else
        gV.lo = 1000000
        local UV, UV = IV(gV, NV)
        VV(gV, gV.accf, NV.pop)
        HO(UV.MouseButton2Click, function()
          KO(gV)
        end)
        wV(UV, function()
          KO(gV)
        end)
      end
      if aV.bind then
        gV.bnd.key = aV.bind
        qV(gV, aV.bind)
      end
      gV:draw()
      QV(gV)
      return gV
    end
    EV.rnd = function(wV, VV)
      local NV, aV = wV.min, wV.max
      VV = Y(tonumber(VV) or NV, NV, aV)
      local UV = wV.step
      VV = if UV > 0 then NV + (O(((VV - NV) / UV) + 0.5) * UV) else VV
      return tonumber(E(wV.pat, Y(VV, NV, aV)))
    end
    EV.eff = function(wV)
      local VV = wV.bnd
      if VV then
        if VV.act then
          return VV.v
        end
      end
      return wV.val
    end
    EV.set = function(wV, VV, NV)
      VV = wV:rnd(VV)
      if VV == wV.val then
        return wV
      end
      wV.val = VV
      wV:draw()
      if wV.bnd.act then
        return wV
      end
      if wV.drg then
        if wV.o.release then
          wV.pend = true
          return wV
        end
      end
      wV:fire(NV)
      return wV
    end
    EV.setbv = function(wV, VV)
      VV = wV:rnd(VV)
      local NV = wV.bnd
      if NV.v == VV then
        return wV
      end
      NV.v = VV
      if NV.act then
        wV:draw()
        wV:fire()
      end
      return wV
    end
    EV.load = function(wV, VV)
      if type(VV) == "number" then
        wV:set(VV)
      end
    end
    EV.fmtv = function(wV, VV)
      local NV = wV.o.fmt
      if NV then
        return NV(VV)
      end
      if wV.zero then
        if VV <= wV.min then
          return wV.zero
        end
      end
      return E(wV.pat, VV) .. wV.suf
    end
    EV.draw = function(E)
      local wV, EV, VV, NV = E:eff(), E.dis, E.bnd, E.max - E.min
      local aV = ((NV > 0) and ((wV - E.min) / NV)) or 0
      if E.drawn then
        s(E.fil, {Size = H(aV, 1)}, 0.12)
        s(E.kn, {Position = H(aV, 0.5)}, 0.12)
      else
        E.drawn = true
        E.fil.Size = H(aV, 1)
        E.kn.Position = H(aV, 0.5)
      end
      E.fil.BackgroundTransparency = (EV and 0.6) or 0
      E.kn.BackgroundTransparency = (EV and 0.6) or 0
      if E.lbl then
        E.lbl.TextColor3 = (EV and wO.faint) or wO.txt
      end
      if not (E.vl:IsFocused()) then
        E.vl.Text = E:fmtv(wV)
        aV, NV = E.vl, (EV and wO.faint) or ((VV.act and wO.acc) or wO.txt)
        aV.TextColor3 = NV
      end
      E.vl.TextEditable = not EV
      E:kbdraw()
    end
    local E = setmetatable({}, G)
    E.__index = E
    local function wV(EV, VV, NV, aV)
      if NV then
        for NV, UV in next, VV, nil do
          EV[NV] = UV
        end
      else
        s(EV, VV, aV or 0.12, hO)
      end
    end
    local function EV(VV)
      local NV = UO("UIGradient", {Enabled = false, Parent = VV})
      local function aV()
        local UV = VV.AbsoluteSize.X
        local gV = (UV > 1) and (VV.TextBounds.X > (UV + 1.5))
        NV.Enabled = gV
        if gV then
          local gV = Y(1 - ((18 * JO()) / UV), 0.05, 0.95)
          NV.Transparency = D({m(0, 0), m(gV, 0), m(1, 1)})
        end
      end
      HO(VV:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"), aV)
      HO(VV:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), aV)
      aV()
    end
    local function m(VV, NV, aV, UV, gV)
      gV = gV or 22
      local XV = UO("TextButton", {Size = v((UV and 0) or NV, gV), AutomaticSize = (UV and n) or e, BackgroundColor3 = BO, BackgroundTransparency = EO.ctl, LayoutOrder = aV or 0, Parent = VV})
      gO(XV, 6)
      VV = oO(XV, EO.ctle)
      pO(XV, 9, 8, 0, 0)
      MO(XV, (UV and 2) or 6)
      aV = UO("TextLabel", {Size = (UV and v(0, gV)) or x(1, -16, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = (UV and n) or e, TextSize = 12, ClipsDescendants = true, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = XV}, {TextColor3 = "sub"})
      if UV then
        pO(aV, 0, 4, 0, 0)
        UO("UISizeConstraint", {MaxSize = W(154, gV), Parent = aV})
      end
      EV(aV)
      return XV, aV, UO("ImageLabel", {Size = v(10, 10), Image = aO("chevron"), LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = XV}, {ImageColor3 = "dim"}), VV
    end
    local function VV(NV, aV)
      local UV = UO("TextButton", {Size = v(0, 22), AutomaticSize = n, LayoutOrder = aV or 0, Parent = NV})
      MO(UV, 1)
      aV = UO("TextLabel", {Size = v(0, 22), AutomaticSize = n, TextSize = 13, ClipsDescendants = true, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = UV}, {TextColor3 = "sub"})
      pO(aV, 0, 4, 0, 0)

      EV(aV)

    end
    FV.dropdown = function(EV, NV, aV)
      NV = NV or {}
      local UV = YV(E, EV, NV, "drp")
      UV.multi = NV.multi == true
      UV.values = (NV.values or NV.options) or {}
      if UV.multi then
        UV.val = {}
        local gV = NV.default
        if type(gV) == "table" then
          for XV = 1, #gV, 1 do
            UV.val[XV] = gV[XV]
          end
        elseif gV ~= nil then
          UV.val[1] = gV
        end
      else
        UV.val = NV.default
        if UV.val == nil then
          if not (NV.none) then
            UV.val = UV.values[1]
          end
        end
      end
      UV.srt = function(gV, XV)
        return (o(UV.values, gV) or 0) < (o(UV.values, XV) or 0)
      end
      UV.ind = {on = (NV.ind ~= nil) and (NV.ind ~= false), name = ((type(NV.ind) == "string") and NV.ind) or ""}
      local gV = EV.pop
      UV.fly = ((gV ~= nil) and (NV.par == nil)) and (NV.box ~= true)
      local XV, oV, RV = NV.par, NV.w or 112, NV.lo
      if aV then
        mV(aV, UV)
        UV.lo = aV:nexta()
        XV, oV, RV = aV.accf, NV.w or 96, UV.lo
      else
        if XV then
        else
          UV.lo = 1000000
          local aV, pV = IV(UV, EV)
          XV, RV = UV.accf, UV.lo
          HO(pV.MouseButton1Click, function()
            UV:flip()
          end)
          HO(pV.MouseButton2Click, function()
            KO(UV)
          end)
          if UV.fly then
            uV(aV, gV, function()
              UV.rh = true
              UV:draw()
            end, function()
              UV.rh = false
              UV:draw()
            end)
          end
        end
      end
      if UV.fly then
        UV.btn, UV.t, UV.ch = VV(XV, RV)
      else
        UV.btn, UV.t, UV.ch, UV.sk = m(XV, oV, RV, NV.auto, NV.h)
      end
      UV.ctl = UV.btn
      uV(UV.btn, gV, function()
        UV.bh = true
        UV:draw()
      end, function()
        UV.bh = false
        UV:draw()
      end)
      HO(UV.btn.MouseButton1Click, function()
        UV:flip()
      end)
      UV:draw(true)
      QV(UV)
      return UV
    end
    E.flip = function(m)
      if m.dis then
        return
      end
      if m.lp then
        if m.lp.isopen then
          AO(m.lp)
        else
          m:openlist()
        end
      else
        m:openlist()
      end
    end
    E.has = function(m, EV)
      if m.multi then
        return o(m.val, EV) ~= nil
      end
      return m.val == EV
    end
    E.none = function(m)
      if m.multi then
        return #m.val == 0
      end
      return m.val == nil
    end
    E.text = function(m)
      if m:none() then
        return m.o.empty or (((m.multi and not m.fly) and "None") or "Select")
      end
      if m.multi then
        local EV = #m.val
        local VV = table.create(EV)
        for NV = 1, EV, 1 do
          VV[NV] = tostring(m.val[NV])
        end
        return c(VV, ", ")
      end
      return tostring(m.val)
    end
    E.draw = function(m, EV)
      local VV = m.dis
      if VV then
        if m.lp then
          AO(m.lp)
          return
        end
      end
      local NV, aV, UV = m.lp ~= nil, if VV then not VV else m.bh or m.rh, m:none()
      m.t.Text = m:text()
      local gV, XV
      if VV then
        gV, XV = wO.faint, wO.faint
      else
        gV, XV = ((NV or aV) and wO.txt) or ((UV and wO.dim) or wO.sub), (NV and wO.txt) or ((aV and wO.sub) or wO.dim)
      end
      wV(m.t, {TextColor3 = gV}, EV)
      UV = m.sk
      if UV then
        local gV, oV = m.btn, {}
        oV.BackgroundTransparency = ((NV or aV) and EO.ctlh) or EO.ctl
        wV(gV, oV, EV)
        wV(UV, {Transparency = (NV and 0.88) or EO.ctle}, EV)
        gV, oV = m.ch, {ImageColor3 = XV}
        oV.Rotation = (NV and 180) or 0
        wV(gV, oV, EV, 0.16)
      else
        wV(m.ch, {ImageColor3 = XV}, EV)
      end
      if m.lbl then
        m.lbl.TextColor3 = (VV and wO.faint) or wO.txt
      end
      VV = m.items
      if VV then
        UV, aV, NV = m.hv, m.multi
        for gV = 1, #VV, 1 do
          local XV = VV[gV]
          local VV, oV = m:has(XV.v), UV == XV
          NV = NV or (((VV and not aV) and gV) or nil)
          local gV, RV = XV.t, {}
          RV.TextColor3 = ((VV or oV) and wO.txt) or wO.sub
          wV(gV, RV, EV, 0.1)
          if aV then
            wV(XV.m, {BackgroundColor3 = (VV and wO.acc) or BO, BackgroundTransparency = (VV and 0) or EO.trk}, EV, 0.14)
            wV(XV.k, {Position = x(0, (VV and 12) or 2, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = (VV and BO) or wO.knob}, EV, 0.18)
          end
        end
        if m.cap then
          m.cap(UV and UV.i, NV, EV)
        end
      end
    end
    E.set = function(m, EV, VV)
      if m.multi then
        local NV = m.val
        EV = if EV == NV then (T(EV)) else EV
        p(NV)
        if type(EV) == "table" then
          for aV = 1, #EV, 1 do
            local UV = EV[aV]
            if o(m.values, UV) then
              if not (o(NV, UV)) then
                NV[#NV + 1] = UV
              end
            end
          end
        elseif EV ~= nil then
          if o(m.values, EV) then
            NV[1] = EV
          end
        end
        M(NV, m.srt)
      else
        if EV ~= nil then
          if not (o(m.values, EV)) then
            return m
          end
        end
        if m.val == EV then
          return m
        end
        m.val = EV
      end
      m:draw()
      m:fire(VV)
      return m
    end
    E.pick = function(m, EV)
      local VV = m.val
      local NV = o(VV, EV)
      if NV then
        if m.o.min1 then
          if #VV == 1 then
            return
          end
        end
        R(VV, NV)
      else
        VV[#VV + 1] = EV
        M(VV, m.srt)
      end
      m:draw()
      m:fire()
    end
    E.setvalues = function(m, EV)
      m.values = EV or {}
      if m.multi then
        EV = m.val
        for VV = #EV, 1, -1 do
          if not (o(m.values, EV[VV])) then
            R(EV, VV)
          end
        end
      elseif m.val ~= nil then
        if not (o(m.values, m.val)) then
          m.val = m.values[1]
        end
      end
      if m.lp then
        if m.lp.isopen then
          AO(m.lp)
        end
      end
      m:draw()
      m:fire()
      return m
    end
    E.ser = function(m)
      if m.multi then
        return T(m.val)
      end
      return m.val
    end
    E.load = function(m, T)
      if m.multi then
        if type(T) == "table" then
          m:set(T)
        end
      elseif T ~= nil then
        m:set(T)
      end
    end
    E.openlist = function(m)

        if UV > 0 then
          mV.h = VV
        end
      end

      mV.v = UV
      mV:draw()
      mV:fire(NV)
      return mV
    end

    j.setkey = function(q, J, D)
      q.lst = false
      if LO.listen == q then
        LO.listen = nil
      end
      if J == nil then
        if q.o.nonone then
          q:draw()
          return q
        end
      end
      if J == q.val then
        q:draw()
        return q
      end
      if q.val then
        if not (q.tmp) then
          JV(q, q.val)
        end
      end
      q.val = J
      if J then
        if not (q.tmp) then
          qV(q, J)
        end
      end
      q:draw()
      q:fire(D)
      return q
    end

    local lV, WV = u(12, 20, 25), 0.686274528503418
    local DV = u(210, 220, 230)

    local function u(YV)
      return (U(U(U(U(YV, "<[^>]->", ""), "&lt;", "<"), "&gt;", ">"), "&amp;", "&"))
    end
    local function YV(OV, QV)

      end)
      HO(OV:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"), function()
        QV.TextColor3 = OV.TextColor3
      end)
      return OV, QV, FV
    end
    local function u(OV, QV)
      OV.FontFace = ZV
      OV.TextSize = 16

        OV.AutomaticSize = S

        if not (QV) then

      end

    end

      end

          gV += 1

          if UV then
          else
            local pV = UO("Frame", {Size = x(1, 0, 0, 20), Parent = VV})

      else

    local b = {ok = "ok", bad = "bad", warn = "warn"}
    local function e(yO)
      local iO = o(T.l, yO)
      if iO then
        R(T.l, iO)
      end
      BV(yO)
    end
    TO.notify = function(R, yO, iO, vO)
      R = T.f
      if R then
        if LO.dead then
          return
        elseif not (T.on) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      T.n = T.n + 1
      local CO, sO = b[iO] or "acc", UO("Frame", {Size = v(0, 34), LayoutOrder = T.n, Parent = R})
      local b, R, iO = mO(sO, true)
      b.Visible = false
      MO(R, 0)
      YV(R, "code", 1, CO, 18, 0.15)
      OV(R, 8, 2)
      u({Text = LO.brand or "polar", LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = R}, {TextColor3 = CO})
      ZV(R, 4)
      u({Text = FO(tostring(yO), wO.acc), RichText = true, LayoutOrder = 5, Parent = R})
      iO()
      sO.Size = v(R.AbsoluteSize.X, 34)
      HO(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
        sO.Size = v(b.AbsoluteSize.X, 34)
      end)
      iO = T.l
      iO[#iO + 1] = sO
      while #iO > 6 do
        e(iO[1])
      end
      AV(b, true, 0.24, nil, true)
      k(vO or 4, function()
        if sO.Parent then
          if LO.dead then
            return
          end
        else
          return
        end
        AV(b, false, 0.3, nil, true, function()
          e(sO)
        end)
      end)
    end
    TO.log = function(u, b, R, e)
      return u:notify(b, R, e)
    end
    AO, IO, KO, wV = l, IV, i, I
  end
  local i = {}

  end
  i.mount = function(b, l)
    return l(UO("Frame", {Size = H(1, 1), Parent = b.frame}), {make = UO, corner = gO, stroke = oO, pad = pO, list = cO, scale = JO, fonts = VO, controls = function(l)

  i.col = function(b, l)
    local I = b.cols
    l = Y(O(tonumber(l) or 1), 1, 4)
    if l > b.nc then
      b.nc = l
    end
    local R = b.nc
    if #I < R then
      for e = #I + 1, R, 1 do
        local yO = UO("ScrollingFrame", {ScrollBarThickness = 0, Parent = b.frame})
        pO(yO, 2, 2, 10, 12)
        cO(yO, 8)
        I[e] = yO
      end
      for b = 1, R, 1 do
        I[b].Position = x((b - 1) / R, ((b - 1) * 8) / R, 0, 0)
        I[b].Size = x(1 / R, (-(R - 1) * 8) / R, 1, 0)
      end
    end
    return I[l]
  end
  i.section = function(b, l)
    l = (if type(l) == "string" then {name = l} else l) or {}

    b.sn = b.sn + 1

      end
    end

  end

  local u = {}

  b.profile = function(l, I)
    I = I or {}
    local R = I.global or "Global"
    local K, e = {R}, I.items or {}
    for yO = 1, #e, 1 do
      if e[yO] ~= R then
        K[#K + 1] = e[yO]
      end
    end
    local e = setmetatable({tab = l, items = K, g = R, data = {}, els = {}, id = (I.id or I.flag) or l.name}, u)
    e.cur = (o(K, I.default) and I.default) or R
    l.prof = e
    e.idd = l:tbdrop({values = K, default = e.cur, cb = function(l)
      e:select(l)
    end})
    TO.profs[#TO.profs + 1] = e
    return e
  end
  u.store = function(l)
    local I = tostring(l.cur)
    local R = l.data[I]
    if R then
    else
      if not (l.dirty) then
        if I ~= l.g then
          return
        end
      end
      R = {}
      l.data[I] = R
    end
    I = l.els
    for K = 1, #I, 1 do
      l = I[K]
      R[l.flag] = l:ser()
    end
  end
  u.apply = function(l)
    local I = tostring(l.cur)
    local R = l.data[I]
    R = if R == nil then if I ~= l.g then l.data[l.g] else R else R
    l.ld = true
    I = l.els
    for K = 1, #I, 1 do
      local e = I[K]
      K = R and R[e.flag]
      e:load(if K == nil then e.def else K)
    end
    l.ld = false
    l.dirty = false
    if l.cb then
      L(l.cb, l.cur)
    end
  end
  u.select = function(l, I)
    if I == l.cur then
      return
    elseif not (o(l.items, I)) then
      return
    end
    l:store()
    l.cur = I
    if l.idd.val ~= I then
      l.idd:set(I, true)
    end
    l:apply()
  end
  u.spread = function(l, I)
    local R = I.flag
    for K, e in next, l.data, nil do
      if K ~= l.g then
        e[R] = I:ser()
      end
    end
  end
  u.get = function(l, I, R)
    local K = tostring(l.cur)
    R = ((R ~= nil) and tostring(R)) or K
    R = if K == l.g then l.g else if o(l.items, R) then R else l.g
    if R == K then
      return TO.flags[I]
    end
    K = l.data[R]
    if K == nil then
      if R ~= l.g then
        return l:get(I, l.g)
      end
    end
    local l, R = TO.fl[I], K and K[I]
    R = if R == nil then l and l.def else R
    return if l then (l:unser(R)) else R
  end
  u.ser = function(l)
    l:store()
    return {cur = l.cur, data = l.data}
  end
  u.load = function(u, l)
    if type(l) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    u.data = ((type(l.data) == "table") and l.data) or {}
    if l.cur ~= nil then
      if o(u.items, l.cur) then
        u.cur = l.cur
        u.idd:set(l.cur, true)
      end
    end
    u:apply()
  end
  local u = {}
  u.__index = u
  u.group = function(l)
    return l
  end
  u.barhl = function(l, I)
    local R = l.cur
    if not (R) then
      return
    end
    local K = R.nb
    if K.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then
      return
    end
    R = JO()
    local e, yO = (K.AbsolutePosition - l.bls.AbsolutePosition) / R, K.AbsoluteSize / R
    K, R = v(e.X, e.Y), v(yO.X, yO.Y)
    if I then
      s(l.bhl, {Position = K, Size = R}, 0.24)
    else
      l.bhl.Position, l.bhl.Size = K, R
    end
  end
  u.tab = function(l, I)
    I = (if type(I) == "string" then {name = I} else I) or {}
    l.nn = l.nn + 1
    local R = setmetatable({win = l, o = I, name = I.name or "Tab", pages = {}, tn = 0}, b)
    local K = UO("TextButton", {Size = v(0, 26), AutomaticSize = n, LayoutOrder = l.nn, ZIndex = 4, Parent = l.bls})
    pO(K, 10, 12, 0, 0)
    MO(K, 6)
    R.ni = UO("ImageLabel", {Size = v(13, 13), Image = aO(I.icon or "misc"), LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 4, Parent = K}, {ImageColor3 = "dim"})
    R.nl = UO("TextLabel", {Size = v(0, 26), AutomaticSize = n, Text = R.name, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 4, Parent = K}, {TextColor3 = "dim"})
    R.nb = K
    R.frame = UO("Frame", {Size = H(1, 1), Visible = false, Parent = l.body})
    R.tl = UO("Frame", {Size = v(0, 40), AutomaticSize = n, Visible = false, LayoutOrder = 10 + l.nn, Parent = l.tl})
    MO(R.tl, 8)
    R.tr = UO("Frame", {Size = v(0, 40), AutomaticSize = n, Visible = false, Parent = l.tr})
    MO(R.tr, 16, C.Right)
    uV(K, nil, function()
      R.hov = true

      R:navdraw()

    HO(K.MouseButton1Click, function()
      l:select(R)
    end)
    HO(K:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
      if l.cur == R then
        l:barhl(true)
      end
    end)
    K = l.tabs
    K[#K + 1] = R
    if l.cur then
      R:navdraw()
    else
      l:select(R)
    end
    return R
  end
  u.select = function(l, I)
    local R = l.cur
    if R == I then
      return
    end
    w()
    l.cur = I
    if R then
      AV(R.frame, false, 0.12)
      R.tl.Visible = false
      R.tr.Visible = false
      R:navdraw()
    end
    AV(I.tl, true, 0.2)
    AV(I.tr, true, 0.2)
    AV(I.frame, true, 0.2, (R and 0.07) or nil)
    I:navdraw()
    l:barhl(R ~= nil)
    P(function()
      if l.cur == I then
        l:barhl(R ~= nil)
      end
    end)
  end
  u.toggle = function(l, I)
    TO:toggle(I)
    return l
  end
  local function l()
  end
  local I, R
  do
    I = function()
      return TO.dir .. "/configs"
    end
    local function K(e)
      return I() .. ("/" .. (e .. ".json"))
    end
    local function e(yO)
      return V(g(U(tostring(yO or ""), "[\\/:%*%?\"<>|]", ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "", 1, 40)
    end
    local function V()
      return os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    end
    local function U(yO)
      if not (yO) then
        return nil
      end
      local iO = dV(yO)
      return {iO.X.Scale, iO.X.Offset, iO.Y.Scale, iO.Y.Offset}
    end
    local function yO(iO)
      if type(iO) == "table" then
        if #iO == 4 then
          return x(tonumber(iO[1]) or 0, tonumber(iO[2]) or 0, tonumber(iO[3]) or 0, tonumber(iO[4]) or 0)
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function iO()
      local vO = LO.hold
      return {kbp = q and U(q.g), wmp = D and U(D.g), spp = J and U(J.g), mob = U(LO.mob), size = (vO and {vO.Size.X.Offset, vO.Size.Y.Offset}) or nil}
    end
    local function U(vO)
      if type(vO) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
      local mO = yO(vO.kbp)
      if mO then
        if q then
          if q.g then
            _V(q.g, mO)
          end
        end
      end
      mO = yO(vO.wmp)
      if mO then
        if D then
          if D.g then
            _V(D.g, mO)
          end
        end
      end
      mO = yO(vO.spp)
      if mO then
        if J then
          if J.g then
            _V(J.g, mO)
          end
        end
      end
      mO = yO(vO.mob)
      if mO then
        if LO.mob then
          _V(LO.mob, mO)
        end
      end
      local yO, mO = vO.size, LO.hold
      if mO then
        if type(yO) == "table" then
          if tonumber(yO[1]) then
            if tonumber(yO[2]) then
              mO.Size = v(Q(680, O(tonumber(yO[1]))), Q(400, O(tonumber(yO[2]))))
            end
          end
        end
      end
      eO()
    end
    local function yO()
      local vO, mO = {flags = {}, binds = {}, inds = {}, profs = {}, ui = iO()}, TO.profs
      for iO = 1, #mO, 1 do
        local FO = mO[iO]
        vO.profs[FO.id] = FO:ser()
      end
      mO = TO.els
      for iO = 1, #mO, 1 do
        local FO = mO[iO]
        iO = FO.flag
        if iO and FO.o.nocfg then
          vO.flags[iO] = FO:ser()
        elseif iO then
          if not (FO.prof) then
            vO.flags[iO] = FO:ser()
          end
          local mO = FO.bnd
          if mO and (mO.key or ((FO.kind == "sld") and (mO.v ~= FO.val))) then
            vO.binds[iO] = {k = mO.key, m = mO.mode, v = mO.v}
          end
          mO = FO.ind
          if mO and (mO.on or (mO.name ~= "")) then
            vO.inds[iO] = {on = mO.on, n = mO.name}
          end
        end
      end
      return vO
    end
    local function iO(vO)
      if type(vO) ~= "table" then
        return false
      end
      local mO, FO, CO, sO, rO = ((type(vO.flags) == "table") and vO.flags) or {}, ((type(vO.binds) == "table") and vO.binds) or {}, ((type(vO.inds) == "table") and vO.inds) or {}, ((type(vO.profs) == "table") and vO.profs) or {}, TO.els
      for ZV = 1, #rO, 1 do
        local AV = rO[ZV]
        ZV = AV.flag
        if ZV and AV.o.nocfg then
          local BV = mO[ZV]
          if BV ~= nil then
            AV:load(BV)
          end
        elseif ZV then
          if not (AV.prof) then
            local BV = mO[ZV]
            BV = if BV == nil then if AV.o.migrate then AV.o.migrate(mO) else BV else BV
            AV:load(if BV == nil then AV.def else BV)
          end
          local BV = AV.bnd
          if BV then
            local bV, lV, WV = FO[ZV]
            if type(bV) == "table" then
              lV, WV = ((type(bV.k) == "string") and bV.k) or nil, (((bV.m == "hold") or (bV.m == "toggle")) and bV.m) or nil
              if AV.kind == "sld" then
                if type(bV.v) == "number" then
                  BV.v = AV:rnd(bV.v)
                end
              end
            else
              if AV.kind == "sld" then
                BV.v = AV.val
              end
            end
            if BV.key ~= lV then
              AV:setbind(lV, WV)
            elseif WV then
              if BV.mode ~= WV then
                AV:setbind(lV, WV)
              end
            end
          end
          BV = AV.ind
          if BV then
            local bV = CO[ZV]
            if type(bV) == "table" then
              BV.on = bV.on == true
              BV.name = ((type(bV.n) == "string") and bV.n) or ""
            else
              BV.on = (AV.o.ind ~= nil) and (AV.o.ind ~= false)
              BV.name = ((type(AV.o.ind) == "string") and AV.o.ind) or ""
            end
          end
        end
      end
      rO = TO.profs
      for CO = 1, #rO, 1 do
        FO = rO[CO]
        mO = sO[FO.id]
        if type(mO) == "table" then
          FO:load(mO)
        else
          FO.data = {}
          FO:apply()
        end
      end
      U(vO.ui)
      nO()
      return true
    end
    local function U(vO, mO)
      local FO = lO({meta = {name = vO, modified = V(), ver = TO.ver}, data = mO})
      return (FO ~= nil) and qO.write(K(vO), FO)
    end
    local function vO(mO)
      LO.cfg = mO
      qO.write(TO.dir .. "/last.txt", mO or "")
    end
    local function mO(FO)
      if type(FO) ~= "string" then
        return nil
      elseif FO == "" then
        return nil
      end
      local CO = WO(FO)
      if CO then
      else
        local sO, rO = pcall(xO, FO)
        CO = if sO then (WO(rO)) else CO
      end
      if CO then
        if type(CO.data) == "table" then
          return CO.data
        end
      end
      return CO
    end
    local xO = {seen = {}, busy = {}, get = false, pack = function(FO)
      local CO = mO(FO)
      if type(CO) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      elseif type(CO.flags) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      end
      FO = {}
      for sO, rO in next, CO.flags, nil do
        local ZV = TO.fl[sO]
        if ZV then
          if not (ZV.o.nocfg) then
            FO[sO] = rO
          end
        else
          FO[sO] = rO
        end
      end
      return lO({data = {flags = FO, binds = CO.binds, inds = CO.inds, profs = CO.profs}})
    end, fail = function(FO, CO)
      if FO == 404 then
        return "Share code {" .. (tostring(CO) .. "} not found")
      elseif FO == 429 then
        return "Too many share requests, wait a minute"
      elseif FO == 413 then
        return "Config is too big to share"
      elseif FO == 400 then
        return "Config can not be shared"
      end
      return "Share server is not responding"
    end, names = function()
      local FO, CO = {}, qO.list(I())
      for sO = 1, #CO, 1 do
        local rO = g(CO[sO], "([^/\\]+)%.json$")
        if rO then
          FO[#FO + 1] = rO
        end
      end
      M(FO)
      return c(FO, "\000")
    end}
    TO.export = function(c)
      return lO({meta = {name = LO.cfg or "shared", modified = V(), ver = TO.ver}, data = yO()})
    end
    TO.share = function(V)
      local c = V:export()
      return (c and bO(c)) or nil
    end
    TO.import = function(V, c)
      V = mO(c)
      if not V then
        return false
      end
      return iO(V)
    end
    TO.save = function(V, c)
      c = e((c or LO.cfg) or "default")
      c = if c == "" then "default" else c
      if U(c, yO()) then
        vO(c)
        V:notify("Saved config {" .. (c .. "}"), "ok")
        l()
        return true
      end
      return false
    end
    TO.load = function(V, c)
      c = e(c)
      local FO = mO(qO.read(K(c)))
      if not (FO) then
        V:notify("Config {" .. (c .. "} is broken"), "bad")
        return false
      end
      iO(FO)
      vO(c)
      V:notify("Loaded config {" .. (c .. "}"), "ok")
      l()
      return true
    end
    TO.create = function(V, c, FO)
      c = e(c)
      if c == "" then
        V:notify("Enter a config name", "warn")
        return false
      end
      if qO.has(K(c)) then
        V:notify("Config {" .. (c .. "} already exists"), "warn")
        return false
      end
      FO = g(tostring(FO or ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
      if FO ~= "" then
        if xO.get then
          return false
        end
        local CO, sO = LO.share
        if CO then
          if #FO <= 32 then
            xO.get = true
            local rO, ZV, AV = pcall(CO.get, FO)
            xO.get = false
            if LO.dead then
              return false
            end
            local CO = (rO and mO(ZV)) or nil
            if not (CO) then
              V:notify(xO.fail(rO and AV, FO), "bad")
              return false
            end
            sO = CO
          else
            sO = (mO(FO))
          end
        else
          sO = (mO(FO))
        end
        if not (sO) then
          V:notify("Share code is invalid", "bad")
          return false
        end
        if qO.has(K(c)) then
          V:notify("Config {" .. (c .. "} already exists"), "warn")
          return false
        end
        iO(sO)
      end
      U(c, yO())
      vO(c)
      V:notify("Created config {" .. (c .. "}"), "ok")
      l()
      return true
    end
    TO.sharecode = function(V, U)
      U = e(U)
      local c = qO.read(K(U))
      if not (c) then
        return nil
      end
      local yO = LO.share
      if not (yO) then
        setclipboard(bO(c))
        V:notify("Share code for {" .. (U .. "} copied"))
        return true
      end
      local iO = xO.seen[U]
      if iO then
        if iO.raw == c then
          setclipboard(iO.code)
          V:notify("Share code {" .. (iO.code .. ("} for {" .. (U .. "} copied"))), "ok")
          return iO.code
        end
      end
      if xO.busy[U] then
        return nil
      end
      iO = xO.pack(c)
      if not iO then
        V:notify("Config {" .. (U .. "} is broken"), "bad")
        return nil
      end
      xO.busy[U] = true
      local bO, mO, FO = pcall(yO.put, iO)
      xO.busy[U] = nil
      if LO.dead then
        return nil
      end
      if (if bO then type(mO) ~= "string" else not bO) or (mO == "") then
        V:notify(xO.fail(bO and FO), "bad")
        return nil
      end
      xO.seen[U] = {raw = c, code = mO}
      setclipboard(mO)
      V:notify("Share code {" .. (mO .. ("} for {" .. (U .. "} copied"))), "ok")
      return mO
    end
    TO.delete = function(V, U)

        yO.meta.name = c
      end

        if not (qO.write(K(c), iO)) then
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
      qO.del(K(U))
      if LO.cfg == U then
        vO(c)
      end
      V:notify("Renamed {" .. (U .. ("} to {" .. (c .. "}"))))
      l()
      return true
    end

    end

-- Module f
modules.f = function()
  local G = table.create
  local i = table.clear
  local u, j = table.move, {trim = function(w, t)
    for Z = #w, t + 1, -1 do
      w[Z] = nil
    end
    return w
  end, drop = function(w, t)
    local Z = #w
    w[t] = w[Z]
    w[Z] = nil
  end}
  j.copy_with = function(w, t, Z)
    local h = #t
    u(t, 1, h, 1, w)
    if Z ~= nil then
      h += 1
      w[h] = Z
    else
    end
    return j.trim(w, h)
  end
  local w = {}
  w.__index = w
  w.new = function(t)
    return setmetatable({items = G(t or 8), head = 1, tail = 0}, w)
  end
  w.count = function(G)
    return (G.tail - G.head) + 1
  end
  w.push = function(G, t)
    local Z = G.tail + 1
    G.tail = Z
    G.items[Z] = t
    return t
  end
  w.peek = function(G)
    if G.head > G.tail then
      return nil
    end
    return G.items[G.head]
  end
  w.shift = function(G)
    local t = G.head
    if t > G.tail then
      return nil
    end
    local Z = G.items
    local h = Z[t]
    Z[t] = nil
    G.head = t + 1
    if G.head > G.tail then
      G.head = 1
      G.tail = 0
    elseif t > 64 then
      local A = G.tail - t
      u(Z, t + 1, G.tail, 1)
      j.trim(Z, A)
      G.head = 1
      G.tail = A
    end
    return h
  end
  w.remove = function(G, t)
    local Z = G.items
    u(Z, t + 1, G.tail, t)
    Z[G.tail] = nil
    G.tail = G.tail - 1
    if G.head > G.tail then
      G.head = 1
      G.tail = 0
    end
  end
  w.reset = function(G)
    i(G.items)
    G.head = 1
    G.tail = 0
  end
  j.queue = w
  local G = {}
  G.__index = G
  G.new = function(i, u)
    return setmetatable({items = {}, create = i, hide = u, count = 0, used = 0}, G)
  end
  G.open = function(i)
    i.used = 0
  end
  G.next = function(i)
    local u = i.used + 1
    i.used = u
    local w = i.items[u]
    if w == nil then
      w = i.create()
      if w == nil then
        i.used = u - 1
        return nil
      end
      i.items[u] = w
      if u > i.count then
        i.count = u
      end
    else
    end
    return w
  end
  G.close = function(i)
    local u = i.hide
    if not (u) then
      return
    end
    local w = i.items
    for t = i.used + 1, i.count, 1 do
      local i = w[t]
      if i ~= nil then
        u(i)
      end
    end
  end
  G.purge = function(i, u)
    local w = i.items
    for t = i.count, 1, -1 do
      local Z = w[t]
      w[t] = nil
      if Z ~= nil then
        if u then
          u(Z)
        end
      end
    end
    i.count = 0
    i.used = 0
  end
  j.pool = G
  return j
end

-- Module g
modules.g = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local u = G.storage
  local j = G.workspace
  local w = G.players
  local t, Z, h, A, B, d, _, b, x, v = os.clock, {version = 0}, {}, 0, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  local H = {GetAttribute = function(l, W)
    return rawget(l, "folder"):GetAttribute(W)
  end, GetAttributes = function(l)
    return rawget(l, "folder"):GetAttributes()
  end, GetAttributeChangedSignal = function(l, W)
    return rawget(l, "folder"):GetAttributeChangedSignal(W)
  end}
  local function l(W, q)
    return (W:IsA("Model") and (W:GetAttribute("Bot") == true)) and (W:GetAttribute("CombatantId") == q)
  end
  local function W(q, J, D, m)
    if not (q) then
      return D, m
    end
    local Y = q:GetChildren()
    for O = 1, #Y, 1 do
      q = Y[O]
      if l(q, J) then
        O = (((q:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true) and 2) or 0) + ((q:IsDescendantOf(j) and 1) or 0)
        if O > m then
          m, D = O, q
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return D, m
  end
  local function q(J)
    local D = rawget(J, "folder"):GetAttribute("CombatantId")
    if D == nil then
      return nil
    end
    local m = rawget(J, "m")
    if m then
      if m.Parent then
        if m:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true then
          if m:IsDescendantOf(j) then
            if l(m, D) then
              return m
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local l = t()
    if l < (rawget(J, "next") or 0) then
      return ((m and m.Parent) and m) or nil
    end
    rawset(J, "next", l + 0.1)
    l, m = W(j:FindFirstChild("Characters"), D, nil, -1)
    l = if m < 3 then W(u:FindFirstChild("_PVS_CulledCharacters"), D, l, m) else l
    rawset(J, "m", l)
    return l
  end
  local j = {__index = function(t, l)
    local W = H[l]
    if W then
      return W
    end
    W = rawget(t, "folder")
    if l == "Character" then
      return q(t)
    elseif l == "Parent" then
      return ((W.Parent ~= nil) and w) or nil
    elseif (l == "Name") or (l == "DisplayName") then
      local w = W:GetAttribute("DisplayName")
      return ((type(w) == "string") and w) or W.Name
    elseif l == "UserId" then
      local w = W:GetAttribute("UserId")
      return tonumber(w) or w
    elseif l == "avatar" then
      return W:GetAttribute("AvatarUserId")
    end
    return nil
  end, __tostring = function(w)
    return "npc:" .. tostring(rawget(w, "folder").Name)
  end}
  local function w()
    A = 0
    table.clear(d)
    table.clear(_)
    for t, H in B, nil, nil do
      A += 1
      h[A] = H
      local l = t:GetAttribute("ActorId")
      if l ~= nil then
        d[l] = H
      end
      l = t:GetAttribute("UserId")
      if l ~= nil then
        _[l] = H
        t = tonumber(l)
        if t then
          _[t] = H
        end
      end
    end
    local t, H = #h, A
    for l = t, H + 1, -1 do
      h[l] = nil
    end
    Z.version = Z.version + 1
  end
  local function t(H)
    if H:IsA("Folder") then
      if B[H] then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local l = setmetatable({folder = H}, j)
    B[H] = l
    w()
    i.connect(H:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ActorId"), w)
    for H = 1, #b, 1 do
      pcall(b[H], l)
    end
  end
  local function H(l)
    local W = B[l]
    if not (W) then
      return
    end
    B[l] = nil
    w()
    for w = 1, #x, 1 do
      pcall(x[w], W)
    end
  end
  local function w(l)
    if v == l then
      return
    end
    v = l
    i.connect(l.ChildAdded, t)
    i.connect(l.ChildRemoved, H)
    local v = l:GetChildren()
    for H = 1, #v, 1 do
      t(v[H])
    end
  end
  Z.list = function()
    local t = A
    return h, t
  end
  Z.is = function(t)
    return (type(t) == "table") and (getmetatable(t) == j)
  end
  Z.actor = function(j)
    return ((j ~= nil) and d[j]) or nil
  end
  Z.key = function(j)
    if j == nil then
      return nil
    end
    return _[j] or _[tonumber(j) or j]
  end
  Z.on = function(j, t)
    if j then
      b[#b + 1] = j
    end
    if t then
      x[#x + 1] = t
    end
  end
  G = u:FindFirstChild("Combatants")
  if G then
    w(G)
  end
  i.connect(u.ChildAdded, function(G)
    if G.Name == "Combatants" then
      if G:IsA("Folder") then
        w(G)
      end
    end
  end)
  i.teardown(function()
    table.clear(B)
    table.clear(d)
    table.clear(_)
    table.clear(b)
    table.clear(x)
    table.clear(h)
    A = 0
  end)
  return Z
end

-- Module h
modules.h = function()
  local G, i, u, j = modules.load("b"), modules.load("f"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("g")
  local w = G.players
  local G, t, Z, h = i.trim, {}, 0, true
  local i = -1
  local function A()
    h = true
  end
  local function B()
    h = true
    task.defer(A)
  end
  u.connect(w.PlayerAdded, A)
  u.connect(w.PlayerRemoving, B)
  B = {all = function()
    local A, d = h
    if A then
      d = A
    else
      local _ = i
      d = _ ~= j.version
    end
    if d then
      h = false
      i = j.version
      A = w:GetPlayers()
      local i = #A
      for w = 1, i, 1 do
        t[w] = A[w]
      end
      local w, A = j.list()
      for j = 1, A, 1 do
        i += 1
        t[i] = w[j]
      end
      G(t, i)
      Z = i
    end
    d = Z
    return t, d
  end, reset = function()
    G(t, 0)
    Z, h = 0, true
  end}
  u.teardown(B.reset)
  return B
end
