-- Module k
modules.k = function()
  local G, i, u = modules.load("b"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("g")
  local j = G.lp
  local w = G.workspace
  local t, Z = G.storage, i.kinematics
  local h = Vector3.zero
  local A = Vector3.new
  local B = math.min
  local d = math.max
  local _, b, x = math.atan2, {["Counter-Terrorists"] = true, Terrorists = true}, {run = 19.5, walk = 0.52, duck = 0.34, scope = 0.6}
  G = t:FindFirstChild("MovementV2")
  G = G and (G:FindFirstChild("SpeedProfile"))
  if G then
    if G:IsA("ModuleScript") then
      i, t = pcall(require, G)
      if i then
        if type(t) == "table" then
          if type(t.TopSpeed) == "number" then
            if t.TopSpeed > 0 then
              x.run = t.TopSpeed
            end
          end
          if type(t.WalkModifier) == "number" then
            if t.WalkModifier > 0 then
              x.walk = t.WalkModifier
            end
          end
          if type(t.CrouchModifier) == "number" then
            if t.CrouchModifier > 0 then
              x.duck = t.CrouchModifier
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local G = {spd = x, slots = {}}
  local i = G.slots
  local function t(v)
    local H = v.LookVector
    return _(-H.X, -H.Z)
  end
  local function _(v, H)
    if Z then
      if type(Z.getVelocity) == "function" then
        local l, W = pcall(Z.getVelocity, v, H)
        if l then
          if typeof(W) == "Vector3" then
            return W
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return H.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  end
  local function Z(v)
    if typeof(v) ~= "Vector3" then
      return h
    end
    return A(v.X, 0, v.Z)
  end
  G.slot = function(A)
    local v = i[A]
    if v then
    else
      v = {plr = A, mode = "none", pos = nil, at = 0, hit = 0, vel = h, yaw = 0, err = 0, gen = nil, live = nil, cur = nil, cerr = 0, ghost = nil, stand = nil, duck = nil, snap = 0, spos = nil, svel = h, syaw = 0, dk = 0, void = false, seen = nil, peek = 0}
      i[A] = v
    end
    return v
  end
  G.drop = function(A)
    i[A] = nil
  end
  G.frozen = function()
    return w:GetAttribute("GameState") == "Buy Period"
  end
  G.who = function(A)
    return (typeof(A) == "Instance") or u.is(A)
  end
  local function u(A)
    return A:GetAttribute("CharacterGeneration") or A:GetAttribute("Generation")
  end
  G.dead = function(A)
    if A:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= false then
      return true
    end
    local v = A:GetAttribute("Health")
    if type(v) == "number" then
      if v <= 0 then
        return true
      end
    end
    local H = A.Character
    if H then
      if H:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
        return true
      end
      v = H:GetAttribute("Health")
      if type(v) == "number" then
        if v <= 0 then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    v = i[A]
    return (((v ~= nil) and (v.died ~= nil)) and ((os.clock() - v.died) < 2)) and (v.died_gen == u(A))
  end
  G.kill = function(i)
    i.died = os.clock()
    i.died_gen = u(i.plr)
    i.mode = "none"
    i.live = nil
  end
  G.enemy = function(i)
    if i == j then
      return false
    elseif not (G.who(i)) then
      return false
    end
    local A = i:GetAttribute("Team")
    if not (b[A]) then
      return false
    end
    if w:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Deathmatch" then
      return true
    end
    return A ~= j:GetAttribute("Team")
  end
  G.shown = function(i)
    local j = i.Character
    if j then
      if j.Parent then
        if not (j:IsDescendantOf(w)) then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    if j:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
      return nil
    elseif j:GetAttribute("ClientCharacterPresentationVisible") == false then
      return nil
    end
    i = j:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if i then
      if not (i:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    return j, i
  end
  G.spawn = function(i, j, w)
    local A = i.plr
    local b, v, H = A:GetAttribute("PresentationSpawnPosition"), A:GetAttribute("PresentationSpawnYaw"), 1
    i.stand = nil
    i.duck = nil
    i.void = false
    i.seen = nil
    if w then
      if ((j - i.snap) < 1) and i.spos then
        b, v, H = i.spos, i.syaw, 0.3
      else
        b = if G.frozen() then b else nil
      end
    else
    end
    if typeof(b) ~= "Vector3" then
      i.mode = "none"
      i.live = nil
      return
    end
    i.pos = b
    i.at = j
    i.hit = 0
    i.vel = h
    i.err = H
    i.yaw = ((type(v) == "number") and v) or 0
    i.mode = "est"
  end
  G.snap = function(i, j, w, A, b, v)
    i.snap = v
    i.spos = j
    i.svel = Z(w)
    i.syaw = ((type(A) == "number") and A) or i.syaw
    i.dk = ((type(b) == "number") and b) or 0
    if i.mode == "live" then
      return
    elseif G.dead(i.plr) then
      return
    end
    i.pos = j
    i.vel = i.svel
    i.yaw = i.syaw
    i.at = v
    i.hit = v
    i.err = 0.3
    i.mode = "est"
    i.void = false
    i.seen = nil
  end
  G.sync = function(i, j, w)
    local A = i.plr
    if G.dead(A) then
      i.mode = "none"
      i.live = nil
      return
    end
    local b = u(A)
    if b ~= i.gen then
      local u = i.gen == nil
      i.gen = b
      G.spawn(i, j, u)
    end
    local u, b = G.shown(A)
    if u then
      A = b.CFrame
      i.pos = A.Position
      i.vel = Z(_(u, b))
      i.yaw = t(A)
      i.at = j
      i.hit = j
      i.err = 0.5
      i.mode = "live"
      i.live = u
      i.void = false
      i.seen = nil
      return
    end
    if i.mode == "live" then
      i.mode = "est"
      i.live = nil
      i.void = false
      i.seen = nil
      if i.spos then
        if (j - i.snap) < 0.25 then
          i.pos = i.spos
          i.vel = i.svel
          i.yaw = i.syaw
          i.at = i.snap
          i.hit = i.snap
          i.err = 0.3
        else
          i.at = j
        end
      else
        i.at = j
      end
    end
    if w then
      if i.mode == "est" then
        i.at = j
        i.vel = h
      end
    end
  end
  G.crouched = function(i, u)
    if (u - i.snap) < 0.5 then
      return i.dk >= 0.5
    end
    return i.plr:GetAttribute("IsCrouching") == true
  end
  G.guess = function(i, u)
    local j, w = i.pos, u - i.at
    if j then
      if w <= 0 then
        return j, i.err
      end
    else
      return j, i.err
    end
    local t = i.plr
    local Z, h = if G.crouched(i, u) then x.run * x.duck else if t:GetAttribute("IsWalking") == true then x.run * x.walk else if t:GetAttribute("IsSniperScoped") == true then x.run * x.scope else x.run, i.vel
    local u, t, A = h.Magnitude, j + (h * B(w, 0.3)), w - 0.3
    if A <= 0 then
      return t, i.err
    end
    return if u > 0.5 then if Z > 0 then t + (h * ((B(u, Z) / u) * B(A, 1.5))) else t else t, i.err + (A * d(Z, 3))
  end
  return G
end

-- Module l
modules.l = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local u = G.storage
  local j = math.clamp
  local w = Vector3.new
  local t, Z = Vector3.one, {"Head", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand", "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand", "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot", "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"}
  local h = Instance.new("Folder")
  i.own(h)
  local A = {}
  local B = G.weak()
  local G = {names = Z, owners = B}
  local function d(_)
    local b = _:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if b then
      if not (b:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local x, v, H, l = b.CFrame:Inverse(), {}, {}, 0
    for W = 1, #Z, 1 do
      local q = Z[W]
      W = _:FindFirstChild(q)
      if W then
        if W:IsA("BasePart") then
          v[q] = x * W.CFrame
          H[q] = W.Size
          l += 1
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    if l < 8 then
      return nil
    end
    return {off = v, size = H, root = b.Size}
  end
  G.grab = d
  local function _(b)
    local x = {}
    for v, H in b.off, nil, nil do
      x[v] = H - w(0, 1.35 * j((H.Position.Y + 3) / 4.4, 0, 1), 0)
    end
    return {off = x, size = b.size, root = b.root}
  end
  G.kit = function(j)
    if type(j) ~= "string" then
      return nil
    end
    local b = A[j]
    if b ~= nil then
      return b or nil
    end
    b = u:FindFirstChild("Assets")
    b = b and (b:FindFirstChild("Characters"))
    local u = b and (b:FindFirstChild(j))
    b = (u and d(u)) or nil
    A[j] = b or false
    return b
  end
  G.learn = function(u, j, b, x)
    local v = (b and "duck") or "stand"
    if u.stance ~= v then
      u.stance = v
      u.since = x
      return
    end
    if (x - (u.since or 0)) < 0.35 then
      return
    elseif (x - (u.learnt or 0)) < 0.25 then
      return
    end
    b = d(j)
    if b then
      u.learnt = x
      u[v] = b
    end
  end
  G.pick = function(u, j)
    if j then
      if u.duck then
        return u.duck
      end
    end
    local b = u.stand
    if b == nil then
      local x = u.plr.Character
      b = (((x and x.Parent) and (x:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true)) and d(x)) or false
      u.stand = b
    else
    end
    b = b or G.kit(G.look(u.plr))
    if not (b) then
      return u.duck
    end
    if not (j) then
      return b
    end
    u = b.low
    if u then
    else
      u = _(b)
      b.low = u
    end
    return u
  end
  local function u(j, d, _)
    local b = Instance.new("Part")
    b.Name = j
    b.Size = d
    b.Anchored = true
    b.CanCollide = false
    b.CanQuery = false
    b.CanTouch = false
    b.CastShadow = false
    b.Massless = true
    b.Transparency = 1
    b.Parent = _
    return b
  end
  G.look = function(j)
    return j:GetAttribute("PresentationCharacterName") or j:GetAttribute("CharacterName")
  end
  G.ghost = function(j, d)
    local _, b = G.look(j.plr) or "?", j.ghost
    if (b and (b.key == _)) and (b.model.Parent == h) then
      if b.src ~= d.size then
        b.src = d.size
        for x, v in b.parts, nil, nil do
          local H = d.size[x]
          if H then
            if v.Size ~= H then
              v.Size = H
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return b
    end
    if b then
      B[b.model] = nil
      pcall(b.model.Destroy, b.model)
    end
    local x = Instance.new("Model")
    x.Name = j.plr.Name
    local v, H = u("HumanoidRootPart", d.root or w(2, 2, 1), x), {}
    for w = 1, #Z, 1 do
      local l = Z[w]
      H[l] = u(l, d.size[l] or t, x)
    end
    x.PrimaryPart = v
    x:SetAttribute("CharacterType", "PlayerCustomCharacter")
    x:SetAttribute("Dead", false)
    x.Parent = h
    b = {model = x, root = v, parts = H, key = _, src = d.size}
    j.ghost = b
    B[x] = j.plr
    return b
  end
  G.place = function(u, j, w)
    u.root.CFrame = w
    local t = j.off
    for Z, h in u.parts, nil, nil do
      j = t[Z]
      if j then
        h.CFrame = w * j
      end
    end
  end
  G.mirror = function(u, j)
    local w, t = u.model, j:GetAttribute("Health")
    if u.hp ~= t then
      u.hp = t
      w:SetAttribute("Health", t)
    end
    t = j:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
    if u.cap ~= t then
      u.cap = t
      w:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", t)
    end
  end
  G.drop = function(u)
    local j = u.ghost
    u.ghost = nil
    if j then
      B[j.model] = nil
      pcall(j.model.Destroy, j.model)
    end
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    table.clear(A)
  end)
  return G
end

-- Module m
modules.m = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local u, j = modules.load("j"), modules.load("g")
  local w = modules.load("k")
  local t = G.players
  local G = u.remotes
  local u, Z = w.slots, {}
  local function h(A)
    if type(A) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    local B = tonumber(A.Victim)
    if not (B) then
      return
    end
    A = ((B > 0) and t:GetPlayerByUserId(B)) or j.key(B)
    B = A and u[A]
    if B then
      w.kill(B)
    end
  end
  local u = false
  Z.start = function()
    if u then
      return
    end
    u = true
    i.spawn(function()
      local u = G and G.UI
      local G = ((type(u) == "table") and u.UIPlayerKilled) or nil
      if type(G) ~= "table" then
        return
      elseif type(G.Listen) ~= "function" then
        return
      end
      local u, j = pcall(G.Listen, function(G)
        pcall(h, G)
      end)
      if u then
        if type(j) == "function" then
          i.adopt(j)
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  return Z
end

-- Module n
modules.n = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local u, j = modules.load("j"), modules.load("g")
  local w = modules.load("i")
  local t = modules.load("k")
  local Z = G.lp
  local h = G.players
  local A = G.storage
  local G, B, d = u.snap_codec, u.root_frame, os.clock
  local u = Vector3.new
  local _ = ((type(G) == "table") and G.decode) or nil
  local b = ((type(G) == "table") and G.applyDeltaToCanonicalBaseline) or nil
  local G, x, v = ((type(B) == "table") and B.simulationToVisualRootPosition) or nil, {}
  local B, H = {}
  local l = {}
  local W, q, J, D = -1, {}, {tick = -1, at = 0, wanted = false}, {}
  J.listen = function(m)
    D[#D + 1] = m
  end
  local function m(Y)
    local O, Q = Y.Position, Y.DuckAmount or 0
    if G then
      local Y, F = pcall(G, O, Q)
      if Y then
        if typeof(F) == "Vector3" then
          return F
        end
      end
    end
    return O - u(0, ((((Q >= 0.999) and 4.05) or 5.4) * 0.5) - 3, 0)
  end
  local function G(u)
    if type(u) ~= "number" then
      return nil
    elseif u <= 0 then
      return nil
    end
    local Y = q[u]
    if (Y == nil) or (Y.Parent ~= h) then
      Y = h:GetPlayerByUserId(u) or false
      q[u] = Y
    else
    end
    return Y or nil
  end
  local function u(Y, O)
    local Q = #D > 0
    for F, I in Y, nil, nil do
      F = G(I.UserId) or j.actor(I.ActorId)
      if F and (F ~= Z) then
        local G = t.enemy(F)
        if G or Q then
          local j = m(I)
          if G and (w.vis or w.aim) then
            t.snap(t.slot(F), j, I.Velocity, I.LookYaw, I.DuckAmount, O)
          end
          if Q then
            for G = 1, #D, 1 do
              pcall(D[G], F, j, I, O)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function G(j, t)
    local Z = j.Sequence
    if Z == v then
      return
    end
    if Z ~= H then
      H, B = Z, {}
      table.clear(l)
    end
    local D = j.ChunkIndex or 0
    if l[D] then
      return
    end
    l[D] = true
    D = j.Actors or {}
    for m, Y in D, nil, nil do
      m = B
      m[Y.ActorId] = Y
    end
    local m = j.ServerTick
    if type(m) == "number" then
      if m >= W then
        W = m
        J.tick = m
        J.at = t
        u(D, t)
      end
    end
    m, D = j.ChunkCount or 1, 0
    for j in l, nil, nil do
      D += 1
    end
    if D >= m then
      x, v, B, H = B, Z, {}, nil
      table.clear(l)
    end
  end
  local function j(t, Z)
    local D = t.ServerTick
    if type(D) ~= "number" then
      return
    elseif D <= W then
      return
    end
    W = D
    J.tick = D
    J.at = Z
    local W, m = {}, 0
    if t.BaselineSequence == v then
      D = {}
      for Y, Y in t.RemovedActorIds or {}, nil, nil do
        D[Y] = true
      end
      local Y = {}
      if b then
        local O = t.Deltas or {}
        for Q, F in O, nil, nil do
          Q = x
          local O = Q[F.ActorId]
          if O then
            if not (D[F.ActorId]) then
              local Q, I = pcall(b, O, F)
              if Q then
                if type(I) == "table" then
                  Y[F.ActorId] = I
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local b = x
      for O, Q in b, nil, nil do
        if D[O] then
        else
          m += 1
          W[m] = Y[O] or Q
        end
      end
    else
    end
    for b, b in t.Actors or {}, nil, nil do
      m += 1
      W[m] = b
    end
    u(W, Z)
  end
  local function u(t)
    if w.vis then
      if not (_) then
        return
      end
    elseif w.aim then
      if not (_) then
        return
      end
    elseif J.wanted then
      if not (_) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local w, Z = pcall(_, t)
    if w then
      if type(Z) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    w = d()
    if Z.Kind == "Baseline" then
      G(Z, w)
    elseif Z.Kind == "Delta" then
      j(Z, w)
    end
  end
  local G = false
  J.start = function()
    if G then
      return
    elseif not (_) then
      return
    end
    G = true
    i.spawn(function()
      local G = A:WaitForChild("MovementV2Remotes", 30)
      local j = G and (G:WaitForChild("RemoteSnapshot", 30))
      if not (j) then
        return
      end
      i.connect(j.OnClientEvent, function(G)
        pcall(u, G)
      end)
    end)
  end
  i.connect(h.PlayerRemoving, function(G)
    q[G.UserId] = nil
  end)
  i.teardown(function()
    table.clear(x)
    table.clear(B)
    table.clear(l)
    table.clear(q)
    v, H = nil, nil
  end)
  return J
end

-- Module o
modules.o = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local u = G.workspace
  local j = G.collection
  local w = G.lp
  local G = os.clock
  local t = string.lower
  local Z, h, A, B, d = string.sub, {barriers = true, pvscells = true, pvsvolumes = true, pvsstaticocclusion = true, pvsvisibilitygeometry = true}, {"BreakableDoor", "BreakableGlass", "Ceiling Fan", "Flag", "Flower Pot", "Garage", "Market Window", "Snowman", "Television", "TugBoat", "Vent", "VertigoCar", "VertigoCrane", "VertigoGenerator", "Water"}, {"BreakableDoor", "BreakableGlass", "Garage", "Market Window", "Vent"}, {}
  d[Enum.Material.Glass] = true
  d[Enum.Material.ForceField] = true
  local _ = {["Counter-Terrorists"] = true, Terrorists = true}
  local b = Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency
  local x = RaycastParams.new()
  x.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
  x.IgnoreWater = true
  x.RespectCanCollide = false
  local v, H = {ready = false}
  local l = 0
  local function W(q, J)
    return (q:GetAttribute(J) == true) or j:HasTag(q, J)
  end
  local function q(J, D)
    for m = 1, #D, 1 do
      if j:HasTag(J, D[m]) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function j(J)
    return (W(J, "PVSIgnore") or W(J, "PVSDynamic")) or q(J, A)
  end
  local function A(J)
    local D = t(J)
    return (h[D] == true) or (Z(D, 1, 24) == "__pvsvisibilityobjstage_")
  end
  local function t(Z)
    if Z.Anchored then
      if d[Z.Material] then
        return false
      elseif Z.Transparency > 0.01 then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local h = Z:GetChildren()
    for d = 1, #h, 1 do
      Z = h[d]
      if Z:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
        if Z.AlphaMode == b then
          return false
        end
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local function Z(h)
    return (((h:GetAttribute("PVSNegativeAuthority") ~= nil) or (h:GetAttribute("PVSVisibilityGeometryVersion") ~= nil)) or (h:GetAttribute("PVSVisibilityGeometryComplete") ~= nil)) or (h:GetAttribute("PVSVisibilityGeometryFingerprint") ~= nil)
  end
  local function h(d, b, J)
    if A(d.Name) then
      return 0
    end
    local D, m, Y, O, Q, F, I = {d}, {W(d, "PVSOccluder")}, {j(d)}, 1, 0, 0, (G())
    while O > 0 do
      local E, V, N = D[O], m[O], Y[O]
      D[O] = nil
      m[O] = nil
      Y[O] = nil
      O -= 1
      if V then
        if N then
        else
          if E:IsA("BasePart") then
            if t(E) then
              d = Q + 1
              b[d] = E
              Q = d
            else
            end
          else
          end
        end
      else
      end
      local t = E:GetChildren()
      for d = 1, #t, 1 do
        E = t[d]
        if A(E.Name) then
        else
          O += 1
          D[O] = E
          m[O] = V or W(E, "PVSOccluder")
          Y[O] = N or j(E)
        end
      end
      F += 1
      if (F % 64) == 0 then
        if (G() - I) > 0.004 then
          task.wait()
          if not (J()) then
            return nil
          end
          I = (G())
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return Q
  end
  local function j(t, A, d)
    local b = t:FindFirstChild("Barriers") or t:FindFirstChild("Barriers", true)
    if not (b) then
      return 0
    end
    t = b:GetDescendants()
    t[#t + 1] = b
    local W, J = 0, (G())
    for D = 1, #t, 1 do
      local m = t[D]
      if (m:IsA("BasePart") and m.CanQuery) and ((m:IsA("Part") or m:IsA("WedgePart")) or m:IsA("CornerWedgePart")) then
        local t, Y = m, false
        while t do
          local O = Y
          if (t:GetAttribute("PVSIgnore") == true) or q(t, B) then
            Y = true
            break
          end
          if t == b then
            Y = O
            break
          end
          t = t.Parent
        end
        if Y then
        else
          W += 1
          A[W] = m
        end
      else
      end
      if (D % 64) == 0 then
        if (G() - J) > 0.004 then
          task.wait()
          if not (d()) then
            return nil
          end
          J = (G())
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return W
  end
  local function G(t)
    l += 1
    local A = l
    H = t
    v.ready = false
    x.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}
    if not t then
      return
    end
    i.spawn(function()
      local function B()
        local d = (l == A) and (t.Parent ~= nil)
        return d
      end
      for A = 1, 5, 1 do
        if not (B()) then
          return
        end
        local d, b = {}, Z(t)
        local Z = ((b and h) or j)(t, d, B)
        if Z then
          if not (B()) then
            return
          end
        else
          return
        end
        local j = (b and tonumber(t:GetAttribute("PVSVisibilityExportExpectedParts"))) or nil
        if (Z > 0) and ((if j then Z >= (j * 0.9) else not j) or (A == 5)) then
          b = u:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
          if b then
            d[Z + 1] = b
          end
          x.FilterDescendantsInstances = d
          v.ready = true
          return
        end
        task.wait(2)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function j()
    local t = u:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if t then
      if t:GetAttribute("MapName") ~= nil then
        return t
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  v.sync = function()
    local t = j()
    if t ~= H then
      G(t)
    end
    return v.ready
  end
  v.eye = function()
    if v.ready then
      if not (_[w:GetAttribute("Team")]) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local G = w.Character
    if G then
      if G:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= false then
        return nil
      elseif not (G:IsDescendantOf(u)) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local j = G:FindFirstChild("CameraPart") or G:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if j then
      if j:IsA("BasePart") then
        return j.Position
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  v.clear = function(G, j)
    return u:Raycast(G, j - G, x) == nil
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    l += 1
    H = nil
    v.ready = false
    x.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}
  end)
  return v
end

-- Module p
modules.p = function()
  local G, i, u = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("h")
  local j, w = modules.load("g"), modules.load("i")
  local t = modules.load("k")
  local Z = modules.load("l")
  local h, A, B = modules.load("m"), modules.load("n"), modules.load("o")
  local d, _ = G.players, G.lp
  local G = os.clock
  local b = t.slots
  local x = Z.owners
  local v = math.clamp
  local H = math.min
  local l = CFrame.new
  local W, q = CFrame.Angles, {cfg = w, state = t, snap = A, sight = B}
  local function J(D)
    local m = b[D]
    if m then
      Z.drop(m)
      t.drop(D)
    end
  end
  local function D(m, Y)
    return (((((m.mode == "est") and not m.void) and (m.ghost ~= nil)) and (m.cur ~= nil)) and ((Y - m.at) <= w.mem)) and (m.cerr <= w.err)
  end
  local function m(Y, O, Q, F, I)
    if (F - Y.peek) < 0.05 then
      return
    end
    Y.peek = F
    local E = O.parts
    local V, N = E.Head, E.UpperTorso
    if (V and B.clear(Q, V.Position)) or (N and B.clear(Q, N.Position)) then
      O = Y.seen
      if O then
        if (F - O) >= I then
          Y.void = true
        end
      else
        Y.seen = F
      end
    else
      Y.seen = nil
    end
  end
  q.step = function()
    if not (w.vis) then
      if not (w.aim) then
        return
      end
    end
    local Y, O, Q, F, I, E = G(), t.frozen(), (B.sync() and B.eye()) or nil, w.peek + (v(tonumber(_:GetAttribute("Ping")) or 100, 0, 500) / 1000), u.all()
    for u = 1, E, 1 do
      local B = I[u]
      if t.enemy(B) then
        u = t.slot(B)
        t.sync(u, Y, O)
        if u.mode == "live" then
          Z.learn(u, u.live, t.crouched(u, Y), Y)
        elseif u.mode == "est" then
          local _, O = t.guess(u, Y)
          u.cur = _
          u.cerr = O
          if _ then
            O = Z.pick(u, t.crouched(u, Y))
            if O then
              local I = Z.ghost(u, O)
              Z.place(I, O, l(_) * W(0, u.yaw, 0))
              Z.mirror(I, B)
              if Q then
                if D(u, Y) then
                  m(u, I, Q, Y, F)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      elseif b[B] then
        J(B)
      end
    end
  end
  q.char = function(u)
    if w.vis then
      if not (t.who(u)) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local B = b[u]
    if not (B) then
      return nil
    end
    if B.mode == "live" then
      return B.live
    end
    if D(B, G()) then
      return B.ghost.model
    end
    return false
  end
  q.armed = function(u, B)
    if not (w.aim) then
      return false
    end
    local _ = b[u]
    return (((((_ ~= nil) and (_.mode == "est")) and not _.void) and (_.ghost ~= nil)) and (_.ghost.model == B)) and ((G() - _.hit) <= w.age)
  end
  q.target = function(u)
    local B = w.aim and b[u]
    if B then
      if B.mode == "est" then
        if not (B.void) then
          if B.ghost then
            if (G() - B.hit) <= w.age then
              return B.ghost.model
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return u.Character
  end
  q.ghost = function(u)
    return (u ~= nil) and (x[u] ~= nil)
  end
  q.fade = function(u)
    local B = t.who(u) and b[u]
    if B then
      if B.mode ~= "est" then
        return 1
      end
    else
      return 1
    end
    u = G()
    if (u - B.hit) < 0.25 then
      local t = B.cerr
      if t then
        if t <= 1 then
          return 1
        end
      else
        return 1
      end
    end
    return v(H(1 - ((B.cerr or 0) / w.err), 1 - ((u - B.at) / (((w.mem > 0) and w.mem) or 1))) * 0.85, 0.2, 0.85)
  end
  q.info = function(u)
    local w = b[u]
    if not (w) then
      return nil
    end
    return w.mode, w.cur or w.pos, w.cerr, G() - w.at, G() - w.snap, w.void
  end
  i.connect(d.PlayerRemoving, J)
  j.on(nil, J)
  i.teardown(function()
    for G, i in b, nil, nil do
      Z.drop(i)
      b[G] = nil
    end
  end)
  h.start()
  A.start()
  return q
end

-- Module t
modules.t = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u = modules.load("a"), G.guiservice
  local j = math.min
  local w = math.max
  local t, Z, h = Vector2.new, {Line = {"From", "To"}, Square = {"Position", "Size"}, Image = {"Position", "Size"}, Text = {"Position"}, Circle = {"Position"}, Triangle = {"PointA", "PointB", "PointC"}}, {}

    for _ = 1, #B, 1 do
      d[B[_]] = true
    end
    h[A] = d
  end
  local A, B, d, _, b, x, v, H, l = {}, 0, 0, {}, 0, {}, 0, {}, {}
  local function W(q, J, D, m, Y)
    local O = B
    for Q = 1, O, 1 do
      local O = A[Q]
      if q < (O[3] + Y) then
        if D > (O[1] - Y) then
          if J < (O[4] + Y) then
            if m > (O[2] - Y) then
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function q()
    B = 0
    local J = G.drawmask()
    if not (J) then
      return
    end
    local G = #J
    if G == 0 then
      return
    end
    local D = u:GetGuiInset()
    for u = 1, G, 1 do
      local G = J[u]
      if typeof(G) == "Instance" then
        if G.Parent then
          if G.Visible then
            local J, m = G.AbsolutePosition, G.AbsoluteSize
            if m.X > 0.5 then
              if m.Y > 0.5 then
                B += 1
                u = A[B]
                if u then
                else
                  u = {}
                  A[B] = u
                end
                u[1] = J.X + D.X
                u[2] = J.Y + D.Y
                u[3] = u[1] + m.X
                u[4] = u[2] + m.Y
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function G(u, J)
    local D, m, Y, O, Q = u.X, u.Y, J.X, J.Y, B
    local F = false
    for I = 1, Q, 1 do
      local Q, E, V, N, a, U = A[I], Y - D, O - m, 0, 1, true
      if E == 0 then
        U = if D < Q[1] then false else if D > Q[3] then false else U
      else
        local g, X = (Q[1] - D) / E, (Q[3] - D) / E
        if g > X then
          g, X = X, g
        else
        end
        N, a = if g > N then g else N, if X < a then X else a
      end
      if U then
        if V == 0 then
          U = if m < Q[2] then false else if m > Q[4] then false else U
        else
          local g, X = (Q[2] - m) / V, (Q[4] - m) / V
          if g > X then
            g, X = X, g
          else
          end
          N, a = if g > N then g else N, if X < a then X else a
        end
      else
      end
      if U then
        if N <= a then
          Q = ((E * E) + (V * V)) ^ 0.5
          if (N * Q) < 1 then
            if ((1 - a) * Q) < 1 then
              return nil
            end
          end
          if N >= (1 - a) then
            local Q, U = D + (E * N), m + (V * N)
            Y, O = Q, U
          else
            local Q, N = D + (E * a), m + (V * a)
            D, m = Q, N
          end
          I = true
          F = I
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    if not (F) then
      return u, J
    end
    return t(D, m), t(Y, O)
  end
  local function u(J, D)
    local m, Y = J.X, J.Y
    local O, Q, F = m + D.X, Y + D.Y, B
    local I = false
    for E = 1, F, 1 do
      local F = A[E]
      if m < F[3] then
        if O > F[1] then
          if Y < F[4] then
            if Q > F[2] then

              if F[2] > Y then
                E = j(Q, F[2])
                local X = (O - m) * (E - Y)
                if X > V then
                  V, N, a, U, g = X, m, Y, O, E
                else
                end
              else
              end
              if F[4] < Q then
                local E = w(Y, F[4])
                local X = (O - m) * (Q - E)
                if X > V then
                  V, N, a, U, g = X, m, E, O, Q
                else
                end
              else
              end
              if F[1] > m then
                local E = j(O, F[1])
                local X = (E - m) * (Q - Y)
                if X > V then
                  V, N, a, U, g = X, m, Y, E, Q
                else
                end
              else
              end
              if F[3] < O then
                local E = w(m, F[3])
                local F = (O - E) * (Q - Y)
                if F > V then
                  V, m = F, E
                else
                  m, Y, O, Q = N, a, U, g
                end
              else
                m, Y, O, Q = N, a, U, g
              end
              if V <= 1 then
                return nil
              end
              local F = true
              I = F
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    if not (I) then
      return J, D
    end
    return t(m, Y), t(O - m, Q - Y)
  end
  local function J(D)
    local m, Y, O = D.d, D.w, D.keys
    for Q = 1, #O, 1 do
      local F = O[Q]
      m[F] = Y[F]
    end
    D.hid = false
    m.Visible = true
  end
  local function D(m)
    local Y, O, Q = m.d, m.w, m.cls
    if not (O.Visible) then
      Y.Visible = false
      m.hid = false
      return
    end
    if B == 0 then
      J(m)
      return
    end
    if Q == "Line" then
      local F, I = G(O.From, O.To)
      if not (F) then
        Y.Visible = false
        m.hid = true
        return
      end
      Y.From = F
      Y.To = I
      m.hid = false
      Y.Visible = true
      return
    end
    if Q == "Square" then
      if Y.Filled then
        local G, F = u(O.Position, O.Size)
        if not (G) then
          Y.Visible = false
          m.hid = true
          return
        end
        Y.Position = G
        Y.Size = F
        m.hid = false
        Y.Visible = true
        return
      end
    end
    local G, u, F, I
    if Q == "Text" then
      local E, V = O.Position, Y.TextBounds
      G = (Y.Center and (E.X - (V.X * 0.5))) or E.X
      u = G + V.X
      F, I = E.Y, E.Y + V.Y
    else
      if Q == "Circle" then
        local E, V = O.Position, Y.Radius
        G, F, u, I = E.X - V, E.Y - V, E.X + V, E.Y + V
      else
        if Q == "Triangle" then
          local Q, E, V = O.PointA, O.PointB, O.PointC
          G, u, F = j(Q.X, E.X, V.X), w(Q.X, E.X, V.X), j(Q.Y, E.Y, V.Y)
          I = w(Q.Y, E.Y, V.Y)
        else
          local j, w = O.Position, O.Size
          G, F, u, I = j.X, j.Y, j.X + w.X, j.Y + w.Y
        end
      end
    end
    if W(G, F, u, I, (m.hid and 6) or 0) then
      Y.Visible = false
      m.hid = true
      return
    end
    J(m)
  end
  local function G(u)
    local j = H[u]
    if not (j) then
      return
    end
    local w = _[b]
    local J = H[w]
    _[j.i] = w
    if J then
      J.i = j.i
    end
    _[b] = nil
    b -= 1
    if j.mi > 0 then
      w = x[v]
      J = H[w]
      x[j.mi] = w
      if J then
        J.mi = j.mi
      end
      x[v] = nil
      v -= 1
    end
    H[u] = nil
  end
  local function u(j)
    local w = H[j]
    if not (w) then
      return
    end
    G(j)
    pcall(w.d.Remove, w.d)
  end
  local j = {__index = function(w, J)
    local m = H[w]
    if not (m) then
      return nil
    end
    if J == "Remove" then
      return u
    elseif J == "Destroy" then
      return u
    end
    if m.tr[J] then
      return m.w[J]
    end
    return m.d[J]
  end, __newindex = function(u, w, J)
    local m = H[u]
    if not (m) then
      return
    end
    if not (m.tr[w]) then
      u = m.u
      if u[w] ~= J then
        u[w] = J
        m.d[w] = J
      end
      return
    end
    u = m.w[w]
    if u ~= J then
      m.w[w] = J
      if B == 0 then
        m.d[w] = J
      elseif m.mi == 0 then
        m.d[w] = J
      else
        D(m)
      end
    end
  end}
  local function u(w, J)
    return w[J]
  end
  l.new = function(w, J)
    local m, Y, O, Q = Drawing.new(w), h[w] or h.Square, Z[w] or Z.Square, {}
    for Z in Y, nil, nil do
      local h, F = pcall(u, m, Z)
      if h then
        Q[Z] = F
      end
    end
    if Q.Visible == nil then
      Q.Visible = false
    end
    for u = 1, #O, 1 do
      local Z = O[u]
      if Q[Z] == nil then
        Q[Z] = t()
      end
    end
    local u = setmetatable({}, j)
    b += 1
    _[b] = u
    local j = {d = m, cls = w, tr = Y, keys = O, w = Q, u = {}, hid = false, i = b, mi = 0}
    H[u] = j
    if J then
      v += 1
      x[v] = u
      j.mi = v
    end
    return u
  end
  l.mask_step = function()
    if not (pcall(q)) then
      B = 0
    end
    local u = (v > 0) and ((B > 0) or (d > 0))
    if u then
      local u = v
      for j = u, 1, -1 do
        local u = x[j]
        j = H[u]
        if j then
          if not (pcall(D, j)) then
            G(u)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    d = B
  end
  l.count = function()
    local G = b
    return G
  end
  l.mask_active = function()
    local G = B
    return G > 0
  end
  l.mask_test = function(G, u, j, w)
    if B == 0 then
      return false
    end
    return W(G, u, j, w, 0)
  end
  l.purge = function()
    local G = b
    for u = G, 1, -1 do
      local j = _[u]
      if j then
        local w = H[j]
        if w then
          pcall(w.d.Remove, w.d)
          H[j] = nil
        end
      end
      _[u] = nil
    end
    G = v
    for u = G, 1, -1 do
      x[u] = nil
    end
    b, v, B, d = 0, 0, 0, 0
    table.clear(H)
    table.clear(A)
  end
  i.teardown(l.purge)
  return l
end
