    _ += 1
    local l = h[_]
    if l then
    else
      l = b()
      d += 1
      h[d] = l
    end
    local b = l.image
    if l.uid ~= H then
      l.uid = H
      b.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. (tostring(H) .. "&w=48&h=48")
    end
    if (l.x ~= u) or (l.y ~= x) then
      l.x = u
      l.y = x
      b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(u, x)
    end
    if l.size ~= v then
      l.size = v
      b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v, v)
    end
    if not (l.shown) then
      l.shown = true
      b.Visible = true
    end
  end
  j.close = function()
    local u, b = Z + 1, t
    for x = u, b, 1 do
      local v = w[x]
      if v then
        if v.shown then
          v.shown = false
          v.image.Visible = false
        end
      end
    end
    u, b = _ + 1, d
    for x = u, b, 1 do
      local v = h[x]
      if v then
        if v.shown then
          v.shown = false
          v.image.Visible = false
        end
      end
    end
    u, b = B + 1, A
    for x = u, b, 1 do
      local u = i[x]
      if u then
        if u.shown then
          u.shown = false
          u.image.Visible = false
        end
      end
    end
    _ = 0
  end
  j.purge = function()
    local u = t
    for b = u, 1, -1 do
      local x = w[b]
      w[b] = nil
      if x then
        pcall(x.image.Destroy, x.image)
      end
    end
    u = d
    for w = u, 1, -1 do
      local b = h[w]
      h[w] = nil
      if b then
        pcall(b.image.Destroy, b.image)
      end
    end
    u = A
    for w = u, 1, -1 do
      local u = i[w]
      i[w] = nil
      if u then
        pcall(u.image.Destroy, u.image)
      end
    end
    t, Z, d, _, A, B = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  end
  G.teardown(j.purge)
  return j
end

-- Module x
modules.x = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("s")
  local u = G.lp
  local j = table.find
  local w = os.clock
  local t = Color3.new().Lerp
  local Z, h = math.sin, {}
  local A = G.weak()
  local B = G.weak()
  h.char_info = function(d)
    local _ = B[d]
    if _ then
    else
      _ = {}
      B[d] = _
    end
    return _
  end
  h.shared_for = function(B, d)
    local _ = A[d]
    if _ then
    else
      _ = {}
      A[d] = _
    end
    local A = i.frame()
    if _.frame ~= A then
      _.frame = A
      _.vis = false
      local A = B.isFr(d)
      _.fr = A
      local b = B.tSet[(A and "fr") or "en"]
      _.opt = b
      _.clone = B._clones[d]
      A = b.en
      if (if A then (d == u) and not B.allowlocal else not A) or (((d.UserId ~= nil) and (#B.wlist > 0)) and not j(B.wlist, d.UserId)) then
        _.en = false
        _.char = nil
      else
        b = B.getChar(d)
        _.char = b
        _.en = b ~= nil
      end
    end
    return _
  end
  local u = G.weak()
  h.opt_flags = function(G, j)
    G = u[j]
    if G then
    else
      G = {}
      u[j] = G
    end
    local u = i.frame()
    if G.frame ~= u then
      G.frame = u
      local u, A, B = ((j.hb or j.ht) and true) or false, ((j.ab or j.at) and true) or false, ((((j.bomb or j.scope) or j.flashed) or j.defuse) and true) or false
      G.hp = u
      G.arm = A
      G.wep = ((j.wep or j.wepIcon) and true) or false
      G.mon = (j.mon and true) or false
      G.pn = (j.pn and true) or false
      G.ind = B
      G.corn = (((((((((((((u or A) or B) or j.box) or j.name) or j.av) or j.dis) or j.wep) or j.wepIcon) or j.mon) or j.pn) or j.tr) or j.b3d) and true) or false
    end
    return G
  end
  h.grad = function(G, u, j, A)
    return t(G, u, (Z(((j * 3.1416) + (w() * 2)) + ((A or 0) * 6.283)) * 0.5) + 0.5)
  end
  h.box_col = function(G, u, j, w, Z, A)
    return (G and t(u, j, (w - Z) / A)) or u
  end
  h.find_part = function(G, u)
    local j = G:FindFirstChild(u)
    if j then
      if j.Parent == G then
        if j:IsA("BasePart") then
          return j
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  h.draw_line = function(G, u, j, w, t, Z)
    if t then
      if Z then
        local A, B = j(t)
        local t, d = j(Z)
        if B then
          if d then
            w.From = A
            w.To = t
            w.Visible = true
            w.Color = i.parse_col(G, u.skelCol[1])
            w.Transparency = u.skelCol[2]
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    w.Visible = false
    return false
  end
  return h
end

-- Module y
modules.y = function()
  local G, i, u = modules.load("b"), {}, {}
  local j = G.storage:FindFirstChild("Database")
  G = j and (j:FindFirstChild("Custom"))
  j = G and (G:FindFirstChild("Weapons"))
  if j then
    G = j:GetChildren()
    for j = 1, #G, 1 do
      local w = G[j]
      if w:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local G, t = pcall(require, w)
        if G then
          if type(t) == "table" then
            j = t.Icon
            if type(j) == "string" then
              if j ~= "" then
                i[w.Name] = j
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  u.map = i
  u.of = function(G)
    if type(G) ~= "string" then
      return nil
    elseif G == "" then
      return nil
    end
    return i[G]
  end
  return u
end

-- Module z
modules.z = function()
  local G = modules.load("s")
  local i = modules.load("x")
  local u = modules.load("v")
  local j = modules.load("u")
  local w = modules.load("w")
  local t = modules.load("y")
  local Z = math.floor
  local h = math.round
  local A = math.min
  local B = math.clamp
  local d = Color3.new().Lerp
  local _ = Vector2.zero.Lerp
  local b = string.sub
  local x = Vector2.new
  local v = G.hb_off
  local H = G.ht_off
  local l = G.ho_off
  local W = G.bb_off
  local q = G.bo_off
  local J = G.bt_off
  local D = G.n_off
  local m, Y, O = Color3.new(), {bx = 0, by = 0, lx = 0, ly = 0, rx = 0, ry = 0, sb = 0, sl = 0, sr = 0}, {bone = function(Q, F, I, E, V)
    if E then
      if not (V) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local N, a = Q:project(E)
    local E, U = Q:project(V)
    if a then
      if U then
        u.line(N, E, F, I, 1)
      end
    end
  end}
  local function Q(F, I, E)
    E = E or 0
    if I == "right" then
      local V = E * 7
      local N = x(v.X + V, 0)
      return F.tr + N, F.br + N, l, x(H.X + V, 0), "v"
    elseif I == "bottom" then
      local V = E * 22
      local N = x(0, W.Y + V)
      return F.bl + N, F.br + N, q, x(0, J.Y + V), "h"
    end
    I = E * 7
    local q = x(v.X + I, 0)
    return F.tl - q, F.bl - q, l, x(H.X + I, 0), "v"
  end
  O.bar_geom = Q
  local function l(q, J, F, I, E, V)
    for N = 1, 10, 1 do
      local a, U = (N - 1) / 10, N / 10
      u.line(_(q, J, a), _(q, J, U), d(F, I, (a + U) * 0.5), E, V)
    end
  end
  local function q(J, F, I, E, V, N, a, U, g)
    local X = #J
    if X == 0 then
      return 0
    end
    local o = j.bounds(E, J)
    local R = F - (o * 0.5)
    for p = 1, X, 1 do
      local c, M = b(J, p, p), ((X > 1) and ((p - 1) / (X - 1))) or 0
      F = i.grad(a, U, M, g)
      if V then
        u.outlined_text(x(R, I), E, F, N, V, N, c, false)
      else
        u.text(x(R, I), E, F, N, c, false)
      end
      R += j.bounds(E, c)
    end
    return o
  end
  O.grad_text = q
  O.place = function(b, J, F, I, E, V, N, a, U, g)
    local X, o = j.bounds(I, J)
    local R, p
    if F == "left" then
      R, p = Y.lx - (X * 0.5), (Y.ly + Y.sl) + (o * 0.5)
      Y.sl = Y.sl + (o + 2)
    else
      if F == "right" then
        R, p = Y.rx + (X * 0.5), (Y.ry + Y.sr) + (o * 0.5)
        Y.sr = Y.sr + (o + 2)
      else
        R, p = Y.bx, (Y.by + Y.sb) + (o * 0.5)
        Y.sb = Y.sb + (o + 2)
      end
    end
    if a then
      q(J, R, p - (o * 0.5), I, N, V, U, g, b.ph)
    elseif N then
      u.outlined_text(x(R, p), I, E, V, N, V, J, true)
    else
      u.text(x(R, p), I, E, V, J, true)
    end
  end
  O.place_icon = function(b, b, J, F, I, E)
    local V, N
    if J == "left" then
      V, N = Y.lx - (F * 0.5), (Y.ly + Y.sl) + (F * 0.5)
      Y.sl = Y.sl + (F + 2)
    else
      if J == "right" then
        V, N = Y.rx + (F * 0.5), (Y.ry + Y.sr) + (F * 0.5)
        Y.sr = Y.sr + (F + 2)
      else
        V, N = Y.bx, (Y.by + Y.sb) + (F * 0.5)
        Y.sb = Y.sb + (F + 2)
      end
    end
    w.icon(Z(V), Z(N), F, b, I, (E or 1) * u.k())
  end
  local function b(J, F, I, E, V, N, a, U, g)
    local X, o = F.tl, F.br
    local R, p, c, M = X.X, X.Y, o.X - 1, o.Y - 1
    F, o = (c - R) + 1, (M - p) + 1
    if F <= 0 then
      return
    elseif o <= 0 then
      return
    end
    X, J = Z(F * 0.25), Z(o * 0.25)
    X, J = if X < 1 then 1 else X, if J < 1 then 1 else J
    F = M - p
    F = if F <= 0 then 1 else F
    if U then
      u.filled_rect(x(R - 1, p - 1), x(X + 2, 3), a, g)
      u.filled_rect(x(c - X, p - 1), x(X + 2, 3), a, g)
      u.filled_rect(x(R - 1, M - 1), x(X + 2, 3), a, g)
      u.filled_rect(x(c - X, M - 1), x(X + 2, 3), a, g)
      u.filled_rect(x(R - 1, p - 1), x(3, J + 2), a, g)
      u.filled_rect(x(c - 1, p - 1), x(3, J + 2), a, g)
      u.filled_rect(x(R - 1, M - J), x(3, J + 2), a, g)
      u.filled_rect(x(c - 1, M - J), x(3, J + 2), a, g)
    end
    U, a = i.box_col(V, I, E, p, p, F), i.box_col(V, I, E, M, p, F)
    u.filled_rect(x(R, p), x(X, 1), U, N)
    u.filled_rect(x((c - X) + 1, p), x(X, 1), U, N)
    u.filled_rect(x(R, M), x(X, 1), a, N)
    u.filled_rect(x((c - X) + 1, M), x(X, 1), a, N)
    a = (V and A(6, J)) or 1
    for U = 1, a, 1 do
      g, X = Z((J * (U - 1)) / a), Z((J * U) / a)
      X = if X <= g then g + 1 else X
      local J, a, T, L = p + g, p + X, (M - X) + 1, (M - g) + 1
      o, U = i.box_col(V, I, E, (J + a) * 0.5, p, F), i.box_col(V, I, E, (T + L) * 0.5, p, F)
      u.filled_rect(x(R, J), x(1, a - J), o, N)
      u.filled_rect(x(c, J), x(1, a - J), o, N)
      u.filled_rect(x(R, T), x(1, L - T), U, N)
      u.filled_rect(x(c, T), x(1, L - T), U, N)
    end
  end
  local function i(J, J, F, I, E)
    local V, N = J.tl, J.br
    local a, U, g, X = V.X, V.Y, N.X - 1, N.Y - 1
    N, J = (g - a) + 1, (X - U) + 1
    if N <= 0 then
      return
    elseif J <= 0 then
      return
    end
    u.filled_rect(x(a, U), x(N, 1), F, E)
    u.filled_rect(x(a, X), x(N, 1), I, E)
    V = A(24, J)
    for o = 1, V, 1 do
      N, X = Z((J * (o - 1)) / V), Z((J * o) / V)
      X = if X <= N then N + 1 else X
      local V, o, R = U + N, U + X, d(F, I, ((N + X) * 0.5) / J)
      u.filled_rect(x(a, V), x(1, o - V), R, E)
      u.filled_rect(x(g, V), x(1, o - V), R, E)
    end
  end
  local function J(F, I, E, V, N)
    local a = I.Y
    if a <= 0 then
      return
    elseif I.X <= 0 then
      return
    end
    local U, g, X = A(24, a), F.tl.X, F.tl.Y
    for o = 1, U, 1 do
      local R, p = Z((a * (o - 1)) / U), Z((a * o) / U)
      p = if p <= R then R + 1 else p
      F = d(E, V, ((R + p) * 0.5) / a)
      u.filled_rect(x(g, X + R), x(I.X, p - R), F, N)
    end
  end
  O.draw = function(F)
    if not (F.en) then
      return
    end
    if F._quiet then
      return
    end
    local I, E, V, N = F.itf, F.opt, F.corn, F.onSc or false
    local a, U = I.shSet.tSz, I._clones[F.plr]
    if not (N) then
      if E.offAr then
        if F.dir then
          if not (U) then
            local g, X = G.viewport(), E.offArPad or 18
            local o, R = g * 0.5, F.dir
            local g, p, c = o + (R * A((o.X - X) / math.max(math.abs(R.X), 0.0001), (o.Y - X) / math.max(math.abs(R.Y), 0.0001))), E.offArCol, math.deg(math.atan2(R.Y, R.X)) + 90
            w.put(Z(g.X), Z(g.Y), E.offArSz or 22, c, p[1], (p[2] or 1) * u.k())
          end
        end
      end
      return
    end
    if not (V) then
      return
    end
    local A, g, X, o, R = V.br - V.tl, E.box, E.boxType == "Corners", E.boxGrd, G.parse_col(F, E.boxOCol[1], true)
    if g then
      if E.boxF then
        if E.boxFGrd then
          J(V, A, E.boxFGrdCol[1], E.boxFGrdCol[2], E.boxFCol[2])
        else
          u.filled_rect(V.tl, A, G.parse_col(F, E.boxFCol[1]), E.boxFCol[2])
        end
      end
    end
    if g then
      if X then
        b(F, V, (o and E.boxGrdCol[1]) or G.parse_col(F, E.boxCol[1]), E.boxGrdCol[2], o, E.boxCol[2], R, E.boxO, E.boxOCol[2])
      elseif o then
        if E.boxO then
          u.rect(V.tl, A, R, E.boxOCol[2], 3)
        end
        i(F, V, E.boxGrdCol[1], E.boxGrdCol[2], E.boxCol[2])
      else
        if E.boxO then
          u.rect(V.tl, A, R, E.boxOCol[2], 3)
        end
        u.rect(V.tl, A, G.parse_col(F, E.boxCol[1]), E.boxCol[2], 1)
      end
    end
    R, U, X, N, A = E.hbSide or "left", E.abSide or "right", E.hb, E.ab, 0
    local i, b, J, p, c = if X then if N then if R == U then 1 else 0 else 0 else 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    if X then
      local M, T, L, k, P = Q(V, R, A)
      o = ((F.maxHp > 0) and (F.hp / F.maxHp)) or 0
      g = _(T, M, o)
      if E.hbo then
        u.line(M - L, T + L, G.parse_col(F, E.hboCol[1], true), E.hboCol[2], 3)
      end
      if E.hbGrd then
        l(g, T, E.hbGrdCol[1], E.hbGrdCol[2], 1, 1)
      elseif E.hbCol and E.hbCol[1] then
        u.line(g, T, G.parse_col(F, E.hbCol[1]), E.hbCol[2] or 1, 1)
      else
        u.line(g, T, d(E.dyCol, E.hlCol, o), 1, 1)
      end
      if E.ht then
        L = h(F.hp) .. "hp"
        local d, z = j.bounds(a, L)
        I = _(T, M, o)
        local M, T
        if P == "h" then
          M, T = I.X - (d * 0.5), I.Y + k.Y
        else
          if R == "right" then
            M, T = I.X + k.X, I.Y - (z * 0.5)
          else
            M, T = (I.X - k.X) - d, I.Y - (z * 0.5)
          end
        end
        local k = (E.htOut and G.parse_col(F, E.htOCol, true)) or nil
        if E.htGrd then
          q(L, M + (d * 0.5), T, a, k, E.htCol[2], E.htGrdCol[1], E.htGrdCol[2], F.ph)
        elseif k then
          u.outlined_text(x(M, T), a, G.parse_col(F, E.htCol[1]), E.htCol[2], k, E.htCol[2], L, false)
        else
          u.text(x(M, T), a, G.parse_col(F, E.htCol[1]), E.htCol[2], L, false)
        end
        b, J = d, z
      else
      end
    else
    end
    if N then
      local d, M, T, L, k = Q(V, U, i)
      A = E.armMax or 100
      o = B(F.arm / A, 0, 1)
      g = _(M, d, o)
      if E.abo then
        u.line(d - T, M + T, G.parse_col(F, E.aboCol[1], true), E.aboCol[2], 3)
      end
      if E.abGrd then
        l(g, M, E.abGrdCol[1], E.abGrdCol[2], 1, 1)
      else
        u.line(g, M, G.parse_col(F, E.abCol[1]), E.abCol[2] or 1, 1)
      end
      if E.at then
        I = h(F.arm) .. "ap"
        local B, l = j.bounds(a, I)
        T = _(M, d, o)
        local d, _
        if k == "h" then
          d, _ = T.X - (B * 0.5), T.Y + L.Y
        else
          if U == "left" then
            d, _ = (T.X - L.X) - B, T.Y - (l * 0.5)
          else
            d, _ = T.X + L.X, T.Y - (l * 0.5)
          end
        end
        local Q = (E.atOut and G.parse_col(F, E.atOCol, true)) or nil
        if Q then
          u.outlined_text(x(d, _), a, G.parse_col(F, E.atCol[1]), E.atCol[2], Q, E.atCol[2], I, false)
        else
          u.text(x(d, _), a, G.parse_col(F, E.atCol[1]), E.atCol[2], I, false)
        end
        p, c = B, l
      else
      end
    else
    end
    I, o = 0, 0
    if E.name then
      g = F.plr.DisplayName
      local B, d = j.bounds(a, g)
      local j, _, l = (V.tl.X + V.tr.X) * 0.5, (((V.tl.Y + V.tr.Y) * 0.5) - d) - D.Y, (E.nOut and G.parse_col(F, E.nOCol, true)) or nil
      if E.nGrd then
        q(g, j, _, a, l, E.nCol[2], E.nGrdCol[1], E.nGrdCol[2], F.ph)
      elseif l then
        u.outlined_text(x(j, _), a, G.parse_col(F, E.nCol[1]), E.nCol[2], l, E.nCol[2], g, true)
      else
        u.text(x(j, _), a, G.parse_col(F, E.nCol[1]), E.nCol[2], g, true)
      end
      I, o = B, d
    else
    end
    if E.av then
      local u, j, B, d, _ = a + 6, (V.tl.X + V.tr.X) * 0.5, (V.tl.Y + V.tr.Y) * 0.5
      if E.name and (I > 0) then
        d, _ = ((j + (I * 0.5)) + (u * 0.5)) + 4, (B - (o * 0.5)) - D.Y
      else
        d, _ = j, (B - (u * 0.5)) - D.Y
      end
      g = F.plr
      w.avatar(Z(d), Z(_), u, ((type(g) == "table") and g.avatar) or g.UserId)
    end
    o, A, I = 6, 6, 0
    if X then
      if R == "left" then
        o += (v.X + 3) + 0
        o = if E.ht then o + (H.X + math.max(b, 24)) else o
      else
        if R == "right" then
          A += (v.X + 3) + 0
          A = if E.ht then A + (H.X + math.max(b, 24)) else A
        else
          g = (W.Y + 4) + 0
          g = if E.ht then g + J else g
          I = if g > I then g else I
        end
      end
    else
    end
    if N then
      if U == "left" then
        o += (v.X + 3) + (i * 7)
        o = if E.at then o + (H.X + math.max(p, 24)) else o
      else
        if U == "right" then
          A += (v.X + 3) + (i * 7)
          A = if E.at then A + (H.X + math.max(p, 24)) else A
        else
          R = (W.Y + 4) + (i * 22)
          R = if E.at then R + c else R
          I = if R > I then R else I
        end
      end
    else
    end
    Y.bx = (V.bl.X + V.br.X) * 0.5
    Y.by = (((V.bl.Y + V.br.Y) * 0.5) + G.d_off.Y) + I
    Y.lx = V.tl.X - o
    Y.rx = V.tr.X + A
    Y.ly = V.tl.Y
    Y.ry = V.tr.Y
    Y.sb = 0
    Y.sl = 0
    Y.sr = 0
    X, U, R = F.indicators, F.fr or false, O.place
    if X then
      if E.bomb then
        if not U then
          if X.bomb == true then
            R(F, "bomb", E.bombPos or "right", a, G.parse_col(F, E.bombCol[1]), E.bombCol[2], m, E.bombGrd, E.bombGrdCol[1], E.bombGrdCol[2])
          end
        end
      end
      if E.scope then
        if not U then
          if X.scope == true then
            R(F, "scope", E.scopePos or "right", a, G.parse_col(F, E.scopeCol[1]), E.scopeCol[2], m, E.scopeGrd, E.scopeGrdCol[1], E.scopeGrdCol[2])
          end
        end
      end
      if E.flashed then
        if X.flashed == true then
          R(F, "flashed", E.flashedPos or "right", a, G.parse_col(F, E.flashedCol[1]), E.flashedCol[2], m, E.flashedGrd, E.flashedGrdCol[1], E.flashedGrdCol[2])
        end
      end
      if E.defuse then
        if not U then
          if X.defuse == true then
            R(F, "defuse", E.defusePos or "right", a, G.parse_col(F, E.defuseCol[1]), E.defuseCol[2], m, E.defuseGrd, E.defuseGrdCol[1], E.defuseGrdCol[2])
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if E.dis then
      R(F, h(F.dis) .. " studs", E.dPos or "bottom", a, G.parse_col(F, E.dCol[1]), E.dCol[2], (E.dOut and G.parse_col(F, E.dOCol, true)) or nil, E.dGrd, E.dGrdCol[1], E.dGrdCol[2])
    end
    if E.wep then
      U = F.wep
      if type(U) == "string" then
        if U ~= "" then
          R(F, U, E.wPos or "bottom", a, G.parse_col(F, E.wCol[1]), E.wCol[2], (E.wOut and G.parse_col(F, E.wOCol, true)) or nil, E.wGrd, E.wGrdCol[1], E.wGrdCol[2])
        end
      end
    end
    if E.wepIcon then
      g = t.of(F.wep)
      if g then
        I = E.wepIconCol
        O.place_icon(F, g, E.wepIconPos or "bottom", E.wepIconSz or 16, G.parse_col(F, I[1]), I[2])
      end
    end
    if E.mon then
      R(F, "$" .. Z(F.mon), E.monPos or "right", a, G.parse_col(F, E.monCol[1]), E.monCol[2], m, E.monGrd, E.monGrdCol[1], E.monGrdCol[2])
    end
    if E.pn then
      R(F, Z(F.pn) .. "ms", E.pnPos or "right", a, G.parse_col(F, E.pnCol[1]), E.pnCol[2], m, E.pnGrd, E.pnGrdCol[1], E.pnGrdCol[2])
    end
    if E.skel then
      if F.skpts then
        V, N, X, g = F.skpts, G.parse_col(F, E.skelCol[1]), E.skelCol[2], O.bone
        g(F, N, X, V.hd, V.ur)
        g(F, N, X, V.ur, V.lr)
        g(F, N, X, V.ur, V.lua)
        g(F, N, X, V.lua, V.lfa)
        g(F, N, X, V.ur, V.rua)
        g(F, N, X, V.rua, V.rfa)
        g(F, N, X, V.lr, V.lul)
        g(F, N, X, V.lul, V.lll)
        g(F, N, X, V.lr, V.rul)
        g(F, N, X, V.rul, V.rll)
      end
    end
  end
  return O
end

-- Module A
modules.A = function()
  local G = modules.load("s")
  local i = modules.load("x")
  local u = getgenv()
  local j = math.min
  local w = table.clear
  local t = CFrame.fromMatrix
  local Z, h = CFrame.identity.PointToObjectSpace, {}
  h.__index = h
  h.new = function(A, B)
    return setmetatable({plr = A, itf = B, ph = math.random(), char = nil, en = false, fr = false, onSc = false, dis = 0, corn = nil, charCache = {}, cacheValid = false, links = {}, skpts = nil, dir = nil, viewport = nil, activeCam = nil, indicators = nil, hp = 0, maxHp = 100, arm = 0, wep = "", mon = 0, pn = 0, _hd = nil, _quiet = false, _cornT = {}, _cornPts = {}, _arSnap = true}, h)
  end
  h.project = function(A, B)
    local d, _ = A.viewport, A.activeCam
    if d then
      return G.vp_point(B, _, d)
    end
    if G.overridden() then
      return G.project_view(B)
    end
    A, d = _:WorldToViewportPoint(B)
    return Vector2.new(A.X, A.Y), d, A.Z
  end
  h.drop_events = function(A)
    local B = A.links
    local A, d = B.added, B.removed
    if A then
      pcall(A.Disconnect, A)
      B.added = nil
    end
    if d then
      pcall(d.Disconnect, d)
      B.removed = nil
    end
  end
  local function A(B, d)
    if G.body_parts[d.Name] then
      B.cacheValid = false
    end
  end
  h.watch = function(B, d)
    B:drop_events()
    if not (d) then
      return
    end
    local _ = B.links
    _.added = d.ChildAdded:Connect(function(b)
      A(B, b)
    end)
    _.removed = d.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(d)
      A(B, d)
    end)
  end
  h.validate = function(A)
    local B = A.char
    if B then
      if B.Parent then
        if A.cacheValid == false then
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local d = A.charCache
    A = #d
    if A == 0 then
      return false
    end
    for _ = 1, j(3, A), 1 do
      local j = d[_]
      if j then
        if j.Parent then
          if j.Parent ~= B then
            return false
          end
        else
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  h.rebuild = function(j)
    local A = j.charCache
    if j.char then
      if not (j.char.Parent) then
        w(A)
        return
      end
    else
      w(A)
      return
    end
    G.char_parts(j.char, A)
    j.cacheValid = true
  end
  h.update = function(j)
    local A = j.itf
    local B = i.shared_for(A, j.plr)
    local d = B.opt
    j.opt = d
    j.indicators = nil
    j._quiet = false
    local _ = j.plr
    if if _ then not j.plr.Parent else not _ then
      j.en = false
      j.char = nil
      j.onSc = false
      w(j.charCache)
      j.cacheValid = false
      j.skpts = nil
      j._hd = nil
      j:drop_events()
      return
    end
    _ = B.char
    if _ ~= j.char then
      j.char = _
      w(j.charCache)
      j.cacheValid = false
      j.cacheChar = nil
      j.skpts = nil
      j.dir = nil
      j._hd = nil
      j._arSnap = true
      j:watch(_)
    end
    j.en = B.en
    j.fr = B.fr
    if not (j.en) then
      j.onSc = false
      j.cacheValid = false
      j.skpts = nil
      return
    end
    _ = j._hd
    if if _ then _.Parent ~= j.char else not _ then
      _ = (j.char and j.char:FindFirstChild("Head")) or nil
      j._hd = _
    else
    end
    if if _ then not _.Parent else not _ then
      w(j.charCache)
      j.cacheValid = false
      j.skpts = nil
      j.onSc = false
      return
    end
    local b, x = G.camera(), B.clone
    local v = x and x.viewport
    if v then
      if not (rawget(u, "VISUALS_TAB_OPEN")) then
        j.onSc = false
        return
      end
      b = v.CurrentCamera or b
    else
    end
    j.viewport = v
    j.activeCam = b
    local u, H, l = j:project(_.Position)
    local W = A.shSet
    local q = W.limDis and (l > W.maxDis)
    j.onSc = H and not q
    j.dis = (((G.overridden() and G.view_frame().Position) or b.CFrame.Position) - _.Position).Magnitude
    W = G.viewport()
    if v then
    elseif q then
    elseif l > 0.05 then
      H = ((G.rt.foc or 800) * 8) / l
      if u.X > -H then
        if u.Y > -H then
          if u.X < (W.X + H) then
            if u.Y < (W.Y + H) then
              B.vis = true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if j.onSc then
      q = i.opt_flags(A, d)
      if q.hp then
        j.hp, j.maxHp = A.getHp(j.plr, j.char)
      end
      if q.arm then
        j.arm = A.getArm(j.plr)
      end
      if q.wep then
        j.wep = A.getWep(j.plr)
      end
      if q.mon then
        j.mon = (A.getMoney and A.getMoney(j.plr)) or 0
      end
      if q.pn then
        j.pn = (A.getPing and A.getPing(j.plr)) or 0
      end
      if q.ind then
        if type(A.getIndicators) == "function" then
          j.indicators = A.getIndicators(j.plr, j.char, d.flashed == true)
        end
      end
      if d.skel then
        j:skeleton()
      else
        j.skpts = nil
      end
      if not (q.corn) then
        j.corn = nil
        j._quiet = not d.skel
        return
      end
      if #j.charCache == 0 then
        j:rebuild()
      elseif not (j.cacheValid) then
        j:rebuild()
      end
      if #j.charCache == 0 then
        j.onSc = false
        return
      end
      B, H = G.bounds(j.charCache)
      if B then
        if not H then
          j.onSc = false
          j.cacheValid = false
          return
        end
      else
        j.onSc = false
        j.cacheValid = false
        return
      end
      if v then
        j.corn = G.calc_corners_viewport(B, H, b, v, j._cornT, j._cornPts)
      else
        j.corn = G.calc_corners(B, H, j._cornT, j._cornPts)
      end
      return
    end
    if d.offAr then
      if not (x) then
        v = u - (G.viewport() * 0.5)
        v = if l <= 0 then -v else v
        B = v.Magnitude
        if B > 0.001 then
          j.dir = v / B
          return
        end
        W = (G.overridden() and G.view_frame()) or b.CFrame
        A = Z(t(W.Position, W.RightVector, Vector3.yAxis), _.Position)
        H = Vector2.new(A.X, A.Z)
        q = H.Magnitude
        j.dir = (((q > 0.001) and (H / q)) or j.dir) or Vector2.new(0, -1)
      end
    end
  end
  h.skeleton = function(G)
    local u = G.char
    if u then
      if not (G.onSc) then
        G.skpts = nil
        return
      end
    else
      G.skpts = nil
      return
    end
    local j = G._skparts
    if j then
    else
      j = {}
      G._skparts = j
    end
    if (G._skchar ~= u) or not G.cacheValid then
      local t = i.find_part
      G._skchar = u
      j.hd = t(u, "Head")
      j.ur = t(u, "UpperTorso") or t(u, "Torso")
      j.lr = t(u, "LowerTorso") or t(u, "Torso")
      j.lua = t(u, "LeftUpperArm") or t(u, "Left Arm")
      j.rua = t(u, "RightUpperArm") or t(u, "Right Arm")
      j.lfa = t(u, "LeftLowerArm") or t(u, "LeftHand")
      j.rfa = t(u, "RightLowerArm") or t(u, "RightHand")
      j.lul = t(u, "LeftUpperLeg") or t(u, "Left Leg")
      j.rul = t(u, "RightUpperLeg") or t(u, "Right Leg")
      j.lll = t(u, "LeftLowerLeg") or t(u, "LeftFoot")
      j.rll = t(u, "RightLowerLeg") or t(u, "RightFoot")
    end
    u = j.hd
    if u then
      if not (u.Parent) then
        G.skpts = nil
        return
      end
    else
      G.skpts = nil
      return
    end
    local i = G._skpts
    if i then
    else
      i = {}
      G._skpts = i
    end
    w(i)
    i.hd = u.Position
    local u, t, Z, A, B, d, _, b, x, v = j.ur, j.lr, j.lua, j.rua, j.lfa, j.rfa, j.lul, j.rul, j.lll, j.rll
    if u then
      if u.Parent then
        i.ur = u.Position
      end
    end
    if t then
      if t.Parent then
        i.lr = t.Position
      end
    end
    if Z then
      if Z.Parent then
        i.lua = Z.Position
      end
    end
    if A then
      if A.Parent then
        i.rua = A.Position
      end
    end
    if B then
      if B.Parent then
        i.lfa = B.Position
      end
    end
    if d then
      if d.Parent then
        i.rfa = d.Position
      end
    end
    if _ then
      if _.Parent then
        i.lul = _.Position
      end
    end
    if b then
      if b.Parent then
        i.rul = b.Position
      end
    end
    if x then
      if x.Parent then
        i.lll = x.Position
      end
    end
    if v then
      if v.Parent then
        i.rll = v.Position
      end
    end
    G.skpts = i
  end
  h.destroy = function(G)
    G:drop_events()
    if G.av then
      pcall(G.av.Destroy, G.av)
      G.av = nil
    end
    w(G.charCache)
    G.corn = nil
    G.skpts = nil
    G.char = nil
    G._hd = nil
    G.viewport = nil
    G.activeCam = nil
    G.indicators = nil
  end
  return h
end

-- Module B
modules.B = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i = modules.load("a")
  local u = modules.load("s")
  local j = modules.load("x")
  local w = modules.load("p")
  local t = G.workspace
  local Z = G.lp
  local h = u.white
  local A = math.min
  local B = math.max
  local d, _, b = Vector3.new, {["Counter-Terrorists"] = true, CT = true}, {}
  b.UpperTorso = d(1, 1.04, 1)
  b.LowerTorso = d(0.95, 1.5, 1)
  b.Torso = d(1, 1, 1)
  local x = (Enum.AdornShading and Enum.AdornShading.XRay) or nil
  local v = (Enum.AdornCullingMode and Enum.AdornCullingMode.Never) or nil
  if type(setfflag) == "function" then
    pcall(setfflag, "AdornShadingAPI", "True")
  end
  local H, l
  local function W()
    local q = t.CurrentCamera
    if not (q) then
      return nil
    end
    if if H then not H.Parent else not H then
      H = Instance.new("Folder")
      H.Parent = q
      i.own(H)
      l = Instance.new("Part")
      local i = l
      i.Size = Vector3.one
      l.Anchored = true
      l.CanCollide = false
      l.CanQuery = false
      l.CanTouch = false
      l.CastShadow = false
      l.Massless = true
      l.Locked = true
      l.Transparency = 1
      l.Parent = H
    elseif H.Parent ~= q then
      H.Parent = q
    end
    q = H
    return q
  end
  local i = Vector3.one * 0.004
  local q = CFrame.new()
  local J, D, m, Y = Vector3.zero, false, 0, {}
  Y.__index = Y
  Y.begin_frame = function(O)
    local Q = t.CurrentCamera
    if not (Q) then
      return false
    end
    if not (W()) then
      return false
    end
    local F = Q.CFrame
    l.CFrame = F
    q = F:Inverse()
    J = F.Position
    m += O or 0
    D = m >= 0.6
    if D then
      m = 0
    end
    return true
  end
  local function m(O)
    local Q = tonumber(O.chamsGlow) or 4
    return if Q < 1 then 1 else Q
  end
  local function O(Q, F)
    return Color3.new(Q.R * F, Q.G * F, Q.B * F)
  end
  local Q = u.body_parts
  local function F(I, E)
    if I.Parent ~= E then
      return false
    elseif not (Q[I.Name]) then
      return false
    end
    if not (I:IsA("BasePart")) then
      return false
    end
    E = I.Size
    return ((E.X > 0.05) and (E.Y > 0.05)) and (E.Z > 0.05)
  end
  local function Q(I)
    local E = I:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
    if E then
      I = E.Scale
      if typeof(I) == "Vector3" then
        return I
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function I(E, V)
    local N, a = E.Size, E.Name
    local U = N
    if a == "Head" then
      local g = Q(E)
      N = if g then U * g else U
      return if V ~= 1 then N * V else N
    end
    V = Q(E)
    if V then
      return U * V
    end
    V = b[a]
    if V then
      return U * V
    end
    E, V, a = U.X, U.Y, U.Z
    if V >= E then
      if V >= a then
        return d(E * 1, V * 1.08, a * 1)
      end
    end
    if E >= V then
      if E >= a then
        return d(E * 1.08, V * 1, a * 1)
      end
    end
    return d(E * 1, V * 1, a * 1.08)
  end
  Y.new = function(d, b)
    return setmetatable({plr = d, itf = b, parts = {}, slots = G.weak(), links = {}, charRef = nil, shown = false, armed = false, fill_col = nil, glow_col = nil, head_trim = 1}, Y)
  end
  Y.drop_part = function(G, d)
    local b = G.slots[d]
    if not (b) then
      return
    end
    G.slots[d] = nil
    if b.glow then
      pcall(b.glow.Destroy, b.glow)
    end
    if b.fill then
      pcall(b.fill.Destroy, b.fill)
    end
  end
  local function G(d, b)
    local Q = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    Q.Adornee = l
    Q.Transparency = 0
    Q.ZIndex = d
    Q.Visible = false
    if x then
      Q.Shading = x
    end
    if v then
      Q.AdornCullingMode = v
    end
    Q.Parent = b or H
    return Q
  end
  local function d(b, x, v, Q, E)
    local V = E * v
    E = V.Position
    v = A(0.6 / B(E.Magnitude, 0.001), 1)
    local A, B = CFrame.new(E * v) * (V - E), (Q * v):Max(i)
    b.CFrame = A
    b.Size = B
    x.CFrame, x.Size = A, B * 1.12
  end
  Y.snapshot = function(i, A, B)
    B = B or {}
    local b, x = (_[A] and 0.88) or 1, 0
    for v, Q in i:GetChildren() do
      if F(Q, i) then
        x += 1
        A, v = B[x], Q.Size
        if ((if A then A.part ~= Q else not A) or (A.source_size ~= v)) or (A.trim ~= b) then
          A = {part = Q, source_size = v, trim = b, size = I(Q, b)}
          B[x] = A
        else
        end
        A.frame = Q:GetRenderCFrame()
      else
      end
    end
    for i = #B, x + 1, -1 do
      B[i] = nil
    end
    return ((x > 0) and B) or nil
  end
  Y.snapshot_box = function(i, A)
    if not (W()) then
      return nil
    end
    local B = Instance.new("Folder")
    B.Parent = H
    local b, x = O(A, 4), table.create(#i)
    for v, Q in i, nil, nil do
      local i, E = G(0, B), G(1, B)
      i.Color3 = b
      E.Color3 = A
      x[v] = {frame = Q.frame, size = Q.size, glow = i, fill = E}
    end
    return {instance = B, boxes = x}
  end
  Y.draw_snapshot = function(i, A)
    local B = t.CurrentCamera
    if B then
      if not (W()) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local t = B.CFrame
    B = t:Inverse()
    l.CFrame = t
    for t, t in i.boxes, nil, nil do
      d(t.fill, t.glow, t.frame, t.size, B)
      t.fill.Transparency, t.glow.Transparency = 1 - A, 1 - A
      t.fill.Visible, t.glow.Visible = true, true
    end
  end
  Y.add_part = function(i, t)
    if i.slots[t] then
      return
    elseif not (F(t, i.charRef)) then
      return
    end
    local A = {glow = nil, fill = nil, base = I(t, i.head_trim), size = t.Size}
    if i.armed then
      local B, b = G(0), G(1)
      B.Color3 = i.glow_col or h
      b.Color3 = i.fill_col or h
      B.Visible = i.shown
      b.Visible = i.shown
      A.glow = B
      A.fill = b
      i.fade = nil
    end
    local B = #i.parts + 1
    i.parts[B] = t
    i.slots[t] = A
  end
  Y.arm = function(i)
    if i.armed then
      return
    end
    i.armed = true
    local t, A, B, b = i.parts, i.slots, i.fill_col or h, i.glow_col or h
    for x = 1, #t, 1 do
      i = A[t[x]]
      if i then
        if not (i.fill) then
          local t, A = G(0), G(1)
          t.Color3 = b
          A.Color3 = B
          t.Visible = false
          A.Visible = false
          i.glow = t
          i.fill = A
        end
      end
    end
  end
  Y.clear = function(G)
    local i = G.links
    for t = #i, 1, -1 do
      pcall(i[t].Disconnect, i[t])
      i[t] = nil
    end
    i = G.parts
    for t = #i, 1, -1 do
      G:drop_part(i[t])
      i[t] = nil
    end
    table.clear(G.slots)
    G.charRef = nil
    G.shown = false
    G.armed = false
    G.fade = nil
  end
  Y.bind = function(G, i)
    G:clear()
    if not i or not i.Parent then
      return
    end
    G.charRef = i
    G.head_trim = (_[G.itf.getTeam(G.plr)] and 0.88) or 1
    local t = i:GetChildren()
    for A = 1, #t, 1 do
      G:add_part(t[A])
    end
    t = G.links
    t[#t + 1] = i.ChildAdded:Connect(function(A)
      if G.charRef == i then
        G:add_part(A)
      end
    end)
    t[#t + 1] = i.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(t)
      if G.charRef == i then
        G:drop_part(t)
      end
    end)
  end
  Y.rescan = function(G)
    if not (G.charRef) then
      return
    end
    local i, t, A = G.parts, G.slots, 0
    for B = 1, #i, 1 do
      local _ = i[B]
      B = _ and t[_]
      if _ then
        if _.Parent then
          if B then
            local t = A + 1
            i[t] = _
            local b = _.Size
            if B.size ~= b then
              B.size = b
              B.base = I(_, G.head_trim)
            end
            A = t
          else
            if _ then
              G:drop_part(_)
            end
          end
        else
          if _ then
            G:drop_part(_)
          end
        end
      else
        if _ then
          G:drop_part(_)
        end
      end
    end
    for G = #i, A + 1, -1 do
      i[G] = nil
    end
  end
  Y.set_shown = function(G, i)
    G.shown = i
    local t, A = G.parts, G.slots
    for B = 1, #t, 1 do
      G = A[t[B]]
      if G then
        if G.fill then
          G.glow.Visible = i
          G.fill.Visible = i
        end
      end
    end
  end
  Y.recolor = function(G, i, t)
    G.fill_col = i
    G.glow_col = t
    local A, B = G.parts, G.slots
    for _ = 1, #A, 1 do
      G = B[A[_]]
      if G then
        if G.fill then
          G.fill.Color3 = i
          G.glow.Color3 = t
        end
      end
    end
  end
  Y.update = function(G)
    local i = G.itf
    local t = j.shared_for(i, G.plr)
    local j, A = t.opt, t.char
    local B = ((((t.en and j) and j.chams) and A) and A.Parent) and (G.plr ~= Z)
    if if B then not H else not B then
      if G.charRef then
        G:clear()
      end
      return
    end
    if G.charRef ~= A then
      G:bind(A)
    end
    if D then
      G:rescan()
    end
    A, B = G.parts, G.slots
    local Z, _ = #A
    for b = 1, Z, 1 do
      t = A[b]
      if t then
        if t.Parent then
          _ = t
          break
        end
      end
    end
    t = _ ~= nil
    if t then
      local b = i.shSet
      local x = tonumber(b.maxDis)
      if x then
        if b.limDis then
          local b = J
          t = if (b - _.Position).Magnitude > x then false else t
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    if not t then
      if G.shown then
        G:set_shown(false)
      end
      return
    end
    if not (G.armed) then
      G:arm()
    end
    if not (G.shown) then
      G:set_shown(true)
    end
    i = u.parse_col(G, j.chamsOCol[1]) or h
    t = O(i, m(j))
    if G.fill_col ~= i then
      G:recolor(i, t)
    elseif G.glow_col ~= t then
      G:recolor(i, t)
    end
    t = w.fade(G.plr)
    if G.fade ~= t then
      G.fade = t
      j = 1 - t
      for u = 1, Z, 1 do
        i = B[A[u]]
        if i then
          if i.fill then
            i.fill.Transparency = j
            i.glow.Transparency = j
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for i = 1, Z, 1 do
      t = A[i]
      G = t and B[t]
      if G then
        if t.Parent then
          d(G.fill, G.glow, t.CFrame, G.base, q)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  Y.destroy = function(G)
    G:clear()
  end
  return Y
end

-- Module C
modules.C = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("s")
  local u = modules.load("x")
  local j = G.lp
  local G = i.white
  local w, t = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop, {}
  t.__index = t
  t.new = function(Z, h)
    return setmetatable({plr = Z, itf = h, inst = nil, char = nil, root = nil, links = {}, dirty = false, on = false, fc = nil, oc = nil, ft = nil, ot = nil}, t)
  end
  t.drop_links = function(Z)
    local h = Z.links
    for A = #h, 1, -1 do
      Z = h[A]
      h[A] = nil
      pcall(Z.Disconnect, Z)
    end
  end
  t.watch = function(Z, h)
    Z:drop_links()
    if not (h) then
      return
    end
    local A = Z.links
    local function B()
      Z.dirty = true
    end
    A[1] = h.ChildAdded:Connect(B)
    A[2] = h.ChildRemoved:Connect(B)
  end
  t.hide = function(Z)
    local h = Z.inst
    if Z.on then
      Z.on = false
      if h then
        h.Enabled = false
      end
    elseif h then
      if h.Enabled then
        Z.on = false
        if h then
          h.Enabled = false
        end
      end
    end
  end
  t.unbind = function(Z)
    Z:hide()
    Z:drop_links()
    Z.char = nil
    Z.root = nil
    Z.dirty = false
    local h = Z.inst
    if h then
      h.Adornee = nil
    end
  end
  t.ensure = function(Z)
    local h, A = Z.inst, i.holder
    if h then
      if h.Parent == A then
        return h
      end
    end
    if h then
      pcall(h.Destroy, h)
    end
    h = Instance.new("Highlight")
    h.Enabled = false
    h.DepthMode = w
    h.Parent = A
    Z.inst = h
    Z.char = nil
    Z.on = false
    Z.fc = nil
    Z.oc = nil
    Z.ft = nil
    Z.ot = nil
    return h
  end
  t.update = function(w)
    local Z = w.itf
    local h = u.shared_for(Z, w.plr)
    local u, A, B = h.opt, h.char, h.en
    if ((((if B then not u else not B) or not u.hlt) or not A) or not A.Parent) or (w.plr == j) then
      if w.char then
        w:unbind()
      end
      return
    end
    B, h = w:ensure(), w.root
    if w.char ~= A then
      w.char = A
      h = A:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or A:FindFirstChild("Head")
      w.root = h
      w.dirty = false
      w:watch(A)
      B.Adornee = A
    else
      if if h then h.Parent ~= A else not h then
        h = A:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or A:FindFirstChild("Head")
        w.root = h
        w.dirty = h ~= nil
      else
      end
      if w.dirty or (B.Adornee ~= A) then
        w.dirty = false
        B.Adornee = nil
        B.Adornee = A
        w.on = false
      end
    end
    if not h then
      w:hide()
      return
    end
    A = Z.shSet
    if A.limDis then
      Z = tonumber(A.maxDis)
      if Z then
        if (i.view_frame().Position - h.Position).Magnitude > Z then
          w:hide()
          return
        end
      end
    end
    h, Z = u.hltFCol, u.hltOCol
    local u, j, A, d = i.parse_col(w, h[1]) or G, i.parse_col(w, Z[1]) or G, 1 - (tonumber(h[2]) or 0.5), 1 - (tonumber(Z[2]) or 1)
    if w.fc ~= u then
      w.fc = u
      B.FillColor = u
    end
    if w.oc ~= j then
      w.oc = j
      B.OutlineColor = j
    end
    if w.ft ~= A then
      w.ft = A
      B.FillTransparency = A
    end
    if w.ot ~= d then
      w.ot = d
      B.OutlineTransparency = d
    end
    if w.on then
      if not (B.Enabled) then
        w.on = true
        B.Enabled = true
      end
    else
      w.on = true
      B.Enabled = true
    end
  end
  t.destroy = function(G)
    G:drop_links()
    local i = G.inst
    G.inst = nil
    G.char = nil
    G.root = nil
    G.dirty = false
    G.on = false
    if i then
      pcall(i.Destroy, i)
    end
  end
  return t
end

-- Module D
modules.D = function()
  local G = modules.load("s")
  local i = modules.load("v")
  local u = modules.load("z")
  local j = G.white
  local w = Color3.new()
  local t, Z = math.round, {}
  Z.__index = Z
  Z.new = function(h, A)
    A = assert(A, "No options")
    A.en = ((A.en == nil) and true) or A.en
    A.txt = A.txt or "{name}"
    A.txtCol = A.txtCol or {j, 1}
    A.txtOut = ((A.txtOut == nil) and true) or A.txtOut
    A.txtOCol = A.txtOCol or w
    A.txtSz = A.txtSz or 13
    A.txtFnt = A.txtFnt or 3
    A.limDis = A.limDis or false
    A.maxDis = A.maxDis or 150
    A.txtGrd = A.txtGrd or false
    A.txtGrdCol = A.txtGrdCol or {j, Color3.new(1, 0, 0)}
    return setmetatable({inst = assert(h, "No instance"), opt = A, ph = math.random(), dead = false}, Z)
  end
  Z.update = function(j)
  end
  Z.draw = function(j)
    if j.dead then
      return
    end
    local w = j.inst
    if w then
      if not (w.Parent) then
        j.dead = true
        return
      end
    else
      j.dead = true
      return
    end
    local h = j.opt
    if not (h.en) then
      return
    end
    local A, B = pcall(w.GetPivot, w)
    if not (A) then
      return
    end
    A = B.Position
    local B, d, _ = G.to_screen(A)
    if B then
      if not (d) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if h.limDis then
      if _ > h.maxDis then
        return
      end
    end
    local G, d, b = h.txt:gsub("{name}", w.Name):gsub("{distance}", t(_)):gsub("{position}", tostring(A)), h.txtSz, (h.txtOut and h.txtOCol) or nil
    if h.txtGrd then
      u.grad_text(G, B.X, B.Y, d, b, h.txtCol[2], h.txtGrdCol[1], h.txtGrdCol[2], j.ph)
    elseif b then
      i.outlined_text(B, d, h.txtCol[1], h.txtCol[2], b, h.txtCol[2], G, true)
    else
      i.text(B, d, h.txtCol[1], h.txtCol[2], G, true)
    end
  end
  Z.destroy = function(G)
    G.dead = true
    G.inst = nil
  end
  return Z
end

-- Module F
modules.F = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i = modules.load("a")
  local u = modules.load("s")
  local j = modules.load("t")
  local w = modules.load("v")
  local t = modules.load("w")
  local Z = modules.load("z")
  local h = modules.load("A")
  local A = modules.load("B")
  local B = modules.load("C")
  local d = modules.load("D")
  local _, b = modules.load("E"), modules.load("p")
  local x = modules.load("g")
  local v = G.players
  local H = G.workspace
  local l = G.http
  local W = G.lp
  local q = math.floor
  local J, D = os.clock, {}
  D["Counter-Terrorists"] = Color3.fromRGB(120, 170, 255)
  D.Terrorists = Color3.fromRGB(230, 170, 60)
  D.CT = Color3.fromRGB(120, 170, 255)
  D.T = Color3.fromRGB(230, 170, 60)
  local m = {}
  m.ViewResolver = u.resolver
  m._loaded = false
  m._objCache = {}
  m._clones = {}
  m.wlist = _.wlist or {}
  m.shSet = _.shSet
  m.allowlocal = _.allowlocal == true
  m.tSet = _.tSet
  local _, Y, O = {}, 0, 0
  local function Q()
    return H:FindFirstChild("Characters")
  end
  local function F(I)
    return I.Character
  end
  local function I(E)
    return (((typeof(E) == "Instance") and (E.Parent ~= nil)) and E:IsDescendantOf(H)) and (E:GetAttribute("ClientCharacterPresentationVisible") ~= false)
  end
  local function H(E)
    if not (E) then
      return nil
    end
    local V, N = pcall(F, E)
    if V then
      if I(N) then
        return N
      end
    end
    N = E.Name
    if type(N) == "string" then
      V = Q()
      if V then
        E = V:FindFirstChild(N)
        if I(E) then
          return E
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function Q(F)
    if not (F) then
      return nil
    end
    local E, V = pcall(F.GetAttribute, F, "Team")
    if E then
      if type(V) == "string" then
        if V ~= "" then
          return V
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local F, E = {}, 0
  local function V(N)
    return l:JSONDecode(N)
  end
  local function l(N)
    if type(N) ~= "string" then
      return nil
    elseif N == "" then
      return nil
    end
    local a = F[N]
    if a ~= nil then
      return a or nil
    end
    local a, U = pcall(V, N)
    if E > 500 then
      table.clear(F)
      E = 0
    end
    E += 1
    if a then
      if type(U) == "table" then
        F[N] = U
        return U
      end
    end
    F[N] = false
    return nil
  end
  local V = G.weak()
  m.getIndicators = function(N, a, U)
    local g = V[N]
    if g then
    else
      g = {bomb = false, scope = false, flashed = false, defuse = false}
      V[N] = g
    end
    if typeof(N) ~= "Instance" then
      if not (x.is(N)) then
        local V = m._clones[N] ~= nil
        g.bomb = V
        g.scope = V
        g.defuse = V
        g.flashed = V and (U == true)
        return g
      end
    end
    local V = N:GetAttribute("Slot5")
    if g.slot5 ~= V then
      g.slot5 = V
      local X = l(V)
      g.bomb = (X ~= nil) and (X.Weapon == "C4")
    end
    g.scope = (tonumber(N:GetAttribute("ScopeIncrement")) or 0) > 0
    g.defuse = N:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb") == true
    if not (U) then
      g.flashed = false
      return g
    end
    N = J()
    if (g.char ~= a) or (N >= (g.refresh or 0)) then
      g.char = a
      g.refresh = N + 0.05
      g.flashed = false
      V = g.animator
      if if V then V.Parent == nil else not V then
        V = a and (a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true))
        g.animator = V
      else
      end
      if V then
        local N, a = pcall(V.GetPlayingAnimationTracks, V)
        if N then
          for V = 1, #a, 1 do
            U = a[V]
            V = U.Animation
            if U.IsPlaying then
              if V then
                if V.AnimationId == "rbxassetid://101513162753523" then
                  g.flashed = true
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return g
  end
  m.getChar = function(V)
    local N = b.char(V)
    if N == false then
      return nil
    end
    local a = m._clones[V]
    if a then
      N = a.model
      if N then
        if not (N.Parent) then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      if N == nil then
        N = (H(V))
      else
        if not (b.ghost(N)) then
          if not (I(N)) then
            return nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if N then
      if N:GetAttribute("CharacterType") ~= "PlayerCustomCharacter" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    V, a = pcall(N.GetAttribute, N, "Dead")
    if V then
      if a == true then
        return nil
      end
    end
    return N
  end
  m.isFr = function(I)
    if not (I) then
      return false
    end
    if I == W then
      return true
    end
    local V = u.frame()
    if m._mtFrame ~= V then
      m._mtFrame = V
      m._mt = Q(W)
    end
    local W, V = m._mt, Q(I)
    if W then
      if not (V) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    return W == V
  end
  m.getTC = function(W)
    local I = Q(W)
    return (I and D[I]) or nil
  end
  m.getTeam = function(W)
    return Q(W)
  end
  m.getHp = function(W, D)
    D = D or (W and (H(W)))
    if not (D) then
      return 0, 100
    end
    if D:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
      return 0, D:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or 100
    end
    local H, W = D:GetAttribute("Health"), D:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
    return if type(H) ~= "number" then 100 else H, if type(W) ~= "number" then 100 else if W <= 0 then 100 else W
  end
  m.getArm = function(H)
    if not (H) then
      return 0
    end
    local W = l(H:GetAttribute("Armor"))
    if W then
      if type(W.Health) == "number" then
        return W.Health
      end
    end
    return 0
  end
  m.getWep = function(H)
    if not (H) then
      return ""
    end
    local W = l(H:GetAttribute("CurrentEquipped"))
    if W then
      if type(W.Name) == "string" then
        return W.Name
      end
    end
    return ""
  end
  m.getPing = function(H)
    if not (H) then
      return 0
    end
    local l = H:GetAttribute("Ping")
    return ((type(l) == "number") and q(l + 0.5)) or 0
  end
  m.getMoney = function(H)
    if not (H) then
      return 0
    end
    local l = H:GetAttribute("Money")
    return ((type(l) == "number") and q(l + 0.5)) or 0
  end
  local function H(l, W, q, D, Q)
    local I = {key = l, state = W, cham = q, kind = D, hl = Q}
    _[#_ + 1] = I
    m._objCache[l] = I
    return I
  end
  local function l(W)
    local q = m._objCache[W]
    if not (q) then
      return
    end
    m._objCache[W] = nil
    for D = 1, #_, 1 do
      if _[D] == q then
        W = #_
        _[D] = _[W]
        _[W] = nil
        break
      end
    end
    if q.state then
      if q.state.destroy then
        pcall(q.state.destroy, q.state)
      end
    end
    if q.cham then
      pcall(q.cham.destroy, q.cham)
    end
    if q.hl then
      pcall(q.hl.destroy, q.hl)
    end
  end
  local function W(q)
    if m._objCache[q] then
      return
    end
    H(q, h.new(q, m), A.new(q, m), "player", B.new(q, m))
  end
  local function B(q)
    l(q)
  end
  m.AddInst = function(q, D)
    if m._objCache[q] then
      return m._objCache[q].state
    end
    local Q = d.new(q, D)
    H(q, Q, nil, "inst")
    return Q
  end
  m.AddClone = function(d, q, D, Q)
    if m._loaded then
      if d then
        if not (q) then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local I = Q or {}
    local Q = {Name = q.Name, DisplayName = q.DisplayName, UserId = q.UserId, Character = d, Parent = v, GetAttribute = function(V, V)
      return I[V]
    end}
    m._clones[Q] = {model = d, real = q, viewport = D}
    Y += 1
    H(Q, h.new(Q, m), nil, "clone")
    return Q
  end
  m.RemoveClone = function(h)
    if h then
      if not (m._clones[h]) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    m._clones[h] = nil
    Y -= 1
    if Y < 0 then
      Y = 0
    end
    l(h)
  end
  m.UpdateClone = function(h, d)
    local H = h and m._clones[h]
    if not (H) then
      return
    end
    H.model = d
    h.Character = d
  end
  local h, d = false, false
  local function H(l)
    w.scale(1)
    l:draw()
  end
  local function l(q)
    local D = q.state
    D:update()
    w.scale(b.fade(D.plr))
    Z.draw(D)
    w.scale(1)
    D = q.cham
    if D then
      if h then
        D:update()
      end
    end
    D = q.hl
    if D then
      if d then
        D:update()
      end
    end
  end
  local function Z()
    for b = 1, #_, 1 do
      local q = _[b]
      if q.kind == "inst" then
        pcall(H, q.state)
      else
        pcall(l, q)
      end
    end
  end
  local function b()
    for H = 1, #_, 1 do
      local l = _[H].hl
      if l then
        pcall(l.unbind, l)
      end
    end
  end
  local function H()
    for l = 1, #_, 1 do
      local q = _[l].cham
      if q then
        pcall(q.clear, q)
      end
    end
  end
  local function l()
    if not (m._loaded) then
      return
    end
    local q, D = m.tSet.en, m.tSet.fr
    local Q, I = q.en, D.en
    if Q then
    elseif I then
    elseif Y == 0 then
      if d then
        d = false
        b()
      end
      if h then
        h = false
        H()
      end
      return
    end
    local V, N = (((Q and q.chams) or (I and D.chams)) and true) or false, (((Q and q.hlt) or (I and D.hlt)) and true) or false
    if h then
      if not (V) then
        H()
      end
    end
    if d then
      if not (N) then
        b()
      end
    end
    h, d = V, N
    q = J()
    Q = ((O > 0) and (q - O)) or 0
    O = q
    u.begin_frame()
    j.mask_step()
    t.open()
    if h then
      A.begin_frame(Q)
    end
    Z()
    w.scale(1)
    t.close()
  end
  m.step = l
  local function u()
    for Z = 1, #_, 1 do
      local A = _[Z]
      Z = A.state
      if A.kind ~= "inst" then
        if Z.validate then
          if not (Z:validate()) then
            Z.cacheValid = false
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  m.Load = function()
    if m._loaded then
      return
    end
    m._loaded = true
    local Z = v:GetPlayers()
    for A = 1, #Z, 1 do
      W(Z[A])
    end
    local Z, A = x.list()
    for b = 1, A, 1 do
      W(Z[b])
    end
    i.connect(v.PlayerAdded, W)
    i.connect(v.PlayerRemoving, B)
    x.on(function(Z)
      if m._loaded then
        W(Z)
      end
    end, B)
    w.run(l)
    local w = 0
    i.connect(G.run.Heartbeat, function(G)
      w += G
      if w < 0.1 then
        return
      end
      w = 0
      u()
    end)
  end
  m.Unload = function()
    if not (m._loaded) then
      return
    end
    m._loaded = false
    for G = #_, 1, -1 do
      local u = _[G]
      _[G] = nil
      if u.state then
        if u.state.destroy then
          pcall(u.state.destroy, u.state)
        end
      end
      if u.cham then
        pcall(u.cham.destroy, u.cham)
      end
      if u.hl then
        pcall(u.hl.destroy, u.hl)
      end
    end
    h, d = false, false
    table.clear(m._objCache)
    table.clear(m._clones)
    table.clear(F)
    E, Y = 0, 0
    for G = #m.wlist, 1, -1 do
      m.wlist[G] = nil
    end
    t.purge()
    j.purge()
  end
  i.teardown(m.Unload)
  return m
end

      if j.Player == B then
        if typeof(j.Model) == "Instance" then
          return j, j.CameraModelWeapon or j.Weapon
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function j(t, Z)
    if t == nil then
      return t == Z
    elseif Z == nil then
      return t == Z
    end
    return ((t.skin == Z.skin) and (t.wear == Z.wear)) and (t.stat == Z.stat)
  end
  local function t(Z, h)
    local A = {"Weapon", "WeaponL", "WeaponR", "Interactables"}
    for B, d in A, nil, nil do
      local A, _ = Z:FindFirstChild(d), h:FindFirstChild(d)
      if A then
        if not (_) then
          continue
        end
      else
        continue
      end
      d = {}
      for Z, Z in A:GetDescendants() do
        if Z:IsA("MeshPart") then
          d[Z.Name] = Z
        end
      end
      for Z, h in _:GetDescendants() do
        B = h:IsA("MeshPart") and d[h.Name]
        if B then
          A, Z = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance"), B:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
          if Z then
            Z:Clone().Parent = h
          end
          h.TextureID = B.TextureID
          if A then
            A:Destroy()
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function Z(h, A, B)
    if type(m) ~= "function" then
      return
    elseif type(A) ~= "string" then
      return
    end
    local d, _, b = h.Model, pcall(m, A, (B and B.skin) or h.Skin, (B and B.wear) or h.Float)
    if _ then
      if typeof(b) ~= "Instance" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if h.Model == d then
      if G() == h then
        if j(B, H[A]) then
          pcall(t, b, d)
        end
      end
    end
    b:Destroy()
  end
  u.load = function(t)
    local h, A = G()
    local B = A and H[A]
    table.clear(H)
    t = ((type(t) == "table") and t) or {}
    for d, _ in w, nil, nil do
      local b = ((type(t[d]) == "table") and t[d]) or {}
      for x in _, nil, nil do
        v[d][x] = b[x] or {model = "Stock", skin = "Stock", wear = 0, stat = false}
      end
    end
    for d, _ in ((type(t.guns) == "table") and t.guns) or {}, nil, nil do
      H[d] = _
    end
    O()
    local t = A and H[A]
    if h then
      if not (j(t, B)) then
        task.defer(Z, h, A, t)
      end
    end
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    local i, j = G()
    local G = j and H[j]
    table.clear(H)
    if G then
      Z(i, j, nil)
    end
  end)
  local function G(i, j)
    if type(i) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif type(i.skin) ~= "string" then
      return nil
    elseif type(j) ~= "string" then
      return nil
    end
    return {model = j, skin = i.skin, wear = math.clamp(tonumber(i.wear) or 0, 0, 1), stat = i.stat == true}
  end
  u.normalize = function(i)
    local j = {guns = {}, knife = {}, glove = {}}
    i = ((type(i) == "table") and i) or {}
    for t, Z in ((type(i.guns) == "table") and i.guns) or {}, nil, nil do
      if type(t) == "string" then
        j.guns[t] = G(Z, t)
      end
    end
    for t in w, nil, nil do
      local Z = i[t]
      if type(Z) == "table" then
        local i = {"t", "ct"}
        for h, A in i, nil, nil do
          h = Z[A]
          if type(h) == "table" then
            j[t][A] = G(h, h.model)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return j
  end
  u.migrate = function(G)
    local i = {guns = {}, knife = {}, glove = {}}
    for j in w, nil, nil do
      local w = "skins." .. (j .. ".")
      local t, Z = G[w .. "model"], G[w .. "skin"]
      if type(t) == "string" then
        if t ~= "Stock" then
          local h = {model = t, skin = ((type(Z) == "string") and Z) or "Stock", wear = (tonumber(G[w .. "wear"]) or 0) / 100}
          i[j] = {t = h, ct = table.clone(h)}
        end
      end
    end
    return i
  end
  u.look = function(G, i)
    local j, w = v.glove[G] or {}, i and H[i]
    return tostring(j.model) .. ("/" .. (tostring(j.skin) .. ("/" .. (tostring(j.wear) .. ((w and ("/" .. (tostring(w.skin) .. ("/" .. tostring(w.wear))))) or "")))))
  end
  u.equipped = function(G, i)
    if G.kind == "gun" then
      return H[G.name]
    end
    local j = v[G.kind]
    local w = j and j[i]
    if w then
      if w.model == G.name then
        return w
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  return u
end

-- Module H
modules.H = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i = modules.load("a")
  local u = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
  local j = Enum.UserInputType.Touch
  local w = Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
  local t = Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel
  local Z = math.tan
  local h = math.rad
  local A = math.max
  local B, d = math.clamp, {}
  d.__index = d
  local function _(b, x, v, H)
    local l, W = b.make("ViewportFrame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = v, Ambient = (H and Color3.new(1, 1, 1)) or Color3.fromRGB(176, 176, 182), LightColor = (H and Color3.new()) or Color3.fromRGB(245, 244, 241), LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -0.65, -0.85), Parent = x}), Instance.new("Camera")
    W.Parent = l
    l.CurrentCamera = W
    x = Instance.new("WorldModel")
    x.Parent = l
    return {view = l, cam = W, world = x}
  end
  d.new = function(b, x, v)
    v = v or {}
    local H, l, W, q, J = _(x, b, 1, true), _(x, b, 2, false), _(x, b, 3, true), _(x, b, 4, true), x.make("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 5, Parent = b})
    local _ = setmetatable({host = b, view = l.view, cam = l.cam, world = l.world, back = H, veil = W, top = q, fov = v.fov or 30, yaw = v.yaw or 0, pitch = v.pitch or 0.06, base_yaw = v.yaw or 0, base_pitch = v.pitch or 0.06, fill = v.fill or 1.12, xfill = (v.xfill or v.fill) or 1.12, pad = v.pad or 1, shift = v.shift or 0, near = v.near or 0.8, far = v.far or 1.7, zoom = 1, spin = false, model = nil, center = Vector3.zero, size = Vector3.one}, d)
    _:lens(_.fov)
    local x, v
    J.InputBegan:Connect(function(H)
      if _.model then
        if not (_.pinned) then
          if H.UserInputType == u then
            local W
            W, x = H.Position, H
            v = W
          elseif H.UserInputType == j then
            local j
            j, x = H.Position, H
            v = j
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    local function j(H)
      if _.model then
        if not (_.pinned) then
          if H.UserInputType == t then
            _.zoom = B(_.zoom - (H.Position.Z * 0.08), _.near, _.far)
            _:frame()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    J.InputChanged:Connect(j)
    i.connect(G.input.InputChanged, function(j)
      if x then
        if not (j == x) then
          if x.UserInputType == u then
            if j.UserInputType ~= w then
              return
            end
          else
            return
          end
        end
      else
        return
      end
      local u = j.Position - v
      v = j.Position
      _.yaw = _.yaw - (u.X * 0.009)
      _.pitch = B(_.pitch - (u.Y * 0.006), -0.9, 0.9)
      _:frame()
    end)
    i.connect(G.input.InputEnded, function(G)
      if G == x then
        x, v = nil, nil
      end
    end)
    J, b = l.view, function()
      _:frame()
    end
    J:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(b)
    _.dragging = function()
      local G = x
      return G ~= nil
    end
    return _
  end
  d.frame = function(G)
    local i = G.view.AbsoluteSize
    if G.model then
      if i.X < 1 then
        return
      elseif i.Y < 1 then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if G.pinned then
      G.cam.CFrame = G.pinned
      G.back.cam.CFrame = G.pinned
      G.veil.cam.CFrame = G.pinned
      G.top.cam.CFrame = G.pinned
      return
    end
    local u = Z(h(G.fov) * 0.5)
    local j, w = (u * i.X) / i.Y, G.size
    i = math.sqrt((w.X * w.X) + (w.Z * w.Z)) * 0.5
    local t = (A(((w.Y * 0.5) / u) * G.fill, (i / j) * G.xfill) * G.zoom) + (i * G.pad)
    i = (CFrame.new(G.center) * CFrame.fromOrientation(G.pitch, G.yaw, 0)) * CFrame.new(((G.shift * 2) * t) * j, 0, t)
    G.cam.CFrame = i
    G.back.cam.CFrame = i
    G.veil.cam.CFrame = i
    G.top.cam.CFrame = i
  end
  local function G(i)
    local u, j = Vector3.one * 1000000000, Vector3.one * -1000000000
    for w, w in i, nil, nil do
      local i, t = w.Size * 0.5, w.Position
      u, j = (u:Min(t - i)), j:Max(t + i)
    end
    return (u + j) * 0.5, j - u
  end
  d.set = function(i, u, j, w)
    if i.model then
      if i.model ~= u then
        i.model:Destroy()
      end
    end
    i.model = u
    if not (u) then
      return
    end
    if w and (#w > 0) then
      i.center, i.size = G(w)
    else
      local w, t = u:GetBoundingBox()
      i.center = w.Position
      i.size = t
    end
    u.Parent = i.world
    i.pinned = nil
    if not (j) then
      i.yaw, i.pitch = i.base_yaw, i.base_pitch
      i.zoom = 1
    end
    i:frame()
  end
  d.lens = function(i, u)
    i.fov = u
    i.cam.FieldOfView = u
    i.back.cam.FieldOfView = u
    i.veil.cam.FieldOfView = u
    i.top.cam.FieldOfView = u
  end
  d.pin = function(i, u)
    i.pinned = u
    i:frame()
  end
  d.refit = function(i, u)
    if i.model then
      if u then
        if #u > 0 then
          i.center, i.size = G(u)
          i:frame()
        end
      end
    end
  end
  d.turn = function(G, i, u)
    if G.spin then
      if G.model then
        if not (G.pinned) then
          if not (G.dragging()) then
            G.yaw = G.yaw + (i * (u or 0.45))
            G:frame()
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  d.shown = function(G)
    local i = G.view
    G = i.AbsoluteSize
    if G.X < 2 then
      return false
    elseif G.Y < 2 then
      return false
    end
    while i do
      if i:IsA("GuiObject") then
        if i.Visible then
          if i:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
            if i.GroupTransparency > 0.01 then
              return false
            end
          end
        else
          return false
        end
      elseif i:IsA("LayerCollector") then
        return i.Enabled
      end
      i = i.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  d.covered = function(G, i)
    local u, j = G.view.AbsolutePosition, G.view.AbsoluteSize
    local w, t, Z, h = u.X, u.Y, u.X + j.X, u.Y + j.Y
    for j = 1, #i, 1 do
      u = i[j]
      j, G = u.AbsolutePosition, u.AbsoluteSize
      if j.X < Z then
        if (j.X + G.X) > w then
          if j.Y < h then
            if (j.Y + G.Y) > t then
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  d.dock = function(G, i, u, j)
    local w = G:col(2)
    i.Parent = w
    i.LayoutOrder = 0
    i.ClipsDescendants = true
    i.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    i.BackgroundTransparency = 0.97
    u.corner(i, 8)
    u.stroke(i, 0.93)
    local function G()
      local t = u.scale()
      local u = ((w.AbsoluteSize.Y / t) - 30) - (j.AbsoluteSize.Y / t)
      i.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, A(140, math.floor(u)))
    end
    w:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(G)
    j:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(G)
    task.defer(G)
  end
  d.label = function(G, i)
    return i.make("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -10), Text = "", FontFace = i.fonts.s, TextSize = 12, ZIndex = 5, Parent = G}, {TextColor3 = "dim"})
  end
  d.destroy = function(G)
    if G.model then
      G.model:Destroy()
      G.model = nil
    end
  end
  return d
end

-- Module I
modules.I = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u = modules.load("q"), modules.load("a")

  local d = i.world
  local _ = i.white
  local i = G.lp

  local v = w.lib
  local w = os.clock
  local H = Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged
  local l, W, q, J, D, m = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, {ct = "rbxassetid://77870220857645", t = "rbxassetid://99540873384647"}, {ct = "M4A1-S", t = "AK-47"}, {ct = "CT", t = "T"}, {ct = "Counter-Terrorists", t = "Terrorists"}, {HumanoidRootPart = true, CameraPart = true}
  local Y, O, Q = Vector3.one * 0.12, {}

    Q = Q or G.module(b, "Controllers", "MenuSceneController")
    local b = Q
    return b
  end
  local b = "t"

    local I = i:GetAttribute("Team")
    if I == D.ct then
      b = "ct"
    elseif I == D.t then

    else

        return E.GetMenuCharacterTeam()
      end)
      if V then
        if N == D.ct then
          b = "ct"
        elseif V then

            b = "t"
          end
        end
      elseif V then
        if N == D.t then

        end
      end
    end
    I = b

  end
  local function I(E, V)

      return
    elseif a then
    else
      return
    end

    if U then
      if U.skin ~= "Stock" then
        if type(N.GetCharacterModel) == "function" then
          g, X = G.plain(N.GetCharacterModel, j, U.skin, U.wear)

        g, X = G.plain(N.GetBaseWeaponModel, j, "Character")

    end

      if typeof(X) ~= "Instance" then
        return

      return

    X.Archivable = true
    N = X:Clone()

      return
    end
    V = N.PrimaryPart
    if V then
    else
      U = N:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
      V = U and (U:FindFirstChild("Insert"))
    end
    if not V then
      N:Destroy()

    end
    N.Name = j
    N.Parent = E

    E.Name = "WeaponAttachment"

        if not (m[E.Name]) then
          if E.Transparency < 0.99 then
            I[#I + 1] = E
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return I
  end
  local function m(F, I)
    local E = F.Archivable
