    F.Archivable = E
    if if V then not N else not V then
      N = Instance.new("Part")
      N.Size = F.Size
    else
    end
    for E, E in N:GetChildren() do
      if E:IsA("DataModelMesh") then
        if E:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
          E.TextureId = ""
        end
        if I then
          E.Scale = E.Scale * 1.06
        end
      else
        E:Destroy()
      end
    end
    if N:IsA("MeshPart") then
      N.TextureID = ""
    end
    N.Name = "ghost"
    N.Anchored = true
    N.CanCollide = false
    N.CanQuery = false
    N.CanTouch = false
    N.CastShadow = false
    N.Material = l
    N.Reflectance = 0
    N.Transparency = 0
    if I then
      N.Size = F.Size + Y
    end
    return N
  end
  O.build = j
  O.animate = J
  O.side = Q
  O.mount = function(Y)
    Y:mount(function(F, I)
      local E = B.label(F, I)
      local V = B.new(F, I, {fov = 26, yaw = 3.561592653589793, pitch = 0.05, fill = 1.42, xfill = 0.8, near = 0.9, far = 1.6})
      local N = Y:section({name = "preview", side = 2})
      N:toggle({name = "rotate", flag = "vis.preview_spin", cb = function(a)
        d.preview_spin = a
      end})
      B.dock(Y, F, I, N.sec.frame)
      local B
      local Y, I, N, a, U = false, 0
      local g, X, o, R, p, c, M = {}, {}, {}, {}, {Armor = "{\"Health\":100}", Money = 16000, Ping = 24}, {}, 0
      local T = w()
      local function L(k)
        for P = #k, 1, -1 do
          local z = k[P]
          if typeof(z) == "Instance" then
            z:Destroy()
          else
            z.fill:Destroy()
            z.glow:Destroy()
          end
          k[P] = nil
        end
      end
      local function k(P, z)
        L(g)
        L(X)
        L(o)
        table.clear(R)
        local n = N ~= nil
        N = P
        local P, K = {}, N
        for S, S in K:GetChildren() do
          if S:IsA("BasePart") then
            if h.body_parts[S.Name] then
              P[#P + 1] = S
            end
          end
        end
        V:set(N, n, P)
        J(N, z)
        a = W(N)
        p.CurrentEquipped = "{\"Name\":\"" .. (q[z] .. "\"}")
        if U then
          t.UpdateClone(U, N)
        end
        E.Text = ""
      end
      local function h(W, J)
        Y = true
        I += 1
        local P = I
        if not (N) then
          E.Text = "loading model"
        end
        task.spawn(function()
          local z = j(W)
          Y = false
          if P ~= I then
            if z then
              z:Destroy()
            end
            return
          elseif not (F.Parent) then
            if z then
              z:Destroy()
            end
            return
          end
          if z then
            B = J
            k(z, W)
          else
            E.Text = "model unavailable"
          end
        end)
      end
      local j, W, J, F, E, k = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
      local function P()
        local z = Instance.new("Part")
        z.Anchored = true
        z.CanCollide = false
        z.CanQuery = false
        z.CanTouch = false
        z.CastShadow = false
        z.Material = l
        z.Parent = V.top.world
        return z
      end
      local function l(z, n)
        for K = #z, n + 1, -1 do
          z[K] = nil
        end
      end
      local function z(n)
        local K, S, e, C = n.en, 0, 0, 0
        if K and n.hlt then
          local s, r = n.hltFCol, n.hltOCol
          local yO, fO, GO, iO = b(s[1]), b(r[1]), 1 - (tonumber(s[2]) or 0.5), #a
          for uO = 1, iO, 1 do
            local iO, jO, wO = a[uO], g[uO], X[uO]
            if jO then
            else
              jO = m(iO)
              jO.Parent = V.veil.world
              g[uO] = jO
              wO = m(iO, true)
              wO.Parent = V.back.world
              X[uO] = wO
            end
            if jO.Color ~= yO then
              jO.Color = yO
            end
            if wO.Color ~= fO then
              wO.Color = fO
            end
            s = iO.CFrame
            C += 1
            E[C] = jO
            k[C] = s
            e += 1
            J[e] = wO
            F[e] = s
          end
          V.back.view.ImageTransparency = 1 - (tonumber(r[2]) or 1)
          V.veil.view.ImageTransparency = GO
        else
          if #g > 0 then
            L(g)
            L(X)
          end
        end
        local m = 0
        if K then
          if n.chams then
            local a = Z.snapshot(N, D[Q()], R)
            local Z = (a and #a) or 0
            if Z > 0 then
              local D = b(n.chamsOCol[1])
              local b, R, K = D:Lerp(_, 0.35), 0.85 - (math.clamp((tonumber(n.chamsGlow) or 4) / 12, 0, 1) * 0.5), S
              for _ = 1, Z, 1 do
                local s, r = a[_], o[_]
                if r then
                else
                  r = {fill = P(), glow = P()}
                  o[_] = r
                end
                _ = s.size
                if r.fill.Size ~= _ then
                  r.fill.Size = _
                  r.glow.Size = _ * 1.12
                end
                if r.fill.Color ~= D then
                  r.fill.Color = D
                  r.glow.Color = b
                end
                if r.glow.Transparency ~= R then
                  r.glow.Transparency = R
                end
                _ = s.part.CFrame
                K += 1
                j[K] = r.fill
                W[K] = _
                K += 1
                j[K] = r.glow
                W[K] = _
              end
              S = K
            else
            end
            m = Z
          else
          end
        else
        end
        for Z = #o, m + 1, -1 do
          n = o[Z]
          n.fill:Destroy()
          n.glow:Destroy()
          o[Z] = nil
        end
        l(j, S)
        l(W, S)
        l(J, e)
        l(F, e)
        l(E, C)
        l(k, C)
        if C > 0 then
          pcall(V.veil.world.BulkMoveTo, V.veil.world, E, k, H)
        end
        if S > 0 then
          pcall(V.top.world.BulkMoveTo, V.top.world, j, W, H)
        end
        if e > 0 then
          pcall(V.back.world.BulkMoveTo, V.back.world, J, F, H)
        end
      end
      u.connect(G.run.RenderStepped, function()
        local G = w()
        local j = G - T
        T = G
        if v:isopen() then
          if not (V:shown()) then
            x.VISUALS_TAB_OPEN = false
            return
          end
        else
          x.VISUALS_TAB_OPEN = false
          return
        end
        if (G - M) > 0.4 then
          if not (Y) then
            M = G
            local G = Q()
            local w = G .. ("|" .. A.look(G, q[G]))
            if w ~= B then
              h(G, w)
            end
          end
        end
        if not (N) then
          x.VISUALS_TAB_OPEN = false
          return
        end
        if not (U) then
          if t._loaded then
            U = t.AddClone(N, i, V.view, p)
          end
        end
        p.Ping = tonumber(i:GetAttribute("Ping")) or p.Ping
        V.spin = d.preview_spin == true
        V:turn(j)
        z(t.tSet.en)
        x.VISUALS_TAB_OPEN = not V:covered(v:popups(c))
      end)
      u.teardown(function()
        x.VISUALS_TAB_OPEN = nil
        if U then
          pcall(t.RemoveClone, U)
          U = nil
        end
        I += 1
        L(g)
        L(X)
        L(o)
        V:destroy()
      end)
    end)
  end
  return O
end

-- Module J
modules.J = function()
  local G, i, u = modules.load("b"), {}
  local j = false
  i.tex = function()
    if u then
      local w = u
      return w
    elseif j then
      local w = u
      return w
    end
    local w, t = pcall(function()
      local Z, h = G.assets:CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(32, 32)}), buffer.create(4096)
      for A = 0, 31, 1 do
        for B = 0, 31, 1 do
          local d, _ = (((B + 0.5) / 32) * 2) - 1, (((A + 0.5) / 32) * 2) - 1
          local b = (d * d) + (_ * _)
          _, d = ((b >= 1) and 0) or (math.exp(-b * 4.5) * (1 - b)), ((A * 32) + B) * 4
          buffer.writeu8(h, d, 255)
          buffer.writeu8(h, d + 1, 255)
          buffer.writeu8(h, d + 2, 255)
          buffer.writeu8(h, d + 3, math.floor((_ * 255) + 0.5))
        end
      end
      Z:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(32, 32), h)
      return Content.fromObject(Z)
    end)
    if w then
      if t then
        u = t
      else
        j = true
      end
    else
      j = true
    end
    t = u
    return t
  end
  local u
  local j = false
  i.ring = function()
    if u then
      local w, t = u[1], u
      return w, t[2]
    end
    if j then
      return nil
    end
    local w, t, Z = pcall(function()
      local h, A, B, d = G.assets:CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(256, 256)}), G.assets:CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(256, 256)}), buffer.create(262144), buffer.create(262144)
      for G = 0, 255, 1 do
        for _ = 0, 255, 1 do
          local b, x = (((_ + 0.5) / 256) * 2) - 1, (((G + 0.5) / 256) * 2) - 1
          local v = math.abs(math.sqrt((b * b) + (x * x)) - 0.8)
          local b, x, H = math.clamp(1 - ((v - 0.012) / 0.012), 0, 1), (math.exp(-((v / 0.075) ^ 2)) * 0.9) + (math.exp(-((v / 0.025) ^ 2)) * 0.35), ((G * 256) + _) * 4
          buffer.writeu32(B, H, 16777215)
          buffer.writeu32(d, H, 16777215)
          buffer.writeu8(B, H + 3, math.floor((b * 255) + 0.5))
          buffer.writeu8(d, H + 3, math.floor((math.min(x, 1) * 255) + 0.5))
        end
      end
      h:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(256, 256), B)
      A:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(256, 256), d)
      return Content.fromObject(h), Content.fromObject(A)
    end)
    if w then
      if t then
        if Z then
          u = {t, Z}
          return t, Z
        end
      end
    end
    j = true
    return nil
  end
  return i
end

-- Module K
modules.K = function()
  local G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local u = modules.load("h")
  local j = modules.load("j")
  local w = modules.load("k")
  local t = modules.load("p")
  local Z = modules.load("n")
  local h = modules.load("J")
  local A = G.workspace
  local B = G.storage
  local d = G.tween
  local _ = G.debris
  local b = G.lp
  local G = Vector3.new
  local x = math.abs
  local v = math.min
  local H, l = os.clock, {on = false}
  l.col = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  l.alpha = 1
  l.size = 6
  l.life = 0.9
  local W, q, J = {}, setmetatable, {__mode = "k"}
  local D, m, Y = q({}, J), false
  local q, J = 0, {}
  local O = H()
  local Q = RaycastParams.new()
  Q.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  Q.IgnoreWater = true
  local function F()
    local I = B:FindFirstChild("Sounds")
    local B = I and (I:FindFirstChild("FloorSounds"))
    if not (B) then
      return
    end
    for I, I in B:GetDescendants() do
      if I:IsA("Sound") then
        W[I.SoundId] = true
      end
    end
  end
  local function B()
    if Y then
      if Y.Parent then
        local I = Y
        return I
      end
    end
    local I = A.CurrentCamera
    if not (I) then
      return nil
    end
    Y = Instance.new("Folder")
    Y.Parent = I
    i.own(Y)
    I = Y
    return I
  end
  local function I(E)
    local V = E.Parent
    if not (V) then
      return nil
    end
    if V:IsA("Attachment") then
      return V.WorldPosition
    end
    if V:IsA("BasePart") then
      return V.Position
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function E(V, N)
    local a = J[V]
    if a then
      if (N - a.at) < 0.5 then
        return a.pos + (a.vel * (N - a.at))
      end
    end
    N, a = w.shown(V)
    if a then
      return a.Position
    end
    local N, N = t.info(V)
    if typeof(N) == "Vector3" then
      return N
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function t(V, N)
    local a = H()
    local U
    local g = b.Character
    g = g and (g:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    local X
    if g then
      if (g.Position - V).Magnitude < N then
        local o = (g.Position - V).Magnitude
        U, X = b, o
      else
        X = N
      end
    else
      X = N
    end
    local g, o = u.all()
    for u = 1, o, 1 do
      N = g[u]
      if N ~= b then
        if w.dead(N) then
        else
          u = E(N, a)
          if u then
            local a = (u - V).Magnitude
            if a < X then
              X, U = a, N
            else
            end
          else
          end
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return U
  end
  local function u(V)
    local N = t(V, 6)
    if N then
      return (N ~= b) and w.enemy(N)
    end
    return true
  end
  local function V(N, a)
    local U = N.Character
    if U then
      if U.Parent then
        if not (U:IsDescendantOf(A)) then
          return true
        end
      else
        return true
      end
    else
      return true
    end
    N = A.CurrentCamera
    return (N ~= nil) and ((N.CFrame.Position - a).Magnitude > 75)
  end
  local function N(a)
    local U, g = {}, j.ray_ignore
    if type(g) == "function" then
      local j, X = pcall(g)
      U = if j then if type(X) == "table" then table.clone(X) else U else U
    else
    end
    g = A:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    if g then
      table.insert(U, g)
    end
    if b.Character then
      table.insert(U, b.Character)
    end
    if Y then
      table.insert(U, Y)
    end
    Q.FilterDescendantsInstances = U
    g = A:Raycast(a + G(0, 0.5, 0), G(0, -8, 0), Q)
    if g then
      return g.Position, g.Normal
    end
    return a - G(0, 2.5, 0), Vector3.yAxis
  end
  local function j(Q, a)
    if q >= 64 then
      return
    end
    local U = B()
    if not (U) then
      return
    end
    local B = ((x(a.Y) > 0.98) and Vector3.xAxis) or Vector3.yAxis
    local x = a:Cross(B).Unit
    local g, X = x:Cross(a).Unit, Instance.new("Part")
    X.Anchored = true
    X.CanCollide = false
    X.CanQuery = false
    X.CanTouch = false
    X.CastShadow = false
    X.Transparency = 1
    B = l.size
    X.Size = G(B, 0.01, B)
    X.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(Q + (a * 0.012), x, a, g)
    local o = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
    o.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
    o.AlwaysOnTop = true
    o.LightInfluence = 0
    o.Brightness = 2
    o.ZOffset = 4
    o.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
    o.PixelsPerStud = 32
    o.Parent = X
    local R, p, c = l.life, l.col, 1 - l.alpha
    local M = TweenInfo.new(R, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local T = TweenInfo.new(R, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    local L = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.15)
    local k = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    a, x = h.ring()
    local function h(P, z)
      local n = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
      n.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
      n.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
      n.Size = L
      n.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      n.ImageContent = P
      n.ImageColor3 = z
      n.ImageTransparency = c
      n.Parent = o
      d:Create(n, M, {Size = k}):Play()
      d:Create(n, T, {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
    end
    X.Parent = U
    q += 1
    X.Destroying:Once(function()
      q -= 1
    end)
    if a then
      h(x, p)
      h(a, p:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.6))
    else
      Q = Instance.new("Frame")
      Q.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
      Q.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
      Q.Size = L
      Q.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      Q.Parent = o
      B = Instance.new("UICorner")
      B.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
      B.Parent = Q
      g = Instance.new("UIStroke")
      g.Color = p
      g.Thickness = 5
      g.Transparency = c
      g.Parent = Q
      d:Create(Q, M, {Size = k}):Play()
      d:Create(g, T, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 1.5}):Play()
    end
    _:AddItem(X, R + 0.2)
  end
  local function h(B)
    if l.on then
      if not (W[B.SoundId]) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local d = I(B)
    if d then
      if not (u(d)) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    j(N(d))
  end
  local function u(B)
    pcall(j, N(B))
  end
  local function j(B, d, _, x)
    local W = J[B]
    if W then
    else
      W = {pos = d, vel = Vector3.zero, at = x, ground = true, duck = 0, air = false, air_t = 0, peak = 0, acc = 0.25}
      J[B] = W
    end
    local q, Q = ((typeof(_.Velocity) == "Vector3") and _.Velocity) or Vector3.zero, _.OnGround ~= false
    if l.on then
      if w.enemy(B) then
        if V(B, d) then
          if Q then
            if W.air then
              if (x - W.air_t) >= 0.08 then
                if W.peak <= -2.5 then
                  u(d)
                end
              end
            end
          elseif not (W.air) then
            if q.Y > 2 then
              u(d)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if Q then
      W.air = false
    elseif W.air then
      W.peak = v(W.peak, q.Y)
    else
      W.air, W.air_t, W.peak = true, x, q.Y
    end
    W.pos, W.vel, W.at, W.ground, W.duck = d, q, x, Q, tonumber(_.DuckAmount) or 0
  end
  l.step = function()
    local B = H()
    local d = v(B - O, 0.1)
    O = B
    if not (l.on) then
      return
    end
    for _, x in J, nil, nil do
      local v = B - x.at
      if v > 3 then
        J[_] = nil
      elseif v > 0.5 then
        x.acc = 0.25
      elseif x.ground then
        if x.duck > 0.5 then
          x.acc = 0.25
        elseif _:GetAttribute("IsWalking") then
          x.acc = 0.25
        elseif _:GetAttribute("IsCrouching") then
          x.acc = 0.25
        else
          x.acc = x.acc + d
          if x.acc >= 0.3 then
            x.acc = x.acc - 0.3
            local B = x.vel
            if G(B.X, 0, B.Z).Magnitude >= 7.5 then
              local d = x.pos + (G(B.X, 0, B.Z) * v)
              if w.enemy(_) then
                if V(_, d) then
                  u(d)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      else
        x.acc = 0.25
      end
    end
  end
  l.thrown = function(G)
    if not (l.on) then
      return
    end
    local B = t(G, 8)
    if B then
      if B ~= b then
        if w.enemy(B) then
          u(E(B, H()) or G)
        end
      end
    else
      u(G)
    end
  end
  local function G(u)
    if D[u] then
      return
    elseif not (u:IsA("Sound")) then
      return
    end
    D[u] = u.Played:Connect(function()
      pcall(h, u)
    end)
  end
  local function u()
    if m then
      return
    end
    m = true
    Z.listen(j)
    F()
    for j, j in A:GetDescendants() do
      G(j)
    end
    i.connect(A.DescendantAdded, G)
  end
  l.set = function(G)
    l.on = G
    Z.wanted = G
    if G then
      i.spawn(u)
    end
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    l.on = false
    Z.wanted = false
    table.clear(J)
    for G, G in D, nil, nil do
      pcall(G.Disconnect, G)
    end
    table.clear(D)
    if Y then
      pcall(Y.Destroy, Y)
      Y = nil
    end
  end)
  return l
end

-- Module L
modules.L = function()
  local G, i, u = modules.load("q"), modules.load("e"), modules.load("F")
  local j = modules.load("i")
  local w, t = modules.load("I"), modules.load("K")
  local Z = G.white
  local h = G.black
  local A = u.tSet.en
  local B, d, _ = u.tSet.fr, {"bottom", "left", "right"}, {"left", "right", "top", "bottom"}
  local function b(x)
    local v = {"box", "hb", "ab", "n", "w", "d", "mon", "pn", "bomb", "scope", "flashed", "defuse", "ht"}
    for H, H in v, nil, nil do
      x[H .. "Col"] = {Z, 1}
      x[H .. "GrdCol"] = {Z, Z}
    end
    x.boxOCol = {h, 1}
    x.boxFCol = {Z, 0.3}
    x.boxFGrdCol = {Z, Z}
    x.hboCol = {h, 0.5}
    x.aboCol = {h, 0.5}
    x.wepIconCol = {Z, 1}
    x.skelCol = {Z, 1}
    x.chamsFCol = {Z, 0}
    x.chamsOCol = {h, 0}
    x.hlCol = Z
    x.dyCol = Z
  end
  b(A)
  b(B)
  B.bomb = nil
  B.defuse = nil
  B.scope = nil
  local x = {bomb = true, defuse = true, scope = true}
  setmetatable(B, {__index = function(v, v)
    if x[v] then
      return false
    end
    return nil
  end, __newindex = function(v, H, l)
    if not (x[H]) then
      rawset(v, H, l)
    end
  end})
  u.shSet.useTeam = false
  local function x(v)
    return function(H)
      A[v] = H
    end
  end
  local function v(H)
    return function(l)
      A[H][1] = l
    end
  end
  local function H(l)
    return function(W)
      A[l .. "Col"][1] = W
      A[l .. "GrdCol"][1] = W
    end
  end
  local function l(W)
    return function(q)
      A[W .. "GrdCol"][2] = q
    end
  end
  b = i.tabs.visuals:page({name = "players", cols = 3})
  local W, q = b:section({name = "esp"}), b:section({name = "flags"})
  local J, D = b:section({name = "player", side = 3}), W:toggle({name = "enable", flag = "vis.on", cb = function(m)
    A.en = m
    if m then
      if not (u._loaded) then
        u.Load()
      end
    end
  end})
  i = W:toggle({name = "tracker", flag = "vis.track", default = true, cb = function(m)
    j.vis = m
  end})
  i:slider({flag = "vis.trackmem", min = 2, max = 120, default = 30, suffix = "s", sw = 56, cb = function(m)
    j.mem = m
  end}):dep(i)
  i = W:toggle({name = "arrows", flag = "vis.arrow", cb = x("offAr")}):dep(D)
  i:color({flag = "vis.arrowcol", default = Z, cb = v("offArCol")})
  i:settings():slider({name = "size", flag = "vis.arrowsz", min = 16, max = 64, default = 22, suffix = "px", cb = x("offArSz")})
  i = W:toggle({name = "chams", flag = "vis.chams", cb = x("chams")}):dep(D)
  i:color({flag = "vis.chamscol", default = Z, cb = function(j)
    A.chamsOCol[1] = j
    A.chamsFCol[1] = j
  end})
  i:settings():slider({name = "brightness", flag = "vis.chamsglow", min = 1, max = 12, dec = 1, default = 4, cb = x("chamsGlow")})
  i = W:toggle({name = "highlight", flag = "vis.hlt", cb = x("hlt")}):dep(D):settings()
  i:colorpicker({name = "fill", flag = "vis.hltfcol", default = Z, alpha = 0.5, cb = function(j, m)
    A.hltFCol[1], A.hltFCol[2] = j, m
  end})
  i:colorpicker({name = "outline", flag = "vis.hltocol", default = Z, cb = function(j, m)
    A.hltOCol[1], A.hltOCol[2] = j, m
  end})
  i = W:toggle({name = "sound", flag = "vis.sound", option = true, cb = t.set}):dep(D):settings()
  i:colorpicker({name = "color", flag = "vis.soundcol", default = Z, cb = function(j)
    t.col = j
  end})
  i:slider({name = "size", flag = "vis.soundsz", min = 2, max = 16, default = 6, suffix = "st", cb = function(j)
    t.size = j
  end})
  i:slider({name = "transparency", flag = "vis.soundtr", min = 0, max = 100, default = 0, suffix = "%", cb = function(j)
    t.alpha = 1 - (j / 100)
  end})
  i:slider({name = "life", flag = "vis.soundlife", min = 0.3, max = 3, dec = 1, default = 0.9, suffix = "s", cb = function(j)
    t.life = j
  end})
  local function j(t, m, Y, O, Q, F, I)
    local E = t:toggle({name = m, flag = Y, cb = x(O)}):dep(D)
    E:color({flag = Y .. "col", default = Z, cb = H(Q)})
    O = E:settings()
    if F then
      O:dropdown({name = "side", flag = Y .. F, values = ((F == "pos") and d) or _, default = I, cb = x(Q .. (((F == "pos") and "Pos") or "Side"))})
    end

-- Module M
modules.M = function()
  local G, i, u, j = modules.load("b"), modules.load("q"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j")

  local F = {}
  local function I(E)

      return nil

      return nil
    end

    if V then
      if type(N) == "table" then

      end
    end

  end
  local function Z(E)

      return ""

      else
        V[N] = tostring(((type(a) == "table") and a.Sticker) or a)
      end
    end
    return W(V, ";")
  end
  local function E(V)
    return W({tostring(V.Identifier), tostring(V.Name), tostring(V.Skin), tostring(V.Float), tostring(V.StatTrack), tostring(V.NameTag), Z(V.Stickers)}, "|")
  end

        W[V] = N
      end

  end
  local function W()

  end
  local function N()
    if m then
      m = false

  end
  local function a(U)
    local g, X, o, R, p, c, M = t:GetAttribute("CurrentEquipped"), t:GetAttribute("Slot1"), t:GetAttribute("Slot2"), t:GetAttribute("Slot3"), t:GetAttribute("Slot5"), (t:GetAttribute("HasDefuseKit") == true) or (t:GetAttribute("HasRescueKit") == true), t:GetAttribute("Team")
    local T = ((((((U == D.char) and (X == D.s1)) and (o == D.s2)) and (R == D.s3)) and (p == D.s5)) and (c == D.kit)) and (M == D.team)

      end
    end
    D.char = U
    D.raw = g
    D.s1 = X
    D.s2 = o
    D.s3 = R
    D.s5 = p
    D.kit = c
    D.team = M
    R = I(g)

      if m then
        if o == D.sig then
          if U == D.sup then

              return
            end
          end
        end
      end

    D.name = (R and R.Name) or nil

    if R then
      V(A, t, R, Z())
    else
      V(A.ClearPlayerCache, t)
      V(A.RefreshObjectiveKitHolster, t)
      V(A.RefreshBombHolster, t)
    end
  end
  local function Z(A)
    local B, I = t.Character, h.CurrentCamera
    if B then
      if I then
        if B:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
          return
        elseif t:GetAttribute("IsSpectating") == true then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local h = I.CameraSubject
    if I.CameraType ~= l then
      return
    elseif typeof(h) ~= "Instance" then
      return
    elseif not (h:IsDescendantOf(B)) then

      t.CameraMaxZoomDistance = h
      t.CameraMinZoomDistance = h
    elseif t.CameraMinZoomDistance ~= h then

      t.CameraMinZoomDistance = h

      t.CameraMode = B
    end
  end
  local function h()
    local A = ((type(d) == "table") and rawget(d, "peekCurrentEquippedForMovement")) or nil
    if type(A) ~= "function" then
      return "MuzzlePart"
    end

    if type(A) == "table" then
      if A.ShootingOptions == "Dual" then

      end
    end

  end
  F.on = function()

  end

  end

    A = B and (B:FindFirstChild("Equipped"))
    if A then

      end
    end

  end

    local B = F.model()
    local d = B and (B:FindFirstChild("Interactables"))
    if not (d) then
      return nil
    end
    B = d:FindFirstChild(A or h())
    if B then
      if B:IsA("BasePart") then
        return B
      end
    end
    B = d:FindFirstChild("MuzzlePart")
    if B then
      if B:IsA("BasePart") then

      end
    end

  end

    local h = w.third == true
    local A = (h ~= O) or (h and (w.third_dist ~= Q))
    if A then
      local B
      B, O = w.third_dist, h
      Q = B
      Z(h)
    end
    if not (J) then
      return
    end
    A = (h and W()) or nil
    if not A then
      if m then
        N()
      elseif next(D) ~= nil then
        N()
      end
      return
    end
    a(A)
  end
  i = j.weapon
  j = ((type(i) == "table") and u.shared.fields[i]) or nil
  local h, A = (j and j.shoot) or (((type(i) == "table") and rawget(i, "shoot")) or nil), G.getups
  if (((type(b) == "function") and (type(x) == "function")) and (type(h) == "function")) and (type(A) == "function") then
    G, i = pcall(A, h)
    if G and (type(i) == "table") then
      for G, B in i, nil, nil do
        if B == b then
          u.upvalue(h, G, function(G, h, ...)
            if not (Y) then

                if w.third then
                  if typeof(G) == "Instance" then
                    if type(h) == "string" then
                      local w = F.muzzle(G.Name)
                      local B = w and (w:FindFirstChild(h))
                      if B then
                        pcall(x, B)
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            return b(G, h, ...)
          end)
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end
  A = ((type(_) == "table") and _.VFX) or nil
  i = ((type(A) == "table") and A.CreateCharacterMuzzleFlash) or nil
  if type(i) == "table" then
    if type(i.Listen) == "function" then
      j, _ = pcall(i.Listen, function(G)
        if type(G) == "table" then
          if G.UserId == t.UserId then
            Y = true
          end
        end
      end)

          u.adopt(_)
        end
      end

  end

    end

-- Module N
modules.N = function()
  local G = modules.load("q")
  local i = G.world
  local u = G.white
  local j = G.black
  local G = math.sin
  local w = math.floor
  local t, Z = math.clamp, {}
  Z.mats = {forcefield = Enum.Material.ForceField, neon = Enum.Material.Neon, metal = Enum.Material.Metal, chrome = Enum.Material.Glass, flat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, glass = Enum.Material.Glass, foil = Enum.Material.Foil}
  Z.list = {"forcefield", "neon", "metal", "chrome", "flat", "glass", "foil"}
  Z.anims = {"static", "pulse", "rainbow", "gradient", "flicker"}
  local function h(A, B)
    return (G(((B * 6.283185307179586) * (tonumber(i[A .. "_speed"]) or 100)) / 100) * 0.5) + 0.5
  end
  local function G(A, B, d)
    local _, b, x = A:ToHSV()
    A = (B * (tonumber(i[d .. "_speed"]) or 100)) / 400
    return Color3.fromHSV((_ + A) % 1, ((b > 0.05) and b) or 0.85, ((x > 0.05) and x) or 1)
  end
  local function A(B, d, _, b)
    if _ == "pulse" then
      local x = 0.65 * h(B, b)
      return d:Lerp(j, x)
    elseif _ == "rainbow" then
      return G(d, b, B)
    elseif _ == "gradient" then
      local G, x = i[B .. "_col2"] or u, lphPackValues(h(B, b))
      return d:Lerp(G, lphUnpackValues(x))
    elseif _ == "flicker" then
      return (((w(b * (((tonumber(i[B .. "_speed"]) or 100) / 100) * 9)) % 2) == 0) and d) or d:Lerp(j, 0.55)
    end
    return d
  end
  Z.base = function(G, j)
    local w, h, B = i[G .. "_mat"], A(G, i[G .. "_col"] or u, i[G .. "_anim"], j), t((tonumber(i[G .. "_alpha"]) or 100) / 100, 0.05, 1)
    return h, Z.mats[w] or Z.mats.forcefield, w == "chrome", ((B < 1) and (1 - B)) or nil
  end
  Z.shell = function(G)
    local i = G.Archivable
    G.Archivable = true
    local u, j = pcall(G.Clone, G)
    G.Archivable = i
    if u then
      if not (j) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    j:ClearAllChildren()
    j.Name = "shell"
    j.Anchored = true
    j.CanCollide = false
    j.CanQuery = false
    j.CanTouch = false
    j.CastShadow = false
    j.Massless = true
    j.Reflectance = 0
    j.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
    if j:IsA("MeshPart") then
      j.TextureID = ""
    end
    return j
  end
  return Z
end

-- Module O
modules.O = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u, j, w, t = modules.load("q"), modules.load("f"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("M")
  local Z = modules.load("N")
  local h = i.world
  local A = i.misc
  local B = G.workspace
  local d = G.host
  local _ = w.local_char
  local b = w.weapon_props
  local w = u.trim
  local u = table.clear
  local x = os.clock
  local v = Enum.Material.ForceField
  local H = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
  local l, W, q, J, D = i.white, {HumanoidRootPart = true, Camera = true, ViewmodelLight = true, MuzzlePart = true}, {SurfaceGui = 1, BillboardGui = 1, Beam = 1, Trail = 1, Highlight = 1, PointLight = 1, SpotLight = 1, SurfaceLight = 1, Smoke = 1, Fire = 1, Sparkles = 1, ParticleEmitter = 2, Decal = 3}, {Shirt = "ShirtTemplate", Pants = "PantsTemplate"}, {WeaponModel = true, WeaponAttachments = true}
  local i = NumberSequence.new(1)
  local m = G.weak()
  local Y = G.weak()
  local O = G.weak()
  local Q = G.weak()
  local F = G.weak()
  local I = G.weak()
  local E, V, N, a, U = G.weak(), {}, {}, {}
  local g, X, o = true, 0, {}
  local function R(p)
    local c = o[p]
    if c then
      return c
    end
    c = nil
    if type(b) == "function" then
      local M, T = pcall(b, p)
      c = if M then if type(T) == "table" then T else c else c
    else
    end
    if c then
    else
      local b = G.module(G.storage, "Database", "Custom", "Weapons", p)
      c = if type(b) == "table" then b else c
    end
    G.reclaim()
    local G = "other"
    if c then
      local b, M, T = c.Class, c.MuzzleType, c.Type
      G = if b == "Melee" then "knife" else if b == "Grenade" then "grenades" else if b == "C4" then "bomb" else if b == "Weapon" then if M == "Sniper" then "snipers" else if M == "ShotGun" then "shotguns" else if M == "MachineGun" then "machine guns" else if (T == "Pistol") and (M ~= "Zeus x27") then "pistols" else if T == "Rifle" then "rifles" else if T == "SMG" then "smgs" else G else G
    else
    end
    if c then
      o[p] = G
    end
    return G
  end
  local function G(b, o)
    local p = b.Name
    if p == "Left Arm" then
      return true
    elseif p == "Right Arm" then
      return true
    elseif p == "Glove" then
      return true
    elseif p == "Sleeve" then
      return true
    end
    local c = b.Parent
    while c and (c ~= o) do
      p = c.Name
      if p == "Left Arm" then
        return true
      elseif p == "Right Arm" then
        return true
      elseif p == "Arms" then
        return true
      end
      c = c.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  local function b(o, p)
    local c = o.Parent
    while c and (c ~= p) do
      if D[c.Name] then
        if c.Parent == p then
          return true
        end
      end
      c = c.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  local function D()
    local o = B.CurrentCamera
    if o ~= U then
      for B = #a, 1, -1 do
        a[B]:Disconnect()
        a[B] = nil
      end
      U, g = o, true
      if o then
        local function B()
          g = true
        end
        a[1] = o.ChildAdded:Connect(B)
        a[2] = o.ChildRemoved:Connect(B)
      end
    end
    if g then
      g = false
      local B = 0
      if o then
        local p = o:GetChildren()
        for o = 1, #p, 1 do
          local c = p[o]
          if c:IsA("Model") then
            B += 1
            N[B] = c
          else
          end
        end
      else
      end
      w(N, B)
    end
    return N
  end
  local function B(o, p)
    local c, M = E[o]
    if c then
      M = c
    else
      M = {parts = {}, texs = {}, arms = {}, vis = {}, cloth = {}, dirty = true}
      E[o] = M
      local function c()
        M.dirty = true
      end
      M.added = o.DescendantAdded:Connect(c)
      M.gone = o.DescendantRemoving:Connect(c)
    end
    if M.dirty then
      M.dirty = false
      M.arm_tops = nil
      M.tool_tops = nil
      local c, T, L, k, P = M.parts, M.texs, M.arms, M.vis, M.cloth
      u(L)
      local u, z, n, K, S = o:GetDescendants(), 0, 0, 0, 0
      for e = 1, #u, 1 do
        local C = u[e]
        if not (p) then
          if b(C, o) then
            continue
          end
        end
        if C:IsA("BasePart") then
          e = C.Name
          if p then
            if W[e] then
            else
              z += 1
              c[z] = C
              L[C] = G(C, o)
            end
          else
            if e ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
              if e ~= "CameraPart" then
                local G = z + 1
                c[G] = C
                z = G
              else
              end
            else
            end
          end
        else
          if C:IsA("Texture") then
            n += 1
            T[n] = C
          else
            if p then
              if q[C.ClassName] then
                K += 1
                k[K] = C
              else
              end
            else
              if C.ClassName == "Decal" then
                K += 1
                k[K] = C
              else
                if J[C.ClassName] then
                  S += 1
                  P[S] = C
                else
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      w(c, z)
      w(T, n)
      w(k, K)
      w(P, S)
    end
    return M
  end
  local function G()
    for u, b in E, nil, nil do
      if not (u.Parent) then
        if b.added then
          b.added:Disconnect()
        end
        if b.gone then
          b.gone:Disconnect()
        end
        E[u] = nil
      end
    end
  end
  local function u(b, W, o, p, c, M)
    local T, L = o or v, m[b]
    if L then
    else
      L = {mat = b.Material, col = b.Color, refl = b.Reflectance, t = b.Transparency}
      if b:IsA("MeshPart") then
        L.tex = b.TextureID
      end
      m[b] = L
      o = b:GetChildren()
      for k = 1, #o, 1 do
        local P = o[k]
        if P:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
          if Y[P] == nil then
            Y[P] = b
            k = L.sa
            if k then
            else
              k = {}
              L.sa = k
            end
            k[#k + 1] = P
            P.Parent = nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
    L.gen = c
    if b.Material ~= T then
      b.Material = T
    end
    if b.Color ~= W then
      b.Color = W
    end
    if p then
      if b.Reflectance ~= p then
        b.Reflectance = p
      end
      L.lit = true
    elseif L.lit then
      L.lit = nil
      b.Reflectance = L.refl
    end
    if L.tex then
      if b.TextureID ~= "" then
        b.TextureID = ""
      end
    end
    if M and (L.t < 1) then
      o = ((M > L.t) and M) or L.t
      if b.Transparency < 1 then
        if b.Transparency ~= o then
          b.Transparency = o
        end
      end
      L.faded = true
    elseif L.faded then
      L.faded = nil
      if b.Transparency < 1 then
        b.Transparency = L.t
      end
    end
  end
  local function b(W, o, p, c, M, T)
    if not (c) then
      u(W, o, p, nil, M, T)
      return false
    end
    if W.Transparency < 1 then
      if W.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1 then
        u(W, o, p, 1, M, T)
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function u(W)
    local o = m[W]
    if not (o) then
      return
    end
    m[W] = nil
    local p = W.Parent ~= nil
    if p then
      W.Material = o.mat
      W.Color = o.col
      if o.lit then
        W.Reflectance = o.refl
      end
      if o.faded then
        if W.Transparency < 1 then
          W.Transparency = o.t
        end
      end
      if o.tex then
        W.TextureID = o.tex
      end
    end
    local c = o.sa
    if c then
      for M = 1, #c, 1 do
        o = c[M]
        Y[o] = nil
        if p then
          o.Parent = W
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function W(o, p)
    local c = O[o]
    if c then
      c.gen = p
    else
      O[o] = {t = o.LocalTransparencyModifier, gen = p}
    end
    if o.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
      o.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
    end
  end
  local function o(p)
    local c = O[p]
    if not (c) then
      return
    end
    O[p] = nil
    if p.Parent then
      p.LocalTransparencyModifier = c.t
    end
  end
  local function p(c, M)
    local T = Q[c]
    if T then
      T.gen = M
    else
      Q[c] = {t = c.Transparency, gen = M}
    end
    if c.Transparency < 1 then
      c.Transparency = 1
    end
  end
  local function c(M)
    local T = Q[M]
    if not (T) then
      return
    end
    Q[M] = nil
    if M.Parent then
      M.Transparency = T.t
    end
  end
  local function M(T, L)
    local k = q[T.ClassName]
    if not (k) then
      return
    end
    local q = F[T]
    if q then
      q.gen = L
    else
      q = {k = k, gen = L}
      if k == 3 then
        q.t = T.Transparency
      else
        q.e = T.Enabled
        if k == 2 then
          q.t = T.Transparency
        end
      end
      F[T] = q
    end
    if k == 3 then
      if T.Transparency < 1 then
        T.Transparency = 1
      end
    else
      if T.Enabled then
        T.Enabled = false
      end
      if k == 2 then
        if T.Transparency ~= i then
          T.Transparency = i
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function i(q)
    local T = F[q]
    if not (T) then
      return
    end
    F[q] = nil
    if not (q.Parent) then
      return
    end
    if T.k == 3 then
      q.Transparency = T.t
    else
      if T.k == 2 then
        q.Transparency = T.t
      end
      q.Enabled = T.e
    end
  end
  local function q(T, L)
    local k = I[T]
    local P = (k and k.k) or J[T.ClassName]
    local J = T[P]
    if k then
      if J ~= "" then
        k.t = J
      end
    else
      k = {k = P, t = J}
      I[T] = k
    end
    k.gen = L
    if J ~= "" then
      T[P] = ""
    end
  end
  local function J(T)
    local L = I[T]
    if not (L) then
      return
    end
    I[T] = nil
    if T.Parent then
      T[L.k] = L.t
    end
  end
  local function T(L, k, P)
    local z = (P and "arm_tops") or "tool_tops"
    local n = L[z]
    if n ~= nil then
      return n
    end
    local K, S, e = L.parts, L.arms, {}
    for C = 1, #K, 1 do
      local s = K[C]
      if S[s] ~= P then
        while (s and (s ~= k)) and not e[s] do
          e[s] = true
          s = s.Parent
        end
      end
    end
    local C, s = {}, 0
    n = {}
    for r = 1, #K, 1 do
      local yO = K[r]
      if S[yO] == P then
        local P, K = yO.Parent, yO
        while (P and (P ~= k)) and not e[P] do
          K = if P:IsA("Model") then P else K
          P = P.Parent
        end
        if C[K] then
        else
          C[K] = true
          s += 1
          r = n
          if s > 8 then
            n = false
            break
          end
          r[s] = K
        end
      else
      end
    end
    L[z] = n
    return n
  end
  local function L(k, P, z)
    local n = V[k]
    if n then
    else
      local K = Instance.new("Highlight")
      K.FillTransparency = 1
      K.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
      K.DepthMode = H
      K.Adornee = k
      K.Parent = d
      n = {inst = K}
      V[k] = n
    end
    n.gen = z
    if n.col ~= P then
      n.col = P
      n.inst.OutlineColor = P:Lerp(l, 0.6)
    end
  end
  local function d()
    for H, l in V, nil, nil do
      V[H] = nil
      pcall(l.inst.Destroy, l.inst)
    end
  end
  local H = {kind_of = R, restore_all = function()
    for l in m, nil, nil do
      u(l)
    end
    for l, k in Y, nil, nil do
      Y[l] = nil
      if k then
        if k.Parent then
          l.Parent = k
        end
      end
    end
  end, show_all = function()
    for l in O, nil, nil do
      o(l)
    end
    for l in Q, nil, nil do
      c(l)
    end
    for l in F, nil, nil do
      i(l)
    end
    for l in I, nil, nil do
      J(l)
    end
  end, drop_cache = function()
    for l, Y in E, nil, nil do
      if Y.added then
        Y.added:Disconnect()
      end
      if Y.gone then
        Y.gone:Disconnect()
      end
      E[l] = nil
    end
    for l = #a, 1, -1 do
      a[l]:Disconnect()
      a[l] = nil
    end
    w(N, 0)
    U, g = nil, true
  end, sync = function()
    local w, l, Y, E = h.body_chams, h.tool_chams, h.third, h.hand_chams
    if w then
    elseif l then
    elseif Y then
    elseif E then
    elseif next(m) == nil then
      if next(O) == nil then
        if next(Q) == nil then
          if next(F) == nil then
            if next(I) == nil then
              if next(V) == nil then
                return
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local N = (_ and _.getCurrentCharacter()) or nil
    local _, a, U = ((N and not N.IsDestroyed) and N.Character) or nil, D(), x()
    X += 1
    N = X
    if _ and w then
      local x = B(_, false)
      local D, g, X, k, P = x.parts, Z.base("body_chams", U)
      local z = false
      for n = 1, #D, 1 do
        z = if b(D[n], g, X, k, N, P) then true else z
      end
      if z then
        k, X, D = x.texs, x.vis, x.cloth
        for x = 1, #k, 1 do
          p(k[x], N)
        end
        for x = 1, #X, 1 do
          M(X[x], N)
        end
        for x = 1, #D, 1 do
          q(D[x], N)
        end
        L(_, g, N)
      end
    end
    local x, q, D, g = Z.base("hand_chams", U)
    local X, k, P, z = Z.base("tool_chams", U)
    w = A.hands
    U, _ = w or (E and (D or (q == v))), h.tool_chams_kinds
    for Z = 1, #a, 1 do
      local h = a[Z]
      Z = B(h, true)
      local A, n, K, S, e = Z.parts, Z.texs, Z.arms, Z.vis, l and ((_ == nil) or (_[R(h.Name)] == true))
      local C, s, r = e and (P or (k == v)), false, false
      for v = 1, #A, 1 do
        local yO = A[v]
        v = K[yO]
        if Y or (w and v) then
          W(yO, N)
        else
          if v then
            s = if E then if b(yO, x, q, D, N, g) then true else s else s
          else
            r = if e then if b(yO, X, k, P, N, z) then true else r else r
          end
        end
      end
      if Y then
        for w = 1, #n, 1 do
          p(n[w], N)
        end
        for w = 1, #S, 1 do
          M(S[w], N)
        end
      elseif s or r then
        if U and C then
          L(h, (r and X) or x, N)
        else
          K = T(Z, h, s)
          if K then
            A = (s and x) or X
            for w = 1, #K, 1 do
              L(K[w], A, N)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if Y and l then
      a = t.model()
      if a and ((_ == nil) or (_[R(t.name() or "")] == true)) then
        g, q = B(a, true).parts, false
        for w = 1, #g, 1 do
          q = if b(g[w], X, k, P, N, z) then true else q
        end
        if q then
          L(a, X, N)
        end
      end
    end
    for w, t in m, nil, nil do
      if t.gen ~= N then
        u(w)
      end
    end
    for u, w in O, nil, nil do
      if w.gen ~= N then
        o(u)
      end
    end
    for u, w in Q, nil, nil do
      if w.gen ~= N then
        c(u)
      end
    end
    for u, w in F, nil, nil do
      if w.gen ~= N then
        i(u)
      end
    end
    for i, u in I, nil, nil do
      if u.gen ~= N then
        J(i)
      end
    end
    for i, u in V, nil, nil do
      if u.gen ~= N then
        V[i] = nil
        u.inst:Destroy()
      end
    end
    G()
  end}
  H.unload = function()
    d()
    H.restore_all()
    H.show_all()
    H.drop_cache()
  end
  j.teardown(H.unload)
  return H
end

-- Module Q
modules.Q = function()
  local G = bit32.bxor
  local i = bit32.band
  local u = bit32.rshift
  local j = math.floor
  local w = math.ceil
  local t = math.min
  local Z, h = math.clamp, {}
  for A = 0, 255, 1 do
    local B = A
    for d = 1, 8, 1 do
      B = if (B % 2) == 1 then G(3988292384, u(B, 1)) else u(B, 1)
    end
    h[A] = B
  end
  local function A(B, d, _)
    local b = 4294967295
    for x = d, (d + _) - 1, 1 do
      b = G(h[i(G(b, buffer.readu8(B, x)), 255)], u(b, 8))
    end
    return G(b, 4294967295)
  end
  local function G(h, B, d)
    buffer.writeu8(h, B, i(u(d, 24), 255))
    buffer.writeu8(h, B + 1, i(u(d, 16), 255))
    buffer.writeu8(h, B + 2, i(u(d, 8), 255))
    buffer.writeu8(h, B + 3, i(d, 255))
  end
  local h = {137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10}
  local B = {mask = function(d, _, b)
    if not (buffer) then
      return nil
    end
    local x = _ * (1 + (d * 4))
    local v, H, l = buffer.create(x), 1, 0
    local function W(q)
      H = (H + q) % 65521
      l = (l + H) % 65521
    end
    local q = 0
    for J = 0, _ - 1, 1 do
      local D = (J + 0.5) / _
      buffer.writeu8(v, q, 0)
      W(0)
      q += 1
      for m = 0, d - 1, 1 do
        J = j((Z(b(math.abs((((m + 0.5) / d) * 2) - 1), D), 0, 1) * 255) + 0.5)
        buffer.writeu8(v, q, 255)
        buffer.writeu8(v, q + 1, 255)
        buffer.writeu8(v, q + 2, 255)
        buffer.writeu8(v, q + 3, J)
        W(255)
        W(255)
        W(255)
        W(J)
        q += 4
      end
    end
    b = ((2 + (math.max(1, w(x / 65535)) * 5)) + x) + 4
    local j, w = buffer.create((45 + b) + 12), 0
    for Z = 1, #h, 1 do
      buffer.writeu8(j, w, h[Z])
      w += 1
    end
    G(j, w, 13)
    w += 4
    buffer.writestring(j, w, "IHDR")
    W = w
    w = W + 4
    G(j, w, d)
    w += 4
    G(j, w, _)
    w += 4
    buffer.writeu8(j, w, 8)
    w += 1
    buffer.writeu8(j, w, 6)
    w += 1
    buffer.writeu8(j, w, 0)
    w += 1
    buffer.writeu8(j, w, 0)
    w += 1
    buffer.writeu8(j, w, 0)
    w += 1
    G(j, w, A(j, W, 17))
    w += 4
    G(j, w, b)
    w += 4
    buffer.writestring(j, w, "IDAT")
    _ = w
    w = _ + 4
    buffer.writeu8(j, w, 120)
    w += 1
    buffer.writeu8(j, w, 1)
    d = x
    w += 1
    W = 0
    while d > 0 do
      x = t(65535, d)
      buffer.writeu8(j, w, (((d - x) == 0) and 1) or 0)
      w += 1
      buffer.writeu8(j, w, i(x, 255))
      w += 1
      buffer.writeu8(j, w, i(u(x, 8), 255))
      w += 1
      local t = i(bit32.bnot(x), 65535)
      buffer.writeu8(j, w, i(t, 255))
      w += 1
      buffer.writeu8(j, w, i(u(t, 8), 255))
      w += 1
      buffer.copy(j, w, v, W, x)
      w += x
      W += x
      d = d - x
    end
    G(j, w, (l * 65536) + H)
    w += 4
    G(j, w, A(j, _, 4 + b))
    w += 4
    G(j, w, 0)
    w += 4
    buffer.writestring(j, w, "IEND")
    G(j, w + 4, A(j, w, 4))
    return buffer.tostring(j)
  end}
  return B
end

        W[1] = o
        l.FilterDescendantsInstances = W
        local Q = H + A
        local A = j:Raycast(Q, H - Q, l)
        if not (A) then
          break
        end
        local j, l = A.Instance, (H - A.Position).Magnitude
        Q = j.MaterialVariant
        local F, E = ((Q ~= "") and d[Q]) or nil
        if F ~= nil then
          if not (Y) then
            H = (J[Q] or 0) + l
            J[Q] = H
            if H > (Z(F) + I) then
              break
            end
          end
          E = (D(j))
        else
          local d = D(j)
          if not (Y) then
            local H = (q[d] or 0) + l
            q[d] = H
            if H > (Z(B[d] or 0) + I) then
              break
            end
          end
          E = A.Material
        end
        X += 1
        U[X] = {instance = j, position = A.Position, normal = A.Normal, material = E}
      end
    end
    return U
  end
  x.cast = v
  x.probe = _
  x.through = O
  x.patch = function(j)
    if type(w) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif type(j) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    local Z = G.getups
    if type(Z) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    local G, A = pcall(Z, j)
    if G then
      if type(A) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    for G, Z in A, nil, nil do
      if Z == w.cast then
        i.upvalue(j, G, v)
      elseif Z == w.castThrough then
        i.upvalue(j, G, O)
      end
    end
  end
  t = u.bullet
  if type(t) == "table" then
    x.patch(rawget(t, "_performRaycast"))
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    h(W)
    h(q)
    h(J)
    m.instance = nil
    m.position = nil
    m.normal = nil
    m.material = nil
    b = nil
  end)
  return x
end

-- Module U
modules.U = function()

    if not (t) then
      return w, false
    end
    u = nil
    j = t:FindFirstChild("CameraPart")
    if j and (j:IsA("BasePart")) then
      u = j.Position
    else
      local G = t:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      u = if G then if G:IsA("BasePart") then (G.CFrame * i).Position else u else u
    end
    if not u then
      return w, false
    end
    if (u - w).Magnitude > 1 then
      return u, true
    end
    return u, false
  end}
end

          if type(x) == "table" then
            if typeof(x.Origin) == "Vector3" then
              if typeof(x.Direction) == "Vector3" then
                if type(x.Distance) == "number" then
                  if x.Distance > 0 then
                    _:push({packet = x, time = os.clock()})
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if A.impacts then
          G.elevate(Z.impacts, x)
        end
        if i then
          G.elevate(i, w, x)
        end
        return x
      end
    end)
  end
  Z.unload = function()
    m = false
    A.tracers = false
    A.impacts = false
    for G = #t, 1, -1 do
      local i = t[G]
      t[G] = nil
      if i.part.Parent then
        pcall(i.part.Destroy, i.part)
      end
    end
    for G = #F, 1, -1 do
      N(F[G])
      F[G] = nil
    end
    for G = #Y, 1, -1 do
      N(Y[G])
      Y[G] = nil
    end
    _:reset()
  end
  j.teardown(Z.unload)
  return Z
end

-- Module X
modules.X = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u, j = G.guiservice, {n = 0}, {}
  u.rects = j
  u.update = function()
    local w, t = 0, G.drawmask()
    if t then
      if #t > 0 then
        local G, Z = i:GetGuiInset(), w
        for i = 1, #t, 1 do
          local h = t[i]
          if typeof(h) == "Instance" then
            if h.Parent then
              if h.Visible then
                local t, A = h.AbsolutePosition, h.AbsoluteSize
                if A.X > 0 then
                  if A.Y > 0 then
                    i = Z + 1
                    local h = j[i]
                    if h then
                    else
                      h = {}
                      j[i] = h
                    end
                    local B, d = t.X + G.X, t.Y + G.Y
                    h[1], h[2], h[3], h[4] = B, d, B + A.X, d + A.Y
                    Z = i
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        end
        w = Z
      else
      end
    else
    end
    u.n = w
  end
  u.point = function(G, i)
    for w = 1, u.n, 1 do
      local t = j[w]
      if G >= t[1] then
        if G <= t[3] then
          if i >= t[2] then
            if i <= t[4] then
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  u.box = function(G, i, w, t)
    for Z = 1, u.n, 1 do
      local h = j[Z]
      if G < h[3] then
        if w > h[1] then
          if i < h[4] then
            if t > h[2] then
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  u.clip = function(G, i, j, w, t)
    local Z, h = G.X, G.Y
    local G, A, B, d, _, b, x, v = i.X - Z, i.Y - h, 0, 1, -t, -t, j + t, w + t
    if G == 0 then
      if Z < _ then
        return nil
      elseif Z > x then
        return nil
      end
    else
      j, i = (_ - Z) / G, (x - Z) / G
      if j > i then
        j, i = i, j
      else
      end
      B, d = if j > B then j else B, if i < d then i else d
      if B > d then
        return nil
      end
    end
    if A == 0 then
      if h < b then
        return nil
      elseif h > v then
        return nil
      end
    else
      t, x = (b - h) / A, (v - h) / A
      if t > x then
        t, x = x, t
      else
      end
      B, d = if t > B then t else B, if x < d then x else d
      if B > d then
        return nil
      end
    end
    return B, d
  end
  return u
end

-- Module Y
modules.Y = function()
  local G, i, u, j = modules.load("b"), modules.load("q"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("X")
  local w = G.assets
  local t = math.clamp
  local Z = math.min
  local h = math.max
  local A = math.floor
  local B = math.ceil
  local d = math.abs
  local _ = string.sub
  local b = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  local x = Color3.new()
  local v, H = Vector2.zero, {alive = true, available = false, resolution = 256, owners = {}}
  local l = G.screen(2147479999)
  H.gui = l
  H.available = l ~= nil
  local W = Enum.ImageCombineType.Overwrite
  local q, J = H.owners, {}
  local function D(m)
    local Y = q[m]
    if Y then
    else
      Y = {open = false, ready = false, failed = false, expect = false, fill_used = 0, fills = {}, stroke_used = 0, strokes = {}, point_used = 0, points = {}}
      q[m] = Y
      J[#J + 1] = m
    end
    return Y
  end
  local function m(Y)
    if not (Y) then
      return
    end
    local O = Y.banks
    for Q = 1, #O, 1 do
      Y = O[Q]
      if Y then
        if Y.label then
          pcall(Y.label.Destroy, Y.label)
        end
        if Y.image then
          pcall(Y.image.Destroy, Y.image)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function Y(O)
    if not (O) then
      return
    end
    local Q = O.banks
    for F = 1, #Q, 1 do
      O = Q[F]
      if O then
        F = O.groups
        for O = 1, #F, 1 do
          local Q = F[O]
          if Q then
            pcall(Q.Destroy, Q)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function O(Q)
    if not (Q) then
      return
    end
    local F = Q.banks
    for I = 1, #F, 1 do
      Q = F[I]
      if Q then
        I = Q.frames
        for Q = 1, #I, 1 do
          local F = I[Q]
          if F then
            pcall(F.Destroy, F)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local Q
  local function F()
    local I, E = Q, Vector2.new(H.resolution, H.resolution)
    for V = 1, 2, 1 do
      local N = w:CreateEditableImage({Size = E})
      if not (N) then
        error("image")
      end
      local w = {image = N}
      I.banks[V] = w
      V = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
      w.label = V
      V.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      V.BorderSizePixel = 0
      V.ImageColor3 = b
      V.ImageTransparency = 0.72
      V.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
      V.Visible = false
      V.ZIndex = 1
      V.ImageContent = Content.fromObject(N)
      V.Parent = l
    end
  end
  local function w()
    local I = Q
    for E = 1, 2, 1 do
      local V = {groups = {}, paths = {}, memo = {{}, {}, {}}}
      I.banks[E] = V
      for I = 1, 3, 1 do
        E = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
        V.groups[I] = E
        E.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        E.BorderSizePixel = 0
        E.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        E.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        E.GroupTransparency = 1
        E.Visible = false
        E.ZIndex = I + 2
        E.Parent = l
        local N = Instance.new("Path2D")
        V.paths[I] = N
        N.Visible = false
        N.ZIndex = I + 2
        N.Parent = E
      end
    end
  end
  local function I()
    local E = Q
    for V = 1, 2, 1 do
      local N = {frames = {}}
      E.banks[V] = N
      for E = 1, 3, 1 do
        V = Instance.new("Frame")
        N.frames[E] = V
        V.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        V.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        V.BorderSizePixel = 0
        V.Visible = false
        V.ZIndex = E + 11
        V.Parent = l
        E = Instance.new("UICorner")
        E.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        E.Parent = V
      end
    end
  end
  local function E(V, N)
    if H.alive then
      if not (H.available) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local a = {banks = {}, active = 0}
    Q = a
    local U = pcall(V)
    Q = nil
    if not (U) then
      N(a)
      return nil
    end
    return a
  end
  local function Q(V)
    return ((((typeof(V) == "Vector2") and (V.X == V.X)) and (V.Y == V.Y)) and (d(V.X) < 100000000)) and (d(V.Y) < 100000000)
  end
  local function V(N, a)
    if j.n == 0 then
      return false
    end
    local U, g, X, o = N.X, N.Y, a.X, a.Y
    return j.box(Z(U, X), Z(g, o), h(U, X), h(g, o))
  end
  local N, a, U = {}, {}, {}
  local function g(X, o, R)
    local p = 0
    for c = 1, #X, 1 do
      local M = X[c]
      if Q(M) then
        c = ((p > 0) and N[p]) or nil
        if c then
          if (M - c).Magnitude > 0.2 then
            local c = p + 1
            N[c] = M
            p = c
          else
          end
        else
          local c = p + 1
          N[c] = M
          p = c
        end
      else
      end
    end
    p = if o then if p > 2 then if (N[1] - N[p]).Magnitude <= 0.2 then p - 1 else p else p else p
    if p <= ((R and 512) or 96) then
      return N, p
    end
    X = (o and p) or (p - 1)
    U[1] = 0
    for c = 1, X, 1 do
      R = ((c == p) and 1) or (c + 1)
      U[c + 1] = U[c] + (N[R] - N[c]).Magnitude
    end
    R = U[X + 1]
    if R <= 0.2 then
      return N, 0
    end
    local c = 1
    for M = 1, 96, 1 do
      local T = R * ((o and ((M - 1) / 96)) or ((M - 1) / 95))
      while (c < X) and (U[c + 1] < T) do
        c += 1
      end
      local X, o = ((c == p) and 1) or (c + 1), U[c + 1] - U[c]
      local R = ((o > 0) and ((T - U[c]) / o)) or 0
      a[M] = N[c]:Lerp(N[X], t(R, 0, 1))
    end
    return a, 96
  end
  local N = {}
  local function a(U, X, o, R)
    for p = 1, X, 1 do
      local c, M, T = U[p]
      if R then
        M, T = v, v
      else
        if o then
          local o, R = U[((p == 1) and X) or (p - 1)], U[((p == X) and 1) or (p + 1)]
          local L, k = (R - o) / 6, Z((c - o).Magnitude, (R - c).Magnitude) * 0.42
          L = if L.Magnitude > k then if L.Magnitude > 0 then L.Unit * k else L else L
          M, T = -L, L
        else
          if (p == 1) and (X > 1) then
            M, T = v, (U[2] - c) / 3
          else
            if (p == X) and (X > 1) then
              M, T = (U[X - 1] - c) / 3, v
            else
              if X > 2 then
                local o, R = U[p - 1], U[p + 1]
                local U, L = (R - o) / 6, Z((c - o).Magnitude, (R - c).Magnitude) * 0.42
                U = if U.Magnitude > L then if U.Magnitude > 0 then U.Unit * L else U else U
                M, T = -U, U
              else
                M, T = v, v
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      N[p] = Path2DControlPoint.new(UDim2.fromOffset(c.X, c.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(M.X, M.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(T.X, T.Y))
    end
    for U = #N, X + 1, -1 do
      N[U] = nil
    end
    return N
  end
  local function U(X)
    if X then
      if not (X.label) then
        return true

    else
      return true
    end
    X.label.Visible = false
    return true
  end
  local function X(o)
    if not (o) then
      return true

      U(R[o])
    end
    return true
  end
  local function o(R)
    if not (R) then
      return true
    end
    local p, c = R.groups, R.paths
    for M = 1, #p, 1 do
      R = c[M]
      if R then
        R.Visible = false
      end
      local R = p[M]
      if R then
        R.Visible = false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local function R(p)
    if not (p) then
      return true
    end
    local c = p.banks
    for p = 1, #c, 1 do
      o(c[p])
    end
    return true
  end
  local function p(c)
    if not (c) then
      return true
    end
    local M = c.frames
    for T = 1, #M, 1 do
      c = M[T]
      if c then
        c.Visible = false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local function c(M)
    if not (M) then
      return true
    end
    local T = M.banks
    for M = 1, #T, 1 do
      p(T[M])
    end
    return true
  end
  local function M(T)
    if T then
      if not (T.label) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    T.label.Visible = true
    return true
  end
  local function T(L)
    local k = L and L.groups
    if k then
      if #k < 3 then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    for L = 1, 3, 1 do
      k[L].Visible = true
    end
    return true
  end
  local function L(k)
    local P = k and k.frames
    if P then
      if #P < 3 then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    for k = 1, 3, 1 do
      P[k].Visible = true
    end
    return true
  end
  local function k(P, z)
    if not (P) then
      return
    end
    local n = P.pending
    P.pending = nil
    if type(n) == "number" then
      if n > 0 then
        if n ~= P.active then
          z(P.banks[n])
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function P(z)
    local n, K, S = z.fills, z.strokes, z.points
    for e = 1, #n, 1 do
      k(n[e], U)
    end
    for n = 1, #K, 1 do
      k(K[n], o)
    end
    for n = 1, #S, 1 do
      k(S[n], p)
    end
    z.ready = false
  end
  local function k(z, n, K)
    local S = z.pending
    if S == nil then
      return
    end
    if S == 0 then
      K(z)
      z.active = 0
    else
      local K, e = z.banks[S], z.banks[z.active]
      if e then
        if e ~= K then
          n(e)
        end
      end
      z.active = S
    end
    z.pending = nil
  end
  local function z(n)
    local K, S, e, C = n.fills, n.strokes, n.points, true
    for s = 1, #K, 1 do
      local r = K[s]
      s = r.pending
      if ((type(s) == "number") and (s > 0)) and not M(r.banks[s]) then
        C = false
        break
      end
    end
    if C then
      for M = 1, #S, 1 do
        local s = S[M]
        M = s.pending
        if ((type(M) == "number") and (M > 0)) and not T(s.banks[M]) then
          C = false
          break
        end
      end
    else
    end
    if C then
      for M = 1, #e, 1 do
        local T = e[M]
        M = T.pending
        if ((type(M) == "number") and (M > 0)) and not L(T.banks[M]) then
          C = false
          break
        end
      end
      if not (C) then
        P(n)
        return false
      end
    else
      P(n)
      return false
    end
    for M = 1, #K, 1 do
      k(K[M], U, X)
    end
    for M = 1, #S, 1 do
      k(S[M], o, R)
    end
    for M = 1, #e, 1 do
      k(e[M], p, c)
    end
    n.ready = false
    return true
  end
  local M = {}
  local function T()
    local L, k, n, K, S, e, C, s = M.bank, M.style, M.color, M.closed, M.width, M.opacity, M.base, M.controls
    local r, yO, fO = L.groups, L.paths, (k == "flat") or (k == "trail")
    for GO = 1, 3, 1 do
      local iO, uO, jO
      if fO and (GO < 3) then
        r[GO].Visible = false
        yO[GO].Visible = false
        continue
      elseif k == "flat" then
        iO, uO, jO = 1, 1, 0.55
      else
        if k == "trail" then
          iO, uO, jO = 1.2, 1, 0.85
        else
          if k == "wave" then
            iO, uO = (((GO == 1) and 5) or ((GO == 2) and 2.45)) or 0.95, (((GO == 1) and 0.22) or ((GO == 2) and 0.62)) or 1
            local k = ((GO == 1) and 0.08) or ((GO == 2) and 0.34)
            jO = k or 0.68
          else
            iO, uO = (((GO == 1) and 4.8) or ((GO == 2) and 2.35)) or 1, (((GO == 1) and 0.14) or ((GO == 2) and 0.46)) or 0.94
            local k = ((GO == 1) and 0) or ((GO == 2) and 0.22)
            jO = k or 0.58
          end
        end
      end
      local k, fO, wO, tO, ZO, hO, AO = C + GO, r[GO], yO[GO], L.memo[GO], 1 - (e * uO), n:Lerp(b, jO), S * iO
      if tO.z ~= k then
        tO.z = k
        fO.ZIndex = k
        wO.ZIndex = k
      end
      if tO.fade ~= ZO then
        tO.fade = ZO
        fO.GroupTransparency = ZO
      end
      if tO.tint ~= hO then
        tO.tint = hO
        wO.Color3 = hO
      end
      if tO.thick ~= AO then
        tO.thick = AO
        wO.Thickness = AO
      end
      if tO.closed ~= K then
        tO.closed = K
        wO.Closed = K
      end
      wO:SetControlPoints(s)
      wO.Visible = true
    end
  end
  local function L(k, n, K, S, e, C, s, r)
    if k then
      if K < ((S and 3) or 2) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local yO = ((k.active ~= 0) and k.active) or 1
    local fO = k.banks and k.banks[yO]
    if not (fO) then
      return false
    end
    if yO ~= k.active then
      o(fO)
    end
    M.bank = fO
    M.style = s
    M.color = e
    M.closed = S
    M.width = h(0.65, tonumber(C) or 1.5)
    M.opacity = t(tonumber(r) or 1, 0, 1)
    M.base = (((s == "trail") and 8) or ((s == "wave") and 5)) or 2
    M.controls = a(n, K, S, (s == "flat") or (s == "trail"))
    if not (pcall(T)) then
      if yO ~= k.active then
        o(fO)
      end
      return false
    end
    k.pending = yO
    return true
  end
  local function a(o, M, T, k, n, K, S, e)
    local C = D(o)
    o = C.stroke_used + 1
    C.stroke_used = o
    local s = C.strokes[o]
    if s then
    else
      s = E(w, Y)
      if not (s) then
        C.failed = true
        return false
      end
      C.strokes[o] = s
    end
    o = L(s, M, T, k, n, K, S, e)
    if not o then
      C.failed = true
    end
    return o
  end
  local w = {}
  local function o(M, T, L, k, n, K, S, e, C)
    local s, r = g(T, L, (e == "flat") or (e == "trail"))
    if r < ((L and 3) or 2) then
      return true
    end
    if j.n == 0 then
      return a(M, s, r, L, k, n, e, C)
    end
    local yO, fO = 0
    if not (L) then
      fO = yO
      for GO = 1, r - 1, 1 do
        local iO, uO = s[GO], s[GO + 1]
        if V(iO, uO, K, S) then
          if fO >= 2 then
            a(M, w, fO, false, k, n, e, C)
          end
          fO = 0
        else
          if fO == 0 then
            GO = fO + 1
            w[GO] = iO
            fO = GO
          else
            if (iO - w[fO]).Magnitude > 0.1 then
              T = fO + 1
              w[T] = iO
              fO = T
            else
            end
          end
          if (uO - w[fO]).Magnitude > 0.1 then
            fO += 1
            w[fO] = uO
          else
          end
        end
      end
      if fO >= 2 then
        a(M, w, fO, false, k, n, e, C)
      end
      return true
    end
    L = nil
    for GO = 1, r, 1 do
      T = ((GO == r) and 1) or (GO + 1)
      if V(s[GO], s[T], K, S) then
        L = GO
        break
      end
    end
    if not L then
      return a(M, s, r, true, k, n, e, C)
    end
    fO = yO
    for GO = 1, r, 1 do
      T = (((L + GO) - 1) % r) + 1
      yO, GO = ((T == r) and 1) or (T + 1), s[T]
      local T = s[yO]
      if V(GO, T, K, S) then
        if fO >= 2 then
          a(M, w, fO, false, k, n, e, C)
        end
        fO = 0
      else
        if fO == 0 then
          local L = fO + 1
          w[L] = GO
          fO = L
        else
          if (GO - w[fO]).Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local L = fO + 1
            w[L] = GO
            fO = L
          else
          end
        end
        if (T - w[fO]).Magnitude > 0.1 then
          fO += 1
          w[fO] = T
        else
        end
      end
    end
    if fO >= 2 then
      a(M, w, fO, false, k, n, e, C)
    end
    return true
  end
  local w = {}
  local function a()
    local M, T, L, k, n = w.bank, w.at, w.color, w.core, w.opacity
    local K = M.frames
    for M = 1, 3, 1 do
      local S, e, C = (((M == 1) and 2.6) or ((M == 2) and 1.6)) or 1, (((M == 1) and 0.12) or ((M == 2) and 0.35)) or 1, (((M == 1) and 0) or ((M == 2) and 0.1)) or 0.45
      local s, r = (k * 2) * S, K[M]
      r.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(T.X, T.Y)
      r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
      r.BackgroundColor3 = L:Lerp(b, C)
      r.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (n * e)
    end
  end
  local function M(T, L, k, n, K, S, e)
    if Q(L) then
      if typeof(k) ~= "Color3" then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end

  end

    end

    h(w.destroy)
  end
  u.own(l)
  u.teardown(H.destroy)
  i.world.zonefill = H
  return H
end

      return
    end

    end

    local lO, WO, qO, JO = v(2.5, xO * 0.16), fO * 2, GO * 2, 0

      if iO.used >= 900 then
        break
      end
      vO, bO = BO[DO], BO[DO + 1]
      local BO, dO, mO = (bO - vO).Magnitude
      if BO > 0 then
        dO, mO = Z.clip(vO, bO, WO, qO, xO)
      else
      end
      if dO then
        local WO, qO = v(JO, dO * BO), mO * BO
        while (WO < qO) and (iO.used < 900) do
          DO = vO:Lerp(bO, WO / BO)
          if not (hO(DO)) then
            t(DO, _O, xO, HO)
          end
          WO += lO
        end
        JO = v(0, WO - BO)
      else
        JO = 0
      end
    end
  end
