  local function OO(QO)
    BO, dO, _O, bO, xO, vO, HO, lO, WO, qO, JO, DO = QO.CFrame:GetComponents()
    local FO = QO.ViewportSize
    local IO, EO, VO = v(FO.X, 1), v(FO.Y, 1), w(O(QO.FieldOfView * 0.5))
    FO, QO = IO * 0.5, EO * 0.5
    fO, GO, YO = FO, QO, VO
    mO = VO * (IO / EO)
  end
  local function w(O)
    local QO, FO, IO = O.X - BO, O.Y - dO, O.Z - _O
    O = ((QO * vO) + (FO * WO)) + (IO * DO)
    return -O
  end
  local function O(QO)
    local FO, IO, EO = QO.X - BO, QO.Y - dO, QO.Z - _O
    QO = -(((FO * vO) + (IO * WO)) + (EO * DO))
    if QO <= 0 then
      return nil, QO
    end
    local BO, dO, _O, vO = ((FO * bO) + (IO * HO)) + (EO * qO), ((FO * xO) + (IO * lO)) + (EO * JO), Vector2.new, fO
    FO, EO = vO + ((vO * BO) / (QO * mO)), GO
    vO = EO - ((EO * dO) / (QO * YO))
    return _O(FO, vO), QO
  end
  local function BO(dO, dO)
    local _O, bO = O(dO)
    if bO <= 0.05 then
      return nil
    end
    return _O
  end
  local function dO(_O, bO, xO, vO)
    _O, bO = w(xO), w(vO)
    if _O <= 0.05 then
      if bO <= 0.05 then
        return nil
      end
    end
    if _O <= 0.05 then
      xO = (xO:Lerp(vO, i((0.05 - _O) / (bO - _O), 0, 1)))
    else
      vO = if bO <= 0.05 then vO:Lerp(xO, i((0.05 - bO) / (_O - bO), 0, 1)) else vO
    end
    _O, bO = O(xO), O(vO)
    if _O then
      if not bO then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local xO, vO = Z.clip(_O, bO, fO * 2, GO * 2, 256)
    if not (xO) then
      return nil
    end
    if (xO > 0) or (vO < 1) then
      return _O:Lerp(bO, xO), _O:Lerp(bO, vO)
    end
    return _O, bO
  end
  local function Z(fO, GO)
    if typeof(fO) ~= "Vector3" then
      return nil
    elseif typeof(GO) ~= "Vector3" then
      return nil
    elseif GO.Magnitude < 0.001 then
      return nil
    end
    local _O = GO.Unit
    return CFrame.lookAt(fO, fO + _O, ((H(_O.Y) > 0.98) and P) or k)
  end
  local function k(P, fO, GO, _O)
    local bO = #fO
    for xO = 1, bO, 1 do
      P[xO] = _O:PointToWorldSpace(GO:PointToObjectSpace(fO[xO]))
    end
    Y(P, bO)
  end
  local function P(fO, GO, _O)
    local bO = #GO
    for xO = 1, bO, 1 do
      fO[xO] = GO[xO] + _O
    end
    Y(fO, bO)
  end
  local fO, GO = {}, 0
  local function _O(bO)
    if GO == 0 then
      GO += 1
      fO[GO] = bO
    elseif (bO - fO[GO]).Magnitude > 0.1 then
      GO += 1
      fO[GO] = bO
    end
  end
  local function bO(xO, vO, HO, lO, WO, qO, JO, DO)
    local mO, YO = h.zonefill, #qO
    if type(mO) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif YO < 2 then
      return
    end
    GO = 0
    local QO = YO - 1
    for YO = 1, QO, 1 do
      local QO, FO = dO(vO, HO, qO[YO], qO[YO + 1])
      if QO and FO then
        if GO > 0 then
          if (fO[GO] - QO).Magnitude > 1.5 then
            if GO >= 2 then
              Y(fO, GO)
              mO.stroke(xO, fO, false, JO, DO, lO, WO, "flat", 0.98)
              AO(fO, GO, JO, DO, lO, WO, 0.16)
            end
            GO = 0
          end
        end
        _O(QO)
        _O(FO)
      elseif GO >= 2 then
        Y(fO, GO)
        mO.stroke(xO, fO, false, JO, DO, lO, WO, "flat", 0.98)
        AO(fO, GO, JO, DO, lO, WO, 0.16)
        GO = 0
      else
        GO = 0
      end
    end
    if GO >= 2 then
      Y(fO, GO)
      mO.stroke(xO, fO, false, JO, DO, lO, WO, "flat", 0.98)
      AO(fO, GO, JO, DO, lO, WO, 0.16)
    end
    GO = 0
  end
  local xO = {}
  local function vO(HO, lO, WO, qO, JO, DO, mO, YO, QO, FO)
    local IO, EO = h.zonefill, #DO
    if type(IO) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif EO < 2 then
      return
    end
    local VO, NO = i(tonumber(QO) or 0, 0, 1), i(tonumber(FO) or 0, 0, 1)
    if VO <= 0 then
      return
    elseif NO <= 0 then
      return
    end
    xO[1] = 0
    for aO = 1, EO - 1, 1 do
      xO[aO + 1] = xO[aO] + (DO[aO + 1] - DO[aO]).Magnitude
    end
    FO = xO[EO]
    if FO <= 0.01 then
      return
    end
    QO = FO * VO
    VO = v(0, QO - (FO * 0.135))
    GO = 0
    FO = EO - 1
    for aO = 1, FO, 1 do
      local FO, UO = xO[aO], xO[aO + 1]
      EO = UO - FO
      if EO > 0 then
        if UO >= VO then
          if FO <= QO then
            local UO, gO = i((VO - FO) / EO, 0, 1), i((QO - FO) / EO, 0, 1)
            if gO >= UO then
              local QO, FO = dO(lO, WO, DO[aO]:Lerp(DO[aO + 1], UO), DO[aO]:Lerp(DO[aO + 1], gO))
              if QO and FO then
                if GO > 0 then
                  if (fO[GO] - QO).Magnitude > 1.5 then
                    if GO >= 2 then
                      Y(fO, GO)
                      IO.trail(HO, fO, mO, YO, qO, JO, NO)
                      AO(fO, GO, mO, YO * 1.3, qO, JO, 0.3 * NO)
                    end
                    GO = 0
                  end
                end
                _O(QO)
                _O(FO)
              elseif GO >= 2 then
                Y(fO, GO)
                IO.trail(HO, fO, mO, YO, qO, JO, NO)
                AO(fO, GO, mO, YO * 1.3, qO, JO, 0.3 * NO)
                GO = 0
              else
                GO = 0
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if GO >= 2 then
      Y(fO, GO)
      IO.trail(HO, fO, mO, YO, qO, JO, NO)
      AO(fO, GO, mO, YO * 1.3, qO, JO, 0.3 * NO)
    end
    GO = 0
  end
  local function GO(AO, dO, _O, HO, lO, WO)
    local qO = h.zonefill
    if type(qO) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    for JO = 1, #lO, 1 do
      local DO = BO(dO, lO[JO])
      if DO then
        qO.point(AO, DO, WO, 1.7, _O, HO, 0.82)
      end
    end
  end
  local function AO(dO, _O, HO, lO, WO, qO)
    local JO, DO = BO(_O, WO), h.zonefill
    if JO then
      if type(DO) == "table" then
        DO.point(dO, JO, qO, 3.4, HO, lO, 0.98)
      end
    end
    return JO
  end
  local function BO(dO, dO)
    if typeof(dO) ~= "Vector3" then
      return -math.huge
    end
    return w(dO)
  end
  local function dO(_O, HO, lO, WO)
    if typeof(lO) ~= "Vector3" then
      return nil
    end
    HO = w(lO)
    if HO > 0.15 then
      return (O(lO))
    end
    if typeof(WO) ~= "Vector3" then
      return nil
    end
    _O = w(WO)
    if _O <= 0.15 then
      return nil
    end
    local w = lphPackValues(i((0.15 - HO) / (_O - HO), 0, 1))
    return (O(lO:Lerp(WO, lphUnpackValues(w))))
  end
  local function w(_O, HO, lO)
    if BO(_O, HO) > 0.15 then
      return HO
    end
    local WO, qO
    for JO = 1, #lO, 1 do
      HO = lO[JO]
      if typeof(HO) == "Vector3" then
        JO = BO(_O, HO)
        if JO > 0.15 then
          if WO then
            if JO > WO then
              WO, qO = JO, HO
            else
            end
          else
            WO, qO = JO, HO
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return qO
  end
  local BO = {}
  local function _O(HO, lO, WO, qO, JO, DO, mO, YO)
    local QO, FO = h.zonefill, #mO
    if type(QO) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif FO < 3 then
      return
    end
    QO.expectFill(HO)
    local IO = w(WO, DO, mO)
    if not (IO) then
      return
    end
    local w, EO = dO(lO, WO, DO, IO), 0
    for VO = 1, FO, 1 do
      DO = dO(lO, WO, mO[VO], IO) or O(mO[VO]:Lerp(IO, 0.5))
      if DO then
        EO += 1
        BO[EO] = DO
      else
      end
    end
    if EO < 3 then
      return
    end
    Y(BO, EO)
    QO.stroke(HO, BO, true, YO, 1.5, qO, JO, "base", 0.94)
    if w then
      QO.draw(HO, w, BO, YO, qO, JO, lO.ViewportSize)
    end
    return w, BO
  end
  local function w(O, dO, HO, lO, WO, qO)
    local JO = z
    if if JO then not O else not JO then
      hO()
      return
    elseif JO.weapon ~= dO then
      hO()
      return
    elseif JO.mode ~= HO then
      hO()
      return
    elseif H(JO.rangeScale - lO) > 0.001 then
      hO()
      return
    end
    local DO, mO = JO.throwFrame, Z(WO, qO)
    if DO then
      if not (mO) then
        hO()
        return
      end
    else
      hO()
      return
    end
    k(yO.points, JO.points, DO, mO)
    k(yO.bounces, JO.bounces, DO, mO)
    WO = mO:PointToWorldSpace(DO:PointToObjectSpace(JO.endpoint))
    if JO.ring and (typeof(JO.ringCenter) == "Vector3") then
      DO = WO - JO.endpoint
      P(yO.ring, JO.ring, DO)
      yO.center = JO.ringCenter + DO
    else
      Y(yO.ring, 0)
      yO.center = nil
    end
    mO = G.drawmask()
    qO, DO = (mO and B:GetGuiInset()) or Vector2.zero, O.CFrame
    OO(O)
    local G, B = i(tonumber(h.nade_path_width) or 2, 1, 4), h.nade_path_col or b
    local b, k, P = h.nade_radius_col or B, dO .. ("|" .. (tostring(HO) .. ("|" .. tostring(lO)))), os.clock()
    if yO.key ~= k then
      yO.key = k
      yO.started = P
    elseif type(yO.started) ~= "number" then
      yO.key = k
      yO.started = P
    end
    local k, YO, OO, QO, FO = (P - yO.started) % 2.15
    if k < 1.35 then
      dO = i(k / 1.35, 0, 1)
      YO, OO = (dO * dO) * (3 - (2 * dO)), x(i(dO / 0.06, 0, 1), i((1 - dO) / 0.035, 0, 1)) * 0.98
    else
      if k < 1.97 then
        lO = i((k - 1.35) / 0.62, 0, 1)
        QO, FO = (lO * lO) * (3 - (2 * lO)), (m(J * lO) ^ 0.78) * 0.98
      else
      end
    end
    HO = h.zonefill
    k = type(HO) == "table"
    if k then
      HO.begin("prediction_path")
    end
    bO("prediction_path", O, DO, mO, qO, yO.points, B, G)
    GO("prediction_path", O, mO, qO, yO.bounces, B)
    P = AO("prediction_path", O, mO, qO, WO, B)
    if k then
      HO.finish("prediction_path")
    end
    if k then
      HO.begin("prediction")
    end
    WO, lO = nil
    if JO.ring then
      if yO.center then
        WO, lO = _O("prediction", O, DO, mO, qO, yO.center, yO.ring, b)
      else
      end
    else
    end
    if k then
      HO.finish("prediction")
    end
    if k then
      HO.begin("prediction_fx")
    end
    vO("prediction_fx", O, DO, mO, qO, yO.points, B, G, YO, OO)
    if (WO and lO) and QO then
      HO.pulse("prediction_fx", WO, lO, QO, b, 1.7, mO, qO, FO)
    elseif yO.center then
    elseif P then
      if QO then
        HO.circle("prediction_fx", P, 26 * QO, B, 1.7, mO, qO, FO)
      end
    end
    if k then
      HO.finish("prediction_fx")
    end
    t()
  end
  local function G(t, B)
    local b = t[#t]
    if b then
      if (B - b).Magnitude > 0.01 then
        t[#t + 1] = B
      end
    else
      t[#t + 1] = B
    end
  end
  local function t(B, b, x)
    local O = A:Raycast(B + M, c, R)
    B = if O then O.Position + (O.Normal * 0.06) else B
    local k, P = table.create(32), B + T
    for T = 1, 32, 1 do
      O = ((J * 2) * (T - 1)) / 32
      local J = Vector3.new(D(O), 0, m(O))
      local D = A:Raycast(P, J * b, R)
      local m = B + (J * (if D then if H(D.Normal.Y) < 0.65 then i(D.Distance - 0.12, 0.35, b) else b else b))
      J = A:Raycast(m + M, c, R)
      k[T] = if J then J.Position + (J.Normal * 0.06) else m + L
      if x then
        if (T % 4) == 0 then
          if x() then
            coroutine.yield()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return B, k
  end
  local function B()
    if type(N) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif type(N.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement) ~= "function" then
      return nil
    end
    local b, x = pcall(N.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement)
    if b then
      if x then
        if x.IsDestroyed then
          return nil
        elseif x.IsEquipped == false then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    b = x.Properties
    if b then
      if b.Class ~= "Grenade" then
        return nil
      elseif not (j[x.Name]) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    return x
  end
  local function b(x)
    if a then
      local J, D = pcall(a, x)
      if J then
        if typeof(D) == "Vector3" then
          return D
        end
      end
    end
    local J = x and (x:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if J then
      if J:IsA("BasePart") then
        return J.AssemblyLinearVelocity
      end
    end
    return Vector3.zero
  end
  local function x()
    local J, D, m = B(), A.CurrentCamera, _.Character
    if J then
      if D then
        if m then
          if m:IsDescendantOf(A) then
            if m:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
              return nil
            end
          else
            return nil
          end
        else
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local B = m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if B then
      if not (B:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local O, N = (d:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) and "Near") or "Far", J.Properties
    local d = v(0.01, (tonumber(N and N.Range) or 60) / 40)
    d = if _:GetAttribute("IsCrouching") == true then d * 0.8 else d
    local a, c = B.Position, D.CFrame.LookVector
    N, B = V.calculateThrowParameters(a, c, O, d)
    if typeof(N) ~= "Vector3" then
      return nil
    elseif typeof(B) ~= "Vector3" then
      return nil
    end
    return J, D, m, O, d, N, B, c, a
  end
  local B = {}
  local function d(J, D, m)
    if J then
      if I then
        F(2)
      end
    end
    local O, N, N, a, c, M, T, L, k = x()
    if not (O) then
      return nil
    end
    local P = g[O.Name]
    if not (P) then
      return nil
    end
    local GO, AO = b(N), A:GetServerTimeNow()
    local dO, _O, bO = V.createInitialState(M, T, a, GO, c, AO), (O.Name == "Molotov") or (O.Name == "Incendiary Grenade"), ((P.fuse and (P.fuse > 0)) and P.fuse) or nil
    AO = V.createConfig(P.radius, c, a == "Near", bO, (_O and 0.1) or nil, _O or nil)
    AO.restitution = P.restitution or AO.restitution
    AO.maxBounces = P.maxBounces or AO.maxBounces
    _O, bO = A:FindFirstChild("Debris"), 0
    if _O then
      bO = 1
      B[bO] = _O
    else
    end
    bO += 1
    B[bO] = N
    Y(B, bO)
    R.FilterDescendantsInstances = B
    bO = _:GetAttribute("Team")
    N, _O = pcall, ((bO == "Terrorists") and "TGrenade") or ((bO == "Counter-Terrorists") and "CTGrenade")
    N(p, R, _O or "Default")
    bO = V.Constants or {}
    N = (tonumber(D) or tonumber(bO.FIXED_TIMESTEP)) or 0.0078125
    local A, _, p, vO, HO = W((tonumber(bO.MAX_SIMULATION_TIME) or 10) / N) + 2, v(1, l((0.0625 / N) + 0.5)), {dO.position}, {}, dO.position
    _O, bO = 0
    local l = 0
    for W = 1, A, 1 do
      local lO, WO = V.step(dO, AO, R, N)
      HO = lO.position
      _O += 1
      if WO then
        if WO.type == "bounce" then
          W = WO.position
          vO[#vO + 1] = W
          local V = #p
          if V > 1 then
            if (p[V] - W).Magnitude < (P.radius * 1.5) then
              p[V] = nil
            end
          end
          G(p, W)
        else
          bO = WO
        end
      else
      end
      if ((_O >= _) or WO) or lO.isAtRest then
        G(p, lO.position)
        _O = 0
      else
      end
      if bO then
        dO = lO
        break
      elseif lO.isAtRest then
        dO = lO
        break
      end
      l += 1
      if l >= 8 then
        if J then
          if J() then
            coroutine.yield()
          end
        end
        l = 0
      else
      end
      dO = lO
    end
    G(p, HO)
    N, P, A = X[O.Name]
    if N then
      if m ~= false then
        P, A = t(HO, o[N], J)
      else
      end
    else
    end
    return {points = p, bounces = vO, endpoint = HO, ringCenter = P, ring = A, weapon = O.Name, mode = a, rangeScale = c, rootPosition = k, aimLook = L, velocity = GO, throwFrame = Z(M, T), exact = D == nil, computedAt = os.clock(), reason = (bO and bO.type) or "rest"}
  end
  local function G(Z)
    if type(Z) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif j[Z.Weapon] then
      if type(Z.Physics) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local j, A = Z.Physics, g[Z.Weapon] or {}
    local _, l, W, J = tonumber(j.Radius), tonumber(j.FuseTime), tonumber(j.Restitution), tonumber(j.MaxBounces)
    if _ then
      if _ > 0 then
        A.radius = _
      end
    end
    if l then
      if l >= 0 then
        A.fuse = l
      end
    end
    if W then
      A.restitution = W
    end
    if J then
      A.maxBounces = J
    end
    g[Z.Weapon] = A
  end
  local function j(Z)
    if type(Z) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif type(Z.Voxels) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    local A = Z.Voxels
    Z = #A
    if Z == 0 then
      return
    end
    local _, l = 0, 0
    for W = 1, Z, 1 do
      local J = A[W].Position
      _, l = _ + J.X, l + J.Z
    end
    local W, J, D = _ / Z, l / Z, 0
    for _ = 1, Z, 1 do
      local Z = A[_]
      local A, _ = Z.Position.X - W, Z.Position.Z - J
      D = v(D, q((A * A) + (_ * _)) + ((tonumber(Z.Size) or 0) * 0.5))
    end
    if D > 0 then
      o.smoke = v(o.smoke, i(D, 8, 24))
    end
  end
  local function Z(A)
    if type(A) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif typeof(A.Position) ~= "Vector3" then
      return
    elseif type(A.Voxels) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    local _ = A.Voxels
    local l = #_
    if l < 2 then
      return
    else
      local W = tonumber(A.Duration)
      if W then
        if W < 2 then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
    end
    local W, J = A.Position, 0
    for D = 1, l, 1 do
      A = _[D]
      local _, l, m = A.Position, (tonumber(A.SizeX) or 0) * 0.5, (tonumber(A.SizeZ) or 0) * 0.5
      local A, O = _.X - W.X, _.Z - W.Z
      for W = -1, 1, 2 do
        for V = -1, 1, 2 do
          _, D = A + (l * W), O + (m * V)
          J = v(J, q((_ * _) + (D * D)))
        end
      end
    end
    if J > 0 then
      o.fire = v(o.fire, i(J, 8, 24))
    end
  end
  local function i(A, _)
    if type(A) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif type(A.Listen) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    local v, l = pcall(A.Listen, _)
    if v then
      if type(l) == "function" then
        u.adopt(l)
      end
    end
  end
  local function A()
    if type(U) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif not (u.alive()) then
      return
    end
    i(U.Projectile and U.Projectile.Spawn, G)
    i(U.VFX and U.VFX.CreateVoxelSmoke, j)

      D = h:Raycast(m + M, c, a)
      GO[T] = if D then D.Position + (D.Normal * 0.06) else m + L
    end
    return e, GO
  end
  local function J(D, m, Q)
    if type(D) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif #D == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    local a, c = Vector3.zero, 0
    for M = 1, #D, 1 do
      local T = D[M]
      if type(T) == "table" then
        if typeof(T.Position) == "Vector3" then
          local M, L = a + T.Position, c + 1
          a, c = M, L
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    if c == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    local M, T = ((typeof(Q) == "Vector3") and Q) or (a / c), 0
    for a = 1, #D, 1 do
      Q = D[a]
      if type(Q) == "table" then
        if typeof(Q.Position) == "Vector3" then
          local D, c = l(Q.Position.X - M.X), l(Q.Position.Z - M.Z)
          if m == "smoke" then
            a = H(0, tonumber(Q.Size) or 0) * 0.5
            T = H(T, q((D * D) + (c * c)) + a)
          else
            local l, a = D + (H(0, tonumber(Q.SizeX) or 0) * 0.5), c + (H(0, tonumber(Q.SizeZ) or 0) * 0.5)
            T = H(T, q((l * l) + (a * a)))
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return M, i(if T <= 0 then ((m == "smoke") and 14.7) or 17.6 else T, 2, 40)
  end
  local function l(q)
    if q == "Smoke Grenade" then
      return "smoke"
    end
    if q == "Molotov" then
      return "fire"
    elseif q == "Incendiary Grenade" then
      return "fire"
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function q(D, m)
    local Q, a, c = os.clock(), 10
    for M = #p, 1, -1 do
      local T = p[M]
      if (Q - T.time) > 2.5 then
        table.remove(p, M)
      else
        if l(T.weapon) == m then
          local m = (T.position - D).Magnitude
          if m < a then
            a, c = m, T
          else
          end
        else
        end
      end
    end
    if c then
      table.remove(p, table.find(p, c))
      return c.weapon
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function D(m)
    local Q = X[m]
    if not (Q) then
      return
    end

    g[Q] = c
    g[a] = nil
    X[m] = nil

        X[c.key] = Q
      end
    end
  end

      end
    end
  end
  local function Q(a, c, M, T, L, e)
    if c == nil then
      return nil
    end
    c = tostring(c)
    local s, GO = J(M, a, T)
    if not (s) then
      return nil
    end
    T, M = n(s, GO)

    s = X[J]
    local AO = s and g[s]
    if AO then
    else
      AO = {id = c, key = J, kind = a, created = n}
      g[#g + 1] = AO
      X[J] = #g
    end
    AO.center = T
    AO.ring = M
    AO.radius = GO
    AO.team = e or AO.team
    s = tonumber(L)
    if s then
      if s > 0 then
        AO.expires = n + s
        AO.span = s
      elseif not (AO.expires) then
        AO.expires = n + 20
      end
    elseif not (AO.expires) then
      AO.expires = n + 20
    end

    if L then
      AO.weapon = L
    end
    if not (AO.weapon) then
      AO.weapon = ((a == "smoke") and "Smoke Grenade") or "Molotov"
    end
    task.defer(m, AO, ((a == "smoke") and "VoxelSmoke_") or "VoxelFire_", c)
    return AO
  end

  end
  local function M(T)
    local L, n = c(T), T.physics
    T = tonumber(n.FuseTime)
    T = if T then if T <= 0 then nil else T else nil
    local c = E.createConfig(tonumber(n.Radius) or 0.5, 1, false, T, nil, nil)
    c.restitution = tonumber(n.Restitution) or c.restitution
    c.maxBounces = tonumber(n.MaxBounces) or c.maxBounces
    T = RaycastParams.new()
    T.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    T.RespectCanCollide = false
    T.IgnoreWater = true
    local e, s = {j}, _.Character
    if s then
      e[2] = s
    end
    T.FilterDescendantsInstances = e
    pcall(U, T, n.CollisionGroup or "Default")
    e = E.Constants or {}
    local GO, AO = i((tonumber(n.Step) or tonumber(e.FIXED_TIMESTEP)) or 0.0078125, 0.001, 0.05), tonumber(e.MAX_SIMULATION_TIME) or 10
    e = math.ceil(H(0, AO - L.simulationTime) / GO) + 2
    for i = 1, v(12000, e), 1 do
      s, AO = E.step(L, c, T, GO)
      if s.isAtRest then
        L = s
        break
      elseif AO then
        if AO.type ~= "bounce" then
          L = s
          break
        end
      end
      L = s
    end
    return L.position
  end

  local function l(c, n, e)
    local s, GO = {}, c:GetChildren()
    for AO = 1, #GO, 1 do
      local dO = GO[AO]
      if dO:IsA("BasePart") then
        AO = dO.Size
        if n == "smoke" then
          local _O, bO = #s + 1, {Position = dO.Position}
          bO.Size, s[_O] = H(AO.X, AO.Z), bO
        else
          s[#s + 1] = {Position = dO.Position, SizeX = AO.X, SizeZ = AO.Z}
        end
      end
    end
    GO = Q(n, e, s, nil, nil, nil)
    if GO then
      GO.instance = c
      GO.expires = math.huge
    end
  end
  local function Q()

      i(c[n])

    c = j:GetChildren()
    for n = 1, #c, 1 do

      if O(n, 1, 11) == "VoxelSmoke_" then

          l(e, "smoke", c)
        end
      elseif O(n, 1, 10) == "VoxelFire_" then
        local c = O(n, 11)
        if not (X["fire:" .. c]) then
          l(e, "fire", c)
        end
      end
    end
  end

          return e.Position

        local e, s = pcall(n.GetPivot, n)
        if e then
          c.position = s.Position
          return s.Position
        end
        return c.position
      end
    end
    if not (n) then
      local n = j

      if e then
        if e:IsA("Model") then
          c.model = e
          c.modelseen = true
          return O(c)
        end
      end
    end
    if c.modelseen then
      c.expires = 0
    end
    return c.position
  end

    end
    if type(S) == "string" then

        end
      end
    end

  local function U(e)
    if c(e) then
      if typeof(e.endpoint) ~= "Vector3" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local c = _.Character
    if c then
      if c:IsDescendantOf(h) then
        if c:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local _ = (c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    if _ then
      if not (_:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local s = _.Position - e.endpoint
    local GO = s.Magnitude
    local AO = GO / (tonumber(E.Constants and E.Constants.SOURCE_TO_STUDS) or 0.0763888888888889)
    if AO > 350 then
      return nil
    end
    if GO > 0.3 then
      local E = e.endpoint + (s.Unit * 0.2)
      local s, dO = _.Position - E, {j, c}
      if e.model then
        dO[3] = e.model
      end
      S.FilterDescendantsInstances = dO
      dO = h:Raycast(E, s, S)
      if dO then
        if dO.Distance < (s.Magnitude - 0.2) then
          return nil
        end
      end
    end
    GO = (AO - 25) / 140
    c, AO = v(98, 105 * Y(-(GO * GO))), B()
    if AO > 0 then
      _ = c * 0.5
      c = if ((c - _) * 0.5) > AO then c - (AO / 0.5) else _
    else
    end
    c = W(c + 0.5)
    if c < 1 then
      return nil
    end
    return c
  end
  local B = {}
  local function _(v, W, Y, E)
    local c = E.ring

    if S < 3 then

    end

    for _O = 1, S, 1 do

      if not (bO) then
        dO = false
        break
      end
      B[_O] = bO
    end

      for c = #B, S + 1, -1 do

      e.stroke("active", B, true, s, 1.5, W, Y, "base", 0.92)
      if AO then
        e.draw("active", AO, B, s, W, Y, v.ViewportSize)
      end
    end
    S = I[E.weapon] or I[(t and "Smoke Grenade") or "Molotov"]
    x(v, W, Y, E.center + k, S, GO, nil, b, 32)
  end
  local function t(v)
    local W = 0
    for Y = 1, #o, 1 do
      local E = o[Y]
      Y = E.model
      if ((v >= (E.expires or 0)) or ((Y and E.modelseen) and not Y.Parent)) or (Y and (Y:GetAttribute("SimulationFinished") == true)) then
        R[E.id] = nil
      else
        W += 1
        o[W] = E
        R[E.id] = W
      end
    end
    for Y = #o, W + 1, -1 do
      o[Y] = nil
    end
    W = 0
    for Y = 1, #g, 1 do
      local E = g[Y]
      if (v >= (E.expires or math.huge)) or (E.instance and not E.instance.Parent) then
        X[E.key] = nil
      else
        W += 1
        g[W] = E
        X[E.key] = W
      end
    end
    for Y = #g, W + 1, -1 do
      g[Y] = nil
    end
    for W = #p, 1, -1 do
      if (v - p[W].time) > 2.5 then
        table.remove(p, W)
      end
    end
  end

    return nil
  end

    end
