  local function H()
    if c then
      if k then
        if W(c) then
          local Y = c
          return e(Y)
        end
      elseif E(c) then
        local Y = c
        return v(Y), nil
      end
      c = nil
    end
    local Y = os.clock()
    if not (n) then
      if (Y - S) < 0.25 then
        return nil, nil
      end
    end
    n, S = false, Y
    Y = d:GetTagged("Bomb")
    local n = #Y
    for S = 1, n, 1 do
      local C = Y[S]
      if W(C) then
        local W, S = e(C)
        if W then
          c, k = C, true
          return W, S
        end
      end
    end
    Y = d:GetTagged("WeaponDropped")
    n = #Y
    for W = 1, n, 1 do
      local n = Y[W]
      if E(n) then
        W = v(n)
        if W then
          c, k = n, false
          return W, nil
        end
      end
    end
    return nil, nil
  end
  local function v()
    t(os.clock())
    local t = K()
    if t then
      local W = G.drawmask()
      local Y = (W and A:GetGuiInset()) or Vector2.zero
      if Z.bomb_esp == true then
        local A, E = H()
        if typeof(A) == "Vector3" then
          P(t, W, Y, A, E)
        end
      end
      if Z.nade_zones == true then
        for A = 1, #g, 1 do
          _(t, W, Y, g[A])
        end
      end
      if Z.nades_live == true then
        for A = 1, #o, 1 do
          local _ = o[A]
          A = O(_)
          if typeof(A) == "Vector3" then
            local H = U(_)
            x(t, W, Y, A, I[_.weapon], Z.nade_icon_col or b, (H and (tostring(H) .. " dmg")) or nil, Z.nade_dmg_col or b, 30)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  F.step = function()
    fO, iO = 0, false
    if j then
      local t = Z.zonefill
      local A = type(t) == "table"
      if A then
        t.begin("active")
      end
      pcall(v)
      if A then
        t.finish("active")
      end
    end
    if not (pcall(hO)) then
      pcall(ZO)
    end
    if not (pcall(w)) then
      pcall(BO)
    end
  end
  local function w()
    if not (j) then
      local t = h:WaitForChild("Debris", 60)
      G.reclaim()
      if t then
        if not (u.alive()) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      j = t
    end
    l(V.Projectile and V.Projectile.Spawn, T)
    l(V.Projectile and V.Projectile.Bounce, M)
    l(V.Projectile and V.Projectile.Resolve, L)
    l(V.VFX and V.VFX.CreateVoxelSmoke, D)
    l(V.VFX and V.VFX.DestroyVoxelSmoke, q)
    l(V.VFX and V.VFX.CreateVoxelFire, m)
    l(V.VFX and V.VFX.UpdateVoxelFire, a)
    l(V.VFX and V.VFX.DestroyVoxelFire, J)
    u.connect(d:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Grenade"), i)
    Q()
  end
  u.spawn(w)
  u.teardown(function()
    local G = Z.zonefill
    if type(G) == "table" then
      G.clear("active")
    end
    z(uO)
    uO = nil
    G = wO
    for i = 1, G, 1 do
      z(jO[i])
    end
    wO = 0
    table.clear(jO)
    table.clear(tO)
    table.clear(N)
    table.clear(yO)
    table.clear(g)
    table.clear(X)
    table.clear(o)
    table.clear(R)
    table.clear(p)
    table.clear(B)
    r, fO, c = 0, 0, nil
  end)
  return F
end

-- Module aa
modules.aa = function()
  local G, i, u, j = modules.load("b"), modules.load("q"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("y")
  local w = modules.load("X")
  local t = i.world
  local Z = t.drops_opt
  local h = G.workspace
  local A, B, d = G.collection, i.white, {step = function()
  end}
  local _ = G.screen(2147479990)
  if not _ then
    return d
  end
  u.own(_)
  local b = {}
  i = G.storage:FindFirstChild("Database")
  G = i and (i:FindFirstChild("Custom"))
  i = G and (G:FindFirstChild("Weapons"))
  if i then
    for x, v in i:GetChildren() do
      if v:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        G, x = pcall(require, v)
        if G then
          if type(x) == "table" then
            local G = x.Class
            local i, x = v.Name, ((G == "Weapon") and "weapons") or ((G == "Grenade") and "grenades")
            b[i] = x or "other"
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local G, i = {}, {}
  local function x(v)
    if G[v] then
      return
    elseif not (v:IsA("PVInstance")) then
      return
    end
    local H = {model = v, name = v:GetAttribute("Weapon"), part = nil}
    G[v] = H
    i[#i + 1] = H
  end
  local function v(H)
    local l = G[H]
    if not (l) then
      return
    end
    G[H] = nil
    H = table.find(i, l)
    if H then
      i[H] = i[#i]
      i[#i] = nil
    end
  end
  for H, H in A:GetTagged("WeaponDropped") do
    x(H)
  end
  u.connect(A:GetInstanceAddedSignal("WeaponDropped"), x)
  u.connect(A:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("WeaponDropped"), v)
  local A, x, H, l = {}, 0, 0, 0
  local function W()
    local q = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    q.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    q.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    q.BorderSizePixel = 0
    q.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
    q.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    q.Visible = false
    q.ZIndex = 2
    q.Parent = _
    local _ = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    _.Enabled = false
    _.Parent = q
    return {img = q, grad = _}
  end
  local function _()
    local q = t.view
    if type(q) == "table" then
      if type(q.Resolve) == "function" then
        local J, D = pcall(q.Resolve)
        if J then
          if type(D) == "table" then
            return D, q.Project
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return h.CurrentCamera, nil
  end
  local function q(J, D, m)
    if D then
      local Y, O, Q, Q = pcall(D, m, J)
      if Y then
        if typeof(O) == "Vector2" then
          if type(Q) == "number" then
            return ((Q > 0.05) and O) or nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
    D = h.CurrentCamera
    if not D then
      return nil
    end
    J = D:WorldToViewportPoint(m)
    return ((J.Z > 0.05) and Vector2.new(J.X, J.Y)) or nil
  end
  local function J(D)
    local m = D.model
    if m:IsA("Model") then
      local Y = D.part
      if Y then
        if Y.Parent == nil then
          local O = m.PrimaryPart
          D.part = O
          Y = O
        else
        end
      else
        local O = m.PrimaryPart
        D.part = O
        Y = O
      end
      if Y then
        return Y.Position
      end
      local D, Y = pcall(m.GetPivot, m)
      return (D and Y.Position) or nil
    end
    return (m:IsA("BasePart") and m.Position) or nil
  end
  local D, m, Y
  local function O(Q, F)
    H += 1
    local I = A[H]
    if I then
    else
      I = W()
      A[H] = I
      x = H
    end
    local W, E, V, N = I.img, I.grad, Q.X, Q.Y
    if (I.x ~= V) or (I.y ~= N) then
      I.x = V
      I.y = N
      W.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(V, N)
    end
    if I.asset ~= F then
      I.asset = F
      W.Image = F
    end
    if Z.grad then
      Q = m
      V, F = Q ~= Z.a
      if V then
        F = V
      else
        N = Y
        F = N ~= Z.b
      end
      if F then
        local Q, F = Z.a, Z.b
        m, Y = Q, F
        D = ColorSequence.new(Z.a, Z.b)
      end
      if I.tint ~= B then
        I.tint = B
        W.ImageColor3 = B
      end
      if I.seq ~= D then
        I.seq = D
        E.Color = D
      end
      if not (I.grad_on) then
        I.grad_on = true
        E.Enabled = true
      end
    else
      local B = Z.col
      if I.tint ~= B then
        I.tint = B
        W.ImageColor3 = B
      end
      if I.grad_on then
        I.grad_on = false
        E.Enabled = false
      end
    end
    if H > l then
      W.Visible = true
    end
  end
  local function B()
    local W, D = _()
    if not (W) then
      return
    end
    local _, m = Z.kinds, w.n > 0
    for Z = #i, 1, -1 do
      local Y = i[Z]
      Z = Y.model
      if Z.Parent == nil then
        v(Z)
      elseif Z:IsDescendantOf(h) then
        local h = Y.name
        if h then
        else
          h = Z:GetAttribute("Weapon")
          Y.name = h
        end
        local Z = j.of(h)
        if Z then
          if _[b[h] or "other"] then
            local j = J(Y)
            local h = j and (q(W, D, j))
            if h then
              if m then
                if not (w.point(h.X, h.Y)) then
                  O(h, Z)
                end
              else
                O(h, Z)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  d.step = function()
    H = 0
    if t.drops then
      pcall(B)
    end
    local j, w = H + 1, l
    for t = j, w, 1 do
      A[t].img.Visible = false
    end
    l = H
  end
  u.teardown(function()
    table.clear(A)
    table.clear(G)
    table.clear(i)
    x, H, l = 0, 0, 0
  end)
  return d
end

-- Module ab
modules.ab = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u = modules.load("q"), modules.load("a")
  local j = modules.load("J")
  local w = modules.load("_")
  local t = modules.load("X")
  local Z = i.world
  local h = Z.ntrail_opt
  local A, A = G.guiservice, i.white
  local i = os.clock
  local B = math.max
  local d, _ = math.clamp, {step = function()
  end}
  if type(w.shots) ~= "table" then
    return _
  elseif type(w.pos) ~= "function" then
    return _
  elseif type(w.flat) ~= "function" then
    return _
  end
  local b, x, v, H, l, W, q, J = {["HE Grenade"] = "he", Flashbang = "flash", ["Smoke Grenade"] = "smoke", ["Decoy Grenade"] = "decoy", Molotov = "molotov", ["Incendiary Grenade"] = "molotov"}, {}, {}, 0, 0, 0, 0
  local D, m, Y, O, Q, F, I, E, V, N = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, 1920, 1080
  local function a()
    local U = j.tex()
    if not (U) then
      return nil
    end
    if not (J) then
      J = G.screen(2147479997)
      if not (J) then
        return nil
      end
      u.own(J)
    end
    local j = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    j.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    j.BorderSizePixel = 0
    j.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    j.ImageContent = U
    j.Visible = false
    j.Parent = J
    H += 1
    v[H] = j
    q += 1
    return j
  end
  local function j(J, U, g, X)
    if l >= 1200 then
      return
    end
    local o = v[l + 1]
    if o then
    else
      if q >= 48 then
        return
      end
      o = a()
      if not (o) then
        return
      end
    end
    l += 1
    local R, p, c = l, J.X, J.Y
    if (Y[R] ~= p) or (O[R] ~= c) then
      Y[R] = p
      O[R] = c
      o.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p, c)
    end
    if Q[R] ~= g then
      Q[R] = g
      o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(g, g)
    end
    if F[R] ~= U then
      F[R] = U
      o.ImageColor3 = U
    end
    if I[R] ~= X then
      I[R] = X
      o.ImageTransparency = 1 - X
    end
    if R > W then
      o.Visible = true
    end
  end
  local function J(U)
    return (t.n > 0) and t.point(U.X, U.Y)
  end
  local function U(g, X)
    table.clear(E)
    for o, R in w.shots, nil, nil do
      local p, c = R.id, R.weapon
      if p then
        if b[c] then
          E[p] = true
          o = x[p]
          if o then
          else
            o = {pts = {}, ts = {}, kind = b[c], still = 0, rest = false, last = g}
            x[p] = o
          end
          local b, p = pcall(w.pos, R)
          if b then
            if typeof(p) == "Vector3" then
              if not (o.rest) then
                local b, R = o.pts, o.ts
                local c, M = #b, g - o.last
                o.last = g
                if (c == 0) or ((p - b[c]).Magnitude > 0.03) then
                  b[c + 1] = p
                  R[c + 1] = g
                  o.still = 0
                else
                  o.still = o.still + M
                  if o.still > 0.15 then
                    o.rest = true
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for b, o in x, nil, nil do
      if not (E[b]) then
        o.rest = true
      end
      local R, p, c = o.pts, o.ts, 0
      for M = 1, #p, 1 do
        if not ((g - p[M]) > X) then
          break
        end
        c = M
      end
      if c > 0 then
        table.move(R, c + 1, #R + c, 1)
        table.move(p, c + 1, #p + c, 1)
      end
      if #R == 0 then
        if o.rest then
          x[b] = nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function b(g, X, o, R)
    local p, c = g.pts, g.ts
    local M = #p
    if M < 2 then
      return
    elseif not (h.kinds[g.kind]) then
      return
    end
    g = 0
    for T = M, 1, -1 do
      local L = w.flat(p[T], R)
      if L then
        g += 1
        D[g] = L
        m[g] = d((X - c[T]) / o, 0, 1)
      else
        if g > 0 then
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if g < 2 then
      return
    end
    M, X = B(1, tonumber(h.width) or 2), h.col or A
    local T, L, k, P, z, n, K = h.a or X, h.b or X, h.grad == true, B(1.5, M * 0.75), g - 1, 0, 0
    for S = 1, z, 1 do
      if l >= 1200 then
        break
      end
      R, c = D[S], D[S + 1]
      o, g, p = (c - R).Magnitude
      if o > 0 then
        g, p = t.clip(R, c, V, N, 48)
      else
      end
      if g then
        local t, D = B(n, g * o), p * o
        while true do
          local g = (t < D) and (l < 1200)
          if not g then
            break
          end
          g = t / o
          local D, p = R:Lerp(c, g), m[S] + ((m[S + 1] - m[S]) * g)
          g = math.floor((((1 - p) ^ 1.15) * 64) + 0.5) / 64
          if g > 0.01 then
            if J(D) then
            else
              local J, m, R = (k and T:Lerp(L, p)) or X, M * (0.5 + (0.5 * g)), K + 1
              if (R % 2) == 1 then
                j(D, J, m * 9, 0.2 * g)
              end
              j(D, J:Lerp(A, 0.45), m * 3.2, 0.7 * g)
              K = R
            end
          else
          end
          t = t + P
        end
        n = B(0, t - o)
      else
        n = 0
      end
    end
  end
  local function j()
    local t, A = l + 1, W
    for B = t, A, 1 do
      v[B].Visible = false
    end
    W, l = l, 0
  end
  _.step = function()
    l, q = 0, 0
    if Z.ntrail then
      if (H < 256) and (next(x) == nil) then
        for t = 1, 8, 1 do
          if not (a()) then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      local t, Z = i(), d(tonumber(h.life) or 0.6, 0.1, 3)
      pcall(U, t, Z)
      local i, h = G.workspace.CurrentCamera, ((next(x) ~= nil) and w.view()) or nil
      if i and h then
        local G = i.ViewportSize
        local i, w = G.X, G.Y
        V, N = i, w
        for G, G in x, nil, nil do
          pcall(b, G, t, Z, h)
        end
      end
    elseif next(x) then
      table.clear(x)
    end
    j()
  end
  u.teardown(function()
    table.clear(x)
    table.clear(v)
    table.clear(E)
    table.clear(Y)
    table.clear(O)
    table.clear(Q)
    table.clear(F)
    table.clear(I)
    H, l, W, q = 0, 0, 0, 0
  end)
  return _
end

-- Module ac
modules.ac = function()
  local G, i = os.clock, {hooked = false, on = false, fresh = false, broke = false, target = nil, beat = 0, samples = 0, still = 0, ground = false, bx = 0, by = 0, bj = false, input_at = 0}
  i.engage = function(u)
    if not (i.on) then
      i.on = true
      i.fresh = true
      i.broke = false
      i.samples = 0
      i.still = 0
      i.ground = false
    end
    i.target = u
    i.beat = G()
  end
  i.release = function()
    i.on = false
    i.fresh = false
    i.broke = false
    i.target = nil
    i.samples = 0
    i.still = 0
    i.ground = false
  end
  i.active = function(G)
    if not (i.on) then
      return false
    end
    if (G - i.beat) > 0.5 then
      i.release()
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  return i
end

-- Module ad
modules.ad = function()
  local G, i, u = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("h")
  local j, w, t = modules.load("j"), modules.load("T"), modules.load("o")
  local Z = modules.load("k").slots
  local h = modules.load("ac")
  local A = G.lp
  local B = G.workspace
  local G = j.pose
  local d, _, b = j.grenade, j.inventory, os.clock
  local j = w.probe
  local w = Vector3.new
  local x = math.rad
  local v = math.random
  local H = math.clamp
  local l = math.atan2
  local W = math.cos
  local q, J, D, m, Y, O, Q, F, I, E, V, N, a, U, g = math.sin, 3.141592653589793, {["Counter-Terrorists"] = true, Terrorists = true}, 2, 4.5, 3.5, 0.05, 0.25, 2, 10, {on = false, yaw = "backward", jitter = 45, spin_rate = 25, pitch = "off", air_spin = false, air_rate = 30, air_pitch = "off", duck = false, duck_rate = 4, man = 0, auto = false, ang = 90}, 0
  local X, o, R, p, c = 0, false, {s = 0, at = 0, lk = 0, ch = nil}, {}, false
  local M = ((type(G) == "table") and (type(G.getJoints) == "function")) and (type(G.applyVerticalLook) == "function")
  local function T()
    if M then
      if U then
        pcall(G.applyVerticalLook, U, 0, 0)
      end
    end
  end
  local function L(k)
    if M then
      if not (k) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    if g == k then
      if U then
        local P = U
        return P
      end
    end
    T()
    U, g = nil, nil
    local P, z = pcall(G.getJoints, k)
    if P then
      if type(z) == "table" then
        U, g = z, k
      end
    end
    P = U
    return P
  end
  local function k(P)
    local z, n, K, S, e = A:GetAttribute("Team"), B:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Deathmatch", b(), u.all()
    local u, C, s, r, yO
    for fO = 1, e, 1 do
      local e = S[fO]
      if e ~= A then
        fO = e:GetAttribute("Team")
        if n or (((((z ~= nil) and (fO ~= nil)) and D[z]) and D[fO]) and (z ~= fO)) then
          local D, z, n = e.Character
          local S = false
          if D then
            if D:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true then
              if D:IsDescendantOf(B) then
                if D:GetAttribute("ClientCharacterPresentationVisible") ~= false then
                  local B = D:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                  if B then
                    local fO, GO = D:FindFirstChild("Head"), B.Position
                    n = (fO and fO.Position) or (GO + w(0, 1.8, 0))
                    fO = true
                    z, S = GO, fO
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
          local B = r
          if z then
            r = n
          else
            local fO = Z[e]
            local Z = (((fO and (fO.mode == "est")) and (fO.cerr <= E)) and ((K - fO.at) <= I)) and fO.cur
            if Z then
              local I = fO.ghost
              local E = I and I.parts.Head
              r = (E and E.Position) or (Z + w(0, 1.8, 0))
              z = Z
            else
              r = n
            end
          end
          if z then
            local Z = (z - P).Magnitude
            if (if u then S and not C else not u) or ((S == C) and (Z < u)) then
              u, C, s, yO = Z, S, z, (S and D) or nil
            else
              r = B
            end
          else
            r = B
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return s, r, yO
  end
  local function u(Z, B)
    if c then
      return t.clear(Z, B)
    end
    return j(Z, B - Z, nil, p).instance == nil
  end
  local function j(Z, B, D)
    c = t.sync()
    if D then
      local t = u(D, Z - (B * m))
      if t ~= u(D, Z + (B * m)) then
        return (t and 1) or -1
      end
      if t then
        return 0
      end
      t = u(D, Z - (B * Y))
      if t ~= u(D, Z + (B * Y)) then
        return (t and 1) or -1
      end
    end
    D = not u(Z, Z - (B * O))
    if D ~= not u(Z, Z + (B * O)) then
      return (D and -1) or 1
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function u(t, Z, B, D, m)
    local Y = b()
    if R.ch ~= t then
      R.ch = t
      R.s = 0
      R.at = 0
      R.lk = 0
    end
    if Y < R.at then
      return R.s
    end
    R.at = Y + Q
    p[1] = t
    p[2] = m
    local O, Q = Z.Position, t and (t:FindFirstChild("Head"))
    m = w(O.X, (Q and Q.Position.Y) or (O.Y + 1.8), O.Z)
    Q, O = pcall(j, m, w(-W(B), 0, q(B)), D)
    if Q then
      if O ~= nil then
        if O ~= R.s then
          if R.s == 0 then
            R.s, R.lk = O, Y + F
          elseif Y >= R.lk then
            R.s, R.lk = O, Y + F
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return R.s
  end
  local function j()
    if b() < X then
      return true
    elseif h.on then
      return true
    end
    return (A:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb") == true) or (A:GetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb") == true)
  end
  if type(d) == "table" then
    if type(rawget(d, "Throw")) == "function" then
      i.field(d, "Throw", function(w)
        local function t(Z, ...)
          if V.on then
            X = b() + 1.25
          end
          return w(Z, ...)
        end
        return t
      end)
    end
  end
  if type(_) == "table" then
    if type(rawget(_, "PredictGrenadeThrow")) == "function" then
      i.field(_, "PredictGrenadeThrow", function(w)
        local function t(...)
          local Z = w(...)
          if Z == true then
            if V.on then
              X = b() + 0.35
            end
          end
          return Z
        end
        return t
      end)
    end
  end
  d = {cfg = V, reset = function()
    N, a = 0, nil
    R.s = 0
    R.at = 0
    R.lk = 0
  end, relax = function()
    T()
  end, apply = function(w, t)
    if not (V.on) then
      return
    end
    if j() then
      if not (o) then
        o = true
        T()
      end
      return
    end
    o = false
    local j, Z, h = tonumber(t.LookYaw) or 0, tonumber(t.VerticalLook) or 0, w and w.MovementState
    local A = (h and (h.OnGround == false)) and (V.air_spin == true)
    local B, _ = (A and V.air_pitch) or V.pitch
    if A then
      h = N
      N = h + x(tonumber(V.air_rate) or 30)
      _ = j + N
    else
      local b = a
      if b ~= V.yaw then
        N = 0
        a = V.yaw
      end
      local D, m, Y, O = V.yaw, V.man, j + J, w and w.HumanoidRootPart
      if O and ((((m ~= 0) or V.auto) or (D == "backward")) or (D == "jitter")) then
        b = O.Position
        local J, Q, F = k(b)
        if J then
          local I = J - b
          Y = l(I.X, I.Z)
        else
        end
        m = if m == 0 then if V.auto then u(w.Character, O, Y, Q, F) else m else m
      else
      end
      if m ~= 0 then
        _ = Y + (x(tonumber(V.ang) or 90) * (((B == "up") and -m) or m))
      else
        if D == "spin" then
          O = N
          N = O + x(tonumber(V.spin_rate) or 25)
          _ = j + N
        else
          _ = if D == "backward" then Y else if D == "jitter" then Y else j
        end
      end
      _ = if D == "jitter" then _ + x(((v() * 2) - 1) * (tonumber(V.jitter) or 0)) else _
    end
    A = B ~= "off"
    Z = H(if B == "down" then -1 else if B == "up" then 1 else if B == "jitter" then (v() * 2) - 1 else Z, -1, 1)
    t.LookYaw = _
    t.VerticalLook = Z
    if typeof(t.Move) == "Vector2" then
      h = _ - j
      if math.abs(h) > 1e-06 then
        local u, j, _ = W(h), q(h), t.Move
        t.Move = Vector2.new((_.X * u) - (_.Y * j), (_.X * j) + (_.Y * u))
      end
    end
    if V.duck then
      h, B = 1 / (2 * H(tonumber(V.duck_rate) or 4, 1, 12)), tonumber(t.Buttons) or 0
      if (math.floor(os.clock() / h) % 2) == 1 then
        t.Buttons = bit32.bor(B, 2)
      else
        t.Buttons = bit32.band(B, bit32.bnot(2))
      end
    end
    if A then
      if M then
        if w then
          if w.Character then
            t = L(w.Character)
            if t then
              pcall(G.applyVerticalLook, t, Z, 0)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end, unload = function()
    V.on = false
    X, o = 0, false
    T()
    U, g = nil, nil
    R.ch = nil
    table.clear(p)
  end}
  i.teardown(d.unload)
  return d
end

-- Module ae
modules.ae = function()
  local G = {weapon = nil, cframe = nil, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, expires = 0, cmd_samples = 0}
  G.cmd_active = function(i)
    i = i or os.clock()
    if G.cmd_samples <= 0 then
      return false
    elseif i > G.expires then
      return false
    end
    if type(G.yaw) ~= "number" then
      return false
    elseif type(G.pitch) ~= "number" then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  G.cmd_consume = function()
    if G.cmd_samples > 0 then
      G.cmd_samples = G.cmd_samples - 1
    end
  end
  G.clear = function()
    G.weapon = nil
    G.cframe = nil
    G.yaw = 0
    G.pitch = 0
    G.expires = 0
    G.cmd_samples = 0
  end
  return G
end

-- Module af
modules.af = function()
  local G, i, u, j = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("ad")
  local w = modules.load("ae")
  local t = modules.load("ac")
  local Z, h, A = G.lp, G.storage, math.clamp
  local B = math.floor
  local d = math.sqrt
  local _ = math.abs
  local b = math.cos
  local x, v = math.sin, 3.141592653589793
  local H = math.atan2
  local l = bit32.bor
  local W = bit32.band
  local q, J, D, m, Y, O, Q = bit32.bnot, {bhop = false, strafe = false, land_save = false, edge_jump = false, jump_bug = false, edge_bug = false, slow_walk = false, pixel_surf = false}
  local F, I, E, V, N, a, U = false
  do
    local g = h:FindFirstChild("MovementV2")
    if g then
      local X, o, R, p, c, M = pcall(function()
        return require(g.Simulation), require(g.Simulation.State), require(g.Simulation.RuntimeSettings), require(g.Serial), require(g.Buttons)
      end)
      if X and (type(o) == "table") then
        if type(o.step) == "function" then
          if type(R) == "table" then
            if type(p) == "table" then
              if type(c) == "table" then
                if type(M) == "table" then
                  local g = true
                  D, m, Y, O, Q, F = o, R, p, c, M, g
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    I, E, V, N, a, U = D, m, Y, O, Q, F
  end
  local D = (a and a.Jump) or 1
  local m = (a and a.Duck) or 2
  local Y, O, Q = (a and a.Walk) or 4, {char = nil, runtime = nil, bug_pending = false, hz = nil, config = nil, strafe_yaw = nil, strafe_side = 1, strafe_head = nil, strafe_wing = nil, strafe_speed = 0, strafe_cos = 0, capture = false, world = nil, world_tick = nil, world_owner = nil}, {edge = nil, riding = false, retry = 0, flight = 0, glide = 0, pending = 0, jump = false}
  local F = math.round
  local g, X, o = math.max, 6.283185307179586, {}
  lphAppendValues(o, 0, Vector2.zero)
  for R = 0, 15, 1 do
    G = (R * v) / 8
    o[#o + 1] = Vector2.new(b(G), x(G))
  end
  local R, p = {}, {}
  h = u.mv_runtime
  if type(h) == "table" then
    if type(rawget(h, "advance")) == "function" then
      i.field(h, "advance", function(c)
        return function(M, ...)
          O.runtime = M
          return c(M, ...)
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  if type(h) == "table" then
    if type(rawget(h, "_composeWorld")) == "function" then
      G = i.field(h, "_composeWorld", function(c)
        return function(M, T, ...)
          local L, k = c(M, T, ...)
          if L ~= nil then
            O.world = L
            O.world_tick = T
            O.world_owner = M
          end
          return L, k
        end
      end)
      O.capture = rawget(h, "_composeWorld") ~= G
      i.teardown(function()
        O.capture = false
        O.world = nil
        O.world_tick = nil
        O.world_owner = nil
      end)
    end
  end
  local function c(M, T, L)
    if a then
      if type(a.with) == "function" then
        return a.with(M, T, L)
      end
    end
    if L then
      return l(M, T)
    end
    return W(M, q(T))
  end
  local function a(M)
    local T = O.runtime
    if type(T) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    if rawget(T, "_started") ~= true then
      return nil
    end
    if type(M) == "table" then
      local L = rawget(T, "_mapping")
      if type(L) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      elseif L.Generation ~= M.Generation then
        return nil
      end
    end
    return T
  end
  local function M(T)
    local L = ((type(T) == "table") and tonumber(T.SimulationHz)) or nil
    if not (L) then
      return nil
    end
    if O.hz == L then
      if O.config then
        return O.config
      end
    end
    local T, k = pcall(V.getMovementConfig, L)
    if T then
      if type(k) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    O.hz = L
    O.config = k
    return k
  end
  local function V(T, L)
    if U then
      if type(T) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      elseif type(L) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      elseif type(T.Support) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local k = tonumber(T.ServerTick)
    if not (k) then
      return nil
    end
    local P = a(T.Mapping)
    if not (P) then
      return nil
    end
    local z = rawget(P, "_commandStream")
    if type(z) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    local n = (((O.world_owner == P) and (O.world_tick == k)) and O.world) or nil
    if n then
    else
      if O.capture then
      else
        local K = rawget(P, "_timeline")
        if type(K) ~= "table" then
          return nil
        end
        local S, e = pcall(K.resolve, K, k)
        if S then
          if type(e) ~= "table" then
            return nil
          end
        else
          return nil
        end
        K, S = pcall(P._composeWorld, P, k, e.Revision, nil, L)
        n = (K and S) or nil
      end
    end
    if type(n) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif type(n.Composed) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif type(n.Composed.Query) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    k = M(T.Mapping)
    if not k then
      return nil
    end
    local K, S = pcall(z.lastSampledCommandNumber, z)
    if not (K) then
      return nil
    end
    z, K = pcall(N.addUInt32, S or 4294967295, 1)
    if not z then
      return nil
    end
    return {runtime = P, state = L, support = T.Support, world = n, config = k, step = A(tonumber(T.StepSeconds) or 0.015625, 0.001, 0.05), number = K}
  end
  local function T(L)
    local k, P = pcall(E.clone, L.state)
    if k then
      if type(P) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local k, z = pcall(E.cloneSupport, L.support)
    if k then
      if type(z) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    return P, z
  end
  local function E(L)
    local k = ((F(((L % X) / X) * 65536) % 65536) / 65536) * X
    if k >= v then
      return k - X
    end
    return k
  end
  local function v(X, L, k, P, z, n, K, S)
    local e, C = pcall(X.runtime._resolveSupportMotion, X.runtime, X.world, L, k)
    if not (e) then
      return nil
    end
    local e, s, r, yO = pcall(I.step, L, k, {CommandNumber = P, Move = Vector2.new(F(A(z.X, -1, 1) * 127) / 127, F(A(z.Y, -1, 1) * 127) / 127), LookYaw = E(n), VerticalLook = F(A(K, -1, 1) * 127) / 127, Buttons = S}, X.step, X.world.Composed.Query, C, X.config, nil)
    if e then
      if type(s) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      elseif type(r) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      elseif type(yO) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    return s, r, yO
  end
  local function I(E, X, L, k, P)
    local z, n = T(E)
    if not (z) then
      return nil
    end
    return v(E, z, n, E.number, X, L, k, P)
  end
  local function E(X, L, k, P)
    if P.Landed then
      return false
    elseif P.StartSolid then
      return false
    elseif L.OnGround == true then
      return false
    elseif k.OnGround == true then
      return false
    end
    local z, n = L.Velocity, k.Velocity
    if typeof(z) ~= "Vector3" then
      return false
    elseif typeof(n) ~= "Vector3" then
      return false
    elseif z.Y >= -4 then
      return false
    end
    P = _(tonumber(X.config.Gravity) or 60)
    local K = math.max(1.25, (P * X.step) * 1.35)
    if _(n.Y) > K then
      return false
    elseif n.Y <= (z.Y + 4) then
      return false
    end
    return k.Position.Y <= (L.Position.Y + 0.05)
  end
  local function X(L, k, P, z, n)
    local K = c(c(n, D, false), m, false)
    local S, e, e = I(L, k, P, z, K)
    if not (S) then
      return nil
    end
    if E(L, L.state, S, e) then
      return k, false
    end
    if not (e.Landed) then
      return nil
    end
    e = #o + 1
    for C = 0, #o, 1 do
      n = C + 1
      R[n] = C
      p[n] = ((((C == 0) and k) or o[C]) - k).Magnitude
    end
    for C = 2, e, 1 do
      local s, r, yO = R[C], p[C], C - 1
      while (yO >= 1) and (p[yO] > r) do
        R[yO + 1] = R[yO]
        p[yO + 1] = p[yO]
        yO -= 1
      end
      R[yO + 1] = s
      p[yO + 1] = r
    end
    local C, s, r
    for yO = 0, 1, 1 do
      n = yO == 1
      local fO, GO = (n and 0.25) or 0, c(K, m, n)
      for K = 1, e, 1 do
        S = R[K]
        if (yO ~= 0) or (S ~= 0) then
          local R = p[K] + fO
          if C then
            if R >= C then
              break
            end
          end
          local p = ((S == 0) and k) or o[S]
          local o, k, k = I(L, p, P, z, GO)
          if o then
            if E(L, L.state, o, k) then
              C, s, r = R, p, n
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return s, r
  end
  local function E(o, R)
    local p, L = x(R), b(R)
    local k, P = (L * o.X) + (p * o.Y), (-p * o.X) + (L * o.Y)
    L = (k * k) + (P * P)
    if L > 1 then
      R = 1 / d(L)
      k, P = k * R, P * R
    else
    end
    return Vector3.new(k, 0, P)
  end
  local function o(R, p)
    local L, k = x(p), b(p)
    return Vector2.new((k * R.X) - (L * R.Z), (L * R.X) + (k * R.Z))
  end
  local function R(p, L, k, P)
    local z, n = tonumber(p.PositionSnapEpsilon) or 0.001, tonumber(L.BaseMoveSpeed)
    local K = ((n and A(n, 0, tonumber(p.MaxBaseMoveSpeed) or 19.5)) or tonumber(p.MaxSpeed)) or 18.75
    K = if W(k, Y) ~= 0 then K * (tonumber(p.WalkModifier) or 0.52) else K
    n = A((tonumber(L.Stamina) or 100) / g(tonumber(p.StaminaMax) or 100, 1), 0, 1)
    K *= n * n
    if K <= z then
      return nil
    end
    local k, n, S, e = tonumber(p.BunnyHopAirAccelerate) or 0, tonumber(p.BunnyHopAirSpeedCap) or 0
    if (k > 0) and (n > z) then
      S = math.min(K, n)
      e = (k * S) * P
    else
      S, e = (math.min(K, tonumber(p.AirSpeedCap) or 2.25)), (((tonumber(p.AirAccelerate) or 12) * K) * P) * (tonumber(L.GroundSurfaceFriction) or 1)
    end
    if e <= 0 then
      return nil
    end
    return {cap = S, acc = e, top = g(tonumber(p.BunnyHopSpeedCap) or 0, 0)}
  end
  local function p(L, k, P)
    local z = L * k
    k = math.min(P.cap - z, P.acc)
    local n = if k > 0 then d(g(((L * L) + ((2 * k) * z)) + (k * k), 0)) else L
    return if P.top > 0 then if n > P.top then P.top else n else n
  end
  local function L(k, P)
    if k <= 0.001 then
      return 1
    end
    local z, n, K = P.cap, P.acc, P.top
    P = g(z - n, 0)
    if K > 0 then
      local S = math.min(z - P, n)
      if (((k * k) + ((2 * S) * P)) + (S * S)) > (K * K) then
        local S = ((((K * K) - (k * k)) - (n * n)) / (2 * n)) + 0.25
        P = if S <= (z - n) then g(S, -k) else P
      else
      end
    else
    end
    return A(P / k, -1, 1)
  end
  local function k(P, z, n, K)
    if p(P, K, n) <= z then
      return K
    end
    if p(P, -1, n) > z then
      return -1
    end
    local S, e = -1, K
    for C = 1, 14, 1 do
      K = (S + e) * 0.5
      if p(P, K, n) > z then
        e = K
      else
        S = K
      end
    end
    return S
  end
  local function P(z, n)
    local K = tonumber(n.BunnyHopPenaltyThreshold) or 0
    if K <= 0 then
      return z
    elseif z <= K then
      return z
    end
    local S = 1 - ((tonumber(n.BunnyHopPenaltyBase) or 0) + ((z - K) * (tonumber(n.BunnyHopPenaltyScale) or 0)))
    return z * A(g(tonumber(n.BunnyHopMinVelocityRetain) or 0, S), 0, 1)
  end
  local function z(n, K)
    local S = d(g(1 - (n * n), 0))
    return o((O.strafe_head * n) + (O.strafe_wing * S), K)
  end
  local function n(K, S, e, C, s, r)
    local yO, fO = T(K)
    if not (yO) then
      return nil
    end
    local GO = K.number
    for iO = 1, r, 1 do
      local uO, jO, wO = v(K, yO, fO, GO, S, e, C, s)
      if not (uO) then
        return nil
      end
      if wO.Landed then
        return iO
      end
      if uO.OnGround == true then
        return nil
      end
      if iO < r then
        local K, S = pcall(N.addUInt32, GO, 1)
        if not (K) then
          return nil
        end
        yO, fO, GO = uO, jO, S
      else
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function K(S, e, C, s, r, yO)
    local fO = S.config
    local GO = tonumber(fO.BunnyHopPenaltyThreshold) or 0
    if GO <= 0 then
      return nil
    elseif not (O.strafe_head) then
      return nil
    end
    local iO, uO = O.strafe_speed, O.strafe_cos
    local jO = p(iO, uO, e)
    if jO <= GO then
      return nil
    elseif P(jO, fO) >= (GO - 0.05) then
      return nil
    end
    fO = n(S, C, s, r, yO, (A(math.ceil((jO - GO) / (e.acc * 0.9)), 1, 8)))
    if not fO then
      return nil
    end
    s = (GO - 0.05) + (((fO - 1) * e.acc) * 0.9)
    if p(iO, -1, e) > s then
      return nil
    end
    C = k(iO, s, e, uO)
    if C == uO then
      return nil
    end
    return C
  end
  local function p(k)
    local P = O.config
    local n = (P and tonumber(P.BunnyHopPenaltyThreshold)) or 0
    return (n > 0) and (((k.X * k.X) + (k.Z * k.Z)) > ((n - 2.5) ^ 2))
  end
  local function k(P, n, S, e, C)
    local s = Vector3.new(S.X, 0, S.Z)
    local r, yO = s.Magnitude, O.strafe_yaw
    O.strafe_yaw = n
    O.strafe_head = nil
    if r <= 0.05 then
      if P.Magnitude > 0.001 then
        return ((P.Magnitude > 1) and P.Unit) or P
      end
      S = O.strafe_side or 1
      O.strafe_side = S
      return Vector2.new(S, 0)
    end
    S = s / r
    s = Vector3.new(S.Z, 0, -S.X)
    local fO = E(P, n):Dot(s)
    P = nil
    if _(fO) > 0.01 then
      P = ((fO > 0) and 1) or -1
    else
      if yO ~= nil then
        local fO = math.atan2(x(n - yO), b(n - yO))
        P = if _(fO) > 0.0001 then ((fO > 0) and 1) or -1 else P
      else
      end
    end
    if P then
    else
      yO = tonumber(e)
      P = if yO then (((B(yO) % 2) == 0) and 1) or -1 else -(O.strafe_side or 1)
    end
    O.strafe_side = P
    O.strafe_head = S
    O.strafe_wing = s * P
    O.strafe_speed = r
    O.strafe_cos = (C and L(r, C)) or 0
    return z(O.strafe_cos, n)
  end
  local function B()
    Q.edge = nil
    Q.riding = false
    Q.pending = 0
  end
  local function L(P)
    return (((P.Stance == "Ducking") and not (P.JumpHullActive and (P.IsDucking == false))) and "Ducking") or "Standing"
  end
  local function P(n, S, e, C)
    local s, r = pcall(n.Sweep, n, S, e, C, nil, 1, 1)
    if s then
      if type(r) == "table" then
        if not (r.StartSolid) then
          if not (r.AllSolid) then
            if typeof(r.Normal) == "Vector3" then
              if type(r.Fraction) == "number" then
                if r.Fraction < 1 then
                  return r
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function n(S, e, C, s)
    local r, yO = pcall(S.FindGround, S, e, C, s, 1)
    if r then
      if type(yO) == "table" then
        if typeof(yO.Position) == "Vector3" then
          return yO
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function S(e, C)
    return e.height + ((C:Dot(e.tangent) - e.origin) * e.grade)
  end
  local function e(C, s, r)
    local yO = r:Dot(s.normal) - s.plane
    local fO = r - (s.normal * (yO + 0.18))
    yO = S(s, fO)
    r = Vector3.new(fO.X, yO + 0.16, fO.Z)
    local fO, GO = n(C, r, s.stance, 0.32), s.normal * 0.5
    return ((fO ~= nil) and (_(fO.Position.Y - yO) <= 0.16)) and (n(C, (r + GO) + Vector3.new(0, GO:Dot(s.slope), 0), s.stance, 0.32) == nil)
  end
  local function C(s, r, yO, fO, GO)
    local iO, uO, jO, wO = s.config, L(r), r.Position, Vector3.new(yO.X, 0, yO.Z)
    r = fO + (wO / g(iO.DefaultBaseMoveSpeed, wO.Magnitude))
    if r.Magnitude <= 0.25 then
      return nil
    end
    local tO, ZO = s.world.Composed.Query, (GO and iO.JumpSpeed) or g(0, yO.Y)
    local hO, AO, BO, dO = (ZO * ZO) / (2 * iO.Gravity), A(wO.Magnitude * 0.3, 2.8, 5.5), jO + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0), r.Unit
    r, wO, yO = Vector3.new(-dO.Z, 0, dO.X), math.huge, ipairs
    fO = {dO, dO + (r * 0.85), dO - (r * 0.85), r, -r}
    s = nil
    for _O, bO in yO(fO) do
      ZO = BO + (bO.Unit * AO)
      bO = P(tO, BO, ZO, uO)
      if bO then
        if _(bO.Normal.Y) < 0.15 then
          _O, r = Vector3.new(bO.Normal.X, 0, bO.Normal.Z).Unit, BO:Lerp(ZO, bO.Fraction)
          local P = (jO - r):Dot(_O)
          if (P < wO) and ((dO:Dot(_O) < -0.12) or (P <= 0.8)) then
            local yO, fO, ZO = r - (_O * 0.24), jO.Y + ((GO and 0.75) or -0.65), (jO.Y + hO) + ((GO and 0.02) or 0.15)
            local GO = n(tO, Vector3.new(yO.X, ZO + 0.16, yO.Z), uO, (ZO - fO) + 0.16)
            if GO then
              if GO.Position.Y >= fO then
                if GO.Position.Y <= ZO then
                  if typeof(GO.Normal) == "Vector3" then
                    if GO.Normal.Y >= iO.WalkableFloor then
                      local n, fO = Vector3.new(-_O.Z, 0, _O.X), Vector3.new(-GO.Normal.X, 0, -GO.Normal.Z) / GO.Normal.Y
                      yO = {normal = _O, tangent = n, plane = r:Dot(_O), height = GO.Position.Y + (fO:Dot(_O) * 0.06), origin = GO.Position:Dot(n), grade = fO:Dot(n), slope = fO, stance = uO}
                      if e(tO, yO, r) then
                        wO, s = P, yO
                      else
                      end
                    else
                    end
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return s
  end
  local function P(n, s, r, yO, fO)
    local GO, iO, uO = (s.Position:Dot(n.normal) - n.plane) + 0.18, s.Velocity:Dot(n.normal), s.OnGround == true
    local jO = (uO and ((-GO * 4.8) - (iO * 0.88))) or ((-GO * 4.2) - (iO * 0.55))
    iO = fO or (A(if uO then jO else if s.Position.Y < (S(n, s.Position) - 0.035) then math.min(jO, -0.3) else jO, -1, 1))
    GO = d(g(0, 1 - (iO * iO)))
    fO = A(r:Dot(n.tangent), -GO, GO)
    return o((n.tangent * fO) + (n.normal * iO), yO)
  end
  local function d(n, s)
    return (((s.OnGround == true) and (L(s) == n.stance)) and (_(s.Position.Y - S(n, s.Position)) <= 0.16)) and (_((s.Position:Dot(n.normal) - n.plane) + 0.18) <= 0.32)
  end
  local function n(s, r, yO, fO, GO, iO, uO, jO)
    local wO, tO = T(s)
    if not (wO) then
      return nil
    end
    local ZO
    local hO = s.number
    for AO = 1, math.ceil(0.85 / s.step), 1 do
      local BO = jO and (AO == 1)
      AO = (BO and yO) or P(r, wO, fO, GO)
      ZO = ZO or AO
      local yO, fO, jO = v(s, wO, tO, hO, AO, GO, iO, c(uO, D, BO))
      AO = not yO
      if if yO then BO and not jO.Jumped else AO then
        return nil
      elseif L(yO) ~= r.stance then
        return nil
      end
      if d(r, yO) then
        if e(s.world.Composed.Query, r, yO.Position) then
          return ZO
        end
      end
      if yO.OnGround then
        return nil
      elseif yO.Velocity.Y <= 0 then
        if yO.Position.Y < (S(r, yO.Position) - 0.16) then
          return nil
        end
      end
      jO = N.addUInt32
      wO, tO, hO = yO, fO, (jO(hO, 1))
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function s(r, yO, fO, GO, iO, uO, jO)
    local wO = table.clone(r)
    wO.state, wO.support = T(r)
    if not (wO.state) then
      return nil
    end
    local T = g(1, F(0.05 / r.step))
    for F = 1, T * 3, 1 do
      wO.state, wO.support = v(wO, wO.state, wO.support, wO.number, fO, iO, uO, c(jO, D, false))
      if wO.state then
        if not (wO.state.OnGround) then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
      wO.number = N.addUInt32(wO.number, 1)
      if (F % T) == 0 then
        if n(wO, yO, fO, GO, iO, uO, jO, true) then
          return F
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function v(F, N, T, r, yO, fO, GO, iO, uO)
    local jO, wO = E(T, r), Q.edge
    local E = jO
    if wO then
      local tO, ZO = E:Dot(wO.normal), _(E:Dot(wO.tangent))
      if ((uO and Q.riding) or ((tO > 0.72) and (tO > (ZO * 1.6)))) or (L(N) ~= wO.stance) then
        B()
        Q.retry = 0.22
        return nil
      end
      tO = F.world.Composed.Query
      if iO then
        if not (d(wO, N)) then
          B()
          return nil
        end
        local L = GO:Dot(wO.tangent)
        if not (Q.riding) then
          Q.glide = L
        end
        Q.riding = true
        if ZO < 0.08 then
          local hO = ((((Q.glide - L) * Q.glide) > 0) and A(Q.glide / F.config.DefaultBaseMoveSpeed, -1, 1)) or 0
          jO = wO.tangent * hO
        else
          jO = E
        end
        for hO = 1, 3, 1 do
          L = P(wO, N, jO, r, (((hO == 2) and -1) or ((hO == 3) and 1)) or nil)
          hO = I(F, L, r, yO, c(fO, D, false))
          if hO then
            if d(wO, hO) then
              if e(tO, wO, hO.Position) then
                if ZO >= 0.08 then
                  Q.glide = hO.Velocity:Dot(wO.tangent)
                end
                return L, false
              end
            end
          end
        end
      else
        local d = Q.riding
        if if d then not d else (GO.Y > 0) or (N.Position.Y >= (S(wO, N.Position) - 0.16)) then
          Q.flight = Q.flight + F.step
          if Q.flight < 0.85 then
            return P(wO, N, E, r), false
          end
        end
      end
      B()
      Q.retry = 0.18
      return nil
    end
    jO = Q.pending > 0
    if jO then
      Q.pending = Q.pending - 1
      if iO then
        if E.Magnitude >= 0.2 then
          if Q.pending > 0 then
            return T, false
          end
        end
      end
      Q.pending = 0
    end
    local d = uO or jO
    Q.retry = g(0, Q.retry - F.step)
    if iO then
      if E.Magnitude < 0.2 then
        if jO then
          return T, true
        end
        return nil
      end
    end
    if not (d) then
      if Q.retry > 0 then
        return nil
      elseif iO then
        if GO.Magnitude < 2 then
          return nil
        end
      end
    end
    wO = C(F, N, GO, E, iO)
    Q.retry = (wO and 0.12) or 0.045
    if wO then
      N = n(F, wO, T, E, r, yO, fO, iO)
      if N then
        Q.edge = wO
        Q.flight = 0
        return N, iO
      end
      if uO then
        if jO then
        elseif iO then
          d = s(F, wO, T, E, r, yO, fO)
          if d then
            Q.pending = d
            return T, false
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if jO then
      return T, true
    end
    if uO then
      Q.retry = 0
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function d(F)
    O.char = F
    O.bug_pending = false
    O.hz = nil
    O.config = nil
    O.strafe_yaw = nil
    O.strafe_side = 1
    O.strafe_head = nil
    O.strafe_wing = nil
    O.strafe_speed = 0
    O.strafe_cos = 0
    B()
    Q.retry = 0
    Q.flight = 0
    Q.jump = false
  end
  local function F(E, N, g)
    local T = (N and N.State) or (E and E.MovementState)
    if type(T) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    local L = E and E.Character
    if O.char ~= L then
      d(L)
    end
    local P, n, S, e, C, s, r, yO, fO = tonumber(g.Buttons) or 0, ((typeof(g.Move) == "Vector2") and g.Move) or Vector2.zero, (tonumber(g.LookYaw) or tonumber(T.LookYaw)) or 0, (tonumber(g.VerticalLook) or tonumber(T.VerticalLook)) or 0, (((typeof(T.Velocity) == "Vector3") and T.Velocity) or (E and E.GlobalVelocity)) or Vector3.zero, T.OnGround == true, (T.MovementMode == nil) or (T.MovementMode == "Walking")
    L = false
    if not (J.jump_bug) then
      O.bug_pending = false
    end
    if r then
      if J.strafe then
        if s then
          O.strafe_yaw = nil
        end
      else
        O.strafe_yaw = nil
      end
    else
      O.strafe_yaw = nil
    end
    local GO = W(P, D) ~= 0
    local iO = GO and not Q.jump
    Q.jump = GO
    GO = ((J.pixel_surf and r) and (typeof(T.Position) == "Vector3")) and (typeof(T.Velocity) == "Vector3")
    if not GO then
      B()
      Q.retry = 0
    end
    local uO = if (r and J.bhop) and E then if E.JumpInputDown then s else nil else nil
    if O.bug_pending then
      O.bug_pending = false
      if J.jump_bug then
        if r then
          if s then
            local jO, wO, tO = true, false, true
            uO, yO, L = jO, wO, tO
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    E = ((r and ((GO or (J.edge_jump and s)) or (if s then not s else (J.jump_bug or J.edge_bug) or (((J.strafe and J.land_save) and (C.Y < 0)) and p(C))))) and V(N, T)) or nil
    if (E and not L) and GO then
      local p, jO, wO = table.clone(E), rawget(E.runtime, "_state"), rawget(E.runtime, "_support")
      if type(jO) == "table" then
        if typeof(jO.Position) == "Vector3" then
          if typeof(jO.Velocity) == "Vector3" then
            if type(wO) == "table" then
              p.state = jO
              p.support = wO
            end
          end
        end
      end
      jO, wO = p.state, ((J.slow_walk and s) and c(P, Y, true)) or P
      local tO, ZO = v(p, jO, n, S, e, wO, jO.Velocity, jO.OnGround == true, iO)
      if tO then
        uO, fO, L = ZO, tO, true
      else
      end
    else
      if Q.edge or (Q.pending > 0) then
        uO = if Q.pending > 0 then if L then uO else if r then true else uO else uO
        B()
      else
      end
    end
    if (E and not L) and J.edge_jump then
      if s then
        local B, v, v = I(E, n, S, e, c(P, D, false))
        uO = if (B and v.LeftGround) and not v.Jumped then if B.OnGround ~= true then true else uO else uO
      else
      end
    else
    end
    if ((E and not L) and J.edge_bug) and not s then
      if C.Y < -4 then
        iO = if uO ~= nil then (c(P, D, uO)) else P
        iO = if yO ~= nil then (c(iO, m, yO)) else iO
        local B, v = X(E, n, S, e, iO)
        if typeof(B) == "Vector2" then
          local Q, X, p = false, v == true, true
          uO, yO, fO, L = Q, X, B, p
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    if ((E and not L) and J.jump_bug) and not s then
      if C.Y < -4 then
        GO = c(c(P, D, false), m, true)
        local B, v, v = I(E, n, S, e, GO)
        if B then
          if v.Landed then
            O.bug_pending = true
            local B, v, O = false, true, true
            uO, yO, L = B, v, O
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    if (if L then not L else r) and J.strafe then
      if s then
      else
        GO = ((E and E.config) or ((U and (type(N) == "table")) and M(N.Mapping))) or nil
        iO = (GO and R(GO, T, P, (E and E.step) or A(((type(N) == "table") and tonumber(N.StepSeconds)) or 0.015625, 0.001, 0.05))) or nil
        local B = k(n, S, C, N and N.ServerTick, iO)
        if iO and E then
          if J.land_save then
            local v = if uO ~= nil then (c(P, D, uO)) else P
            local O = K(E, iO, B, S, e, if yO ~= nil then (c(v, m, yO)) else v)
            fO = if O then (z(O, S)) else B
          else
            fO = B
          end
        else
          fO = B
        end
      end
    else
    end
    if typeof(fO) == "Vector2" then
      g.Move = fO
    end
    P = if uO ~= nil then (c(P, D, uO)) else P
    P = if yO ~= nil then (c(P, m, yO)) else P
    g.Buttons = if J.slow_walk and r then if s then c(P, Y, true) else P else P
    return yO
  end
  local function B(v, m, Y)
    if typeof(v.Move) ~= "Vector2" then
      return
    end
    local O = m - Y
    if _(O) <= 1e-06 then
      return
    end
    local _, m, Y = b(O), x(O), v.Move
    v.Move = Vector2.new((Y.X * _) - (Y.Y * m), (Y.X * m) + (Y.Y * _))
  end
  local function _(b)
    if b > 0.1 then
      return 1
    elseif b < -0.1 then
      return -1
    end
    return 0
  end
  local function b(x)
    if typeof(x) ~= "Vector3" then
      return 0
    end
    return Vector3.new(x.X, 0, x.Z).Magnitude
  end
  local function x(v)
    local m = v.CameraPart
    if typeof(m) == "Instance" then
      if m:IsA("BasePart") then
        if m.Parent then
          return m.Position
        end
      end
    end
    m = v.HumanoidRootPart
    if typeof(m) == "Instance" then
      if m:IsA("BasePart") then
        if m.Parent then
          return m.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function v(m, Y, O, Q, E)
    local N = Y.Velocity
    if typeof(N) ~= "Vector3" then
      return Vector2.zero
    elseif Y.OnGround ~= true then
      return Vector2.zero
    end
    local U = Vector3.new(N.X, 0, N.Z)
    N = U.Magnitude
    if N < 0.05 then
      return Vector2.zero
    end
    local g, X = o(-U / N, O), V(m, Y)
    if X then
      Y, U = I(X, Vector2.zero, O, Q, E), I(X, g, O, Q, E)
      if Y then
        if U then
          if b(U.Velocity) < b(Y.Velocity) then
            return g
          end
          return Vector2.zero
        end
      end
    end
    if N > 2.5 then
      return g
    end
    return Vector2.zero
  end
  local function m(Y, O, Q, I, E, V)
    local N = os.clock()
    if I.Magnitude > 0.1 then
      t.input_at = N
    elseif E then
      t.input_at = N
    end
    if Y then
      if t.broke then
        return
      elseif not (t.active(N)) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local U, g = _(I.X), _(I.Y)
    if t.fresh then
      t.fresh = false
      t.bx = U
      t.by = g
      t.bj = E
    elseif ((U ~= 0) and (U ~= t.bx)) or ((g ~= 0) and (g ~= t.by)) then
      t.broke = true
      return
    elseif E then
      if not (t.bj) then
        t.broke = true
        return
      end
    end
    if U ~= t.bx then
      t.bx = 0
    end
    if g ~= t.by then
      t.by = 0
    end
    if not (E) then
      t.bj = false
    end
    I = (O and O.State) or Y.MovementState
    if type(I) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    U, N = (tonumber(Q.LookYaw) or tonumber(I.LookYaw)) or 0, tonumber(Q.VerticalLook) or 0
    if V then
      t.samples = 0
    else
      g, E = x(Y), t.target
      if g then
        if typeof(E) == "Vector3" then
          local _ = E - g
          local x = _.Magnitude
          if x > 0.05 then
            local Y = _ / x
            local _, x = H(-Y.X, -Y.Z), A(Y.Y, -0.98, 0.98)
            Q.LookYaw = _
            Q.VerticalLook = x
            t.samples = t.samples + 1
            U, N = _, x
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    V = c(tonumber(Q.Buttons) or 0, D, false)
    Q.Buttons = V
    Q.Move = v(O, I, U, N, V)
    t.ground = I.OnGround == true
    if t.ground then
      if b(I.Velocity) <= 0.25 then
        t.still = t.still + 1
      else
        t.still = 0
      end
    else
      t.still = 0
    end
  end
  h, G = {cfg = J, runtime = function()
    return a(nil)
  end}, u.character
  if type(G) == "table" then
    if type(G.SampleInput) == "function" then
      u = i.field(G, "SampleInput", function(A)
        return function(_, b)
          local x = A(_, b)
          if type(x) ~= "table" then
            return x
          end
          local A, v, H = ((typeof(x.Move) == "Vector2") and x.Move) or Vector2.zero, (_ ~= nil) and (_.JumpInputDown == true), F(_, b, x)
          j.apply(_, x)
          if H ~= nil then
            local j = tonumber(x.Buttons) or 0
            if H then
              x.Buttons = l(j, 2)
            else
              x.Buttons = W(j, q(2))
            end
          end
          H = false
          if w.cmd_samples > 0 then
            if os.clock() <= w.expires then
              local j = tonumber(x.LookYaw) or w.yaw
              x.LookYaw = w.yaw
              x.VerticalLook = w.pitch
              B(x, w.yaw, j)
              w.cmd_samples = w.cmd_samples - 1
              if w.cmd_samples <= 0 then
                w.expires = 0
              end
              H = true
            else
              w.cmd_samples = 0
              w.expires = 0
            end
          else
          end
          m(_, b, x, A, v, H)
          return x
        end
      end)
      t.hooked = G.SampleInput ~= u
      d(nil)
      i.connect(Z.CharacterAdded, function(G)
        w.clear()
        t.release()
        d(G)
      end)
    end
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    w.clear()
    t.hooked = false
    t.release()
    d(nil)
  end)
  return h
end

-- Module ag
modules.ag = function()
  local G, i, u, j, w = modules.load("b"), modules.load("q"), modules.load("f"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j")
  local t = i.misc
  local i = G.lp
  local Z = G.hook
  local h = u.trim
  local u = w.flash_fx
  local A = w.smoke_fx
  local B = w.tracer_fx
  local d = w.camera
  local _, b = tonumber(w.constants and w.constants.DEFAULT_CAMERA_FOV) or 70, {}
  local function x(v)
    if type(u) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    if v then
      if not (b.flash) then
        b.flash = u.Flash
        function u.Flash()
          return false
        end
      end
    elseif b.flash then
      u.Flash = b.flash
      b.flash = nil
    end
  end
  local u
  local v = ((type(A) == "table") and rawget(A, "Create")) or nil
  if type(v) == "function" then
    u = j.detour(v, G.newc(function(...)
      if t.smoke then
        return nil
      end
      return u(...)
    end))
  else
  end
  local function H(l)
    if b.smoke == l then
      return
    elseif type(A) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    b.smoke = l
    if not (u) then
      if v then
        A.Create = (l and (function()
        end)) or v
      end
    end
    if l then
      if type(A.DestroyAll) == "function" then
        pcall(A.DestroyAll)
      end
    end
  end
  local function u(A)
    if type(B) ~= "function" then
      return
    elseif type(Z) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    if A then
      if not (b.tracer) then
        b.tracer = Z(B, function()
        end)
      end
    elseif b.tracer then
      pcall(Z, B, b.tracer)
      b.tracer = nil
    end
  end
  local function Z(A)
    if type(d) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif type(d.updateCameraFOV) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    if A then
      if not (b.fov) then
        local A = d.updateCameraFOV
        b.fov = A
        function d.updateCameraFOV()
          return A(_)
        end
      end
    elseif b.fov then
      d.updateCameraFOV = b.fov
      b.fov = nil
    end
  end
  local A = G.weak()
  local function G(B)
    local d, _ = A[B]
    if d then
      _ = d
    else
      _ = {parts = {}, guis = {}, dirty = true}
      A[B] = _
      local function d()
        _.dirty = true
      end
      _.added = B.DescendantAdded:Connect(d)
      _.gone = B.DescendantRemoving:Connect(d)
    end
    if _.dirty then
      _.dirty = false
      local d, b, v, l, W = _.parts, _.guis, B:GetDescendants(), 0, 0
      for B = 1, #v, 1 do
        local q = v[B]
        if q:IsA("MeshPart") then
          l += 1
          d[l] = q
        else
          if q:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
            W += 1
            b[W] = q
          else
          end
        end
      end
      h(d, l)
      h(b, W)
    end
    return _
  end
  local function B(d)
    if d then
      if typeof(d) ~= "Instance" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local _ = G(d)
    local G, b = _.parts, _.guis
    for _ = 1, #G, 1 do
      d = G[_]
      if d.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
        d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
      end
    end
    for d = 1, #b, 1 do
      G = b[d]
      if G.Enabled then
        G.Enabled = false
      end
    end
  end
  local G
  local d, _, b, v = {}, {}, {}, true
  local function l()
    if G then
      if G.Parent then
        local W = G
        return W
      end
    end
    G = nil
    local W = i:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not (W) then
      return nil
    end
    local i = W:FindFirstChild("MainGui")
    i = i and (i:FindFirstChild("Gameplay"))
    i = i and (i:FindFirstChild("Middle"))
    return i and (i:FindFirstChild("SniperScope"))
  end
  local function i()
    for W = #d, 1, -1 do
      d[W]:Disconnect()
      d[W] = nil
    end
    h(_, 0)
    h(b, 0)
    G, v = nil, true
  end
  local W
  local function q(J)
    if G == J then
      return
    end
    i()
    G = J
    if not J then
      return
    end
    d[1] = J.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
      v = true
      if t.scope then
        W(J)
      end
    end)
    d[2] = J.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
      v = true
    end)
    if J:IsA("GuiObject") then
      d[3] = J:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
        if t.scope then
          if J.Visible then
            J.Visible = false
          end
        end
      end)
    elseif J:IsA("LayerCollector") then
      d[3] = J:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if t.scope then
          if J.Enabled then
            J.Enabled = false
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    v = true
  end
  local function d(J)
    J.Visible = false
  end
  local function J(D)
    D.Enabled = false
  end
  local function D(m)
    m.ImageTransparency = 1
  end
  W = function(m)
    if not (m) then
      return
    end
    if m:IsA("GuiObject") then
      pcall(d, m)
    elseif m:IsA("LayerCollector") then
      pcall(J, m)
    end
    if v then
      v = false
      local v, Y = m:GetDescendants(), 0
      for m = 1, #v, 1 do
        local O = v[m]
        if O:IsA("UIStroke") then
          Y += 1
          _[Y] = O
          b[Y] = 1
        else
          if O:IsA("GuiObject") then
            Y += 1
            _[Y] = O
            b[Y] = ((O:IsA("ImageLabel") or O:IsA("ImageButton")) and 2) or 0
          else
          end
        end
      end
      h(_, Y)
      h(b, Y)
    end
    for h = 1, #_, 1 do
      local v, m = _[h], b[h]
      if m == 1 then
        if v.Enabled then
          pcall(J, v)
        end
      else
        if v.Visible then
          pcall(d, v)
        end
        if m == 2 then
          if v.ImageTransparency ~= 1 then
            pcall(D, v)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local h = {removals = function(d)
    t.scope = d.scope == true
    t.flash = d.flash == true
    t.smoke = d.smoke == true
    t.hands = d.hands == true
    t.bullets = d.bullets == true
    x(t.flash)
    H(t.smoke)
    u(t.bullets)
    Z(t.scope)
  end}
  local function d()
    for _, b in A, nil, nil do
      _ = b.parts
      for v = 1, #_, 1 do
        local J = _[v]
        if J.Parent then
          if J.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1 then
            J.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
          end
        end
      end
      b.added:Disconnect()
      b.gone:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(A)
  end
  h.sync = function()
    if not (t.scope) then
      if G then
        i()
      end
      if next(A) then
        d()
      end
      return
    end
    local G = l()
    q(G)
    W(G)
    G = w.inventory
    if not G then
      return
    end
    local w = G.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement()
    if w then
      if w.IsDestroyed then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    G = w.Viewmodel
    w = G and G.Bobble
    if not w then
      return
    end
    B(w.Scope)
    B(w.ScopeReticlePart)
  end
  h.unload = function()
    x(false)
    H(false)
    u(false)
    Z(false)
    t.scope = false
    t.hands = false
    i()
    d()
  end
  j.teardown(h.unload)
  return h
end

-- Module ah
modules.ah = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u, j = modules.load("q"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j")
  local w = i.misc
  local i = G.lp
  local t = j.char_resolver
  local j = Instance.new("Animation")
  j.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://101513162753523"
  u.own(j)
  local Z, h, A
  local B, d = 0, {}
  local function _()
    if A then
      pcall(A.Stop, A, 0.1)
      pcall(A.Destroy, A)
    end
    Z, h, A, B = nil, nil, nil, 0
  end
  d.set = function(b)
    w.blind = b == true
    if not (w.blind) then
      _()
    end
  end
  d.step = function()
    if not (w.blind) then
      if A then
        _()
      end
      return
    end
    local w = (t and t.getLocalCharacter()) or i.Character
    if w then
      local i = G.workspace
      if w:IsDescendantOf(i) then
        if w:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
          _()
          return
        end
      else
        _()
        return
      end
    else
      _()
      return
    end
    local G = w:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if G then
      if G.Health <= 0 then
        _()
        return
      end
    end
    G = w:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
    if not G then
      _()
      return
    end
    if Z ~= w then
      _()
      Z, h = w, G
    elseif h ~= G then
      _()
      Z, h = w, G
    end
    if not (A) then
      w = os.clock()
      if w < B then
        return
      end
      B = w + 1
      local i, t = pcall(G.LoadAnimation, G, j)
      if i then
        if not (t) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      A = t
      A.Looped = true
      t = A
      t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
    end
    if not (A.IsPlaying) then
      A:Play(0.1, 1, 0)
    end
    G = A.Length
    if G > 0 then
      w = G * 0.5
      if math.abs(A.TimePosition - w) > 0.001 then
        A.TimePosition = w
      end
    end
    if A.Speed ~= 0 then
      A:AdjustSpeed(0)
    end
  end
  u.teardown(_)
  return d
end

-- Module ai
modules.ai = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u = G.module(G.storage, "Components", "Common", "WeaponTimings"), {}
  u.last = G.weak()
  u.global_last = 0
  u.min_interval = function(G)
    local j = 0.05
    if type(G) ~= "table" then
      return j
    end
    if type(i) == "table" then
      if type(i.MinShotInterval) == "function" then
        local w, t = pcall(i.MinShotInterval, G)
        j = if w then if type(t) == "number" then if t > 0 then if t < math.huge then if t > j then t else j else j else j else j else j
      else
      end
    else
    end
    local w = tonumber(G.FireRate)
    j = if w then if w > 0 then if w > j then w else j else j else j
    w = G.FireModes
    if type(w) == "table" then
      G = w.Primary
      if type(G) == "table" then
        local t = tonumber(G.FireRate)
        j = if t then if t > 0 then if t < j then t else j else j else j
      else
      end
      local G = w.Secondary
      if type(G) == "table" then
        local w = tonumber(G.FireRate)
        j = if w then if w > 0 then if w < j then w else j else j else j
      else
      end
    else
    end
    return if j < 0.05 then 0.05 else j
  end
  u.server = function(G)
    local j
    if type(G) == "table" then
      if type(i) == "table" then
        if type(i.MinShotInterval) == "function" then
          local w, t = pcall(i.MinShotInterval, G)
          j = if w then if type(t) == "number" then if t > 0 then if t < math.huge then t else j else j else j else j
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    j = j or (if type(G) == "table" then tonumber(G.FireRate) else j)
    return math.max(0.05, j or 0.1)
  end
  u.wait = function(G, i, j, w)
    j = j or os.clock()
    local t = if i == nil then if G then G.Properties else i else i
    w = math.max(0.05, w or u.min_interval(t))
    i = u.global_last
    if G then
      local t = u.last[G]
      i = if t then if t > i then t else i else i
    else
    end
    G = (i + w) - j
    if G > 0 then
      return G
    end
    return 0
  end
  u.ready = function(G, i, j, w)
    return u.wait(G, i, j, w) <= 0
  end
  u.mark = function(G, i)
    i = i or os.clock()
    if G then
      u.last[G] = i
    end
    u.global_last = i
  end
  u.clear = function(G)
    if G then
      u.last[G] = nil
    end
  end
  return u
end

-- Module aj
modules.aj = function()
  local G, i, u, j = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("ae")
  local w = modules.load("ai")
  local t = G.workspace
  local Z = G.input
  local h = G.plain
  local A = math.clamp
  local B = table.pack
  local d = table.unpack
  local _, b, x = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, false, false
  local v = u.platform
  if type(v) == "function" then
    local H, l = pcall(v)
    G.reclaim()
    b = ((H and (type(l) == "table")) and (table.find(l, "Mobile") ~= nil)) and (#l <= 1)
  else
  end
  v = u.mobile_shoot
  if b then
    if type(v) == "table" then
      if type(rawget(v, "SetManualFireHeld")) == "function" then
        i.field(v, "SetManualFireHeld", function(u)
          local function v(H, ...)
            x = H == true
            return u(H, ...)
          end
          return v
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  local u, v = b, {alive = true, generation = 0}
  v.forcing = G.weak()
  v.intent = G.weak()
  v.manual = G.weak()
  v.last_target = G.weak()
  v.pending = G.weak()
  v.last_shot = 0
  v.last_scan = 0
  v.props = nil
  v.origin = nil
  v.target = nil
  v.held = function()
    if u then
      local G = x
      return G
    end
    return Z:IsMouseButtonPressed(_)
  end
  v.open_gate = function(G)
    local u = rawget(G, "ShootDelayThread")
    if u then
      pcall(task.cancel, u)
    end
    G.ShootDelayThread = nil
    G.IsShooting = false
    G.NextShotDue = nil
  end
  v.can_force = function(G, u)
    if G then
      if G.IsDestroyed then
        return false
      elseif not (G.IsEquipped) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    if G.IsReloading then
      return false
    elseif G.IsAdjustingSuppressor then
      return false
    end
    if type(G.Rounds) ~= "number" then
      return false
    elseif G.Rounds <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    local Z = G.Properties
    if Z then
      if Z.Class ~= "Weapon" then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    if u == "rapid" then
      if G.IsChargeFiring then
        return false
      elseif G.IsBurstShooting then
        return false
      end
      if Z.ShootingOptions == "Revolver" then
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  v.has_pending = function(G)
    for u, u in v.pending, nil, nil do
      if u == G then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  v.bind = function(G, u, Z)
    v.props = G
    v.origin = u
    v.target = Z
  end
  v.unbind = function()
    v.props = nil
    v.origin = nil
    v.target = nil
  end
  v.cancel = function()
    v.generation = v.generation + 1
    for G in v.pending, nil, nil do
      pcall(task.cancel, G)
      v.pending[G] = nil
    end
    for G, u in v.manual, nil, nil do
      v.manual[G] = nil
      if type(u) == "table" then
        if u.thread then
          pcall(task.cancel, u.thread)
          u.thread = nil
        end
      end
    end
    for G in v.last_target, nil, nil do
      v.last_target[G] = nil
    end
    for G in v.intent, nil, nil do
      v.intent[G] = nil
    end
    v.unbind()
  end
  v.toward = function(G, u, Z, ...)
    local _ = t.CurrentCamera
    if _ then
      if G then
        if typeof(u) ~= "Vector3" then
          return false
        elseif typeof(Z) ~= "Vector3" then
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    if (Z - u).Magnitude <= 0.0001 then
      return false
    end
    if not (w.ready(G)) then
      return false
    end
    local t, b = _.CFrame, CFrame.lookAt(u, Z)
    u, Z = b:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    j.weapon = G
    j.cframe = b
    j.yaw = Z
    j.pitch = A(b.LookVector.Y, -1, 1)
    j.expires = os.clock() + 0.12
    j.cmd_samples = 4
    v.last_target[G] = nil
    v.forcing[G] = (v.forcing[G] or 0) + 1
    _.CFrame = b
    Z = B(h(G.shoot, G, ...))
    _.CFrame = t
    v.last_target[G] = nil
    t = (v.forcing[G] or 1) - 1
    v.forcing[G] = ((t > 0) and t) or nil
    j.weapon = nil
    j.cframe = nil
    if Z[1] then
      w.mark(G)
    else
      j.expires = 0
      j.cmd_samples = 0
    end
    return d(Z, 1, Z.n)
  end
  v.force = function(G, u, t)
    if not (v.can_force(G, t)) then
      return false
    end
    if not (w.ready(G, nil, nil, ((t == "rapid") and v.rapid_gap) or nil)) then
      return false
    end
    v.open_gate(G)
    v.last_target[G] = nil
    v.forcing[G] = (v.forcing[G] or 0) + 1
    local Z, A, B = tonumber(G.ShotSeq), tonumber(G.Rounds), h(G.shoot, G, d(u, 1, u.n))
    if t == "rapid" then
      v.open_gate(G)
    end
    t = (v.forcing[G] or 1) - 1
    v.forcing[G] = ((t > 0) and t) or nil
    v.last_target[G] = nil
    t, u = tonumber(G.ShotSeq), tonumber(G.Rounds)
    local h = (Z and t) and (t > Z)
    h = h or (if A then if u then u < A else h else h)
    if B then
      if h then
        w.mark(G)
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    v.alive = false
    v.cancel()
    j.clear()
  end)
  return v
end

-- Module ak

  local m = t.buy_area

  N.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

  local M, T = ((type(O) == "table") and rawget(O, "StartDefuse")) or nil

          i += 1
          T = u
        else
        end

      if i ~= 1 then
        T = nil
      else
      end
    else
    end
  else
  end
  local i, u = {pending = {}, tried = {}, last = 0, wait_until = 0, was_open = false, was_inside = false, team = "", generation = -1, game_state = ""}, 0

        return nil
      end

    if L then
      if k then
        if k.IsDestroyed then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    return k
  end
  local function L()
    local k = d.Character
    if k then
      if not (k:IsDescendantOf(_)) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    if k:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= false then
      return nil
    end
    local P = k:GetAttribute("Health")
    if typeof(P) ~= "number" then
      return nil
    elseif P <= 0 then
      return nil
    end
    return k
  end
  local function k(P)
    local z = P.Character
    if z then
      if not (z:IsDescendantOf(_)) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    if z:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= false then
      return nil
    end
    P = z:GetAttribute("Health")
    if typeof(P) ~= "number" then
      return nil
    elseif P <= 0 then
      return nil
    end
    return z
  end
  local function P(z)
    if z == d then
      return false
    end
    if _:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Deathmatch" then
      return true
    end
    local n, K = d:GetAttribute("Team"), z:GetAttribute("Team")
    if n then
      if not (K) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    if n ~= "Counter-Terrorists" then
      if n ~= "Terrorists" then
        return false
      end
    end
    if K ~= "Counter-Terrorists" then
      if K ~= "Terrorists" then
        return false
      end
    end

  end
  local function z(n, K, S)
