    if n then
      e = 1
      U[e] = n
    else
    end
    if K then
      e += 1
      U[e] = K
    else
    end
    K = _:FindFirstChild("Debris")
    if K then
      e += 1
      U[e] = K
    else
    end
    n, K = w.all()
    for C = 1, K, 1 do
      local K = n[C].Character
      if K then
        if K ~= S then
          C = e + 1
          U[C] = K
          e = C
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return x(U, e)
  end
  local n = {plant = function()
    local K = O()
    local S = K and K.Properties
    if S then
      if S.Class ~= "C4" then
        return
      elseif type(K.shoot) ~= "function" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    S = L()
    if S then
      if K.IsPlanting then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if (tick() - (K.PlantStartedTick or 0)) < 0.55 then
      return
    end
    local e = S.PrimaryPart
    if not (e) then
      return
    end
    if q then
      if type(q.isOnGround) == "function" then
        if not (q.isOnGround(S)) then
          return
        end
      end
    end
    V.FilterDescendantsInstances = z(S, _.CurrentCamera)
    S = _:Raycast(e.Position, g, V)
    if S then
      if not (S.Instance) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if S.Instance:HasTag("PlantArea") then
      if S.Instance:GetAttribute("Site") == nil then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    G.plain(K.shoot, K)
  end}
  local function q()
    local V = b:GetTagged("Bomb")
    for b = 1, #V, 1 do
      local g = V[b]
      if g:IsDescendantOf(_) then
        if g:GetAttribute("Defused") ~= true then
          if g:GetAttribute("Exploded") ~= true then
            if g:GetAttribute("Exploding") ~= true then
              if g:GetAttribute("BombPlanted") ~= nil then
                return g
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function b()
    local V, g = w.all()
    for K = 1, g, 1 do
      local g = V[K]
      if g ~= d then
        if g:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb") == true then
          return g
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function V()
    local g = c.session
    if T then
      local K, S = pcall(v, M)
      local v = ((K and (type(S) == "table")) and S[T]) or nil
      g = if type(v) == "number" then if v > g then v else g else g
    else
    end
    return t(g)
  end
  local function t()
    local v = (V() % 4294967295) + 1
    c.session = v
    if T then
      if type(H) == "function" then
        pcall(H, M, T, v)
      end
    end
    return v
  end
  local function v()
    local H = tonumber(d:GetAttribute("Ping"))
    if not (H) then
      return 0.15
    end
    return Q(H / 1000, 0, 1)
  end
  n.stop_defuse = function(H)
    local g = c.phase
    if g == X then
      if not (A.on) then
        return
      end
    end
    c.phase = X
    c.bomb = nil
    c.final = 0
    A.release()
    if g ~= R then
      if g ~= p then
        return
      end
    end
    if d:GetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb") ~= nil then
      d:SetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb", nil)
    end
    g = ((H and J) and J.C4) and J.C4.CancelDefuse
    if g then
      pcall(g.Send, {SessionId = c.session})
    end
  end
  local function H(g, M)
    c.fails = c.fails + 1
    c.spot = M
    c.retry = g + (((c.fails >= 2) and 1.5) or 0.6)
  end
  local function g(M)
    local T = t()
    c.phase = R
    c.sent = M
    c.sent_at = _:GetServerTimeNow()
    c.acked = 0
    c.final = 0
    c.total = ((d:GetAttribute("HasDefuseKit") == true) and 5) or 10
    d:SetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb", true)
    if not (pcall(J.C4.StartDefuse.Send, {SessionId = T})) then
      n.stop_defuse(false)
      c.retry = M + 0.5
    end
  end
  local function t(M, T)
    c.session = V()
    c.phase = p
    c.bomb = T
    c.since = M
    c.sent = M
    c.sent_at = _:GetServerTimeNow() - 12
    c.acked = M
    c.final = 0
    c.orphan = 0
    c.total = ((d:GetAttribute("HasDefuseKit") == true) and 5) or 10
    d:SetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb", true)
  end
  n.defuse = function()
    local V, M, T = l(), J and J.C4, L()
    local l, J = T and T.PrimaryPart, q()
    T = J and J.PrimaryPart
    if ((if M then not l else not M) or not T) or (d:GetAttribute("Team") ~= "Counter-Terrorists") then
      n.stop_defuse(T ~= nil)
      c.out = false
      c.fails = 0
      c.spot = nil
      return
    end
    local q = l.Position
    local l, K = (q - T.Position).Magnitude, d:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb") == true
    if A.broke then
      n.stop_defuse(true)
      c.out = true
      return
    end
    if c.phase ~= X then
      if c.bomb ~= J then
        n.stop_defuse(true)
        return
      end
    end
    if c.spot then
      if (q - c.spot).Magnitude > 0.75 then
        c.fails = 0
        c.spot = nil
      end
    end
    local S, e = b(), d:GetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb") == true
    if c.phase <= o then
      if K then
        if e then
          c.orphan = 0
        elseif S then
          c.orphan = 0
        elseif c.out then
          c.orphan = 0
        elseif l <= 10 then
          if c.orphan == 0 then
            c.orphan = V
          elseif (V - c.orphan) > 1 then
            A.release()
            t(V, J)
          end
        else
          c.orphan = 0
        end
      else
        c.orphan = 0
      end
    else
      c.orphan = 0
    end
    if c.phase <= o then
      if ((K or S) or e) or (J:GetAttribute("IsGettingDefused") == true) then
        n.stop_defuse(false)
        c.retry = E(c.retry, V + 0.5)
        return
      end
    elseif S then
      if not (K) then
        n.stop_defuse(true)
        c.retry = V + 0.5
        return
      end
    end
    if c.out then
      if l <= 5.5 then
        if (V - A.input_at) < 0.5 then
          return
        end
      end
      c.out = false
    end
    if c.phase == X then
      if l > 5 then
        return
      elseif V < c.retry then
        return
      elseif c.fails >= 3 then
        return
      end
      c.phase = o
      c.since = V
      c.bomb = J
      A.engage(T.Position)
      if not (A.hooked) then
        g(V)
      end
      return
    end
    A.engage(T.Position)
    if c.phase == o then
      T = (A.still >= 6) or (A.ground and ((V - c.since) > 0.75))
      if (l > 5.25) or (T and (l > 5)) then
        n.stop_defuse(false)
        return
      end
      if (V - c.since) > 2 then
        n.stop_defuse(false)
        H(V, q)
        return
      end
      if T then
        if A.samples >= 10 then
          g(V)
        end
      end
      return
    end
    if c.phase == R then
      if not (K) then
        if (V - c.sent) > (1 + (v() * 2)) then
          n.stop_defuse(true)
          H(V, q)
        end
        return
      end
      c.phase = p
      c.acked = V
      c.final = 0
    end
    if not (K) then
      n.stop_defuse(false)
      H(V, q)
      return
    end
    J, S, e = V - c.acked, d:GetAttribute("DefuseStartTime"), _:GetServerTimeNow()
    if ((if typeof(S) == "number" then if S >= (c.sent_at - 1) then if S <= e then e - S else J else J else J) >= (c.total + 0.05)) and ((c.final == 0) or ((V - c.final) >= 0.5)) then
      c.final = V
      pcall(M.Defused.Send)
    end
  end
  local function t(A, b)
    if A then
      if not (b) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local v, H = A.PrimaryPart or A:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), b.PrimaryPart or b:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if v then
      if not (H) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    return F(I(Q(H.CFrame.LookVector:Dot((v.Position - H.Position).Unit), -1, 1))) > 100
  end
  local function A(b, v, H, l)
    local q
    if type(Y) == "function" then
      local J, F = pcall(Y)
      q = if J then if type(F) == "table" then F else q else q
    else
    end
    N.FilterDescendantsInstances = q or z(b, _.CurrentCamera)
    local q, J = w.all()
    local Y, F, I
    for E = 1, J, 1 do
      b = q[E]
      if P(b) then
        E = k(b)
        if E then
          local b = (E:FindFirstChild("Head") or E:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or E.PrimaryPart
          if b then
            local q = b.Position - v
            local J = q.Magnitude
            if ((J > 0.05) and (J <= l)) and (if Y then J < Y else not Y) then
              local l = q.Unit * H
              local H = _:Raycast(v, l, N) or (_:Spherecast(v, 1.5, l, N))
              if H then
                if H.Instance then
                  if H.Instance:IsDescendantOf(E) then
                    Y, F, I = J, E, b
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return F, I
  end
  n.knife = function()
    local b = O()
    local v = b and b.Properties
    if v then
      if v.Class ~= "Melee" then
        return
      elseif type(b.shoot) ~= "function" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if b.IsShooting then
      return
    end
    if b.WeaponEquippedTick then
      if (tick() - b.WeaponEquippedTick) <= 1 then

      end
    end

    if H then
      if not (H.PrimaryPart) then

      end
    else

    end
    local l = H:FindFirstChild("Head") or H.PrimaryPart

    end
    local q, J = tonumber(v.Range) or 3, Q(tonumber(B.knife_range) or 3.5, 2, 5)
    local v, Y = A(H, l.Position, q, J)
    if v then
      if not (Y) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    Z.toward(b, l.Position, Y.Position, B.knife_heavy and t(H, v))
  end
  n.zeus = function()
    local t = O()
    if t then
      if t.Properties then
        if t.Name ~= "Zeus x27" then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if t.IsShooting then
      return
    elseif t.IsReloading then
      return
    end
    if typeof(t.Rounds) == "number" then
      if t.Rounds <= 0 then
        return
      end
    end
    local A = L()
    if A then
      if not (A.PrimaryPart) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local b = _.CurrentCamera
    if not (b) then
      return
    end
    local v, H, l, q = Q(B.zeus_range, 5, 13.5), h.origin(b), w.all()
    local w, h
    for J = 1, q, 1 do
      local Y = l[J]
      if P(Y) then
        J = k(Y)
        if J then
          local Y = J:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if Y then
            local Q = (Y.Position - H).Magnitude
            if Q <= v then
              if w then
                if Q < w then
                  w, h = Q, J
                else
                end
              else
                w, h = Q, J
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    if not (h) then
      return
    end
    q = (h:FindFirstChild("Head") or h:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or h.PrimaryPart
    if not q then
      return
    end
    l = q.Position - H
    local w = l.Magnitude
    if w < 0.5 then
      return
    elseif w > v then
      return
    end
    a.FilterDescendantsInstances = z(A, b, h)
    w = _:Raycast(H, l, a)
    if w then
      if w.Instance then
        if not (w.Instance:IsDescendantOf(h)) then
          return
        end
      end
    end
    Z.toward(t, H, q.Position)
  end
  n.reload = function()
    local w = O()
    local t = w and w.Properties
    if t then
      if t.Class ~= "Weapon" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if w.IsReloading then
      return
    elseif w.IsShooting then
      return
    elseif w.IsAdjustingSuppressor then
      return
    end
    if Z.forcing[w] then
      return
    elseif Z.manual[w] then
      return
    elseif Z.has_pending(w) then
      return
    end
    local h, A = tonumber(w.Rounds), tonumber(t.Rounds) or 30
    if h then
      if h >= A then
        return
      elseif h >= B.auto_reload_min then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    A = tick()
    if (A - u) < 0.8 then
      return
    end
    if Z.held() then
      return
    end
    u = A
    G.plain(w.reload, w)
  end
  local G, u = {"Pistols", "Mid Tier", "Rifles", "Grenades"}, {{"AK-47", "M4A1-S", "M4A4"}, {"Galil AR", "FAMAS"}, {"SG 553", "AUG"}, {"MAC-10", "MP9"}, {"Sawed-Off", "MAG-7"}, {"Glock-18", "USP-S", "P2000"}, {"Tec-9", "Five-SeveN"}, {"Molotov", "Incendiary Grenade"}}
  local function w()
    local t = {}
    if W then
      if type(W.GetEquippedInventoryItem) ~= "function" then
        return t
      end
    else
      return t
    end
    for Z = 1, #G, 1 do
      local h = G[Z]
      for G = 1, 8, 1 do
        Z = ("Loadout.%s.Options.%d"):format(h, G)
        local G, h = pcall(W.GetEquippedInventoryItem, d, Z)
        if G then
          if h then
            if type(h.Name) == "string" then
              t[h.Name] = Z
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local G, Z = pcall(W.GetEquippedInventoryItem, d, "Equipped.Equipped Zeus x27")
    if G then
      if Z then
        if Z.Name == "Zeus x27" then
          t[Z.Name] = "Equipped.Equipped Zeus x27"
        end
      end
    end
    return t
  end
  local function G(t, Z)
    if Z[t] then
      return t, Z[t]
    end
    for h = 1, #u, 1 do
      local A = u[h]
      if table.find(A, t) then
        for t = 1, #A, 1 do
          h = A[t]
          if Z[h] then
            return h, Z[h]
          end
        end
        break
      end
    end
    return nil, nil
  end
  local function t(Z, h)
    if h[Z] then
      return true
    end
    for A = 1, #u, 1 do
      local b = u[A]
      if table.find(b, Z) then
        for u = 1, #b, 1 do
          if h[b[u]] then
            return true
          end
        end
        break
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function u()
    local Z, h, A, b, v = {}, false, false, false, false
    if W then
      if type(W.getCurrentInventory) == "function" then
        local H, l = pcall(W.getCurrentInventory)
        if H then
          if type(l) == "table" then
            local H, W, q, J = true, h, b, A
            for Y, Q in l, nil, nil do
              Y = ((type(Q) == "table") and Q._items) or nil
              if type(Y) == "table" then
                local l = Q._settings
                local Q = (type(l) == "table") and (l._strict_type == "Melee")
                W = if Q then true else W
                for l, F in Y, nil, nil do
                  if type(F) == "table" then
                    if F.IsDestroyed ~= true then
                      if type(F.Name) == "string" then
                        Z[F.Name] = (Z[F.Name] or 0) + 1
                        l = true
                        q, J = l, if Q then true else J
                      else
                      end
                    else
                    end
                  else
                  end
                end
              else
              end
            end
            h, A, b, v = W, J, q, H
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
        local H, l = true, true
        b, v = l, H
      end
    else
      local H, l = true, true
      b, v = l, H
    end
    local H = O()
    if H then
      if type(H.Name) == "string" then
        if not (Z[H.Name]) then
          Z[H.Name] = 1
        end
      end
    end
    return Z, v and ((h and A) or (if h then not h else b))
  end
  local function Z(h)
    table.clear(i.pending)
    local A = d:GetAttribute("Team")
    if A ~= "Terrorists" then
      if A ~= "Counter-Terrorists" then
        return
      end
    end
    local b, v, H = w(), {}, 0
    local function w(l)
      if l then
        if l == "" then
          return
        elseif l == "none" then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      local W, q = G(l, b)
      if W then
        if not (q) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      if t(W, h) then
        return
      elseif t(W, i.tried) then
        return
      elseif v[W] then
        return
      end
      v[W] = true
      H += 1
      i.pending[H] = {name = W, path = q, fails = 0}
    end
    w(B.buy_primary)
    w(B.buy_secondary)
    if B.buy_zeus then
      w("Zeus x27")
    end
    A = B.buy_nades
    if type(A) == "table" then
      for G = 1, #A, 1 do
        w(A[G])
      end
    end
  end
  n.autobuy = function()
    if D then
      if type(D.purchase) ~= "function" then
        return
      elseif not (m) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if not (L()) then
      return
    end
    local G = _:GetAttribute("Gamemode")
    if G ~= "Bomb Defusal" then
      if G ~= "Hostage Rescue" then
        return
      end
    end
    G = d:GetAttribute("Team") or ""
    if G ~= "Terrorists" then
      if G ~= "Counter-Terrorists" then
        return
      end
    end
    local w = _:GetAttribute("GameState") or ""
    local h, A, _ = (d:GetAttribute("BuyMenu") == true) or (w == "Buy Period"), pcall(m, d)
    local b, v, H = if A then _ == true else false, tonumber(d:GetAttribute("CharacterGeneration")) or -1, tick()
    if w ~= i.game_state then
      if w == "Buy Period" then
        table.clear(i.tried)
        B.buy_dirty = true
        i.wait_until = 0
      end
      i.game_state = w
    end
    if h then
      if not (i.was_open) then
        B.buy_dirty = true
      end
    end
    if b then
      if not (i.was_inside) then
        B.buy_dirty = true
      end
    end
    if (G ~= i.team) or (v ~= i.generation) then
      table.clear(i.tried)
      B.buy_dirty = true
      i.wait_until = 0
    end
    i.was_open = h
    i.was_inside = b
    i.team = G
    i.generation = v
    if h then
      if not (b) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    G, h = u()
    if h then
      if i.wait_until > 0 then
        i.wait_until = 0
        B.buy_dirty = true
      end
    else
      if i.wait_until <= 0 then
        i.wait_until = H + 2
      end
      if H < i.wait_until then
        B.buy_dirty = true
        return
      end
    end
    if B.buy_dirty then
      B.buy_dirty = false
      Z(G)
    end
    h = i.pending[1]
    while h and (t(h.name, G) or t(h.name, i.tried)) do
      table.remove(i.pending, 1)
      h = i.pending[1]
    end
    if h then
      if (H - i.last) < 0.38 then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    i.last = H
    if pcall(D.purchase, h.name, h.path, false) then
      i.tried[h.name] = true
      table.remove(i.pending, 1)
    else
      h.fails = h.fails + 1
      if h.fails >= 3 then
        table.remove(i.pending, 1)
      end
    end
  end
  n.step = function()
    if B.auto_plant then
      pcall(n.plant)
    end
    if B.auto_defuse then
      pcall(n.defuse)
    else
      n.stop_defuse(true)
    end
    if B.knife then
      pcall(n.knife)
    end
    if B.zeus then
      pcall(n.zeus)
    end
    if B.auto_reload then
      pcall(n.reload)
    end
    if B.auto_buy then
      pcall(n.autobuy)
    end
  end
  j.connect(d.CharacterAdded, function()
    n.stop_defuse(true)
    c.retry = 0
    c.fails = 0
    c.spot = nil
    c.out = false
  end)
  j.teardown(function()
    n.stop_defuse(true)
    table.clear(i.pending)
    table.clear(i.tried)
    x(U, 0)
  end)
  return n
end

-- Module al
modules.al = function()
  local G = modules.load("b")
  local i, u = modules.load("q"), modules.load("f")
  local j = modules.load("a")
  local w = i.notify
  local t = i.world
  local Z = G.workspace
  local h = G.guiservice
  local A = math.clamp
  local B = math.max
  local d, d = math.floor, {}
  lphAppendValues(d, 0, Vector2.new(0.70710678, -0.70710678), Vector2.new(-0.70710678, -0.70710678), Vector2.new(-0.70710678, 0.70710678), Vector2.new(0.70710678, 0.70710678))
  local y, _ = {-45, 45, -45, 45}
  local function b()
    if _ then
      if _.Parent then
        local x = _
        return x
      end
    end
    _ = G.screen(1000)
    if _ then
      j.own(_)
    end
    local x = _
    return x
  end
  local function x(v)
    local H = Instance.new("Frame")
    H.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    H.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    H.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    H.BorderSizePixel = 0
    H.Visible = false
    H.ZIndex = 10
    local l = Instance.new("UICorner")
    l.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    l.Parent = H
    l = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    l.Thickness = 1.25
    l.Color = Color3.new()
    l.Transparency = 0
    l.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    l.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
    l.Parent = H
    H.Parent = v
    return {frame = H, stroke = l}
  end
  local function v()
    local H = b()
    if not (H) then
      return nil
    end
    local l = {}
    for W = 1, 4, 1 do
      l[W] = x(H)
    end
    return l
  end
  local function x(H)
    if not (H) then
      return
    end
    for l = 1, 4, 1 do
      H[l].frame.Visible = false
    end
  end
  local H, l = {}, {}
  local function W()
    local q = table.remove(H)
    if q then
      local J = b()
      if J then
        for D = 1, 4, 1 do
          if q[D].frame.Parent ~= J then
            q[D].frame.Parent = J
          end
        end
      end
      return q
    end
    return v()
  end
  local function v(q)
    if not (q.arms) then
      return
    end
    x(q.arms)
    H[#H + 1] = q.arms
    q.arms = nil
  end
  local q = {Camera = nil}
  q.CFrame = CFrame.new()
  q.ViewportSize = Vector2.zero
  q.FieldOfView = 70
  q.Override = false
  local function J()
    local D = t.view
    if type(D) == "table" then
      if type(D.Resolve) == "function" then
        local m, Y = pcall(D.Resolve)
        if m then
          if type(Y) == "table" then
            if typeof(Y.CFrame) == "CFrame" then
              if typeof(Y.ViewportSize) == "Vector2" then
                return Y
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    D = Z.CurrentCamera
    if not D then
      return nil
    end
    q.Camera = D
    q.CFrame = D.CFrame
    q.ViewportSize = D.ViewportSize
    q.FieldOfView = D.FieldOfView
    return q
  end
  local function Z(q, D)
    local m = t.view
    if type(m) == "table" then
      if type(m.Project) == "function" then
        local t, Y, O, Q = pcall(m.Project, D, q)
        if t then
          return Y, O, Q
        end
      end
    end
    m = q and q.Camera
    if not m then
      return nil, false, -math.huge
    end
    local t, q = m:WorldToViewportPoint(D)
    return Vector2.new(t.X, t.Y), q, t.Z
  end
  local function t(q, D, m)
    if not (m) then
      return false
    end
    for Y = 1, #m, 1 do
      local O = m[Y]
      if typeof(O) == "Instance" then
        if O.Parent then
          if O.Visible then
            local m, Y = O.AbsolutePosition + D, O.AbsoluteSize
            if q.X >= m.X then
              if q.X <= (m.X + Y.X) then
                if q.Y >= m.Y then
                  if q.Y <= (m.Y + Y.Y) then
                    return true
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function q(D, m, Y, O, Q, F, I)
    local E = D.frame
    E.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(m.X, m.Y)
    E.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(O, Q)
    E.Rotation = Y
    E.BackgroundColor3 = F
    E.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - I
    E.Visible = I > 0.001
    D.stroke.Thickness = B(1, Q * 0.22)
    D.stroke.Transparency = 1 - I
  end
  local function D(m, Y, O)
    local Q = b()
    if not (Q) then
      return
    end
    local b = A(tonumber(m.size) or 14, 4, 24)
    local F, I, E, V = b * 0.95, B(2, b * 0.32), B(2, b * 0.22), m.arms
    for B = 1, 4, 1 do
      b = V[B]
      if b.frame.Parent ~= Q then
        b.frame.Parent = Q
      end
      q(b, Y + (d[B] * (E + (F * 0.5))), y[B], F, I, m.col, O)
    end
  end
  i = {emit = function(y, B)
    local d = w.marks[y]
    if d then
      if w.master[y] then
        if not (d.on) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    B = if typeof(B) == "CFrame" then B.Position else B
    if typeof(B) ~= "Vector3" then
      return
    end
    local w = os.clock()
    if y == "kill" then
      for b = #l, 1, -1 do
        local q = l[b]
        if q.channel == "hit" then
          if (w - q.born) <= 2.5 then
            if (q.position - B).Magnitude <= 0.25 then
              v(q)
              u.drop(l, b)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local b = W()
    if not (b) then
      return
    end
    if #l >= 200 then
      local W = table.remove(l, 1)
      if W then
        v(W)
      end
    end
    l[#l + 1] = {arms = b, channel = y, position = B, col = ((typeof(d.col) == "Color3") and d.col) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), size = A(tonumber(d.size) or 14, 4, 24), duration = A(tonumber(d.fade) or 1, 0.1, 5), born = w}
  end, step = function()
    local y = #l
    if y == 0 then
      return
    end
    local w = J()
    if not (w) then
      for B = y, 1, -1 do
        x(l[B].arms)
      end
      return
    end
    local B = G.drawmask()
    local G, d = (B and h:GetGuiInset()) or Vector2.zero, os.clock()
    for h = y, 1, -1 do
      local y = l[h]
      local b = (d - y.born) / y.duration
      if b >= 1 then
        v(y)
        u.drop(l, h)
      else
        local h, d, v = Z(w, y.position)
        if typeof(h) == "Vector2" then
          if d then
            if type(v) == "number" then
              if v > 0.05 then
                if t(h, G, B) then
                  x(y.arms)
                else
                  local G = A(b, 0, 1)
                  D(y, h, 1 - ((G * G) * (3 - (2 * G))))
                end
              else
                x(y.arms)
              end
            else
              x(y.arms)
            end
          else
            x(y.arms)
          end
        else
          x(y.arms)
        end
      end
    end
  end, unload = function()
    for y = #l, 1, -1 do
      x(l[y].arms)
      l[y] = nil
    end
    u.trim(H, 0)
    if _ then
      pcall(_.Destroy, _)
      _ = nil
    end
  end}
  j.teardown(i.unload)
  return i
end

-- Module am
modules.am = function()
  local y = modules.load("b")
  local G = modules.load("a")
  local i = modules.load("h")
  local u = modules.load("q").notify
  local j, w, t, Z, h, A = modules.load("B"), {}, {}, {}, {}
  local function B(d)
    local _ = u.chams[d]
    return ((u.master[d] and _.on) and _) or nil
  end
  local function u(d)
    local _ = d and d.Parent
    return ((((_ ~= nil) and (_.Name ~= "_PVS_CulledCharacters")) and d:IsDescendantOf(y.workspace)) and (d:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true)) and (d:GetAttribute("ClientCharacterPresentationVisible") ~= false)
  end
  local function d(_)
    local b, x = i.all()
    for i = 1, x, 1 do
      local x = b[i]
      i = (x ~= y.lp) and x.Character
      if i then
        if not (u(i)) then
          continue
        end
      else
        continue
      end
      local b = tonumber(x.UserId) or x.UserId
      local v = b and h[b]
      local H = ((v and (v.char == i)) and v.parts) or nil
      local l = b and j.snapshot(i, x:GetAttribute("Team"), H)
      if l then
        if H then
          v.time = _
        else
          h[b] = {char = i, parts = l, time = _}
        end
      end
    end
    for i, b in h, nil, nil do
      if (_ - b.time) > 3 then
        h[i] = nil
      end
    end
  end
  local function i(_, b, x)
    local v = h[_]
    if (if v then (x - v.time) > 3 else not v) or ((b ~= nil) and (b ~= v.char)) then
      return nil
    elseif #v.parts == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    if u(b) then
      if (x - v.time) > 0.25 then
        return nil
      end
    end
    return v
  end
  local function _(b, x)
    if b then
      if x then
        return x * b:Inverse()
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function b(x, v)
    local H = {}
    for l, W in v.parts, nil, nil do
      l = W.part
      if l then
        H[l.Name] = W.frame
      end
    end
    local v, l = x:FindFirstChild("Head"), x:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or x:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    local W, q = v and _(v.CFrame, H.Head), l and _(l.CFrame, H[l.Name])
    if not (q) then
      return false
    end
    l = {}
    for _, v in x:GetDescendants() do
      if v:IsA("BasePart") then
        _ = (v.Parent == x) and H[v.Name]
        if _ then
          l[v] = _
        elseif v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory") then
          if W then
            l[v] = W * v.CFrame
          else
            l[v] = q * v.CFrame
          end
        else
          l[v] = q * v.CFrame
        end
      end
    end
    for _, x in l, nil, nil do
      _.CFrame = x
    end
    return true
  end
  local function _(x)
    for v, v in x:GetChildren() do
      if (v.Name == "WeaponModel") or (v.Name == "WeaponAttachments") then
        v:Destroy()
      elseif v.Name == "CameraPart" then
        v:Destroy()
      elseif v.Name == "GlowShell" then
        v:Destroy()
      elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
        v.Anchored = true
        v.CanCollide = false
        v.CanQuery = false
        v.CanTouch = false
        v.CastShadow = false
        v.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
        if v.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
          v.Transparency = 1
        end
        _(v)
      elseif v:IsA("Humanoid") then
        v.EvaluateStateMachine = false
        v.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
        v.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
        v.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
        v.AutoRotate = false
        _(v)
      elseif v:IsA("Model") then
        _(v)
      elseif v:IsA("Folder") then
        _(v)
      elseif v:IsA("Accessory") then
        _(v)
      elseif v:IsA("Attachment") then
        _(v)
      elseif not (v:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")) then
        if not (v:IsA("Decal")) then
          if not (v:IsA("SpecialMesh")) then
            if not (v:IsA("Clothing")) then
              if not (v:IsA("ShirtGraphic")) then
                if not (v:IsA("CharacterMesh")) then
                  if not (v:IsA("WrapTarget")) then
                    if not (v:IsA("WrapLayer")) then
                      v:Destroy()
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function x(v, H, l, W, q)
    local J = i(v, H, q)
    if not (J) then
      if not (u(H)) then
        return nil
      end
    end
    if W ~= "ghosts" then
      if J then
        v = table.create(#J.parts)
        for i, u in J.parts, nil, nil do
          v[i] = {frame = u.frame, size = u.size}
        end
        return v
      end
      return j.snapshot(H, l)
    end
    if H then
      if not (H.Parent) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    v = H.Archivable
    if not v then
      H.Archivable = true
    end
    q, l = pcall(H.Clone, H)
    if not v then
      H.Archivable = false
    end
    if q then
      if not l then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    _(l)
    if l:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
      if J then
        if not (b(l, J)) then
          l:Destroy()
          return nil
        end
      end
    else
      l:Destroy()
      return nil
    end
    return l
  end
  local function i(u, _, b)
    local v, H = 1 - b, {}
    for l, W in u:GetDescendants() do
      if W:IsA("BasePart") then
        if W.Transparency < 1 then
          l, b = #H + 1, {instance = W}
          b.opacity, H[l] = (1 - W.Transparency) * 0.58, b
          W.Size = W.Size * 1.012
          if v == 1 then
            W.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            W.MaterialVariant = ""
            W.Color = _
          elseif v > 0 then
            W.Color = W.Color:Lerp(_, v)
          end
        end
        if v == 1 then
          if W:IsA("MeshPart") then
            W.TextureID = ""
          end
        end
      elseif W:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
        if v == 1 then
          W.TextureId = ""
          W.VertexColor = Vector3.one
        end
      elseif W:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
        if v == 1 then
          W:Destroy()
        elseif v > 0 then
          W.Color = W.Color:Lerp(_, v)
        end
      elseif (W:IsA("Decal") or W:IsA("Clothing")) or W:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
        if v == 1 then
          W:Destroy()
        else
          if v > 0 then
            W.Color3 = W.Color3:Lerp(_, v)
          end
          if W:IsA("Decal") then
            local _, v = #H + 1, {instance = W}
            v.opacity, H[_] = (1 - W.Transparency) * 0.58, v
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if #H == 0 then
      u:Destroy()
      return nil
    end
    for _, _ in H, nil, nil do
      _.instance.Transparency = 1 - _.opacity
    end
    if not (A) then
      A = G.own(Instance.new("Folder"))
      b = A
      b.Parent = y.workspace
    end
    u.Name = "Ghost"
    u.Parent = A
    return {instance = u, fades = H}
  end
  local function y(u)
    local A = t[u]
    if A then
      t[u] = nil
      if A.mode == "ghosts" then
        A.snapshot:Destroy()
      end
    end
  end
  local function u(A, _, b, v, H)
    if not (b) then
      return
    end
    local l = if v.mode == "ghosts" then i(b, v.col, v.keep / 100) else j.snapshot_box(b, v.col)
    if not (l) then
      return
    end
    for i = #Z, 1, -1 do
      b = Z[i]
      if b.id == _ then
        b.instance:Destroy()
        table.remove(Z, i)
      end
    end
    if #Z >= 12 then
      table.remove(Z, 1).instance:Destroy()
    end
    l.id = _
    l.channel = A
    l.born = H
    l.duration = v.fade
    Z[#Z + 1] = l
  end
  w.impact = function(i, A, _)
    local b = os.clock()
    for v, v in Z, nil, nil do
      if v.id == i then
        if v.channel == "kill" then
          if (b - v.born) < 0.15 then
            return
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local v = B("kill")
    if v then
      local H = x(i, A, _, v.mode, b)
      if H then
        y(i)
        t[i] = {mode = v.mode, snapshot = H, time = b}
      end
    end
    v = B("hit")
    if v then
      u("hit", i, x(i, A, _, v.mode, b), v, b)
    end
  end
  w.kill = function(i, A, _)
    local b, v, H = B("kill"), os.clock(), t[i]
    if ((b and H) and (H.mode == b.mode)) and ((v - H.time) <= 2.5) then
      t[i] = nil
      u("kill", i, H.snapshot, b, v)
    else
      y(i)
      if b then
        u("kill", i, x(i, A, _, b.mode, v), b, v)
      end
    end
  end
  w.step = function()
    local i, u, A = os.clock(), B("hit"), B("kill")
    if u then
      d(i)
    elseif A then
      d(i)
    elseif next(h) then
      table.clear(h)
    end
    if #Z == 0 then
      if next(t) == nil then
        return
      end
    end
    for d, _ in t, nil, nil do
      if A then
        if A.mode ~= _.mode then
          y(d)
        elseif (i - _.time) > 2.5 then
          y(d)
        end
      else
        y(d)
      end
    end
    for d = #Z, 1, -1 do
      A = Z[d]
      u = (i - A.born) / A.duration
      if ((u >= 1) or not B(A.channel)) or (A.instance.Parent == nil) then
        A.instance:Destroy()
        table.remove(Z, d)
      else
        local i = 1 - (u * u)
        if A.fades then
          for u, u in A.fades, nil, nil do
            u.instance.Transparency = 1 - (u.opacity * i)
          end
        else
          j.draw_snapshot(A, i * 0.72)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  G.teardown(function()
    table.clear(h)
    for G in t, nil, nil do
      y(G)
    end
    for y, y in Z, nil, nil do
      y.instance:Destroy()
    end
    table.clear(Z)
  end)
  return w
end

-- Module an
modules.an = function()
  local y, G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("q"), modules.load("a")
  local u = G.notify
  local j = y.workspace
  local w = Color3.fromRGB(133, 220, 255)
  local function t(Z)
    local h = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    h.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -50, 0)
    h.Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 0.999969, 0.999985)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.new(0.333333, 1, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0.333333, 1, 0.498039))})
    h.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
    h.LightEmission = 1
    h.Enabled = false
    h.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
    h.Rate = 0
    h.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.6, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0, 0)})
    h.Speed = NumberRange.new(15, 15)
    h.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(50, -50)
    h.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=18540695516"
    h.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1, 0)})
    h.Parent = Z
    return h
  end
  local function Z()
    local h = Instance.new("Part")
    h.Anchored = true
    h.CanCollide = false
    h.CanQuery = false
    h.CanTouch = false
    h.Massless = true
    h.CastShadow = false
    h.Transparency = 1
    h.Size = Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01)
    h.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
    local A = {part = h, emitter = t(h), col = nil, count = 30}
    h.Parent = j
    i.own(h)
    return A
  end
  local t = {}
  y, G = pcall(Z)
  if y then
    t.hit = G
  end
  G, y = pcall(Z)
  if G then
    t.kill = y
  end
  Z = {emit = function(y, G)
    local h, A = u.fx[y], t[y]
    if h then
      if u.master[y] then
        if h.on then
          if not (A) then
            return
          end
        else
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    y = nil
    if typeof(G) == "CFrame" then
      y = G
    else
      if typeof(G) == "Vector3" then
        y = CFrame.new(G)
      else
        return
      end
    end
    if not (A.part.Parent) then
      A.part.Parent = j
    end
    A.part.CFrame = y
    y = ((typeof(h.col) == "Color3") and h.col) or w
    if A.col ~= y then
      A.col = y
      A.emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(y)
    end
    A.emitter:Emit(A.count)
  end, unload = function()
    for y, G in t, nil, nil do
      t[y] = nil
      if G.part then
        pcall(G.part.Destroy, G.part)
      end
    end
  end}
  i.teardown(Z.unload)
  return Z
end

-- Module ao
modules.ao = function()
  local y = modules.load("b")
  local G, i = modules.load("q"), modules.load("a")
  local u, j = modules.load("Q"), G.notify
  local w = os.clock
  local t = math.min
  local Z = math.max
  local h = math.abs
  local A = math.sqrt
  local B = math.exp
  local d = math.clamp
  local _ = Rect.new(64, 64, 66, 66)
  local b = B(-4)
  local function x(v, H)
    local l, W = Z(((v * 130) * 0.5) - 1, 0), Z(((h((H * 2) - 1) * 130) * 0.5) - 1, 0)
    return (B(-4 * ((1 - d((A((l * l) + (W * W)) - 24) / 40, 0, 1)) ^ 2)) - b) / (1 - b)
  end
  local h
  local A, B, d = i.shared, y.custom_asset, false
  if type(isfile) == "function" then
    local b, v = pcall(isfile, "bs_health_shot.png")
    d = b and (v == true)
  else
  end
  local b
  if (type(A.edge_uri) == "string") and d then
    h = A.edge_uri
    b = h
  else
    if type(writefile) == "function" then
      if type(B) == "function" then
        if buffer then
          G = u.mask(130, 130, x)
          if G then
            if pcall(writefile, "bs_health_shot.png", G) then
              local G, u = pcall(B, "bs_health_shot.png")
              if G then
                if type(u) == "string" then
                  if #u > 0 then
                    A.edge_uri = u
                    h = u
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    b = h
  end
  if b then
    i.spawn(function()
      local G = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
      G.Image = b
      pcall(y.content.PreloadAsync, y.content, {G})
      G:Destroy()
    end)
  end
  local G, u
  local h, A, d = false, 0
  local x = 1
  local v, H, l = -1, 0, 0
  local function W()
    if G then
      if G.Parent then
        return true
      end
    end
    if not (b) then
      return false
    end
    G = y.screen(1000)
    if not (G) then
      return false
    end
    i.own(G)
    u = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    u.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    local y = u
    y.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    u.Image = b
    y = u
    y.ImageColor3 = d or j.fx.hit.col
    u.ImageTransparency = 1
    y = u
    y.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
    u.SliceCenter = _
    u.Parent = G
    v = 1
    return true
  end
  local function y(_)
    if v ~= _ then
      if u then
        v = _
        u.ImageTransparency = _
      end
    end
  end
  local function _(b)
    return (b * b) * (3 - (2 * b))
  end
  local function b(q)
    if q < 0.18 then
      local J, D = H, (1 - H) * _(q / 0.18)
      return J + D
    end
    return 1 - _((q - 0.18) / 0.95)
  end
  B = {emit = function(_)
    local q = j.screen[_]
    if q then
      if j.master[_] then
        if not (q.on) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if not (W()) then
      return
    end
    local W, J = G.AbsoluteSize, u
    J.SliceScale = Z(t(W.X, W.Y), 180) / 180
    _ = ((typeof(q.col) == "Color3") and q.col) or j.fx.hit.col
    if d ~= _ then
      d = _
      u.ImageColor3 = _
    end
    J = (h and l) or 0
    x = Z((tonumber(q.power) or 100) / 100, J)
    H = ((x > 0) and t(J / x, 1)) or 0
    A, h = w(), true
  end, step = function()
    if not (h) then
      return
    end
    local j = w() - A
    if j >= 1.13 then
      h, l = false, 0
      y(1)
      return
    end
    l = b(j) * x
    y(1 - (t(l, 3.3333333333333335) * 0.3))
  end, unload = function()
    h, l, u, d, v = false, 0, nil, nil, -1
    if G then
      pcall(G.Destroy, G)
      G = nil
    end
  end}
  i.teardown(B.unload)
  return B
end

-- Module ap
modules.ap = function()
  local y = bit32.bxor
  local G = bit32.lrotate
  local i = bit32.lshift
  local u = bit32.rshift
  local j = bit32.band
  local w = string.byte
  local t = string.char
  local Z = string.sub
  local h = table.concat
  local A = table.create
  local B, d, _, b = math.floor, {91, 39, 228, 145, 12, 189, 122, 54, 241, 72, 146, 174, 99, 213, 31, 140, 42, 116, 176, 89, 238, 19, 199, 109, 159, 53, 136, 76, 161, 112, 219, 38}, {{2654435769, 2246822507}, {608135816, 3266489909}, {3084996962, 668265263}, {2246822507, 374761393}}
  local function x(v)
    if not (b) then
      b = {}
      for H = 1, 64, 1 do
        local l = b
        l[w("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", H)] = H - 1
      end
    end
    local H, l, W, q, J = {}, #v, 0, 0, 0
    for D = 1, l, 1 do
      local l = w(v, D)
      D = b[l]
      if D then
        W = (W * 64) + D
        q += 6
        if q >= 8 then
          q -= 8
          local b = 2 ^ q
          local v = B(W / b)
          W -= v * b
          J += 1
          H[J] = t(v % 256)
        else
        end
      else
        if l ~= 61 then
          if l ~= 10 then
            if l ~= 13 then
              if l ~= 32 then
                if l ~= 9 then
                  return nil
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return h(H)
  end
  local function B(b, v, H)
    local l = v
    for v = 1, #b, 1 do
      l = (y(G(y(l, b[v]), 7), H))
    end
    return l
  end
  local function b(v)
    local H = #d
    local l = A(H + #v)
    for A = 1, H, 1 do
      l[A] = d[A]
    end
    for A = 1, #v, 1 do
      l[H + A] = w(v, A)
    end
    local A = B(l, _[1][1], _[1][2])
    local d = B(l, _[2][1], _[2][2])
    local v = B(l, _[3][1], _[3][2])
    local H = B(l, _[4][1], _[4][2])
    local B, _, l, W
    if (((A == 0) and (d == 0)) and (v == 0)) and (H == 0) then
      A, d, v, H = 2654435769, 608135816, 3084996962, 2246822507
      B, _, l, W = A, d, v, H
    else
      B, _, l, W = A, d, v, H
    end
    local function A()
      local d = y(B, i(B, 11))
      d, B, _, l = y(d, u(d, 8)), _, l, W
      local i = y(y(W, u(W, 19)), d)
      W = i
      return i
    end
    return A
  end
  local function i(A, B)
    local d, _ = b(A), #B
    if buffer and buffer.fromstring then
      local b, v = buffer.fromstring(B), 0
      while (v + 4) <= _ do
        buffer.writeu32(b, v, y(buffer.readu32(b, v), d()))
        v += 4
      end
      if v < _ then
        local H, l = d(), 0
        while (v + l) < _ do
          buffer.writeu8(b, v + l, y(buffer.readu8(b, v + l), j(u(H, l * 8), 255)))
          l += 1
        end
      end
      return buffer.tostring(b)
    end
    local b, v, H = {}, 1, 0
    while v <= _ do
      A = d()
      for d = 0, 3, 1 do
        if (v + d) <= _ then
          H += 1
          b[H] = t(y(w(B, v + d), j(u(A, d * 8), 255)))
        else
        end
      end
      v = v + 4
    end
    return h(b)
  end
  local function u(j)
    local t, h, A = #j, 1, 608135816
    while (h + 7) <= t do
      local B, d, _, b, v, H, l, W = w(j, h, h + 7)
      A = y(G(y(y(G(y(y(G(y(y(G(y(y(G(y(y(G(y(y(G(y(y(G(y(A, B), 7), 2654435769), d), 7), 2654435769), _), 7), 2654435769), b), 7), 2654435769), v), 7), 2654435769), H), 7), 2654435769), l), 7), 2654435769), W), 7), 2654435769)
      h = h + 8
    end
    while h <= t do
      A = y(G(y(A, w(j, h)), 7), 2654435769)
      h = h + 1
    end
    return A
  end
  return {decode = function(y)
    if type(y) ~= "string" then
      return nil
    elseif #y < 11 then
      return nil
    end
    local G
    if w(y, 1) ~= 83 then
      G = x(y)
      if type(G) ~= "string" then
        return nil
      elseif #G < 11 then
        return nil
      end
    else
      G = y
    end
    if w(G, 1) ~= 83 then
      return nil
    end
    y = w(G, 2)
    if y ~= 1 then
      if y ~= 2 then
        return nil
      end
    end
    local j, t, h, A = w(G, 7, 10)
    y = i(Z(G, 3, 6), Z(G, 11))
    if u(y) ~= ((((A * 16777216) + (h * 65536)) + (t * 256)) + j) then
      return nil
    end
    return y
  end}
end

-- Module at
modules.at = function()
  local y, G = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local i = y.lp
  local u = y.http
  local j = os.clock
  local w = math.max
  local t = math.min
  local Z = string.lower
  local h = string.find
  local A = table.remove
  local B = y.weak()
  local d, _ = y.weak(), 0.15
  local y, b = -1, {}
  local function x(v)
    if (v - y) < 0.25 then
      local H = _
      return H
    end
    y = v
    local y, H = pcall(i.GetNetworkPing, i)
    local l, W = if y then if type(H) == "number" then if H == H then if H > 0 then H else 0.05 else 0.05 else 0.05 else 0.05, tonumber(i:GetAttribute("Ping"))
    l = if W then if W == W then if W > 0 then if W < 2000 then if (W / 1000) > l then W / 1000 else l else l else l else l else l
    _ = t(l, 1)
    v = _
    return v
  end
  b.pending = function(y, i)
    local t = d[y]
    if not (t) then
      return 0
    end
    local _, v = t.shots, t.hp
    t.hp = i
    if i > (v + 0.01) then
      table.clear(_)
      return 0
    end
    y = j()
    t = x(y)
    local x, H, l = y - ((t * 1.25) + 0.08), ((i < (v - 0.01)) and (y - (t * 0.8))) or nil, 0
    for y = #_, 1, -1 do
      v = _[y]
      if (v.t <= x) or (H and (v.t <= H)) then
        A(_, y)
      else
        l += v.dmg
      end
    end
    return l
  end
  b.reserve = function(y)
    local i, t = y and y.char, tonumber(y and y.dmg)
    if i then
      if t then
        if t <= 0 then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    y = i:GetAttribute("Health")
    if typeof(y) ~= "number" then
      return
    elseif y <= 0 then
      return
    end
    local _ = d[i]
    if _ then
    else
      _ = {hp = y, shots = {}}
      d[i] = _
    end
    y = _.shots
    y[#y + 1] = {t = j(), dmg = t}
    if #y > 64 then
      A(y, 1)
    end
  end
  b.armor = function(y)
    if not (y) then
      return 0, false
    end
    local i, j = y:GetAttribute("Armor"), y.Character
    local t, A = (j and j:GetAttribute("Armor")) or nil, y:GetAttribute("Helmet")
    A = if A == nil then (y:GetAttribute("HasHelmet")) else A
    j = B[y]
    if j then
      if j.raw == i then
        if j.char_armor == t then
          if j.helmet_flag == A then
            return j.health, j.helmet
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local _, x = 0, A == true
    if type(i) == "number" then
      _ = (w(0, i))
    else
      if type(i) == "string" then
        local v, H = pcall(u.JSONDecode, u, i)
        if v then
          if type(H) == "table" then
            j = w(0, tonumber(H.Health) or 0)
            x = x or (H.Helmet == true)
            x = if h(Z(tostring(H.Type or "")), "helmet", 1, true) then true else x
            _ = j
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    _ = if _ <= 0 then if type(t) == "number" then w(0, t) else _ else _
    B[y] = {raw = i, char_armor = t, helmet_flag = A, health = _, helmet = x}
    return _, x
  end
  b.effective_armor = function(y)
    return b.armor(y)
  end
  b.clear = function()
    for y in B, nil, nil do
      B[y] = nil
    end
    for y in d, nil, nil do
      d[y] = nil
    end
  end
  G.teardown(b.clear)
  return b
end

-- Module av
modules.av = function()
  local y, G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("au"), modules.load("as")
  local u = modules.load("at")
  local j = modules.load("p")
  local w = y.lp
  local t = y.workspace
  local Z = y.players
  local h = G.teams
  local G = os.clock
  local A = y.weak()
  local B, d = y.weak(), {}
  local function y(_)
    local b = B[_]
    if b then
    else
      b = {stamp = 0, shield_stamp = 0, shield = false, player = nil, ok = false, root = nil}
      B[_] = b
    end
    return b
  end
  d.part = function(B, _)
    local b = A[B]
    if b then
    else
      b = {}
      A[B] = b
    end
    local A = b[_]
    if A then
      if A.Parent == B then
        return A
      end
    end
    A = B:FindFirstChild(_)
    A = A and (if A:IsA("BasePart") then A else nil)
    b[_] = A
    return A
  end
  d.shielded = function(A)
    local B, _ = y(A), G()
    if _ < B.shield_stamp then
      return B.shield
    end
    local b = A:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField", true) ~= nil
    B.shield_stamp = _ + 0.1
    B.shield = b
    return b
  end
  d.alive = function(A)
    if A then
      if not (A:IsDescendantOf(t)) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    if A:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= false then
      return false
    end
    local B = A:GetAttribute("Health")
    return (typeof(B) == "number") and (B > 0)
  end
  local function A(B, _, b)
    if _:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= false then
      return false
    elseif _:GetAttribute("Invincible") == true then
      return false
    end
    if B:GetAttribute("Invincible") == true then
      return false
    elseif B:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
      return false
    end
    local x = _:GetAttribute("Health")
    if typeof(x) ~= "number" then
      return false
    elseif x <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    local v = G()
    if v >= b.shield_stamp then
      b.shield_stamp = v + 0.1
      b.shield = _:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ForceField", true) ~= nil
    end
    if b.shield then
      return false
    end
    if (x - u.pending(_, x)) <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    b = d.part(_, "HumanoidRootPart")
    if not b then
      return false
    end
    if not (d.part(_, "Head")) then
      return false
    end
    if not (d.part(_, "UpperTorso")) then
      return false
    end
    if not (d.part(_, "LowerTorso")) then
      return false
    end
    if i.team_check then
      x, v = w:GetAttribute("Team"), B:GetAttribute("Team")
      if x then
        if not v then
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
      if h[x] then
        if not (h[v]) then
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
      if t:GetAttribute("Gamemode") ~= "Deathmatch" then
        if x == v then
          return false
        end
      end
    end
    return true, b
  end
  d.valid = function(i, u)
    if i then
      if i == w then
        return false
      elseif i.Parent ~= Z then
        return false
      elseif u then
      else
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    if not (j.armed(i, u)) then
      if i.Character ~= u then
        return false
      elseif not (u:IsDescendantOf(t)) then
        return false
      end
    end
    local j, w = y(u), G()
    if j.player == i then
      if w < j.stamp then
        return j.ok, j.root
      end
    end
    local y, G = A(i, u, j)
    j.stamp = w + 0.002
    j.player = i
    j.ok = y
    j.root = G
    return y, G
  end
  return d
end

-- Module aw

  local H, H, H = math.max, math.min, {on = false, power = 1, step = 0.015625, ticks = 2, gravity = 60, max_speed = 262.5, ground_speed = 24.375, measured = 0}

            end
          end

      if A:IsA("ModuleScript") then

        if type(Y) == "table" then
          y = Y.Gravity
          if type(y) == "number" then
            if y > 0 then
              H.gravity = y
            end
          end
          O = Y.MaxVelocity
          if type(O) == "number" then
            if O > 0 then
              H.max_speed = O
            end
          end
          local y = Y.MaxBaseMoveSpeed
          if type(y) == "number" then
            if y > 0 then
              H.ground_speed = y * 1.25
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  j = u.char_velocity
  if type(j) == "function" then
    W = j
  else
    if G and (type(G.getVelocity) == "function") then
      local y = G.getVelocity
      W = function(u)
        return y(u, u.PrimaryPart)
      end
    else
    end
  end
  if G then
    if type(G.isOnGround) == "function" then
      local y = G.isOnGround
      q = y
    else
    end
  else
  end
  local y, G, u, j, A = W, q, {}, {}, {}
  local W = RaycastParams.new()
  W.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
  W.IgnoreWater = false
  W.CollisionGroup = "Bullet"
  local q = RaycastParams.new()
  q.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  q.IgnoreWater = false
  q.CollisionGroup = "Bullet"
  local Y = RaycastParams.new()
  Y.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  Y.IgnoreWater = false
  Y.CollisionGroup = "Bullet"
  H.lead = function()
    local O = J
    if O ~= H.power then
      J = H.power
      w.reg_hits = 0
      w.reg_miss = 0
      w.reg_lead = 0
    end
    if not (H.on) then
      return 0
    end
    O = tonumber(H.power)
    if O then
      if O ~= O then
        return 0
      elseif v(O) < 0.001 then
        return 0
      end
    else
      return 0
    end
    local w = os.clock()
    local J
    if (w - m) < 0.05 then
      J = D
    else
      J = Z:GetNetworkPing()
      J = if type(J) ~= "number" then 0.05 else if J ~= J then 0.05 else if J <= 0 then 0.05 else if J > 1 then 1 else J
      D, m = J, w
    end
    H.measured = J
    w = J * O
    if w ~= w then
      return 0
    elseif v(w) < 0.001 then
      return 0
    end
    if w > 2 then
      return 2
    end
    if w < -2 then
      return -2
    end
    return w
  end
  H.filter = function(w, Z)
    return _(u, w, Z)
  end
  local function w(Z, _)
    local J = t.part(Z, "HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (J) then
      return _
    end
    local D = t.part(Z, "LeftFoot") or t.part(Z, "RightFoot")
    local m, O = if D then D.Position.Y - (D.Size.Y * 0.5) else (J.Position.Y - (J.Size.Y * 0.5)) - 2, -_.Y
    A[1] = Z
    b(A, 1)
    q.FilterDescendantsInstances = A
    Z = h:Raycast(J.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(O + 6), 0), q)
    if not Z then
      return _
    end
    D = m - Z.Position.Y
    D = if D ~= D then 0 else if D < 0 then 0 else D
    if O <= D then
      return _
    end
    return Vector3.new(_.X, -D, _.Z)
  end
  local function Z(_)
    local q = t.part(_, "HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (q) then
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    local J, D, m = os.clock(), q.Position, l[_]
    if not (m) then
      l[_] = {pos = D, time = J, vel = Vector3.zero}
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    _ = J - m.time
    if _ < 0.008 then
      return m.vel
    end
    if _ > 0.5 then
      m.pos = D
      m.time = J
      m.vel = Vector3.zero
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    q = (D - m.pos) / _
    m.pos = D
    m.time = J
    J, _ = q.X, q.Z
    D = x((J * J) + (_ * _))
    if D ~= D then
      q = Vector3.zero
    else
      if D > H.ground_speed then
        local x = H.ground_speed / D
        q = Vector3.new(J * x, q.Y, _ * x)
      else
      end
    end
    D = q.Y
    q = if D ~= D then Vector3.zero else if D > H.max_speed then Vector3.zero else if D < -H.max_speed then Vector3.zero else q
    m.vel = q
    return q
  end
  H.offset = function(_, x)
    if _ then
      if v(x) < 0.001 then
        return Vector3.zero
      end
    else
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    local l = if y then (y(_)) else nil
    if (typeof(l) ~= "Vector3") or (l.Magnitude < 0.05) then
      local y = t.part(_, "HumanoidRootPart")
      l = (y and y.AssemblyLinearVelocity) or nil
    else
    end
    l = if typeof(l) ~= "Vector3" then Z(_) else if l.Magnitude < 0.05 then Z(_) else l
    local y = l.Magnitude
    if y ~= y then
      return Vector3.zero
    elseif y < 0.05 then
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    local t, Z = (if y > H.max_speed then l * (H.max_speed / y) else l) * x, (G and G(_)) or nil
    t = if Z == true then Vector3.new(t.X, 0, t.Z) else if Z == false then if x > 0 then t - Vector3.new(0, ((0.5 * H.gravity) * x) * x, 0) else t else t
    if t.X ~= t.X then
      return Vector3.zero
    elseif t.Y ~= t.Y then
      return Vector3.zero
    elseif t.Z ~= t.Z then
      return Vector3.zero
    end
    return if t.Y < -0.05 then w(_, t) else t
  end
  local function y(G, w, t, Z)
    local _, x, l, q, J, D, m = t:PointToObjectSpace(G), t:VectorToObjectSpace(w), Z * 0.5, -math.huge, 0, -1, math.huge
    for O = 1, 3, 1 do
      Z, w, G = nil
      if O == 1 then
        Z, w, G = _.X, x.X, l.X
      else
        if O == 2 then
          Z, w, G = _.Y, x.Y, l.Y
        else
          Z, w, G = _.Z, x.Z, l.Z
        end
      end
      if v(w) < 1e-07 then
        if Z < -G then
          return nil
        elseif Z > G then
          return nil
        end
      else
        local _, x, v, l = (-G - Z) / w, (G - Z) / w, -1, D
        if _ > x then
          v = 1
          _, x, D = x, _, v
        else
          D = v
        end
        if _ > q then
          q, J = _, O
        else
          D = l
        end
        m = if x < m then x else m
        if q > m then
          return nil
        end
      end
    end
    if J == 0 then
      return nil
    elseif q ~= q then
      return nil
    elseif q <= 0.05 then
      return nil
    end
    G = if J == 1 then Vector3.new(D, 0, 0) else if J == 2 then Vector3.new(0, D, 0) else Vector3.new(0, 0, D)
    return q, t:VectorToWorldSpace(G)
  end
  H.hit = function(G, w, t, Z, _)
    j[1] = t
    b(j, 1)
    W.FilterDescendantsInstances = j
    local x = G - Z
    local v = h:Raycast(x, w * (_ + 1), W)
    if v then
      if v.Instance == t then
        local h = (v.Position - x).Magnitude
        if h > 0.05 then
          if h <= (_ + 1) then
            return h, v.Normal
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return y(G, w, t.CFrame + Z, t.Size)
  end
  H.path = function(y, G, w, t, Z)
    local h, _ = w - 0.02, B(y, G * w, Y, Z)
    if _ then
      if not (_.instance) then
        return 0, 0, nil, nil
      end
    else
      return 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    local B = _.position - y
    if (((B.X * G.X) + (B.Y * G.Y)) + (B.Z * G.Z)) >= h then
      return 0, 0, nil, nil
    end
    if not (t) then
      return 2, 0, nil, nil
    end
    B = d(y + (G * -0.001), G * (w + 0.001), t, Z, nil, w)
    if not B then
      return 2, 0, nil, nil
    end
    Z = 0
    for w = 1, #B, 1 do
      t = B[w]
      if not (t.instance) then
        break
      end
      _ = t.position - y
      if (((_.X * G.X) + (_.Y * G.Y)) + (_.Z * G.Z)) >= h then
        break
      end
      Z = w
    end
    if Z == 0 then
      return 2, 0, nil, nil
    elseif (Z % 2) ~= 0 then
      return 2, 0, nil, nil
    end
    return 1, Z * 0.5, B, Z + 1
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    H.on = false
    b(u, 0)
    b(j, 0)
    b(A, 0)
  end)
  return H
end

-- Module ax
modules.ax = function()
  local y, G, i, u, j = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("au"), modules.load("as")
