  local Z = modules.load("i")
  local h = y.storage
  local A, B, d = i.inventory, u.groups, {names = {}, valid = {}, aliases = {}}
  d.by_props = y.weak()
  d.active = nil
  d.weapon = nil
  d.on_apply = nil
  d.ui = nil
  local y = {pistols = 1, rifles = 2, snipers = 3, smgs = 4, shotguns = 5, ["machine guns"] = 6, heavy = 7, other = 8}
  d.boxes = function(i)
    local u = {}
    if type(i) == "table" then
      for _, _ in i, nil, nil do
        if B[_] then
          u[_] = true
        end
      end
    end
    return u
  end
  d.category = function(i)
    if type(i) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    local u, B = tostring(rawget(i, "Type") or ""), tostring(rawget(i, "MuzzleType") or "")
    if B == "Zeus x27" then
      return nil
    end
    if B == "Sniper" then
      return "snipers"
    end
    if B == "ShotGun" then
      return "shotguns"
    end
    if B == "MachineGun" then
      return "machine guns"
    end
    if u == "Pistol" then
      return "pistols"
    end
    if u == "Rifle" then
      return "rifles"
    end
    if u == "SMG" then
      return "smgs"
    end
    if u == "Heavy" then
      return "heavy"
    end
    return "other"
  end
  d.load = function()
    local i = h:FindFirstChild("Database")
    local u = i and (i:FindFirstChild("Custom"))
    i = u and (u:FindFirstChild("Weapons"))
    if not i then
      return
    end
    u = i:GetChildren()
    for h = 1, #u, 1 do
      i = u[h]
      if i:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        if i.Name ~= "Zeus x27" then
          local u, B = pcall(require, i)
          h = ((u and (type(B) == "table")) and (B.Class == "Weapon")) and d.category(B)
          if h then
            d.by_props[B] = h
            d.aliases[i.Name:lower()] = h
            if not (d.valid[h]) then
              d.valid[h] = true
              d.names[#d.names + 1] = h
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    table.sort(d.names, function(i, u)
      local h, B = y[i] or math.huge, y[u] or math.huge
      if h == B then
        return i < u
      end
      return h < B
    end)
  end
  d.find_type = function(y)
    if type(y) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    local i = rawget(y, "Properties")
    local u = (i and d.by_props[i]) or nil
    u = u or (if type(i) == "table" then d.category(i) else u)
    if u then
    else
      i = rawget(y, "Name")
      u = if type(i) == "string" then d.aliases[i:lower()] else u
    end
    if u then
      if d.valid[u] then
        return u
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  d.apply = function(y)
    local i = d.ui
    if not i then
      return
    end
    local function u(h)
      return i:get("legit." .. h, y)
    end
    local i, h, B = y ~= nil, j.double_tap, j.rapid
    j.on = (i and u("on")) or false
    j.team_check = u("team")
    j.boxes = d.boxes(u("hb"))
    j.prefer = u("prefer")
    j.baim = (i and (u("baim") == true)) or false
    j.baim_hp = (j.baim and tonumber(u("baimhp"))) or 0
    j.scope_only = (i and (u("scopeonly") == true)) or false
    j.auto_shoot = (i and u("auto")) or false
    j.delay = (i and tonumber(u("delay"))) or 0
    j.flash_check = (i and (u("flashcheck") == true)) or false
    j.smoke_check = (i and (u("smokecheck") == true)) or false
    j.auto_scope = (i and (u("autoscope") == true)) or false
    j.auto_wall = (i and u("aw")) or false
    j.wallbang = false
    j.magic = false
    j.auto_revolver = (i and u("autorev")) or false
    j.auto_switch = (i and u("autoswitch")) or false
    j.double_tap = (i and u("dt")) or false
    j.rapid = (i and (u("rapid") == true)) or false
    j.no_recoil = (i and u("norecoil")) or false
    j.no_spread = (i and u("nospread")) or false
    j.insta_reload = (i and u("instantreload")) or false
    j.min_damage = u("mindmg")
    j.wall_min_damage = u("awmindmg")
    j.fov = u("fov")
    j.draw_fov = (i and u("dfov")) or false
    j.fov_col = u("dfov_col")
    j.fov_grad = u("dfov_grad")
    j.fov_col2 = u("dfov_col2")
    j.fov_fill = u("dfov_fill")
    j.fov_fill_col = u("dfov_fcol")
    j.fov_fill_grad = u("dfov_fgrad")
    j.fov_fill_col2 = u("dfov_fcol2")
    j.multipoint = (i and u("multipoint")) or false
    j.origin_shift = (i and tonumber(u("originshift"))) or 0
    j.head_size = u("headsize")
    j.chest_size = u("chestsize")
    j.stomach_size = u("stomachsize")
    j.arms_size = u("armssize")
    j.legs_size = u("legssize")
    w.on = false
    w.power = 1
    Z.aim = false
    if d.on_apply then
      d.on_apply(h, B)
    end
  end
  d.refresh = function()
    d.apply(d.active)
  end
  d.activate = function(y)
    local i = d.find_type(y)
    if d.weapon == y then
      if d.active == i then
        return
      end
    end
    d.weapon = y
    d.active = i
    d.apply(i)
  end
  local y
  local i = ((type(A) == "table") and rawget(A, "peekCurrentEquippedForMovement")) or nil
  local function u()
    if type(i) ~= "function" then
      return nil
    end
    local j, w = pcall(i)
    if j then
      if type(w) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      elseif w.IsDestroyed then
        return nil
      elseif not (w.IsEquipped) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    return w
  end
  d.held = function()
    local i = y
    if i then
      if not (i.IsDestroyed) then
        if i.IsEquipped then
          d.activate(i)
          return i
        end
      end
    end
    y = nil
    d.activate(nil)
    return nil
  end
  d.adopt = function(i)
    y = i
  end
  d.ensure = function()
    local i = d.held()
    if i then
      return i
    end
    i = u()
    if i then
      y = i
    end
    d.activate(i)
    return i
  end
  d.load()
  G.teardown(function()
    y = nil
    d.weapon = nil
    d.active = nil
    d.ui = nil
    t.clear()
  end)
  return d
end

-- Module ay
modules.ay = function()
  local y, G = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local i = modules.load("h")
  local u, j = modules.load("au"), y.lp
  local w = y.workspace
  local t = y.players
  local Z = u.teams
  local u, h, A, B, d = string.lower, {}, {}, {}, {}
  local _ = y.weak()
  local y
  local b = false
  local x = {picked = h, values = d, set = function(v)
    if b then
      return
    end
    local H = {}
    if type(v) == "table" then
      for l, W in v, nil, nil do
        local q = if (type(l) == "string") and (W == true) then l else if type(W) == "string" then W else nil
        l = q and A[q]
        if l then
          H[l] = true
        end
      end
    elseif type(v) == "string" then
      local l = A[v]
      if l then
        H[l] = true
      end
    end
    table.clear(h)
    for v in H, nil, nil do
      h[v] = true
    end
  end}
  local function v(H, l)
    local W, q = u(H), u(l)
    if W == q then
      return H < l
    end
    return W < q
  end
  x.refresh = function(u)
    table.clear(A)
    table.clear(B)
    local H, l, W = {}, i.all()
    local i, q = j:GetAttribute("Team"), w:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Deathmatch"
    local J, D = Z[i] == true, 0
    for m = 1, W, 1 do
      local W = l[m]
      if W ~= u then
        if W ~= j then
          if W.Parent == t then
            if not (_[W]) then
              local u, j = G.adopt, function()
                x.refresh()
              end
              _[W] = u(W:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(j))
            end
            m = W:GetAttribute("Team")
            if (J and Z[m]) and (q or (i ~= m)) then
              local i, u = W.UserId, W.DisplayName
              local j, Z = if u == W.Name then "@" .. W.Name else u .. (" (@" .. (W.Name .. ")")), D + 1
              d[Z] = j
              A[j] = i
              B[i] = j
              H[i] = true
              D = Z
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    for i = #d, D + 1, -1 do
      d[i] = nil
    end
    table.sort(d, v)
    J = {}
    for i in h, nil, nil do
      if H[i] then
        J[#J + 1] = B[i]
      else
        h[i] = nil
      end
    end
    if y then
      b = true
      pcall(y.setvalues, y, d)
      pcall(y.set, y, J)
      b = false
    end
  end
  x.bind = function(i)
    y = i
  end
  x.unload = function()
    y, b = nil, false
    table.clear(h)
    table.clear(A)
    table.clear(B)
    table.clear(d)
  end
  G.connect(w:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Gamemode"), function()
    x.refresh()
  end)
  G.connect(t.PlayerAdded, function()
    x.refresh()
  end)
  G.connect(t.PlayerRemoving, function(y)
    h[y.UserId] = nil
    x.refresh(y)
  end)
  G.teardown(x.unload)
  return x
end

-- Module az
modules.az = function()
  local y, G, i = modules.load("q"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("_")
  local u = G.smoke_fx
  local G = ((type(u) == "table") and rawget(u, "DoesRayIntersectActiveSmoke")) or nil
  local u = y.misc
  local y = i.zones
  local i = math.clamp
  local j, w = os.clock, {}
  local function t(Z, h, A)
    local B, d, _ = j(), h.X, h.Z
    local j = (d * d) + (_ * _)
    for b = 1, #y, 1 do
      local x = y[b]
      if x.kind == "smoke" then
        if (x.expires or 0) > B then
          if x.center then
            local y, B = x.center, x.radius or 0
            local x, v = Z.X - y.X, Z.Z - y.Z
            b = ((j > 1e-06) and i(-((x * d) + (v * _)) / j, 0, A)) or 0
            local i, j = x + (d * b), v + (_ * b)
            if ((i * i) + (j * j)) <= (B * B) then
              x = Z.Y + (h.Y * b)
              if x >= (y.Y - 2) then
                if x <= (y.Y + 12) then
                  return true
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  w.blocks = function(y, i)
    local j = i - y
    i = j.Magnitude
    if i < 0.001 then
      return false
    end
    local Z = j / i
    if G then
      local j, h = pcall(G, y, Z, i)
      if j then
        if h then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    return (u.smoke == true) and t(y, Z, i)
  end
  return w
end

-- Module aA
modules.aA = function()
  local y, G, i, u = modules.load("b"), modules.load("f"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("h")
  local j, w, t, Z = modules.load("j"), modules.load("T"), modules.load("au"), modules.load("as")
  local h = modules.load("at")
  local A = modules.load("av")
  local B = modules.load("ay")
  local d = modules.load("aw")
  local _ = modules.load("az")
  local b = modules.load("p")
  local x = modules.load("U")
  local v = y.lp
  local H = y.workspace
  local l = w.probe
  local W = w.through
  local q = j.ray_ignore
  local J = t.groups
  local D = t.order
  local m = t.damage_key
  local Y = t.size_key
  local O = G.trim
  local Q = math.clamp
  local F = math.max
  local I = math.min
  local E, E = math.abs, math.huge
  local V = math.cos
  local N = math.rad
  local a, a = math.floor, Vector3.zero
  local U, g = Vector3.yAxis, {}
  local X = RaycastParams.new()
  X.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  X.IgnoreWater = false
  X.CollisionGroup = "Bullet"
  local o, R, p, c, M, T, L = {}
  local k, P, z, n, K, S, e, C, s, r, yO, fO, GO, iO, uO, jO, wO, tO, ZO, hO, AO, BO = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1}, {8, 8, 12, 16, 16}
  for dO = 1, #AO, 1 do
    G, j = AO[dO], BO[dO]
    y = (((dO % 2) == 0) and (3.141592653589793 / j)) or 0
    for BO = 0, j - 1, 1 do
      t = (((BO * 2) * 3.141592653589793) / j) + y
      hO[#hO + 1] = {math.cos(t) * G, math.sin(t) * G, 0}
    end
    if dO == 2 then
      hO[#hO + 1] = {0, 0, G}
    elseif dO == 5 then
      hO[#hO + 1] = {0, 0, G}
    end
  end
  local t = {}
  for BO = 1, #hO, 1 do
    j = hO[BO]
    AO = math.sqrt(((j[1] * j[1]) + (j[2] * j[2])) + (j[3] * j[3]))
    if AO > 0 then
      y, G, w = j[1] / AO, j[2] / AO, j[3] / AO
      if math.abs(G) > 0.985 then
        t[#t + 1] = BO
      elseif AO >= 0.95 then
        if math.abs(y) > 0.985 then
          t[#t + 1] = BO
        elseif math.abs(w) > 0.985 then
          t[#t + 1] = BO
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local y, G, j, AO, BO, dO, _O, bO, xO, vO, HO, lO = #hO, 0, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  local function WO(qO, JO, DO, mO, YO)
    local OO, QO = (DO + mO) + YO, Z.baim_hp
    if Z.baim or (QO > 0) then
      if not ((JO == "UpperTorso") and Z.boxes.chest) then
        if JO == "LowerTorso" then
          if not (Z.boxes.stomach) then
            return OO
          end
        else
          return OO
        end
      end
    else
      return OO
    end
    JO = HO[qO]
    if JO == nil then
      JO = tonumber(qO:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
      JO = F(0, JO - h.pending(qO, JO))
      HO[qO] = JO
    else
    end
    return if JO > 0 then if Z.baim then if DO >= JO then OO + 2000000 else if JO <= QO then OO + 2000000 else OO else if JO <= QO then OO + 2000000 else OO else OO
  end
  local function qO(JO)
    local DO = xO[JO]
    if DO ~= nil then
      return DO, vO[JO]
    end
    local DO, mO = h.effective_armor(JO)
    xO[JO] = DO
    vO[JO] = mO
    return DO, mO
  end
  local function h(JO, DO, mO, YO, OO)
    local QO = m[DO]
    if not (QO) then
      return 0, 0
    end
    DO = OO.DamagePerPart
    if type(DO) ~= "table" then
      return 0, 0
    end
    local FO = DO[QO] or 0
    if FO <= 0 then
      return 0, 0
    end
    DO = FO * ((tonumber(OO.RangeModifier) or 1) ^ F(0, mO / 100))
    DO = if YO > 0 then DO * (tonumber(OO.WallbangMultiplier) or 1) else DO
    YO, FO = qO(JO)
    mO = 0
    if (YO > 0) and ((QO ~= "Head") or FO) then
      JO = DO * Q(tonumber(OO.ArmorPenetration) or 1, 0, 1)
      mO = (DO - JO) * 0.5
      if mO > YO then
        mO, JO = YO, DO - (YO / 0.5)
      else
      end
      DO = (F(0, JO))
    else
    end
    return DO, mO
  end
  local function qO(JO, DO, mO)
    local YO = m[JO]
    if not (YO) then
      return 0
    end
    JO = mO.DamagePerPart
    if type(JO) ~= "table" then
      return 0
    end
    local m = JO[YO] or 0
    if type(m) ~= "number" then
      return E
    end
    if m <= 0 then
      return 0
    end
    YO = tonumber(mO.RangeModifier) or 1
    if YO ~= YO then
      return E
    elseif YO < 0 then
      return E
    elseif YO > 1 then
      return E
    end
    if DO then
      YO = tonumber(mO.WallbangMultiplier) or 1
      if YO ~= YO then
        return E
      elseif YO < 0 then
        return E
      end
      return m * YO
    end
    return m
  end
  local function m(JO, DO, mO)
    local YO = Z.min_damage
    if lO then
      local OO = h(JO, lO, DO, 0, mO)
      if OO > 0 then
        if OO < YO then
          return OO
        end
      end
    end
    return YO
  end
  local function JO(DO)
    return (x.origin(DO))
  end
  local function x(DO, mO, YO)
    local OO = Q(tonumber(YO) or 0, 0, 100) / 100
    if OO <= 0 then
      return 0
    end
    YO = DO.Size
    local QO, FO, IO, EO, VO = F((YO.X * 0.5) - 0.05, 0) * OO, F((YO.Y * 0.5) - 0.05, 0) * OO, F((YO.Z * 0.5) - 0.05, 0) * OO, DO.CFrame, 0
    if ((mO == "head") or (mO == "chest")) or (mO == "stomach") then
      if QO > 0.001 then
        j[1] = EO:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(QO, 0, 0))
        VO = 2
        j[VO] = EO:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(-QO, 0, 0))
      else
      end
      if FO > 0.001 then
        VO += 1
        j[VO] = EO:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, FO, 0))
        VO += 1
        j[VO] = EO:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -FO, 0))
      else
      end
    else
      OO = if (FO >= QO) and (FO >= IO) then Vector3.new(0, FO, 0) else if QO >= IO then Vector3.new(QO, 0, 0) else Vector3.new(0, 0, IO)
      if OO.Magnitude > 0.001 then
        j[1] = EO:PointToWorldSpace(OO)
        j[2] = EO:PointToWorldSpace(-OO)
        VO = 2
      else
      end
    end
    for DO = VO + 1, 4, 1 do
      j[DO] = nil
    end
    return VO
  end
  local function DO(mO, YO, OO, QO, FO, IO)
    local EO = mO - YO
    mO = EO.Magnitude
    if mO < 0.5 then
      return nil
    elseif mO > (IO + 5) then
      return nil
    end
    YO = EO / mO
    if QO < 180 then
      if OO:Dot(YO) < FO then
        return nil
      end
    end
    return YO, mO
  end
  local function mO(YO, OO)
    local QO, FO, IO, EO, VO = not not OO.head, not not OO.chest, not not OO.stomach, not not OO.arms, not not OO.legs
    if R == YO then
      if p == QO then
        if c == FO then
          if M == IO then
            if T == EO then
              if L == VO then
                return o
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    R, p, c, M, T, L = YO, QO, FO, IO, EO, VO
    VO, QO = {}, 0
    if OO[YO] then
      QO = 1
      VO[QO] = YO
    else
    end
    for p = 1, #D, 1 do
      EO = D[p]
      if EO ~= YO then
        if OO[EO] then
          IO = QO + 1
          VO[IO] = EO
          QO = IO
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    if QO == 0 then
      VO[1] = YO
      QO = 1
      for p = 1, #D, 1 do
        IO = D[p]
        if IO ~= YO then
          QO += 1
          VO[QO] = IO
        else
        end
      end
    else
    end
    FO = 0
    for D = 1, QO, 1 do
      EO = VO[D]
      OO = J[EO]
      o[D] = {group = EO, parts = OO, slot = FO}
      FO += #OO
    end
    O(o, QO)
    return o
  end
  local function J(D, p, c, M, T, L, YO, OO)
    local QO, FO, IO = #k, u.all()
    local u, EO = 0, false
    for VO = 1, IO, 1 do
      local IO = FO[VO]
      local FO = b.target(IO)
      if FO ~= YO then
        local YO, NO = A.valid(IO, FO)
        if YO then
          local YO = NO.Position - D
          local D = YO.Magnitude
          if D > 0.5 then
            if (D - 4) <= T then
              local T = c >= 180
              T = T or (if D > 0.01 then p:Dot(YO / D) >= M else T)
              if T then
              else
                if OO then
                  if OO > 0 then
                    local D = d.offset(FO, OO)
                    if ((D.X ~= 0) or (D.Y ~= 0)) or (D.Z ~= 0) then
                      local c = YO + D
                      local D = c.Magnitude
                      T = if D > 0.01 then p:Dot(c / D) >= M else T
                    else
                    end
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              end
              if T then
                local D = u + 1
                k[D] = IO
                P[D] = FO
                z[D] = VO
                n[D] = b.ghost(FO)
                EO = if L then if B.picked[IO.UserId] then true else EO else EO
                u = D
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    for b = u + 1, QO, 1 do
      k[b] = nil
      P[b] = nil
      z[b] = nil
      n[b] = nil
    end
    return u, EO
  end
  local function u(b, D, p, c)
    table.clear(AO)
    table.clear(BO)
    table.clear(dO)
    table.clear(_O)
    table.clear(bO)
    lO = nil
    local M, T = #b, 0
    for L = 1, M, 1 do
      local YO = b[L].parts
      L = #YO
      for OO = 1, L, 1 do
        local L = YO[OO]
        OO = qO(L, false, D)
        if OO > T then
          if OO < E then
            lO, T = L, OO
          else
          end
        else
        end
      end
    end
    M = Z.min_damage
    M = if lO then if T < M then T else M else M
    for T = 1, #b, 1 do
      local L = b[T]
      local lO, YO, OO = (((L.group == p) and 1000000) or 0) + (((Z.baim or (Z.baim_hp > 0)) and 2000000) or 0), -E, L.parts
      for p = 1, #OO, 1 do
        L = OO[p]
        local OO, QO = qO(L, false, D), -E
        QO = if OO >= M then (OO + lO) + 100000 else QO
        p = -E
        if c then
          if Z.magic then
          else
            local c, FO = if OO >= M then OO + lO else p, qO(L, true, D)
            p = if FO >= Z.wall_min_damage then F(c, FO + lO) else c
          end
        else
        end
        AO[L] = QO
        BO[L] = p
        dO[L] = F(QO, p)
        YO = F(YO, dO[L])
      end
      _O[T] = YO
    end
    M = -E
    for D = #b, 1, -1 do
      M = F(M, _O[D])
      bO[D] = M
    end
  end
  local function b(D, p, c, M, T, L)
    local lO = W(D, p, c, M, T, L)
    if lO then
      if #lO == 0 then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    D = 0
    for W = 1, #lO, 1 do
      c = lO[W]
      if c.instance then
        if c.instance:IsDescendantOf(T) then
          return c, D, lO, W
        end
        D = if (W % 2) ~= 0 then D + 1 else D
      else
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function W(D, p, c)
    local M = p.Magnitude
    if M < 0.25 then
      return nil
    end
    local T = l(D, p, X, c)
    if not (T.instance) then
      return D + p
    end
    c = (T.position - D).Magnitude - 0.3
    if c < 0.25 then
      return nil
    end
    return D + (p * (c / M))
  end
  local function D(p, c, M, T, L, lO)
    local qO = ((p - 1) * y) + c
    if not (jO[p]) then
      jO[p] = true
      local YO = (p - 1) * y
      for OO = 1, y, 1 do
        uO[YO + OO] = nil
      end
      YO = T - M
      local OO, QO, FO = ((YO.Magnitude > 0.001) and YO.Unit) or U, YO.X, YO.Z
      YO = ((((QO * QO) + (FO * FO)) > 1e-06) and Vector3.new(-FO, 0, QO).Unit) or Vector3.xAxis
      wO[p] = YO
      tO[p] = YO:Cross(OO)
      ZO[p] = Vector3.new(OO.X, 0, OO.Z)
    end
    T = uO[qO]
    if T == nil then
      local U = hO[c]
      T = W(M, (((wO[p] * U[1]) + (tO[p] * U[2])) + (ZO[p] * U[3])) * lO, L) or false
      uO[qO] = T
    else
    end
    return T
  end

            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      end
    else
    end
    if OO then
      if A.valid(_, J) then
        if not (OO:IsDescendantOf(J)) then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    if ((d.on and (N > 0)) and (lO == 0)) and OO:IsA("BasePart") then
      F = d.offset(J, N)
      if ((F.X ~= 0) or (F.Y ~= 0)) or (F.Z ~= 0) then
        ZO = ((typeof(cO) == "Vector3") and cO) or v
        q = (OO.Position + F) - ZO
        wO = q.Magnitude
        if ((wO > 0.5) and (wO <= (tO + 5))) and not (Q and JO(ZO, ZO + q)) then
          qO = q / wO
          c, H = d.hit(ZO, qO, OO, F, wO)
          T, M, mO, L, YO = c or wO, 0, 0
          p, hO = oO, RO
          if Z.magic then
            oO, RO = L, YO
          else
            M, mO, oO, RO = d.path(ZO, qO, T, U, d.filter(V, J))
          end
          local y, G = h(_, OO.Name, T, mO, W)
          local u = ((mO > 0) and Z.wall_min_damage) or m(_, T, W)
          if (M ~= 2) and (y >= u) then
            lO, FO, IO, EO, VO, NO, aO, UO, gO, XO, pO, cO = N, y, G, mO == 0, qO, OO, ZO + (qO * T), H or -qO, OO.Material, mO, T, ZO
          else
            oO, RO = p, hO
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    Q = nil
    if oO then
      Q = {}
      c = 0
      for y = 1, RO - 1, 1 do
        JO = oO[y]
        if JO then
          if JO.instance then
            mO = c + 1
            Q[mO] = {Position = JO.position, Instance = JO.instance, Material = (JO.material and JO.material.Name) or "Plastic", Normal = JO.normal or a, Exit = (y % 2) == 0}
            c = mO
          else
          end
        else
        end
      end
    else
      Q = g
    end
    return {player = _, char = J, part = OO, shot = {visible = EO, dir = VO, hit_part = NO, hit_pos = aO, normal = UO, material = gO, walls = XO, wall_hits = Q, dist = pO, origin = cO}, dmg = FO, armor_dmg = IO or 0, group = QO, lead = lO}
  end}
  i.teardown(function()
    O(k, 0)
    O(P, 0)
    O(z, 0)
    O(n, 0)
    O(K, 0)
    O(S, 0)
    O(e, 0)
    O(C, 0)
    O(s, 0)
    O(r, 0)
    O(yO, 0)
    O(fO, 0)
    O(GO, 0)
    O(iO, 0)
    O(uO, 0)
    table.clear(jO)
    O(j, 0)
    O(o, 0)
    table.clear(AO)
    table.clear(BO)
    table.clear(dO)
    table.clear(_O)
    table.clear(bO)
    table.clear(xO)
    table.clear(vO)
    table.clear(HO)
    R = nil
  end)
  return w
end

-- Module aC
modules.aC = function()
  local y, G = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local i = modules.load("h")
  local u, j = modules.load("j"), modules.load("aj")
  local w = modules.load("as")
  local t = modules.load("aB")
  local Z = modules.load("ax")
  local h = modules.load("av")
  local A = y.lp
  local B = y.workspace
  local d = y.input
  local _, b = y.storage, y.clips
  local x = y.keyframes
  local v, H, l, W = y.getups, y.info, u.weapon, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
  local q = math.max
  local J = math.min
  local D = math.clamp
  local m = math.huge
  local Y = os.clock
  local O, Q = y.plain, {}
  local F = y.weak()
  local I = y.weak()
  local E, V, N = y.weak(), 0, 0.03333333333333333
  local a = -m
  local U, g, X = -m, false
  y = ((type(l) == "table") and rawget(l, "startRevolverCharge")) or nil
  if ((type(y) == "function") and (type(v) == "function")) and (type(H) == "function") then
    u, l = pcall(v, y)
    if u and (type(l) == "table") then
      for o, o in l, nil, nil do
        if (type(o) == "function") and (H(o, "n") == "completeRevolverChargeShot") then
          X = o
          break
        end
      end
    else
    end
  else
  end
  local function o(R)
    if type(R) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif R.ShootingOptions ~= "Revolver" then
      return nil
    end
    local p = R.FireModes
    R = ((type(p) == "table") and p.Primary) or nil
    if type(R) == "table" then
      if R.InputBehavior == "Charge" then
        return R
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function R(p, c)
    local M = p.Viewmodel
    p = ((type(M) == "table") and M.Animation) or nil
    if type(p) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    M = c.Animation
    return (((type(M) == "string") and p:getAnimation(M)) or nil) or (p:getAnimation("Shoot"))
  end
  local function p(c)
    local M
    if c:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
      local T = c:GetKeyframes()
      for L = 1, #T, 1 do
        local k = T[L]
        L = k:GetMarkers()
        for T = 1, #L, 1 do
          M = if L[T].Name == "Shoot" then if M then if k.Time < M then k.Time else M else k.Time else M
        end
      end
    else
      local T = c:GetDescendants()
      for c = 1, #T, 1 do
        local L = T[c]
        if L:IsA("MarkerCurve") then
          c = L:GetMarkers()
          for T = 1, #c, 1 do
            local L = c[T]
            M = if L.Value == "Shoot" then if M then if L.Time < M then L.Time else M else L.Time else M
          end
        else
        end
      end
    end
    return M
  end
  local function c(M, T, L)
    if not (M) then
      return nil
    end
    local k, P = pcall(M[T], M, L)
    if k then
      if typeof(P) ~= "Instance" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    T, k = pcall(p, P)
    pcall(P.Destroy, P)
    if T then
      if type(k) == "number" then
        return k
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function p(M)
    local T = c(b, "GetAnimationClipAsync", M) or c(x, "GetKeyframeSequenceAsync", M)
    if T then
      if G.alive() then
        Q[M] = T
      end
    end
  end
  local function b(x)
    if type(x) == "string" then
      if x ~= "" then
        if Q[x] == nil then
          Q[x] = false
          G.spawn(p, x)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  y = _:FindFirstChild("Database")
  _ = y and (y:FindFirstChild("Custom"))
  l = _ and (_:FindFirstChild("Weapons"))
  if l then
    v = l:GetChildren()
    for x = 1, #v, 1 do
      u = v[x]
      if u:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        y, x = pcall(require, u)
        H = (y and o(x)) or nil
        _ = H and x.CameraAnimations
        if typeof(_) == "Instance" then
          local y = _:FindFirstChild(((type(H.Animation) == "string") and H.Animation) or "Shoot")
          if y then
            if y:IsA("Animation") then
              b(y.AnimationId)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function y(u, _)
    local x, v = q(tonumber(u.ChargeTime) or 0, 0), _ and _.Animation
    u = v and v.AnimationId
    b(u)
    v = u and Q[u]
    if v then
      return q(x, v) + 0.03333333333333333, v
    end
    return x + 0.05, nil
  end
  local function u(_, b)
    F[_] = nil
    I[_] = nil
    E[_] = b
    if _.IsChargeFiring then
      O(_.cancelRevolverCharge, _, false)
    end
  end
  local function _(b, x)
    if b.IsDestroyed then
      return false
    elseif not (b.IsEquipped) then
      return false
    end
    if b.IsShooting then
      return false
    elseif b.IsReloading then
      return false
    elseif b.IsAdjustingSuppressor then
      return false
    elseif b.IsAlternativeFireHeld then
      return false
    elseif b.IsInspecting then
      return false
    end
    local v = b.Rounds
    if type(v) ~= "number" then
      return false
    elseif v <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    if (x - (E[b] or -m)) < 0.05 then
      return false
    end
    if d:IsMouseButtonPressed(W) then
      return false
    elseif B:GetAttribute("GameState") == "Buy Period" then
      return false
    end
    if A:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb") == true then
      return false
    elseif A:GetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb") == true then
      return false
    end
    if not (h.alive(A.Character)) then
      return false
    end
    x = b.Viewmodel
    v = ((type(x) == "table") and x.Animation) or nil
    x = ((type(v) == "table") and v:getAnimation("Equip")) or nil
    v = (x and x.Length) or 0
    return (((v > 0) and (v * 0.925)) or 0.5) < (tick() - (tonumber(b.WeaponEquippedTick) or 0))
  end
  local function B(d)
    local b = d and F[d]
    if b == nil then
      return nil, nil
    elseif d.IsChargeFiring ~= true then
      return nil, nil
    elseif I[d] ~= d.ChargeStartTick then
      return nil, nil
    end
    return b, tick() - (tonumber(d.ChargeStartTick) or 0)
  end
  local function d(b)
    local x, v = B(b)
    return (x ~= nil) and ((x - v) <= 0.05)
  end
  local function b(x)
    if (x - U) < 0.1 then
      local v = g
      return v
    end
    U, g = x, false
    x = A.Character
    local v = x and (x:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if not (v) then
      return false
    end
    local H, l, W = v.Position, i.all()
    for i = 1, W, 1 do
      x = l[i]
      if x ~= A then
        i = x.Character
        if i then
          local A, v = h.valid(x, i)
          if A then
            if v then
              if (v.Position - H).Magnitude <= 50 then
                g = true
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    W = g
    return W
  end
  local function i(h)
    local A = ((h - a) < 0.75) or b(h)
    return A
  end
  local h = {spot = function(A)
    a = A or Y()
  end, engage = function(A, b)
    b = b or (Y())
    a = b
    local x, v = B(A)
    if x then
      if (x - v) > 0.05 then
        if not (j.held()) then
          u(A, b)
        end
      end
    end
  end, wait = function(A)
    local b, x = B(A)
    if not (b) then
      return nil, nil
    end
    return q(b - x, 0), b
  end, ready = function(A)
    local b, x = B(A)
    A = ((b ~= nil) and (x >= b)) and (x <= (b + N))
    return A
  end, held = function(A)
    return B(A) ~= nil
  end, can_slam = function(A, B)
    if A then
      if A.IsChargeFiring then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    return ((B or Y()) - (E[A] or -m)) >= 0.05
  end}
  h.fire = function(A)
    local B = o(A.Properties)
    if B then
      if not (h.ready(A)) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local b = R(A, B)
    B = nil
    if X then
      B = O(X, A)
    else
      A.CurrentWalkSpeedOverride = nil
      B = O(A.shoot, A, "Primary")
    end
    if not (A.IsChargeFiring) then
      F[A] = nil
      I[A] = nil
      if b then
        if b.Speed == 0 then
          pcall(b.AdjustSpeed, b, 1)
        end
      end
    end
    return B
  end
  h.slam = function(A)
    if not (h.can_slam(A, Y())) then
      return false
    end
    return O(A.shoot, A, "Secondary")
  end
  h.pull = function(A, B)
    if h.ready(A) then
      return h.fire(A)
    end
    if B then
      return h.slam(A)
    end
    return false
  end
  local function A(B, b, x, v)
    local H = B.ChargeShootConnection
    if H then
      pcall(H.Disconnect, H)
      B.ChargeShootConnection = nil
    end
    H = B.ChargeThread
    if H then
      pcall(task.cancel, H)
      B.ChargeThread = nil
    end
    H = R(B, b)
    local l, W = y(b, H)
    b = tick() - (tonumber(B.ChargeStartTick) or 0)
    F[B] = l
    if H then
      local y, U = q((W or l) - 0.01, 0), H.TimePosition
      if H.Speed ~= 0 then
        if (U + x) >= y then
          H:AdjustSpeed(0)
        end
      end
      if H.Speed == 0 then
        local x = J(b, y)
        if U < x then
          H.TimePosition = x
        elseif U > y then
          H.TimePosition = x
        end
      end
    end
    if b < l then
      return
    end
    if j.held() then
      if h.fire(B) then
        return
      end
    end
    if B.IsChargeFiring then
      if b > (l + N) then
        u(B, v)
      end
    end
  end
  h.step = function()
    local y = Y()
    local B = D((y - V) * 2, 0.02, 0.1)
    V = y
    N = D(B, 0.03333333333333333, 0.05)
    local b = Z.ensure()
    local Z = b and o(b.Properties)
    if not (Z) then
      return
    end
    if b.IsChargeFiring then
      E[b] = y
    end
    local x, v = w.on and w.auto_revolver, t.on and t.auto_revolver
    local H = x or v
    H = if (H and (if x then w.auto_switch else not x)) and (if v then t.auto_switch else not v) then if i(y) then false else H else H
    if F[b] ~= nil then
      if b.IsChargeFiring ~= true then
        F[b] = nil
        I[b] = nil
      elseif I[b] ~= b.ChargeStartTick then
        F[b] = nil
        I[b] = nil
      elseif H then
        A(b, Z, B, y)
        return
      elseif j.held() then
        A(b, Z, B, y)
        return
      elseif d(b) then
        A(b, Z, B, y)
        return
      else
        u(b, y)
        return
      end
    end
    if H then
      if not (b.IsChargeFiring) then
        if _(b, y) then
          if O(b.startRevolverCharge, b, nil) then
            if b.IsChargeFiring then
              b.IsFireHeld = false
              b.FireInputBinding = nil
              I[b] = b.ChargeStartTick
              E[b] = y
              A(b, Z, B, y)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  G.teardown(function()
    for y in F, nil, nil do
      F[y] = nil
      if y.IsChargeFiring then
        if not (y.IsDestroyed) then
          O(y.cancelRevolverCharge, y, false)
        end
      end
    end
    table.clear(I)
    table.clear(E)
    table.clear(Q)
    a, g = -m, false
  end)
  return h
end

  end}

end

-- Module aE
modules.aE = function()
  local y, G, i, u = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("aj")
  local j = modules.load("ae")
  local w = modules.load("U")
  local t = modules.load("ai")
  local Z = modules.load("as")
  local h = modules.load("at")
  local A = modules.load("av")
  local B = modules.load("ax")
  local d = modules.load("aA")
  local _ = modules.load("aC")
  local b = modules.load("g")
  local x = modules.load("aD")
  local v = modules.load("af")
  local H = y.lp
  local l = y.workspace
  local W, q = y.info, y.plain
  local J, D, m, Y, O = i.weapon, i.bullet, i.camera, i.crosshair, i.remotes
  local Q = i.hints
  local F = i.root_frame
  local I, E = i.hit_flinch, i.fire_ready
  local V = i.legit_ready
  local N = table.pack
  local a = table.unpack
  local U = math.max
  local g = math.abs
  local X, X, o, R = math.floor, N(), {tick = nil, seq = nil, id = nil}
  local p, c = i.mv_runtime, i.local_char
  local M = ((type(c) == "table") and rawget(c, "GetRemoteViewTick")) or nil
  if ((type(p) == "table") and (type(M) == "function")) and (type(y.getups) == "function") then
    local T, L = pcall(y.getups, M)
    if T and (type(L) == "table") then
      for T, T in L, nil, nil do
        if (type(T) == "table") and (getmetatable(T) == p) then
          R = T
          break
        end
      end
    else
    end
  else
  end
  local function T()
    local L = R and rawget(R, "_remoteClock")
    if type(L) ~= "table" then
      return true
    end
    local k, P, z = rawget(L, "_position"), rawget(L, "_latestTicks"), rawget(L, "_renderOffsetTicks")
    if type(k) ~= "number" then
      return true
    elseif type(P) ~= "number" then
      return true
    elseif type(z) ~= "number" then
      return true
    end
    local n = rawget(L, "_jitterTicks")
    local K, S = (if type(n) ~= "number" then 0 else if n ~= n then 0 else if n < 0 then 0 else n) + 2, rawget(L, "_horizonTicks")
    K = if type(S) == "number" then if S > 0 then if S < K then S else K else K else K
    return ((k - z) - P) <= K
  end
  local function L(k)
    local P = k.VisualRoot
    if typeof(P) == "Vector3" then
      return P
    end
    P = k.Actor
    if type(F) == "table" then
      local k, z = pcall(F.simulationToVisualRootPosition, P.Position, P.DuckAmount)
      if k then
        if typeof(z) == "Vector3" then
          return z
        end
      end
    end
    return P.Position
  end
  local function F(k, P)
    local z = #k
    local n = k[z]
    local K, S = n.Actor.Generation, n.Actor.ActorId
    if P >= n.ServerTick then
      return L(n), n.Actor.LookYaw
    end
    for e = z - 1, 1, -1 do
      n = k[e]
      if n.ServerTick <= P then
        local z = k[e + 1]
        if n.Actor.Generation ~= K then
          return nil, nil
        elseif n.Actor.ActorId ~= S then
          return nil, nil
        elseif z.Actor.Generation ~= K then
          return nil, nil
        elseif z.Actor.ActorId ~= S then
          return nil, nil
        end
        local k = z.ServerTick - n.ServerTick
        local K, S, e = ((k > 0) and ((P - n.ServerTick) / k)) or 0, n.Actor.LookYaw, z.Actor.LookYaw
        return L(n):Lerp(L(z), K), S + (((((e - S) + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586) - 3.141592653589793) * K)
      end
    end
    return nil, nil
  end
  local function L(k)
    local P, z = R and rawget(R, "_remoteClock"), R and rawget(R, "_remoteBuffer")
    if type(P) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif type(z) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    local n, K = k.player
    if b.is(n) then
      local b, S = n:GetAttribute("ActorId"), rawget(z, "_actorIdToKey")
      K = (((b ~= nil) and (type(S) == "table")) and S[b]) or nil
    else
      K = if n then n.UserId else K
    end
    n = rawget(z, "_actors")
    local b = (((K ~= nil) and (type(n) == "table")) and n[K]) or nil
    n = ((type(b) == "table") and b.Samples) or nil
    if type(n) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif #n == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    local K, S = pcall(R.getRemoteViewTick, R)
    local e, C, s = rawget(z, "_latestServerTick"), rawget(P, "_latestAtSeconds"), rawget(P, "_hz")
    if K then
      if type(S) ~= "number" then
        return nil
      elseif type(e) ~= "number" then
        return nil
      elseif type(C) ~= "number" then
        return nil
      elseif type(s) ~= "number" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    z = n[#n]
    local r, yO = z.ServerTick, b.Activity
    b = ((type(yO) == "table") and yO[#yO]) or nil
    r = if type(b) == "table" then if b.Active then if b.Generation == z.Actor.Generation then if b.ActorId == z.Actor.ActorId then if type(b.ServerTick) == "number" then if b.ServerTick > r then b.ServerTick else r else r else r else r else r else r
    b = rawget(P, "_maxBehindTicks")
    b = if type(b) ~= "number" then 12 else if b ~= b then 12 else if b < 2 then 12 else b
    yO = rawget(P, "_jitterTicks")
    yO = if type(yO) ~= "number" then 0 else if yO ~= yO then 0 else if yO < 0 then 0 else yO
    P = U(S, ((e + ((H:GetNetworkPing() + U(os.clock() - C, 0)) * s)) - b) + yO)
    P = if P > r then r else P
    P = if P > e then e else P
    if g(P - S) < 0.25 then
      return nil
    end
    z, C, K = k.char and A.part(k.char, "HumanoidRootPart"), F(n, P)
    if z then
      if C then
        if type(K) ~= "number" then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    return P, (CFrame.new(C) * CFrame.Angles(0, K, 0)) * z.CFrame:Inverse()
  end
  local function b(F, k, P)
    o.tick = nil
    if F.rewound then
      return
    elseif k then
      if type(P) ~= "number" then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    F.rewound = true
    local z = F.shot
    if type(z) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif typeof(z.origin) ~= "Vector3" then
      return

  local function p(c, M, L, k)
    if u.alive then

        return

    else
      return
    end

    z = task.defer(function()

      if (if n then P ~= u.generation else not n) or not Z.double_tap then
        u.pending[z] = nil
        return

        u.pending[z] = nil
        return

        u.pending[z] = nil
        return
      end

      if n > 0 then
        task.wait(n + 0.001)
        local K = u.alive
        if (if K then P ~= u.generation else not K) or not Z.double_tap then
          u.pending[z] = nil
          return
        elseif B.held() ~= c then
          u.pending[z] = nil
          return
        elseif u.manual[c] then
          u.pending[z] = nil
          return
        end
      end
      n = false
      if L or k then
        local P, K, S
        if k then
          P, K, S = F(c, k)
        else
        end
        if S then
        else
          P, K, S = F(c)
        end
        if S then
          u.bind(P, K, S)
          n = true
        else
          if L then
            u.pending[z] = nil
            return
          end
        end
      else
      end
      if u.manual[c] then
        if n then
          u.unbind()
        end
        u.pending[z] = nil
        return
      end
      local L = u.force(c, M, "double")
      if n then
        u.unbind()
      end
      u.pending[z] = nil
      if L then
        u.last_shot = os.clock()
      end
    end)
    u.pending[z] = c
  end

  local function Y(p)
    local c = O and O.Inventory
    local O = c and c.ReloadWeapon

        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local M = p.Properties
    if type(M) ~= "table" then
      return false
    elseif M.Class ~= "Weapon" then
      return false
    elseif M.RechargeTime then
      return false
    end
    local L, k, P = tonumber(M.Rounds), tonumber(p.Rounds), tonumber(p.Capacity)
    if L then
      if k then
        if P then
          if k >= L then
            return false
          end
        else
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local z = p.Identifier
    if type(z) ~= "string" then
      return false
    end
    local n = l:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Deathmatch"
    if P <= 0 then
      if not (n) then
        return false
      end
    end
    if p.IsChargeFiring then
      q(p.cancelRevolverCharge, p, false, false)
    end
    local K = c.CreateMagazine

      if type(K.Send) == "function" then
        pcall(K.Send, z)
      end
    end
    if not (pcall(O.Send, {Identifier = z, Rounds = k, Capacity = P})) then
      return false
    end
    if n and (tonumber(M.ReloadAnimationCount) == 1) then
      p.Rounds = L
      p.Capacity = tonumber(M.Capacity) or P
    else
      c = g(L - k)
      if (P - c) > 0 then
        p.Rounds = L
        p.Capacity = U(0, P - c)
      else
        p.Rounds = k + P
        p.Capacity = 0
      end
    end
    p.CurrentReloadIdentity = nil
    p.IsReloading = false
    p.IsShooting = false
    p.CurrentWalkSpeedOverride = nil
    z = rawget(p, "ReloadTrackFinishedConnection")
    if z then

      p.ReloadTrackFinishedConnection = nil
    end

    if Q then
      if type(Q.clearHint) == "function" then
        q(Q.clearHint, Q, "Reload")
      end
    end
    return true
  end

  local w = {rt = nil, gen = nil, tick = nil}
  w.seen = -math.huge
  x.tick = function(h)
    if not (u.alive) then
      return
    end
    local d, _ = os.clock(), h or v.runtime()
    local b = _ and rawget(_, "_config")
    _ = ((type(b) == "table") and tonumber(b.StepSeconds)) or 0.016666666666666666
    if _ then
      if _ <= 0 then
        return
      elseif _ ~= _ then
        return
      elseif _ == math.huge then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if h then
      local v, l = rawget(h, "_mapping"), rawget(h, "_lastPredictedServerTick")
      if type(v) ~= "table" then
        return
      elseif type(l) ~= "number" then
        return
      end
      b = v.Generation
      if (w.rt ~= h) or (w.gen ~= b) then
        w.rt = h
        w.gen = b
        w.tick = nil
      end
      w.seen = d
      if w.tick == l then
        return
      end
      w.tick = l
    elseif (d - w.seen) < (_ * 2) then
      return
    end
    if not (Z.rapid) then
      if V then
        if Z.on then
          if Z.auto_shoot then
            if u.held() then
              return
            end
          else
            return
          end
        else
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      x.auto(true)
      return
    end
    b = B.ensure()
    if not b then
      return
    end
    u.rapid_gap = t.server(b.Properties) + _
    h, _ = u.held(), u.manual[b]
    if _ then
      if h then
      else
        u.manual[b] = nil
        u.last_target[b] = nil
        _ = nil
      end
    else
    end
    if A.alive(H.Character) then
      if not (y(b)) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    if not (t.ready(b, nil, d, u.rapid_gap)) then
      return
    end
    if h then
      if b.Properties.Automatic then
        return
      elseif not (u.can_force(b, "rapid")) then
        return
      end
      if _ then
      else
        _ = {args = X, generation = u.generation}
        u.manual[b] = _
      end
      W(b, _)
    else
      x.auto(true)
    end
  end
  m = i.mv_runtime
  if type(m) == "table" then
    if type(rawget(m, "_stepPrediction")) == "function" then
      I = G.field(m, "_stepPrediction", function(y)
        return function(i, ...)
          local t, Z = y(i, ...)
          if t then
            pcall(x.tick, i)
          end
          return t, Z
        end
      end)
      x.ticked = rawget(m, "_stepPrediction") ~= I
    end
  end
  G.teardown(function()
    x.ticked = false
    w.rt = nil
    w.tick = nil
    w.gen = nil
    j.char = nil
    u.rapid_gap = nil
  end)
  return x
end

-- Module aF
modules.aF = function()
  local y = modules.load("b")
  local G = modules.load("a")
  local i = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  local u, j = math.floor, {}

    return setmetatable({order = w or 999}, j)
  end
  j.build = function(w)
    local t = w.gui
    if t then
      if t.Parent then
        return true
      end
    end
    t = y.screen(w.order)
    if not (t) then
      return false
    end
    G.own(t)

    G.Rotation = 0

    Z.Thickness = 1
    Z.Color = i
    Z.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
    Z.Parent = y

    w.edge = h
    w.fill = G
    w.size = nil

    w.col = nil
    w.col2 = nil
    w.grad = nil
    w.filled = nil
    w.fcol = nil
    w.fcol2 = nil
    w.fgrad = nil
    w.shown = nil
    return true
  end
  j.hide = function(y)
    local G = y.frame
    if G then
      if y.shown ~= false then
        G.Visible = false
        y.shown = false
      end
    end
  end
  j.show = function(y, G, w, t, Z)
    if t ~= t then
      y:hide()
      return
    elseif t <= 0.5 then
      y:hide()
      return
    end
    if not (y:build()) then
      return
    end
    local h, A, B = y.frame, y.stroke, u((t * 2) + 0.5)
    if B ~= y.size then
      y.size = B
      h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(B, B)
    end
    if (G ~= y.x) or (w ~= y.y) then
      y.x = G
      y.y = w
      h.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(G, w)
    end
    G, B, w = Z.fov_col, Z.fov_col2, Z.fov_grad == true
    if w ~= y.grad then
      y.grad = w
      y.col = nil
      y.col2 = nil
      y.edge.Enabled = w
      if w then
        A.Color = i
      end
    end
    if w then
      if (G ~= y.col) or (B ~= y.col2) then
        y.col = G
        y.col2 = B
        y.edge.Color = ColorSequence.new(G, B)
      end
    elseif G ~= y.col then
      y.col = G
      A.Color = G
    end
    w = Z.fov_fill == true
    t = w and (Z.fov_fill_grad == true)
    if (w ~= y.filled) or (t ~= y.fgrad) then
      y.filled = w
      y.fgrad = t
      y.fcol = nil
      y.fcol2 = nil
      y.fill.Enabled = t
      h.BackgroundTransparency = (w and 0.65) or 1
      if t then
        h.BackgroundColor3 = i
      end
    end
    if w then
      A, G = Z.fov_fill_col, Z.fov_fill_col2
      if t then
        if (A ~= y.fcol) or (G ~= y.fcol2) then
          y.fcol = A
          y.fcol2 = G
          y.fill.Color = ColorSequence.new(A, G)
        end
      elseif A ~= y.fcol then
        y.fcol = A
        h.BackgroundColor3 = A
      end
    end
    if y.shown ~= true then
      h.Visible = true
      y.shown = true
    end
  end
  j.destroy = function(y)
    local G = y.gui
    if G then
      pcall(G.Destroy, G)
    end
    y.gui = nil
    y.frame = nil
    y.stroke = nil
    y.edge = nil
    y.fill = nil
    y.shown = nil
  end
  return j
end

modules.aG = function()
  local y, G, i, u = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("aF"), modules.load("as")
  local j = modules.load("ax")
  local w = y.workspace
  local t = math.tan
  local Z = math.rad
  local h = i.new(999)
  local function i()
    local A = j.weapon
    if A then
      if A.IsDestroyed then
        return false
      elseif not (A.IsEquipped) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local j = A.Properties
    if j then
      if j.Class ~= "Weapon" then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    return A.Name ~= "Zeus x27"
  end
  y = {step = function()
    if u.on then
      if u.draw_fov then
        if not (i()) then
          h:hide()
          return
        end
      else
        h:hide()
        return
      end
    else
      h:hide()
      return
    end
    local i = w.CurrentCamera
    if not (i) then
      return
    end
    local j = tonumber(u.fov) or 0
    if j <= 0 then
      h:hide()
      return
    elseif j >= 360 then
      h:hide()
      return
    end
    local w = i.ViewportSize
    local A = (t(Z(j * 0.5)) * (w.Y * 0.5)) / t(Z(i.FieldOfView * 0.5))
    h:show(w.X * 0.5, w.Y * 0.5, A, u)
  end, unload = function()
    h:destroy()
  end}
  G.teardown(y.unload)
  return y
end

      return

      return w:get("trig." .. Z, j)
    end
    local w = j ~= nil
    i.on = (w and t("on")) or false
    i.team_check = t("team")
    i.auto_wall = (w and t("aw")) or false
    i.auto_revolver = (w and t("autorev")) or false
    i.auto_switch = (w and t("autoswitch")) or false
    i.boxes = G.boxes(t("hb"))
    i.prefer = t("prefer")
    i.min_damage = t("mindmg")
    i.wall_min_damage = t("awmindmg")
    i.hit_chance = t("hc")
    i.draw_fov = (w and t("dfov")) or false
    i.fov_col = t("dfov_col")
    i.fov_grad = t("dfov_grad")
    i.fov_col2 = t("dfov_col2")
    i.fov_fill = t("dfov_fill")
    i.fov_fill_col = t("dfov_fcol")
    i.fov_fill_grad = t("dfov_fgrad")
    i.fov_fill_col2 = t("dfov_fcol2")
  end
  u.refresh = function()
    u.apply(u.active)
  end
  u.activate = function(j)
    local w = G.find_type(j)
    if u.weapon == j then
      if u.active == w then
        return
      end
    end
    u.weapon = j
    u.active = w
    u.apply(w)
  end
  y.teardown(function()
    u.weapon = nil
    u.active = nil
    u.ui = nil
    i.on = false
    i.draw_fov = false
  end)

-- Module aI
modules.aI = function()
  local y, G, i = modules.load("b"), modules.load("j"), modules.load("as")
  local u, j, w = G.camera, y.getups, math.rad
  local t = math.min
  local Z = math.max
  local h = math.clamp
  local A, B, d, _ = Vector3.zero
  y, G = ((type(u) == "table") and rawget(u, "toWeaponFirePosition")) or nil, ((type(u) == "table") and rawget(u, "getWeaponKickRotation")) or nil
  if ((type(y) == "function") and (type(G) == "function")) and (type(j) == "function") then
    local b, x = pcall(j, y)
    local y, v = pcall(j, G)
    if ((b and y) and (type(x) == "table")) and (type(v) == "table") then
      u = nil
      for y, y in v, nil, nil do
        if type(y) == "table" then
          u = y
          break
        end
      end
      for y, y in x, nil, nil do
        if type(y) == "function" then
          B = y
        else
          if ((type(y) == "table") and (rawget(y, "p") ~= nil)) and (rawget(y, "d") ~= nil) then
            if y == u then
              d = y
            else
              _ = y
            end
          else
          end
        end
      end
    else
    end
  else
  end
  local y = {ok = false, origin = A}
  y.dir = Vector3.zAxis
  y.up = Vector3.yAxis
  y.right = Vector3.xAxis
  y.half = 0
  local function G(u)
    if B then
      if d then
        if _ then
          local j, b = d.p, _.p
          d.p, _.p = A, A
          local A, x = pcall(B, 1)
          d.p, _.p = j, b
          if A then
            if typeof(x) == "CFrame" then
              return x
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return u.CFrame
  end
  local function u(j, A, B)
    local d = j.Bullet
    if type(d) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    elseif d.IsDestroyed then
      return nil
    end
    local _, b = A.Spread, A.FireModes
    if type(b) == "table" then
      local x = b.Primary
      x = if A.ShootingOptions == "Revolver" then if B then x else b.Secondary or x else x
      _ = if type(x) == "table" then if type(x.Spread) == "table" then x.Spread else _ else _
    else
    end
    b = (type(_) == "table") and _.Range
    if typeof(b) ~= "NumberRange" then
      return nil
    end
    local x, v = pcall(d.getBaseSpreadForConfig, d, _)
    local H, l = pcall(d.getMovementSpreadForConfig, d, _)
    if x then
      if H then
        if type(v) ~= "number" then
          return nil
        elseif type(l) ~= "number" then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    H, x = tonumber(_.MovementMultiplier) or 1, A.AimingOptions == "SniperScope"
    B = (((H == 2) and 6) or ((H == 3) and 12)) or 15
    A = if i.no_spread and (d:getTrueSpread() == 0) then 0 else (if x then if j.IsAiming then v else if v < B then h(B, b.Min, b.Max) else v else v) + l
    return t(if x then if j.IsAiming then if j.Name == "AWP" then if (tick() - (tonumber(j.ScopeStartTick) or 0)) < 0.2 then Z(A, B) else A else A else A else A, 69)
  end
  y.update = function(i, j, t, Z)
    local h = u(i, j, Z)
    if not (h) then
      y.ok = false
      return false
    end
    j = G(t)
    y.origin = j.Position
    y.dir = j.LookVector
    y.up = j.UpVector
    y.right = j.RightVector
    y.half = w(h * 0.5)
    y.ok = true
    return true
  end
  return y
end

-- Module aJ
modules.aJ = function()
  local y = modules.load("b")
  local G, i, u = modules.load("f"), modules.load("a"), modules.load("h")
  local j, w = modules.load("j"), modules.load("aj")
  local t, Z = modules.load("T"), modules.load("U")
  local h, A = modules.load("au"), modules.load("at")
  local B = modules.load("av")
  local d = modules.load("ax")
  local _ = modules.load("aC")
  local b = modules.load("aB")
  local x = modules.load("aH")
  local v = modules.load("aI")
  local H = y.lp
  local l = y.workspace
  local W = t.probe
  local q = t.through
  local t = j.ray_ignore
  local J = j.fire_ready
  local j = G.trim
  local G = h.groups
  local D = h.group_of
  local m = h.damage_key
  local Y = h.teams
  local h = os.clock
  local O = math.sin
  local Q = math.cos
  local F = math.tan
  local I = math.asin
  local E = math.acos
  local V = math.min
  local N = math.max
  local a = math.clamp
  local U = math.ceil
  local g = math.huge
  local X = Vector3.zero
  local o = RaycastParams.new()
  o.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  o.IgnoreWater = false
  o.CollisionGroup = "Bullet"
  local R = y.weak()
  local p = y.weak()
  local c, M, T = y.weak(), {}
  local L, k, P, z = 0
  local n, K, S, e, C = 0, 0, 0, 1
  local s, r, yO = 0, X
  local fO, GO = 0, {}
  local function iO()
    local uO, jO = h(), H.Character
    if T then
      if jO == k then
        if (uO - L) < 0.5 then
          local wO = T
          return wO
        end
      end
    end
    L, k = uO, jO
    if type(t) == "function" then
      local L, uO = pcall(t)
      if L then
        if type(uO) == "table" then
          T = uO
          return uO
        end
      end
    end
    local t, L, uO = 0, l.CurrentCamera, l:FindFirstChild("Debris")
    if L then
      t = 1
      M[t] = L
    else
    end
    if uO then
      t += 1
      M[t] = uO
    else
    end
    if jO then
      t += 1
      M[t] = jO
    else
    end
    T = j(M, t)
    L = T
    return L
  end
  local function t(L)
    local uO = p[L]
    if uO ~= nil then
      return uO, c[L]
    end
    local uO, jO = A.effective_armor(L)
    p[L] = uO
    c[L] = jO
    return uO, jO
  end
  local function A(L, uO, jO, wO)
    local tO = P
    local ZO = tO.DamagePerPart
    local hO = ((type(ZO) == "table") and ZO[uO]) or 0
    if type(hO) ~= "number" then
      return 0
    elseif hO <= 0 then
      return 0
    end
    ZO = hO * ((tonumber(tO.RangeModifier) or 1) ^ N(0, jO / 100))
    ZO = if wO > 0 then ZO * (tonumber(tO.WallbangMultiplier) or 1) else ZO
    jO, hO = t(L)
    if (jO > 0) and ((uO ~= "Head") or hO) then
      L = ZO * a(tonumber(tO.ArmorPenetration) or 1, 0, 1)
      ZO = (N(0, if ((ZO - L) * 0.5) > jO then ZO - (jO / 0.5) else L))
    else
    end
    tO = e
    return ZO * tO
  end
  local function t(L)
    local uO = L.Name
    L = D[uO]
    if L then
      return L, m[uO]
    end
    if uO == "HumanoidRootPart" then
      L = (z.chest and "chest") or "stomach"
      return L, "Torso"
    end
    return nil, nil
  end
  local function D(m)
    return (m.Transparency > 0) or (m.LocalTransparencyModifier > 0)
  end
  local function m(L, uO, jO, wO, tO, ZO)
    local hO = L.Parent
    L = R[hO]
    if L then
      if not (z[uO]) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    if A(L, jO, wO, tO) < ((ZO and b.min_damage) or b.wall_min_damage) then
      return nil
    end
    return hO, uO, wO
  end
  local function A(L, uO)
    local jO = W(L, uO * n, o, T)
    local W = jO.instance
    if not (W) then
      return nil
    end
    local o, wO, tO = jO.position, t(W)
    if wO then
      return m(W, wO, tO, (o - L).Magnitude, 0, true)
    end
    wO, jO = b.auto_wall, D(W)
    if jO then
    elseif wO then
    else
      return nil
    end
    W, o = q(L, uO, S, T, nil, K), 0
    for q = 1, #W, 2 do
      tO = W[q]
      uO = tO.instance
      if uO then
        local W, q = t(uO)
        if W then
          return m(uO, W, q, (tO.position - L).Magnitude, o, jO)
        end
        o += 1
        if jO then
          if D(uO) then
          else
            if not wO then
              return nil
            end
            jO = false
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function t(W, q, D, m)
    if q:IsDescendantOf(l) then
      if q:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= false then
        return false
      elseif q:GetAttribute("Invincible") == true then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    if W:GetAttribute("Invincible") == true then
      return false
    elseif W:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
      return false
    end
    local o = q:GetAttribute("Health")
    if typeof(o) ~= "number" then
      return false
    elseif o <= 0 then
      return false
    elseif B.shielded(q) then
      return false
    end
    if b.team_check then
      o = W:GetAttribute("Team")
      if D then
        if o then
          if Y[D] then
            if not (Y[o]) then
              return false
            end
          else
            return false
          end
        else
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
      if not (m) then
        if D == o then
          return false
        end
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local function W(q, D, m)
    table.clear(R)
    local Y, o, L, uO, jO = n + 5, H:GetAttribute("Team"), l:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Deathmatch", u.all()
    local u, wO, tO = 0, g, 0
    for g = 1, jO, 1 do
      local jO = uO[g]
      if jO ~= H then
        g = jO.Character
        local uO = g and B.part(g, "HumanoidRootPart")
        if uO then
          local ZO = uO.Position - q
          local q = ZO.Magnitude
          if q > 0.5 then
            if q <= Y then
              local Y = E(a(D:Dot(ZO) / q, -1, 1))
              if Y <= (m + I(V(1, 4.5 / q))) then
                if t(jO, g, o, L) then
                  R[g] = jO
                  u = if q > u then q else u
                  if Y < wO then
                    wO, tO = Y, q
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return u, tO
  end
  local function u(t, q, D, m, Y, g)
    local o, L, uO, jO, wO = v.up, v.right, O(D), Q(D), true
    for tO = 1, m, 1 do
      D = ((tO - Y) * 6.283185307179586) / m
      local m, m = A(t, (q * jO) + (((o * Q(D)) + (L * O(D))) * uO))
      if not (m) then
        return false, false
      end
      wO = if m ~= g then false else wO
    end
    return true, wO
  end
  local function t(q, D, m, Y, g, o, L)
    local uO, jO, wO, tO = v.up, v.right, g - 1e-06, a(U((Y * F(m)) / 0.3), 2, 6)
    local ZO, hO, AO, BO = 1 / tO, 1, 0
    g = 0
    for dO = tO, 1, -1 do
      local tO = ((dO - 0.5) * m) * ZO
      local m, _O, bO = O(tO), Q(tO), a(U(((Y * F(tO)) * 6.283185307179586) / 0.3), 6, 24)
      local Y, xO = ZO / bO, (dO % 2) * 0.5
      for ZO = 1, bO, 1 do
        dO = ((ZO - xO) * 6.283185307179586) / bO
        hO -= Y
        ZO, tO = A(q, (D * _O) + (((uO * Q(dO)) + (jO * O(dO))) * m))
        if ZO then
          AO, BO, g = AO + Y, BO or ZO, if tO == o then g + Y else g
        else
        end
        if (AO + hO) < wO then
          return nil, false
        end
        if L then
          if g >= wO then
            return BO, true
          elseif AO >= wO then
            if (g + hO) < wO then
              return BO, false
            end
          end
        elseif AO >= wO then
          return BO, true
        end
      end
    end
    if AO >= wO then
      return BO, if L then g >= wO else not L
    end
    return nil, false
  end
  local function q(D)
    local m = h()
    local Y = m - s
    if C then
      if Y > 0 then
        if Y < 0.1 then
          local O = r
          r = O:Lerp(C:Cross(D) / Y, V(Y / 0.05, 1))
        else
          r = X
        end
      else
        r = X
      end
    else
      r = X
    end
    C, s = D, m
  end
  local function D(m, Y, O, Q, g, o)
    local L, s, uO, jO, wO = r:Cross(O), Q * o, G[g], 0.15
    for G = 1, #uO, 1 do
      Q = B.part(m, uO[G])
      if Q then
        G = Q.Position - Y
        o = G.Magnitude
        if o > 0.5 then
          local uO = Q.Size
          local Q = I(V(1, (V(uO.X, uO.Y, uO.Z) * 0.5) / o))
          if Q >= s then
            uO = G / o
            local G = a(O:Dot(uO), -1, 1)
            local I, V = (E(G) + s) - Q, uO - (O * G)
            G = V.Magnitude
            if I > 0 then
              if G > 1e-06 then
                local O = L:Dot(V) / G
                if O > 0 then
                  if I <= (jO * O) then
                    local G = I / O
                    jO, wO = G, uO
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    if not (wO) then
      yO = nil
      return false
    end
    o = h()
    if yO then
      if (o - fO) > 0.1 then
        yO = o
      end
    else
      yO = o
    end
    fO = o
    if ((o - yO) + jO) > 0.15 then
      return false
    end
    L, o = A(Y, wO)
    return (L == m) and (o == g)
  end
  local function G(m, Y, O)
    local Q, I, E, V = v.dir, v.half, Z.origin(O)
    E, P = if V then E else v.origin, m
    z = b.boxes
    n = tonumber(m.Range) or 500
    O, V = W(E, Q, I)
    if O <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    table.clear(p)
    table.clear(c)
    iO()
    K = O + 6
    S = tonumber(m.Penetration) or 0
    e = N(tonumber(m.BulletsPerShot) or 1, 1)
    m = b.prefer
    local Z, W, g, o = z[m] == true, A(E, Q)
    O = o or V
    o = O * F(I)
    if (Y >= 0.999999) or (o <= 0.02) then
      if not (W) then
        return false
      end
      V = g == m
      if o > 0.02 then
        local A = a(U((o * 6.283185307179586) / 0.3), 6, 24)
        local F, L = u(E, Q, I, A, 0, m)
        if not (F) then
          return false
        end
        V = V and L
        if o > 0.45 then
          F, L = u(E, Q, I * 0.5, N(4, U(A * 0.5)), 0.5, m)
          if not F then
            return false
          end
          V = V and L
        else
        end
      else
      end
      if V then
        return true
      elseif Z then
      else
        return true
      end
      return not D(W, E, Q, I, m, Y)
    end
    g, o = t(E, Q, I, O, Y, m, Z)
    if not g then
      return false
    end
    if o then
      return true
    end
    return not D(W or g, E, Q, I, m, Y)
  end
  local function u(t, Z)
    if t.IsShooting then
      return false
    elseif t.IsBurstShooting then
      return false
    elseif t.IsAdjustingSuppressor then
      return false
    end
    if t.IsChargeFiring then
      if not (_.held(t)) then
        return false
      end
    end
    if t.IsReloading then
      if Z.MuzzleType ~= "ShotGun" then
        return false
      end
    end
    Z = t.Rounds
    if type(Z) ~= "number" then
      return false
    elseif Z <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    if w.manual[t] then
      return false
    elseif w.forcing[t] then
      return false
    elseif w.has_pending(t) then
      return false
    end
    return not w.held()
  end
  local function t(Z, A, W)
    local D, m, Y, O, Q = tonumber(Z.ShotSeq), tonumber(Z.Rounds), if W then _.fire(Z) else if A.ShootingOptions == "Revolver" then _.slam(Z) else y.plain(Z.shoot, Z), tonumber(Z.ShotSeq), tonumber(Z.Rounds)
    W = (D and O) and (O > D)
    W = W or (if m then if Q then Q < m else W else W)
    if Y then
      if W then
        w.last_shot = h()
      end
    end
  end
  local function y()
    if not (J) then
      return false
    end
    local Z = d.ensure()
    x.activate(Z)
    if b.on then
      if not (Z) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local A = Z.Properties
    if type(A) ~= "table" then
      return false
    elseif A.Class ~= "Weapon" then
      return false
    elseif Z.Name == "Zeus x27" then
      return false
    end
    local d = l.CurrentCamera
    if d then
      if not (B.alive(H.Character)) then
        return false
      end
    else
      return false
    end
    local B, x, H = A.ShootingOptions == "Revolver", b.auto_revolver and not b.auto_switch, _.ready(Z)
    local l = (if H then not H else B) and (x or not _.can_slam(Z, h()))
    if not (v.update(Z, A, d, H or l)) then
      return false
    end
    q(v.dir)
    local W = a((tonumber(b.hit_chance) or 100) * 0.01, 0.01, 1)
    if l then
      if not (x) then
        if _.held(Z) then
          if not (w.held()) then
            if G(A, W, d) then
              _.engage(Z, h())
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return true
    end
    if u(Z, A) then
      if G(A, W, d) then
        if B then
          _.spot(h())
        end
        t(Z, A, H)
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  GO.step = function()
    v.ok = false
    if not (y()) then
      C, yO, r = nil, nil, X
    end
  end
  i.teardown(function()
    v.ok = false
    table.clear(R)
    table.clear(p)
    table.clear(c)
    j(M, 0)
    T, k, P, z, C, yO, r = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, X
  end)
  return GO
end

-- Module aL
modules.aL = function()
  local y = modules.load("b")
  local G, i = modules.load("q"), modules.load("a")
  local u, j = modules.load("j"), G.world
  local w = y.lp
  local t = u.inventory
  local Z = u.char_resolver
  local h = u.crosshair
  local A, B, d, _, b = u.runstep, {}, {}
  local u, x, v = false
  local H = 0
  local function l()
    if j.force_xhair then
      if not (Z.isAliveCharacter(w.Character)) then
        return
      end
    else
      return
    end
    local w = t.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement()
    local t = (type(w) == "table") and rawget(w, "Properties")
    if type(t) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif w.IsEquipped ~= true then
      return
    elseif t.Class ~= "Weapon" then
      return
    elseif t.ShowCrosshair ~= false then
      return
    end
    local Z = B[t]
    if Z then
    else
      Z = table.freeze(setmetatable({ShowCrosshair = true}, {__index = t}))
      B[t] = Z
    end
    rawset(w, "Properties", Z)
    _, b = w, t
  end
  local function w()
    local t, Z = _, b
    if not (t) then
      return
    end
    _, b = nil, nil
    if rawget(t, "Properties") == B[Z] then
      rawset(t, "Properties", Z)
    end
  end
  local function t(Z)
    if v then
      local _ = v
      return _
    end
    if type(Z) ~= "function" then
      return nil
    end
    local _ = loadstring("local run, enter, leave, guard, raise = ...\nreturn function(...)\n\009guard(enter)\n\009local ok, err = guard(run, ...)\n\009guard(leave)\n\009if not ok then\n\009\009raise(err, 0)\n\009end\nend", "=bs_xhair")
    if type(_) ~= "function" then
      return nil
    end
    setfenv(_, {})
    local b
    b, x = _(Z, l, w, pcall, error), Z
    v = b
    Z = v
    return Z
  end
  local function Z()
    local _, b = (type(A) == "table") and rawget(A, "Unbind"), y.getups
    if type(_) ~= "function" then
      return nil
    elseif type(b) ~= "function" then
      return nil
    end
    local A, l = pcall(b, _)
    if A then
      if type(l) ~= "table" then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    for A, A in l, nil, nil do
      _ = (type(A) == "table") and rawget(A, "RenderStepped")
      A = (type(_) == "table") and rawget(_, "BindingsByName")
      if type(A) == "table" then
        return A
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function A()
    if not (v) then
      return
    end
    local _ = Z()
    local Z = _ and rawget(_, "UI.Crosshair.Update")
    if type(Z) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif Z.Callback == v then
      return
    elseif type(Z.Callback) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    Z.Callback = v
    if not (d[Z]) then
      d[Z] = true
      i.teardown(function()
        if Z.Callback == v then
          Z.Callback = x
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  local function Z()
    if u then
      return
    elseif type(h) ~= "table" then
      return
    elseif type(setfenv) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    u = true
    i.field(h, "UpdateCrosshair", t)
    A()
    i.connect(y.run.Heartbeat, function()
      if not (j.force_xhair) then
        return
      end
      local y = os.clock()
      if y < H then
        return
      end
      H = y + 1
      A()
    end)
  end
  G = {set = function(y)
    j.force_xhair = y == true
    if j.force_xhair then
      Z()
    end
  end}
  i.teardown(function()
    j.force_xhair = false
    w()
    table.clear(B)
  end)
  return G
end
