            local u, c = (p and p:GetBoundingBox().Position) or (R * CFrame.new(0.5, -0.3, -3)).Position, (R * CFrame.new(D.X, D.Y, D.Z)).Position
            Q:pin(CFrame.lookAt(c, u, R.UpVector))
          end
          q()
          task.delay(0.2, q)
        else
          Q:lens((H.side and 26) or 24)
          Q.fill = (H.side and 1.45) or 1.05
          Q.xfill = 0.92
          Q.pad = 0.2
          if X then
            o, g = H.model:GetBoundingBox()
            local u = (H.side and (b + 0.42)) or (((g.Z > g.X) and ((b * 0.5) - 0.35)) or -0.35)
            Q.base_yaw = u
            Q.base_pitch = (H.side and 0.05) or 0.22
          end
          Q:set(H.model, not X, ((#H.focus > 0) and H.focus) or nil)
          if H.side then
            A.animate(H.model, H.side)
          end
        end
        O.Text = ""
      end
      local function u(A, b, q, D)
        h = true
        x += 1
        local g = x
        if not (H) then
          O.Text = "loading model"
        end
        task.spawn(function()
          local X = F(A, b)
          h = false
          if (g ~= x) or not W.Parent then
            if X then
              X.model:Destroy()
            end
            return
          end
          if X then
            w = q
            U(X, D)
          else
            O.Text = "model unavailable"
          end
        end)
      end
      local function A(b)
        if not (B[b]) then
          return false
        end
        if b == "tool_chams" then
          local b = B.tool_chams_kinds
          local W = (b == nil) or (b[t.kind_of(H.gun)] == true)
          return W
        end
        return true
      end
      local function t(b)
        table.clear(Y)
        local W, q = H.parts, H.tags
        for D = 1, #W, 1 do
          local O = W[D]
          D = q[O]
          local W = Y[D]
          if W == nil then
            W = false
            if A(D) then
              local A, q, F, U = Z.base(D, b)
              W = {col = A, mat = q, glass = F, fade = U, edge = A:Lerp(d, 0.6)}
            else
            end
            Y[D] = W
          else
          end
          if W then
            local A = l[O]
            if A then
            else
              A = {mat = O.Material, col = O.Color, refl = O.Reflectance, t = O.Transparency, sa = {}, decals = {}}
              if O:IsA("MeshPart") then
                A.tex = O.TextureID
                O.TextureID = ""
              end
              for d, d in O:GetChildren() do
                if d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                  A.sa[#A.sa + 1] = d
                  d.Parent = nil
                end
              end
              l[O] = A
            end
            local d, b = (W.glass and 1) or A.refl, W.fade
            local l = (b and (((b > A.t) and b) or A.t)) or A.t
            if O.Material ~= W.mat then
              O.Material = W.mat
            end
            if O.Color ~= W.col then
              O.Color = W.col
            end
            if O.Reflectance ~= d then
              O.Reflectance = d
            end
            if O.Transparency ~= l then
              O.Transparency = l
            end
            l = W.glass and (D == "body_chams")
            for d, d in O:GetChildren() do
              if d:IsA("Decal") then
                if l and (A.decals[d] == nil) then
                  A.decals[d] = d.Transparency
                  d.Transparency = 1
                elseif l then
                elseif A.decals[d] ~= nil then
                  d.Transparency = A.decals[d]
                  A.decals[d] = nil
                end
              end
            end
            if W.glass then
              l = J[O]
              if l then
              else
                l = Z.shell(O)
                if l then
                  l.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                  l.Size = O.Size + v
                  l.Parent = Q.back.world
                  J[O] = l
                end
              end
              if l then
                l.CFrame = O.CFrame
                if l.Color ~= W.edge then
                  l.Color = W.edge
                end
              end
            elseif J[O] then
              N(O)
            end
          else
            V(O)
            N(O)
          end
        end
      end
      i.connect(y.run.RenderStepped, function()
        local y = j()
        local j = y - E
        E = y
        if _:isopen() then
          if not (Q:shown()) then
            return
          end
        else
          return
        end
        if (y - I) > 0.4 then
          if not (h) then
            I = y
            local Z = B.preview_item
            local h, A = G(Z)
            if h then
              if h ~= w then
                u(Z, A, h, (w == nil) or (w:split("|")[1] ~= Z))
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if H then
          Q.spin = B.preview_item_spin == true
          Q:turn(j, 0.6)
          t(y)
        end
      end)
      i.teardown(function()
        x += 1
        a()
        Q:destroy()
      end)
    end)
  end
  return m
end

-- Module aQ
modules.aQ = function()
  local y = modules.load("b")
  local G = modules.load("a")
  local i = {new = function(u, j)
    local w = j.make("ViewportFrame", {Name = "SkinViewport", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Active = true, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(188, 188, 193), LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(245, 244, 241), LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -0.65, -0.85), Parent = u})
    local u = j.make("Camera", {FieldOfView = 34, Parent = w})
    w.CurrentCamera = u
    local j, t, Z, h, A, B
    local d, _, b, x = 0, 0.14, 1, 0
    local function v()
      local H = w.AbsoluteSize
      if j then
        if H.X < 1 then
          return
        elseif H.Y < 1 then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      local l, W, q = CFrame.fromOrientation(_, d, 0), h * 0.5, math.tan(math.rad(u.FieldOfView) / 2)
      local J, D = (q * H.X) / H.Y, 0
      for m = -1, 1, 2 do
        for Y = -1, 1, 2 do
          for O = -1, 1, 2 do
            H = Z
            local Q = H:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(W.X * m, W.Y * Y, W.Z * O))
            Q = l:VectorToObjectSpace(Q)
            D = math.max(D, Q.Z + math.max(math.abs(Q.X) / J, math.abs(Q.Y) / q))
          end
        end
      end
      u.CFrame = l * CFrame.new(0, 0, math.max((D * 1.18) * b, 0.3))
    end
    local function u()
      d, _, b = x, 0.14, 1
      v()
    end
    local function H(l, W)
      if t then
        t:Destroy()
        t = nil
      end
      j = l
      if not (j) then
        A, B = nil, nil
        return false
      end
      l = j
      for q, q in l:GetDescendants() do
        if q:IsA("BaseScript") then
          q:Destroy()
        elseif q:IsA("ModuleScript") then
          q:Destroy()
        elseif q:IsA("Sound") then
          q:Destroy()
        elseif q:IsA("BasePart") then
          q.Anchored = true
          q.CanCollide = false
          q.CanQuery = false
          q.CanTouch = false
          q.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
        end
      end
      if not (j:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)) then
        j:Destroy()
        j = nil
        return false
      end
      local q, J = j:GetBoundingBox(), j
      J:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-q.Position) * j:GetPivot())
      Z, h = j:GetBoundingBox()
      J, l = Z.RightVector, Z.LookVector
      q = (math.abs(J.X) * h.X) + (math.abs(l.X) * h.Z)
      x = ((((math.abs(J.Z) * h.X) + (math.abs(l.Z) * h.Z)) > q) and 1.7507963267948965) or -0.18
      local Z = Instance.new("WorldModel")
      j.Parent = Z
      q = pcall(function()
        Z.Parent = w
      end)
      if not q then
        Z:Destroy()
        j = nil
        return false
      end
      t = Z
      if W then
        v()
      else
        u()
      end
      return true
    end
    w:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(v)
    w.InputBegan:Connect(function(u)
      if j then
        if u.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
          A = u
          B = u.Position
        elseif u.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          A = u
          B = u.Position
        end
      end
    end)
    w.InputChanged:Connect(function(u)
      if j then
        if u.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
          local j, w = math.clamp, b
          b = j(w - (u.Position.Z * 0.09), 0.72, 2)
          v()
        end
      end
    end)
    G.connect(y.input.InputChanged, function(u)
      if A then
        if not (u == A) then
          if A.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if u.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
              return
            end
          else
            return
          end
        end
      else
        return
      end
      local j = u.Position - B
      B = u.Position
      u = d
      d = u - (j.X * 0.008)
      local u, w = math.clamp, _
      _ = u(w - (j.Y * 0.007), -1.2, 1.2)
      v()
    end)
    G.connect(y.input.InputEnded, function(y)
      if y == A then
        A, B = nil, nil
      end
    end)
    return {show = H}
  end}
  return i
end

-- Module aU
modules.aU = function()
  local y, G = modules.load("b"), modules.load("a")
  local i, u = modules.load("e"), y.lp
  local j = y.players
  local w = y.workspace
  local y = i.lib
  local i = string.lower
  local t = math.max
  local Z, h, A = math.floor, {}, false
  local function B(d, _)
    local b = d:GetAttribute("LastKiller") == u.Name
    if b ~= (_:GetAttribute("LastKiller") == u.Name) then
      return b
    end
    return i(d.DisplayName .. ("\000" .. d.Name)) < i(_.DisplayName .. ("\000" .. _.Name))
  end
  local function i()
    local d, _ = {}, t(0, Z(tonumber(u:GetAttribute("Spectators")) or 0))
    if _ == 0 then
      return d
    end
    local t, Z = u:GetAttribute("Team"), w:GetAttribute("ServerGamemode") == "Competitive"
    for w, w in j:GetPlayers() do
      if w ~= u then
        if w.Parent == j then
          if w:GetAttribute("IsSpectating") == true then
            if Z then
              if t then
                if t == "Spectators" then
                  d[#d + 1] = w
                elseif w:GetAttribute("Team") == t then
                  d[#d + 1] = w
                end
              else
                d[#d + 1] = w
              end
            else
              d[#d + 1] = w
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    table.sort(d, B)
    for w = #d, _ + 1, -1 do
      d[w] = nil
    end
    return d
  end
  local function w()
    if A then
      return
    elseif not (G.alive()) then
      return
    end
    A = true
    task.defer(function()
      A = false
      if G.alive() then
        pcall(y.spectators, y, i())
      end
    end)
  end
  local function y(i)
    if i == u then
      return
    elseif h[i] then
      return
    end
    h[i] = i:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsSpectating"):Connect(w)
  end
  for i, i in j:GetPlayers() do
    y(i)
  end
  G.connect(u:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Spectators"), w)
  G.connect(j.PlayerAdded, function(i)
    y(i)
    w()
  end)
  G.connect(j.PlayerRemoving, function(y)
    local i = h[y]
    if i then
      i:Disconnect()
      h[y] = nil
    end
    w()
  end)
  G.teardown(function()
    for y, G in h, nil, nil do
      G:Disconnect()
      h[y] = nil
    end
  end)
  w()
  return true
end

        end

        return Z
      end
    end

  end

                      end
                    end

                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end

      Z(F, j, O, I, m, Y, N, a, U, g)

      J = (H and u) or m
      B.BackgroundColor3 = J
      d.TextColor3 = J
      i.Enabled = (H ~= nil) and (H ~= false)
      h.Enabled = i.Enabled
      J = H and ((Y ~= _) or (O ~= b))
      if J then
        W = ColorSequence.new(Y, O)
        i.Color = W
        h.Color = W
        _, b = Y, O
      end
      Z.Enabled = true
    end
    local i = y.wrap(w, x, function()
      Z.Enabled = false
    end, function()
      t:Destroy()
    end)
    local y, u, w, h
    i.sync = function(A, B)
      if (B.X <= 1) or (B.Y <= 1) then
        i.hide()
        return false
      end
      local d, _, b = A.CFrame, A.FieldOfView, A.FieldOfViewMode
      if ((B ~= y) or (_ ~= u)) or (b ~= w) then
        local x, v = d:VectorToObjectSpace(A:ViewportPointToRay(0, 0).Direction), d:VectorToObjectSpace(A:ViewportPointToRay(B.X, B.Y).Direction)
        x *= -2 / x.Z
        v *= -2 / v.Z
        t.Size = Vector3.new(v.X - x.X, x.Y - v.Y, 0.01)
        h = CFrame.new((x.X + v.X) * 0.5, (x.Y + v.Y) * 0.5, -2.005)
        Z.CanvasSize = B
        y, u, w = B, _, b
      end
      t.CFrame = d * h
      return true
    end
    t.Parent = j
    return i
  end
  return G
end

-- Module aX
modules.aX = function()
  local y, G = modules.load("b"), modules.load("q").world
  local i = y.workspace
  local y, u, j = string.format, {}, {Flashbang = "flash", ["HE Grenade"] = "he"}
  u.new = function(w, t, Z)
    local h, A, B = {}, 0, false
    local function d(_, b, x, v, H)
      if typeof(x) ~= "Vector3" then
        return
      elseif v <= 0 then
        return
      elseif H <= 0 then
        return
      end
      local l = t.flat(x)
      if not (l) then
        return
      end
      x = A + 1
      local W = h[x]
      if W then
      else
        if B then
          return
        end
        local q, J = pcall(w, Z)
        if q then
          if not (J) then
            B = true
            return
          end
        else
          B = true
          return
        end
        h[x] = J
        W = J
      end
      if W.sync then
        if not (W.sync(_, b)) then
          return
        end
      end
      A = x
      v = math.min(v, H)
      W.step(b, l, nil, nil, H - v, H, (Z.txt and y("%.1f", v)) or nil)
    end
    local function y(w, B)
      local _, b = Z.kinds, os.clock()
      if _.smoke or _.molotov then
        for Z, Z in t.zones, nil, nil do
          if _[((Z.kind == "smoke") and "smoke") or "molotov"] then
            if Z.span then
              if Z.expires ~= math.huge then
                d(w, B, Z.center, Z.expires - b, Z.span)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if _.flash or _.he then
        b = i:GetServerTimeNow()
        for Z, x in t.shots, nil, nil do
          Z = j[x.weapon]
          local j = ((Z and _[Z]) and (type(x.physics) == "table")) and tonumber(x.physics.FuseTime)
          if j then
            if j > 0 then
              if type(x.starttime) == "number" then
                d(w, B, t.pos(x), (x.starttime + j) - b, j)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local function j()
      A = 0
      local w = G.ntimer and i.CurrentCamera
      local G = w and w.ViewportSize
      if G then
        if G.X > 1 then
          if G.Y > 1 then
            pcall(y, w, G)
          end
        end
      end
      G = A + 1
      for y = G, #h, 1 do
        h[y].hide()
      end
    end
    return {step = j, drop = function()
      for y, y in h, nil, nil do
        pcall(y.drop)
      end
      table.clear(h)
    end}
  end
  return u
end

  if type(p.platform) == "function" then
    local L, k = pcall(p.platform)
    if L then
      if type(k) == "table" then
        if #k > 0 then
          M = (#k == 1) and (k[1] == "Mobile")
        else
        end
      else
      end
    else
    end
    T = M
  else
    T = M
  end
  G()
  local function p(M)
    if T then
      return modules.load("aW").new(o.workspace, M)
    end
    if Drawing then
      if type(Drawing.new) == "function" then
        return modules.load("aV").new(Drawing.new, M)
      end
    end
  end
  if type(v.flat) == "function" then
    U = modules.load("aX").new(p, v, R.ntimer_opt)
    y.teardown(U.drop)
  else
  end
  if c then
    if type(c.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement) == "function" then
      local M, T = pcall(p, R.ammo_opt)
      G()

            p.hide()

    else

  end
